You just spent  25 bucks and now have an authentic Surf Comber experience.

Came to the surfcomber hotel for my 30th birthday and it was just what I needed. Great location and fun amenities. The rooms are small but it was good enough for my friends and I. I loved the beach staff. PJ was super sweet, friendly, and helpful. The beach staff, LaRonn, Malckhi, and Eddy were hard workers and also very sweet. The waiter in The Social Club, Alex, was so sweet and went above and beyond! I recommend the Surfcomber for a nice low key environment.

Check in easy. Rooms are small. Helpful staff all around. Look for Kurt for pool chairs. Look for James for drinks. Street outside very busy. Lots of people walking. Lots of stores and restaurants close.

So, first - this is a great location. It is “on the beach”, but you aren’t actually next to the ocean. There is a large public walkway and lost of trees/brush between the hotel bar and the actual beach. There is a pool, but it closes at dusk. The lobby is nice, the bar is good too. The rooms are very very small. Plus, ours was next to an alley or something and you could hear workers out there - no sound proofing at all.

With the everything going on in the world, I wanted to have a nice getaway but a fun one. You know you only turn 40 once. So I selected this place and I don’t regret it. This was perfect getaway for me. I was able to get to the beach, enjoy a hell of a great massage, and bottomless mimosa all in one area. The staff was super attentive. And they have bellhop, who’s names escapes me, was super phenomenal! Let them know you are celebrating your birthday for a little surprise. Not to mention this hotel is the perfect location if you don’t want to be directly on the beach but don’t want to be a far walk from it either.   Love this hotel will be definitely booking again!

Claudia was incredible she knew and felt exactly what my wife and I needed after a redeye flight. I have taken a lot of yoga classes, but she was top tier ! Thank you Claudia you really helped us channel our chi for our day and trip! We’ll be back tomorrow !!!

Was worried sick trying to find a rental vehicle while planning my trip, couldn’t find one reasonably, and luckily I ended up never needing one as everything was in walking distance.   Front desk staff was nice and welcoming. Thanks to the bellman Louis for his help as well. Rooms were nice, but small - I did read that pre-book however so no complaints.   Pool and bar team were fun and quick to help. Asked many times to make sure we were okay. Our servers Tina and Chris provided great service for food and drinks at the pool. Pool employee Kurt was super fun to chat with and gave us a list of some awesome restaurants nearby.   Will definitely be back. Thanks for the hospitality folks.

Pros: The hotel grounds were very well kept and quite lovely. Service was very good as everyone was friendly and attentive.   Cons:  The music by the pool was obnoxiously loud and lacked variation.  The hotel rooms were small.  When they "cleaned" our room for our one-time scheduled cleaning is was not truly cleaned at all.  Everything is VERY expensive and you are nickled and dimed for everything.   Overall, our trip was decent. We chose to come to Miami to avoid the  COVID testing required for reentry to the U.S. as we normally do beach vacations internationally in the Caribbean. All-inclusive  properties are worth their value for the money and thus we will be taking our business there in the future.

Well only one of the two windows below has a view of the pool. The other looks at air conditioners. The room was never cleaned. Fresh towels weren’t supplied. The resort fee covers a chair at the beach. You will be nickel and dimed. Most upsetting, the staff violated posted COVID policy pushing into the very small elevator with me. Honestly, I doubt I will ever stay in a Kimpton again after this experience.

Had a great water class with Carla at the surfcomber hotel in Miami Beach, she was great fun and good work out while staying cool in the pool. Wish she was here every day for my stay. Hope to work out with you again… i will highly recommend you for a daily class to the hotel. Caio for now😁

Absolutely a wonderful class.  I’ve never done water Zumba before.  The instructor is very good, and just adorable.  I wish they had water Zumba every day at the Surfcomber during my stay.  Twice a week is not enough.

From the valet, to the gentleman responsible for taking care of our bags, the front desk personnel, restaurant staff, pool / entertainment workers, and especially the guys out back (Eddy, Carlos, Alejandro) me and my mother were taken care of in the exact manner in which we would want to be on a quick weekend getaway. Everyone was chill, transparent, polite, and helpful. The facility was very clean and the restaurant in the Hotel was bomb (brunch). Our flight on out was at 9:00 PM, the day of our check out, and they even agreed to hold our bags so we could have another full day at the beach and pool! Highly recommended. 10/10.  Thank you, Surfcomber!

Amazing location. We went for a long weekend and had a great experience.  The hotel has an amazing location, room was lovely (clean and comfortable)  No housekeeping daily service but they offer towels and amenities by request.( very fast. We didnt have to wait)  Also comp coffee in the restaurant. We used the bike which was a great way to discover miami.  Staff is Fantastic. A big thank you to Karl and Ivanna for making our stay comfortable... Everyone was friendly and ready to help.  We will be back.

Had such an amazing time at the Surfcomber! We are beach people and spent everyday on the sand right in front of the hotel. The Surfcomber has a dedicated section of the beach and you get free chairs and beach towels included with your room. We sprung for a daybed on our longer beach days and didn’t regret it for a second.   PJ, who runs the beach club, along with his team, Paul, Alejandro, Carlos and others, are amazingly friendly and helpful. The Surfcomber is lucky to have them!  And if you want food and drinks, High Tide serves right to your chair on the beach. Allen’s service was amazing and you should look out for him while you are here.

Stayed at the Kimpton for a girls trip and we had a great time! We came during the week, which was definitely a more relaxed vibe than the weekends in Miami.   The hotel staff here are SO friendly and accommodating for everything that you ask for. Pool staff members were also very attentive and came around frequently taking orders.   The pool area itself is beautiful and we never had trouble getting chairs for the three of us.   The best part of our stay was most likely the amazing food that they had at the hotel! You need to try one of their salads from High Tide. They were delicious.   This hotel is also in the perfect location for traveling throughout the Miami area.   Would definitely come back!

Not what I was expecting. Now I know why there are no photos of the bathrooms on the website. A large person will not be able to stay here. Found some stains on the bedding and towels. Also, maybe learn your audience before choosing the music and volume at the pool on a weekday morning. The plus is the Staff has been friendly. Last, not the hotels fault, do yourself a favor and read the recent Miami Beach reviews before coming here. Car racing was right outside the hotel door. Someone is going to get hurt.

FD, F&B plus HSPK teams all did an fantastic job with service and keeping up with the IHG clean promise to the guests to ensure everything is sanitized. My second time to the property and my third time will be soon again!

We're Miami Beach locals and are out of our home for 2 days. I arrived ahead of my husband yesterday and was crazed. Staff - valets,  bellman, front desk - were and are  exceptional. Lunch, breakfast, beach - along with their staff - are making this a more than just pleasant stay. We're going home tomorrow and will definitely recommend  the Surfcomber to future out of town visitors.

I stayed at the Surfcomer and had a great yoga class with Meea. We ended up having a solo session. Meea was very professional and her class was amazing! I would suggest everyone to take it at the hotel.

The Surfcomber offers what the world has come to expect from a Kimpton hotel—youthful vibe, hip style, moderate price point.  Rooms are cramped; perhaps a historic hotel can go only so far in making changes.  But despite stylish design, our room was shabby.  The blinds were busted, the mirror hung unevenly (Room 365).  Even bed linens were worn.  Come on people, you can do better than that. Restaurant food was excellent, albeit extremely expensive.  Note that service charge is included.  Grounds are lovely and that pool felt good.

We had an amazing trip with the best service from the beach team: PJ, Eddy, Rob & Paul! I would highly recommend this hotel for a weekend away. Beautiful location but the service is exceptional when it matters!

The walls at the hotel were very thin and you could easily hear loud neighbors but the front desk was very responsive to noise complaints. Restaurant, pool, and beach were all great. Lequavis, PJ, and Eddy were all very friendly and helpful getting chairs or umbrellas set up every day! Overall pleasant and would come back!

We enjoyed our 5 nights at the Surfcomber.  From the front desk to the beach all employees encountered were friendly and helpful.  Room assigned, although small, fit our needs and appeared to have been recently updated.  We spent the majority of our time on the beach where we rented additional chair + umbrella each day.  Beach food and beverage servers were attentive and friendly and we enjoyed our  lunch time selections which included shrimp tacos and mahi sandwiches.  Pool was a nice way to end the day.   This hotel gets high marks for cleanliness and would highly recommend it especially during covid.

This has been an unforgettable week being here with our Surfcomber beach friends. At the beach we have greatly enjoyed rekindling our friendship with PJ and Markel. It has been fantastic getting to know Tina, Fernando, Lequavis, and the Eddie’s. Thank you guys for such a wonderful vacation and we can’t wait to hang with you for another couple days. Your attentiveness to detail and friendliness are what keep us coming back to the Surfcomber!

Laquavis, Eddy and P.J. were attentive when it mattered most. Unbelievably responsive, polite, and clearly put guests first. They had the chairs and umbrella set quickly and checked in several times throughout the day. Will be back because of them.

My wife and I stayed for a week in February. Loved the location, beach, wine hour, and our room was decent. The only complaints we had were, inconsistent towel service at the beach, confusion on when our room would be cleaned, and some parts of the resort were a little messy at times. When we brought these thing to  the attention of the front office supervisor, Michelle, she was quick to assist and even sent up a bottle of wine to ease our concerns. I would recommend this hotel to others.

The professionalism and positive energy at the beach front service is worth making this your frequent spot! Among the other skilled staff, PJ & LeQuarius stand out as very accommodating. We reserved lounge chairs & umbrellas, and later orders beverages. Accessibility was easy and approachable. With a patient personality, the service is calming yet enthusiastic.

This stay has been quite disappointing. I’m a platinum member and I stay at Kimptons all the time. This place shouldn’t bother calling itself a Kimpton. I didn’t receive any of my promised perks. Asked for a newspaper and after asking for my room number they told me they don’t have newspapers available. The room is extremely small. No housekeeping. Extra “resort fee” but no chairs or towels available at the pool or the beach. Arrived 2 minutes late for wine hour and front desk (who serves the wine) told me: sorry it just ended. It would have taken him two seconds to pour a glass of wine. The staff pretend to be nice but provide ZERO customer service.

We had other plans for the holiday before COVID19 hit, but we made a last minute pivot and decided to go to Miami just to get away from the cold. Our travel agent found us the Kimpton Surfcomber and we are extremely lucky to have spent our Christmas there — 2 rooms for our family of 4. The staff was amazing and extremely accommodating. The location is ideal. We were a few minutes walk from great restaurants, shopping and water activities. And the beds slept better than my own at home! Special shout-out to David (valet), Dale (server at the pool), Claudette (pool attendant), and Ivanna/Michelle/Karl (hotel concierge) who made our trip wonderfully memorable. We would definitely stay again.

It’s got it all - complimentary morning coffees, sweet pool, beach access, complimentary towels and beach chairs, literally they serve you from the ocean, they have complimentary bikes you can peruse around the city / board walk. Primo location 👌🏽. They have dance / yoga classes and other fun complimentary group events.   Markel and Karina served us all the way from the hotel to our beach chairs by the ocean.   And, it’s inexpensive. So, two carveouts:  the actual room of the hotel could be slightly more modern and there is only valet parking but we found a garage two blocks away for $20/ night.

We were coming back from Key West and wanted one day/night in Miami.  Based on location and four star rating we booked Kimpton.   Upside, the grounds and pool outside were fantastic.   The cabanas were nice and direct access to the beach.  Wonderful location.  Now the downside.  The rooms are very small for four people and are in desperate need of being updated.   The rooms are old, windows and shutters were dirty and lamp shades were stained.  Our first room the need was broken and we had to be moved.  Next room the keys would not work and had to go back down for another set.   Front desk was friendly and accommodating.   Expensive to pay $47 valet parking and a resort fee when there is a curfew of 10:00 pm.     Hotel was nice but far from a four star hotel

The hotel need renovation I didn't like my room but the stuff is amazing. Also the managment is very nice and polite. I also was very happy with the waiter in the restaurant the served our breakfast on Wednesday morning I didn't asked for his name but he was very nice and friendly. If I ever return to the hotel it will be because of the amazing stuff. Thanks Walter and everyone else.

I wish I remember her name, but I don’t. It was Saturday morning!

Stayed at Surfcomber as a member of IHG but was very disappointed with the amenities at this hotel. It was much larger than expected and certainly not a boutique hotel as described in previous reviews.  The hotel itself was rather tired in appearance and the carpets in the hallway smelled of “shake and vac”. Our actual room itself was fine but we had to chase the staff several times before it came available for us.  I admit it may have been half term but the pool area was really crowded and sunbeds all booked early in the day.  I would not return to the Surcomber in the future as it did not offer any value for the cost of the room

The pool Supervisor, Taylor, was excellent made sure everyone got their seats timely and had towels when they needed while watching out for people’s safety especially the children. I trusted her with my items and she kept everything safe.

The property was very clean, from the pool, rest rooms and all the grounds.  Beautiful pool with both sun and shade, an area with grass and games, and a great outdoor bar for both lunch and drinks.  Easy walk to the beach for chairs.  All the staff were friendly and helpful and went out of their way to make sure our trip was enjoyable.  Great activities, happy hours, and bike riding.

While there on our anniversary last October they had a function where the locals came in to the pool. I got pushed and broke my leg and have been down for 5 months. management decided to treat me like a criminal and  trash because I was of color. Stay away.

This hotel is apart of the Art Deco District and the building has all their original artitecture. Which is really cool. There is a resort fee included in your rate which covers complimentary coffee, tea and wine. Also when you arrive on the beach there are chairs, umbrellas, towels and sunscreen provided for you!   All staff at the property were very helpful especially Ivanna @ FD and German the bell man. The pool staff and bartenders were very friendly and easy to have conversations with.   This was my first time ever staying at a Kimpton property and I was really impressed. Hands down the best thing about the hotel is  walking through their breathe taking backyard to the pool and then to the beach.  I will be back soon!

My family and I stayed at the Kimpton Surfcomber way back in September to celebrate my mother’s 60th birthday. My sister had been in contact with Omar before we arrived to see if they could setup something in the room for the celebration. He was professional, responsive, and definitely came through for us. The staff at the beach,Teodora and Demetrius, were so great! Super friendly, really attentive, just great service. But the greatest part of our stay was Cheryl. She made my family and I feel so comfortable and welcome. She went out of her way to check-in on us every single day. My entire family and I really appreciated the effort that she went through to make sure that my moms 60th birthday was one that she always remembered. So grateful!

I have traveled a lot.  Luis’ treated me when I parked my car, took my bags, stayed with me while I learned my room wasn’t ready, and checked my bags while I waited.  When I was ready, he took my wife and me to our room, gave us a tour, gave us dining and club advice.  Best of all, he took the time to connect with my wife and me.  Great job!

Turn down the noise level. We are staying here a week. I would have loved to give this hotel the five it deserves. However for some reason they think that this older professional crowd would like to have rap music blasted at them all day. We are not college students looking to party we want a relaxing vacation. Turn down the music   I don’t know why the staff keeps blasting it  All that being said this is a lovely hotel. The pool is beautiful with direct access to the beach the staff is lovely. The food is good. The rooms are a little outdated and on the small side but if you don’t mind that and the constant loud music this is a perfect place to stay

The hotel is lovely! I started my morning with a cup of coffee and walked out to the pool area for a yoga class overlooking the beach! Emma, the yoga teacher, taught a simple and fun flow. The energy in the class was high and inviting. It was the perfect way to start the day before venturing out.

Such a great experience at a beautiful hotel close to the beach. The outside of the hotel is very nice! Would recommend taking advantage of the incredible F&B program and the meditation and yoga session. I had fantastic cocktails from the lead bartender Andres Rairan and also enjoyed a relaxing  meditation session with Shely. I’m looking forward to trying a salsa lesson before I leave and trying more delicious food!

First the good.  Position on Miami beach is excellent and pool and environs are good.  Hotel seems very tired.  Room was clean but overall feel was worn and in need of renovation.  Blinds at the windows with no blackout curtain, so very light once sun up.  What was most annoying was a "uilities" charge which does nor show up when one books as part of the price.  I queried this and was told this was for the use of the pool, beach and beach towels.  This is a hotel with a pool and a beach, and which advertises itself as a beach hotel.  It is rather like charging extra for using the bed!  I refused to pay.

Prior to our arrival, Omar, concierge, reached out to us to discuss our preferences for our trip besides the Super Bowl events.  He asked transportation and general interests that we might be interested in.  We rarely have anyone interested in our visit prior to our arrival.  This set our expectations pretty high.  We arrived on Thursday and have enjoyed every moment of our stay.  Omar, Genesis and Luis were the perfect associates to make for a wonderful, comprehensive stay.  Thanks to all but especially Omar and his crew.

I was hesitant to do it as I never have but feel better now after and recommend you definitely meet Emma and take her yoga class.  You’ll be glad you did!  Thanks Emma!

Shout out to Luis the bell hop who took care of our entire party all weekend!! There was a group of 12 girls staying there, which means we had a lot of stuff and he was so nice and helpful!! He was the best make sure you ask for him!! The property was also so perfect for our Miami getaway!! You can seamlessly walk from the restaurant in the lobby to the pool to the beach so it was perfect for our large group because everyone was able to do what they wanted!! Also we were able to walk to many other bars, restaurants and shopping in the area! 100% will be back!

This was a really dope experience. She made this a real easy time for a newbie. First time I've done yoga and felt like I actually accomplished something. Great instructor definitely check it out if you're in town.

This review is about the whole experience in this hotel, it’s located in the Heart of Miami Beach whit easy access to the beach . The bar at the back of the hotel is fantastic, Angel and Mike made our experience  unique , they were super attentive and give us tips about the city . Happy hr is great with full of diferentes flavors like fish tacos, wings, and ofcurse anchorita margarita hello Latin America and hello Miami indeed ...

A great location for seeing shows at the Fillmore, walk to many area attractions. The lobby, restaurants, pools and gardens are lovely. The rooms are tiny but the bed was very comfortable. The hotel worked to resolve issues we had with excellent service. I am dropping a star because there is an unfortunate lack of sound proofing. We could hear every word of our neighbors conversation. When they played loud music at 1 am, we had to call over ten times to complain. The hotel is on the quieter side atmosphere wise but keep in mind you are stuck hearing the thump, thump thump coming from SLS next door.

I stayed at the Surfcomber for one night before departing on a cruise from Miami. The list is longer but here’s a few: we had adjoining rooms and one had Badly been smoked in, toilet handled didn’t work, windows don’t open, shower handle broken just spins, light in bathroom didn’t always work, smallest elevator ever, smallest gym ever, the fruited water ran out 2:00 and they just didn’t refill it. We will def stay at this hotel again on our next stay and they absolutely provide 5 star standards and was worth every penny we paid . Thank you

Spent one night (and planned on returning a week later) in this nice enough looking (from the outside) hotel with a lovely pool area in an ocean front location.  Those are the good points about this hotel.  However, place is not clean - the walls have dents/are dirty, the windows seem like something from a cheap college dorm, and the rooms did not give any feel of luxury.  Also, we were downgraded from the room that we paid for.  We were offered free breakfast, but we did not want to eat in the hotel.  The lobby was not nearly as nice as the other hotels in the area that charge less.  We cancelled our reservation for the following week and glad we did.  I gave the hotel 3 stars, but my experience was more like a 2 star.

(Confidante and Gates (Hilton) being the other 2).  The Customer Service is above and beyond here, honestly the best of any IHG hotel i've stayed at. Demitrius, Karina, Teodora, and Markel treated us well and offered great service! The food was great—especially the chili shrimp salad and poke bowl. Great spot and great service. The veggie burger was good too! Thank you!

We were having a girl’s’ birthday weekend in Miami & our servers at the beach, Karina & Teodora, were both so fantastic! Excellent recommendations & service! One of the most pleasant & least pretentious beach hangs we have had in a long time!  The hotel itself is in a great location- walkable to everything you want to do! It is an Art Deco building so expect small rooms & thin walls! But this is a Kimpton, so as always, the service makes up for any shortcomings. Even our person from housekeeping Sandy was phenomenal! Our birthday girl even found her to give hugs when we left :)

Especially loved our server on the beach! She gave us awesome recommendations! Unfortunately forgot her name :(  We had a great time learning salsa with Claudia, and Sandy took amazing care of us and our room. Would absolutely come back here.

We didn’t stay at the Surfcomber but we stopped by for drinks when passing on the beach boardwalk.   Mikey, Tiger, and James were all very friendly. They served our group of six quickly and gave us great drink recommendations!   Be sure to stop by for the great ambiance, great drinks, and great staff!

We had such a great trip! Karina took care of us on the beach and she was absolutely fantastic! She was amazing.  Fantastic service.  We would come back just to see her! Demetrios was also amazing and took great care of us.  They are the best!

I lost count. This may be my 8th straight year staying at the Surfcomber on Collins avenue. The staff, as in previous years, deserve a pat on the back for their professionalism.  It''s nice when you are met with a smile whether it be checking in, checking out at 3am or something as simple as renting a beach bike  The Surfcomber is a well kept establishment. I felt safe throughout my stay.  The rooms are clean with plenty of towels...I realize in past reviews some customers did complain about the lack of towels..  After a day on the beach it's nice to come back to a clean room thanks to their House keeping staff.

After our week long stay at Surfcomber, all I can say is Outstanding!   We were greeted each day at the pool with a bright smile from Taylor, Dean, “ T” and Collette.  Collectively they enhanced our experience and enjoyment of the hotel.  The food at the Social Club was delicious as well as the service.  The food, libations and servers from High Tide poolside bar were timely and outgoing.  Ghulam greeted us upon our arrival with a smile and a helpful hand with our luggage.  Lastly, Michelle at the front desk was efficient, and understanding when handling our room change.  The hotel is located on the beach and a block from Lincoln blvd...... We will definitely be returning to Surfcomber with our two canine companions in the near future.

Surfcomber is my go to for South Beach. Being greeted with smiles and acknowledged by front desk staff. from the time I step foot in the property sets the tone for how the stay will be. It's an outstanding one so far. The staff are really impressive. Lucas, my waiter was amazingly attentive during my breakfast at The Social Club. He was very helpful and knowledgable of the menu choices. Rueben and Tiger are my absolute favourite bar tenders anywhere in Miami. They always make me feel welcomed. I highly recommend Surfcomber for your next visit to Miami.

Excellent location, not to noisy as just outside the center of bar scenes, great facility, wonderful breakfast, super beach accommodation/staff. Efficient car valet service. Boardwalk in back of hotel is perfect for walking, fitness or a morning run. BUT by far what makes this property stands out in the pool of so may others on South Beach is, the STAFF! All employees we met were great, with a big genuine smile, special thanks to Nic (Nicolai) at reception which supported us in any question, solved any issue we could think of.  We usually stay at Intercontinental Chopin Plaza but next time, we will be back here. Sure thing.

I visited Surfcomber beach with my friend from Jersey after few months and again had blessing time thanks to beach staff who took an excellent care of us. Markel and Teodora are real professionals when comes to their job. Teodora recommended us few drinks and they tasted delicious! It’s always nice to come back to place where you feel comfortable and pampered and Surfcomber is definitely one of these places.

A very good hotel regarding ambiance and service. The ‘vibe’ is good. Not to noisy. Pool service is excellent; they set up at the chairs with the provided pool towels. Regarding food and drinks at the pool: nothing special, just okay. Rooms are not big but large enough. Room cleaning service is okay (timing of somewhat irregular which can become annoying when after a day at the beach/pool the room is still not done around 4.15pm and you miss the new towels for showering). Nevertheless, this is absolutely a favorite hotel for us. We will return to this hotel when visiting Miami Beach again.  Pool parties at neighbors (SLS) might be experienced as loud but then again this is South Beach. It is part of SoBe’s charm. If you look for a quiet place, look further.

The hotel itself is not pretentious ( which I find many of it's near neighbors are! ). Apart from the excellent location on south beach, the hotel has a very relaxed feel with exceptionally helpful staff, especiallyt the pool attendants, Taylor, Thene & Claudette, who were always happy to assist and with a smile, even when having to make several towel changes after rain ( also think the most comfortable sunbeds ever ! ). If ever returning to Miami for vacation, we will definitely return to The Surfcomber. Highly recommend

Great location with pool & beach facilities. Food good, with nice bar (inside & out). Also put on a few extras and entertaining for adults & kids. On a rainy day, by the pool, our daughter spent a really fun hour making a halloween necklace with Ananda.  Thank you!

We had an amazing time at the beach thanks to the wonderful staff. Teodora was so attentive, personable and sweet. Markel and Demetrius were amazing with the cabana and towel services. Thank you guys for an amazing long weekend! You made our trip so relaxing and stress free!!!

The beautiful sands and surf of South Beach Kimpton Surfcomber are only half the story of our beach experience. We have been so honored to become friends with Teodora, Geelhyano, Luca, Demetrius and Markel. They have made a great place truly fantastic with their attentive service. We were here in May and it was so great to see Teodora again! Thank you so much guys!!!

Staff was amazing and customer service was top notch!! It’s a must see/visit!! Food and drinks was superb!!!! Ate the food so fast I didn’t have time to take pics..this definitely my to-go beach spot for life!!

I stayed at the Kimpton Surfcomber hotel, and I loved the vibe of the place. Stylish, modern. It had great amenities, as well. But, perhaps what really stood out for me was the fact that the hotel had a daily schedule of activities, including fitness classes in the morning. I took a Mat Pilates class with Sierra. She was knowledgeable and friendly. She combined Yoga and Pilates movements for a workout that targeted all the muscles of my body. I left feeling stronger and energized for the rest of the day. I highly recommend it!!

Stayed for 6 nights . We had issue with the room on the first 2 nights as the room was close to the service doors and lifts and could not sleep . Special thanks to Marc who organised the room move. Also very good and attentive service from the pool and outdoor bar team . Taylor , Daniel and Casey were great and made our stay smooth and enjoyable. Pro’s : great  location , the rooms are in okay condition , good size and fantastic beds . The Service in general is very good  Cons : $ 10 water in the bedrooms are a bit excessive, the furniture needs some touch ups ,

Great location, close to the beach and restaurants. They also have bicycles available for guests.  They provide chairs at the beach but only till a certain time in the afternoon, and we would have liked to have them longer, as the sun was still out. The outdoor bar by the pool closes way too early also. The rooms are tiny and cozy, but the windows have no curtains and can be very bright in the morning.  On Sunday morning, we wanted some coffee outside, and they said that they don’t have any available from the menu(along with other juices) Staff was very nice and friendly, valet does take about 15-20 minutes to bring the car around.

Wonderful stay, great location, Nick at the front desk was amazing and made our stay extra special and memorable...our only regret we could not stay longer... most definitely will be back when back in town!

Jeodora & Markel were so attentive and friendly!! In addition to Elizabeth, Jared & concierge Omar!! Will definitely refer to friends and family. Again it was awesome! We will be back again very very very very soon!  Blue sky’s no rain and conveniently located on the beach!

The bathroom is very small. The pool had mold. The staff was very nice and extremely helpful. The beach & location are perfect. The furniture on the deck should be replaced, black mold. No ocean view. The water in the room was $10- why?? The bikes are very old and dangerous- get new bikes!!  The drink that I ordered had no alcohol, never ordered another one. The food was good, not a huge selection.

I also recommend getting the crispy chicken sandwich it was soo yummy! Definitelly coming again!

Maria is very professional. Tanks for te yoga classes because it take my body. God is for the Surfcomber hotel to have these very useful classes. Maria is very professional and compassionate. It felt amazing doing yoga with Maria looking at the beach. Very positive energy.

The location of the hotel is the best, in the middle of Miami Beach and at a few meters from the beach. The social area is in very good condition, like the swimming pool, the bar, the restaurant and the hotel service on the beach.

An old hotel with tiny rooms with even smaller bathrooms, it’s a one person space. Strong scents everywhere, tons of carpet deodorizer gave me an instant headache.   The lobby is hip yet worn, this is the perfect place for spring break kids who are not well traveled. Generally nice modern touches added to a very old historic footprint. The bedding is nice new and fresh but besides that the furnishings and walls are cracked chipped stained etc. Drab brown curtains for closet doors. This several year old remodel needs a total wall to wall remodel.   The website photos don’t reflect reality, this hotel is not as depicted. Think European size room that smells like someone is trying to cover up spilled beer.

I’ve always been a big fan of the Kimpton and IHG hotels. This hotel was also very good overall. However, I got the worst attitude I’ve ever received from all hotels across 5 continents from Giulissa/Julissa from the concierge. We were told the night prior to give concierge a call and we would be able to get a late check out. When we called in the morning, she not only gave us a nasty attitude, but also tried to talk over our voice multiple times and stopped us from taking. When we asked if this is her regular attitude, she said no - if not, does that mean it’s her being racist??  Such small incident completely ruined our last day and I think this is something that should be trained and improved on no matter how small of a position she holds.

The Surfcomber was great! They took awesome care of us especially Teodora on the beach! Her service was great and she always knew when we needed another drink!  There was a party at the pool that we weren’t interested in attending and she made sure we were taken care of with chairs, umbrellas, and drinks. We’ll definitely be back!

We spent most of our days poolside enjoying the sun and great poolside service. There were also lots of activities including wine hour, yoga and social club. Hotel had good energy and friendly staff. Rooms and beds are on smaller side but we were not in them very often. For two people, a room with two beds worked fine. Would definitely return to this hotel.

Professional front desk, busy, enticing restaurant & bar, casual feel. Water cycling & yoga offered. Relaxing pool... dogs allowed by the pool- not my style although I’m  a dog lover. Staff all polite & helpful. Spacious room- tight bathroom but fine fir a long weekend getaway. Close to Lincoln Road & Ocean Drive. Loved it! Will go back again.  4 stars instead of 5 due to teeny-tiny ants on furniture & invading anything sugary left unwrapped in room.

What can I not say about this hotel?  There is just too much to say.  First of all it is a gorgeous, peaceful and the pictures truly show the real deal.  The staff- Mr. Garza, Tania- Housekeeping, Rachel -the Spa, and the pool staff - James and T- were just amazing.  I felt catered to the entire time.  When you walk in, the clean scent smell is wonderful.  There are lots of free offerings; so please make sure to ask when you check-in.  I will be back.

We had a rough day of business with vehicle troubles and subsequently had to stay another night in Miami. Multiple hotels with poor service trying to accommodate us wasted hours of our day driving around. Then we found Surfcomber and   Nick took wonderful care of us and alleviate all of our worries.   If you are in the south beach are I highly recommend the Surfcomber; their custom service it top notch and if you want the best ask for Nick!   We frequent Miami for business and will be returning to this location for sure!   Thank you Nick!

Dionne was absolutely amazing to us at check in! Our flights were canceled and we had to check into another hotel last minute as ours was booked full.  We walked in tired and exhausted and she did everything in her power to make us feel comfortable and welcome from the moment we walked in. We were so overjoyed we may have shed a tear or two.  Service to me is so important and outranks anything else in the hotel.  The hotel itself is great, has a good chill vibe, great music, and great hotel staff. If you want to stay somewhere with a younger crowd and more energy, this is the place for you.   Will definitely be returning again!

Missing better rooms for 5 star review.  Good: - location - beach access - pool, pool bar service and complementary sun protection cream and fruit water - activities such as wine hour with free wine in PM hrs and coffee in the AM hrs  Bad: - front desk service (forgot the name, something starting with J...) we asked for IHG Ambassador member late check out, she said "we dont do late check outs any more" without even checking the room number - rooms are small and outdated - shower water pressure is bad and hard to adjust cold/hot water

We are loving it here beyond words . We were served by Theodora who was literally at our beck and call bringing us drinks and treating us with the utmost of hospitality . Thank god we’re here for 9 days ! We won’t wanna leave by the end of it . Thank you Theodora and kimpton surfcomber for providing such a beautiful facility with the best beach ever !

She made us run into the beach, we did abs, squads and then a beautiful early morning stretch! Overall! Amazing instructor and great workout! Thank you to the hotel for this complementary class.Great instructor

We stayed for 4 nights at this perfectly located hotel - close to ocean drive and backing onto Miami Beach   The staff were all very friendly and helpful across the location. The free coffee in the morning from the coffee station and wine in the afternoon was a nice perk.  The outside area is the standout of this property with an amazing pool, cabanas, court yard, bar and table games. Out the back of the property the hotel also has loungers and a kiosk on the beach.  The rooms are a little basic and the shower is not very powerful but the soaps supplied are one of my favourites - you won’t spend much time in the room anyway!   We used the hotel bikes one day for a ride down ocean drive and these are free to use for up to 2 hrs

We cannot say enough good things about the Surfcomber South Beach Miami.  The property is absolutely beautiful.  The pool area clean and gives you the feeling of a Grecian garden.  From the friendliness of the front desk staff to the amazing beach services by Teodora and Demetrius our visit here has been spectacular.  We have spent almost an equal amount of time on the beach as we have in our room (you have to sleep sometime) and that is no small part due to Teodora and Demetrius.  Their outgoing friendly demeanor, impeccable service, and always smiling faces make you feel as if they are here to take care of you and only you.  This has been one of the most relaxing and wonderful vacations we have had and we home to make it an annual destination in the future.

Sierra was a great instructor! Would take a class again from her.  She led the class well with clear instruction beneficial for all levels of instructor and was energetic and friendly.  Very knowledgeable

My wife and I attended Sierra’s yoga class and she did a great job in getting us to do yoga. She was attentive to where we were at physically. I would highly recommend. For someone who had not done it in a while, it was great.

Our instructor yess  was truly amazing! I’ve done a lot of yoga classes but this one certainly was on the top of the list. A true joy.  The class was a group of three from the hotel and we sat around chatting afterwards about the universal language of yoga which has love and we all walked away learning so much more and earning so much peace

Spent a day on the beach with my Son today. Upon arriving we noticed a girl serving guests and asked her if we could get a couple chairs and some drinks. Her name was Teodora, and she immediately set us up with chairs and had drinks in our hands in no time at all, despite being busy and having other guests to serve. Throughout the day we never wondered where she was and always had everything we needed. I was very impressed with her expertise and attentiveness. Hands down the best service I have received in the 4 years of living in Florida. Thanks Teodora! You are a wonderful asset to the team!

I am staying at this beautiful property with my Mother and today we decided to hit the beach for some fun in the sun. Working in Las Vegas in the service industry, my expectations are always set really high. I visit Miami once a year and am always disappointed with the level of service I receive until I arrived at this property; However the icing on the cake is TEODORA who works on the beach. She has attended to all of our needs and gone above and beyond without us even having to ask. She is personable, charismatic, funny, caring, hardworking, and always there when you need her. I wish all service industry employees were as amazing as Teodora! THANK YOU!

Fantastic place to stay. Very nice and helpful staff. Prime location by the beach. If you decide to enjoy the white sands, ask for Teodora and she will take very good care of you. Highly recommended hotel, location is perfect, rooms are spacious and supplied with anything you will need for your comfort.

Loved loved loved this hotel! This hotel had such a great vibe. First I must thank the front desk for accommodating all our needs while we were staying in the resort, and they would greet us with smiles every time we would pass by. We were welcomed with complementary wine hour which was a surprise :) Housekeeping was great and consistent and food in the restaurant is amazing! By the way, restaurant is open until 3PM for breakfast, so don’t worry, you can sleep in.. Not to mention that location of this place is unbeatable, beach is right behind the pool and Lincoln road and Ocean Drive are walking distance. We will most definitely look for Kimptons in other cities.

Stay in the hotel for 4 nights, the hotel was nice and was spotless clean. Couple of things that I wasn't happy about was on arrival when checking in was told we had to pay a security deposit of €600 as we weren't expecting this it was a shock don't have a problem paying a deposit but thought 600 was a bit steep. Didn't like the pillows as they were feathered pillows and were way to soft. Just small things overall was a nice hotel. It was our 30th anniversary and we were left a bottle of champagne in our room which was very nice so thank you to liz and all at front desk it was appreciated.

We are staying at Kimpton Surfcomer hotel. We made our way to the beach today to enjoy the beautiful weather. We were greeted by ‘Demetrius’ who showed us great hospitality. He took care of all of our needs (complimentary chairs, umbrella) and was very personable. Great service. Our drink waitress was Teodora. She made her rounds quickly and efficiently, and went above and beyond to make sure that out drinks were wonderful. The beach service here is exceptional. No complaints. Great staff.

Me and my friends were at Surfcomber beach . We spent there couple days . If you need a spot to rest and excellent service I highly recommend this place .Theodora, our server took care of us . She suggested different cocktails and their famous burger. Demetrius and Jonson took care of our chairs and umbrellas. I will be back definitely!!

Demetrius,Teodora, and Jhonson are 5 star ⭐️ hosts. I come here every year and really enjoy the great service from all the staff, they make feel at home. The drinks and food are delicious. Thank you guys for making my stay so good.

Absolutely amazing service from Teodora. Every time I needed something, she was there ready to help.  Super service!  I can’t wait to return to enjoy this again. Hopefully better weather...but the service was great despite the rain.

Great hotel. Wonderful service. Beach service (Theodora) is exceptionally helpful and nice.  Breakfast and overall food is excellent and tasty. Especially home made doughnuts !!!  Pool is always packed but beach is awesome and more quiet.   Will definitely come back.

I had a marvelous vacation here, particularly because of the staff. I came down to South Beach to celebrate getting my graduate degree with my boyfriend. From the start, the staff was so kind and thoughtful. Dionne, who works at the front desk offered her congratulations and consistently checked in with my boyfriend and I to ensure that we were having a great stay. I appreciate how attentive she was! In addition, the concierge and cleaning staff were very pleasant and always willing to assist. The property is well-maintained and nicely decorated. The location is close to the beach, bus stops, and great restaurants. I've been to South Beach before, but I would highly recommend this hotel above others. I look forward to to staying here again!

Fantastic location, cool building and vibe, lovely pool, great atmosphere.   Whilst our standard room was a little small, we were only in it sleep since we spent our time at the pool and the beach and walking around Miami Beach.   Free sun cream is provided and also sun beds and towels at the beach and pool. The hotel also provides free tea and coffee in the morning, ice tea/lemonade during the day and wine in the afternoon.   It’s easy to walk to the Lincoln Mall for food and shopping and also Collins Avenue and nearby Ocean Drive are great for the Art Deco buildings.   Highly recommended.

I visited the beach at Surfcomber this weekend and I was surprised by the service provided at this lovely spot. The girls, Teodora and Callie, were really helpful getting us drinks, as well as Markel getting us chairs and umbrellas, they all made us feel welcome and we had a lot of fun here. I am definitely coming back!

My partner and I were staying in the hotel and spent the day on the beach. We got chairs, umbrella, food and drink. Teodora and Callie were super friendly and took great care of us, as did Demetrius. Although prices can be a little steep, it’s a well worth cost! You can order directly with the team or via an app - since the app has a “convenience” fee I would recommend ordering with the staff over the app anytime :-)

When I first stepped into the hotel, I felt ignored. The 2 young ladies seemingly passed me off to (Who I later learned was Jercy), who attempted to assist me.  She couldn't find my reservation. Instead of leaving it at that, she went above and beyond trying to find it (All the while thanking me for my patience). I appreciated that since the other 2 couldn't be bothered.  She eventually enlisted the help of her Assistant Manager Nick, who with further digging, found my reservation.  For the delay and inconvenience, even upgraded me to this NICE suite with no additional charge. Completely changing my initial impression of the property.  I'd like to personally thank Nick and Jercy for all your help and now I'm going to go enjoy the reason I'm here.

Stay was great! Hotel was beautiful and clean. The restaurant downstairs was delicious. Pool was nice and spacious! Staff was friendly. Great location. Sandy was super accommodating and sweet! She was great!

Our stay was very pleasant last couple of days. Our room was clean every day. Thanks to Sandy our cleaning lady. She was also kind in her communication when we saw her in the morning. A really nice hotel!

The hotel was great! The check in was fast the room was clean and the bed was comfortable.  The bathroom was a little small but the staff at the pool was great and the wine hour was a nice touch Looking forward to returning.  The only thing is the beach bar closes way too early.  Enjoy

They spoiled us with 4-hour early check-in to all-day infused water (2 types each day), unlimited excellent morning coffee, wine hour with tasty complimentary hors d'ouvres and availability of 2 beach cruiser bikes each morning! On top of it all we experienced first-class housekeeping, nightly turn-down service, super-comfy beds, upscale toiletries and last but not least a bottle of wine with chocolate torte and raspberries delivered for birthday celebration!! Jerzy (sp?) at front desk had noted it on the ID when checking us in! Staff members  throughout genuinely warm and a pleasure to interact with!! Thanks, Surfcomber!!!

Had a 12 hour layover after my cruise & coming to Kimpton was the perfect place for my kids and I. My older kids couldn't keep up with the morning Florida sun & needed some rest. The front desk staff was very helpful getting us access to the room before check-in. My 8 yr old son oved the pool area, I think it was the frozen drinks from High Tide & yummy burger 😁. I've never come to the Surfcomber with my children, & I was pleasantly surprised with the kid activities that they had on the daily calendar.  I'm a repeat customer to this establishment & what keeps me coming back is the SUPERIOR customer service recieved from the ENTIRE staff. I strongly believe this sets KIMPTON apart from other chains. I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE coming home.

This is my second time visiting the ‘SurfComber’ beach and it has been just as fun as the first! The staff is so nice, and super funny. Really engaging and attentive with out being overwhelming. Although the prices are a touch high ( I’m not staying at the hotel, chair and umbrella 39$) I believe the chair in built into you let hotel stay. Regardless the staff and beach really paid for it!  Thank you Teodora, so nice to have met you! And to the gentlemen Demetrius, Marvel and I believe Houson!?? Yay! Vacation! 💕💕💕

...for making our visit the very best.  You accommodated us in many special ways with your smiles and kindnesses.  Our room, the bikes, afternoon manager's party, morning coffee, and reaching out to make our stay the BEST when the pool was being serviced.  It's folks like you that cause us to choose the Kimpton Surfcomber over any hotel in South Beach.  Gratitude from us to you🙋

Jerzy (sp?) at front desk had noted it on the ID when checking us in! Staff members  throughout genuinely warm and a pleasure to interact with!! Thanks, Surfcomber!!!

Had a 12 hour layover after my cruise & coming to Kimpton was the perfect place for my kids and I. My older kids couldn't keep up with the morning Florida sun & needed some rest. The front desk staff was very helpful getting us access to the room before check-in. My 8 yr old son oved the pool area, I think it was the frozen drinks from High Tide & yummy burger 😁. I've never come to the Surfcomber with my children, & I was pleasantly surprised with the kid activities that they had on the daily calendar.  I'm a repeat customer to this establishment & what keeps me coming back is the SUPERIOR customer service recieved from the ENTIRE staff. I strongly believe this sets KIMPTON apart from other chains. I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE coming home.

This is my second time visiting the ‘SurfComber’ beach and it has been just as fun as the first! The staff is so nice, and super funny. Really engaging and attentive with out being overwhelming. Although the prices are a touch high ( I’m not staying at the hotel, chair and umbrella 39$) I believe the chair in built into you let hotel stay. Regardless the staff and beach really paid for it!  Thank you Teodora, so nice to have met you! And to the gentlemen Demetrius, Marvel and I believe Houson!?? Yay! Vacation! 💕💕💕

...for making our visit the very best.  You accommodated us in many special ways with your smiles and kindnesses.  Our room, the bikes, afternoon manager's party, morning coffee, and reaching out to make our stay the BEST when the pool was being serviced.  It's folks like you that cause us to choose the Kimpton Surfcomber over any hotel in South Beach.  Gratitude from us to you🙋

Teodora and Demetrius from the beach service were simply great! Attentive, helpful and smiling. I wish every hotel had employees like them! Hope to see you guys again! We just spent one day and already missed them!

Stood here 3 nights for a friends bachelor party. Hotel is situated right on the beach and is just a short Uber ride away from all the great spots. The hotel has beach chairs and umbrellas for guest to use. My party really enjoyed the social hour in the lobby daily. Jared was super friendly as was everyone else in the hotel. Would definitely come back on my next visit to Miami.

Stopped in Miami beach for 1 night and had a nice stay at the Surfcomber.  The location is execellent, with direct beach access through the pool area and just a short walk to a bevy of restaurants and bars.  The room and bathroom weren't huge, but we had a comfortable king bed and customary amenities.  The wi-fi also worked well in the room.  Service was very friendly and accommodating.  I would consider staying at the Surcomber again the next time I'm in South Beach..

I know relaxing and South Beach don’t go together. We arrived July 2nd and went to pool. Between the pulsating music and the guys riveting to set up the stage for 4th of July party it was far from relaxing. So the next morning we headed to the beach. We were greeted warmly by Dora, Brett and Manuel. Wow what a difference. The beach was wonderful. We had very attentive service by Dora. She made our trip. Last night I was thinking of changing Hotels but  after today I know we have an oasis to come to.

Very Art Deco, located in the heart of Sobe in front of the beach, this is a landmark : plenty of history, lots of amenities. Large pool, jacuzzi, direct access to the ocean, beach service, pool service and outdoor  games (ping ping, chess...etc.... ) for the youngest. Hammock are ready to welcome you for a nap. The cabanas are available in different seize, to fit your party.   We loved it; clean, upgraded, staff very attentive, atmosphere very friendly, kids friendly, pets friendly, pricing  is reasonable.   Only downside, the food, basic, do not go for elaborate plates , you will be disappointed , stay basic and it is good . Once you know this , you know what to order and get the best out of it.  We will come back !

I took my family to the beach and our day did not start very well because of rain and kids were sad and etc. Once we stepped on the beach the whole team and level of customer service changed our day. Big Thank you to the people on the beach! Joshua, Jhonson, Demetrius and ofcourse Katerina and Teodora! You made my vacation amazing! We will be back!

We went a little left field this year with our base for an annual conference in US.  It was a pleasant hotel with good access to restaurants and night life. My room was airy enough, comfortable and clean.  The pool area was good, not too crowded and with the access to the beach was an added benefit. Other colleagues stayed in a much smarter and more expensive hotel up the drag, but the pool was heaving, and not very pleasant  Free wine and a wicked punch were available every night, and were of a good standard.  Gym was a bit small, but air con brilliant

Not your typical Miami hotel, which is good. Rooms where large, great in house facilities including a good size pool. Backs right into the beach and close to all the action. Food is good as well. Very close to the convention centre as well.

Marc Reid was exceptionally accommodating to myself and my guests.  I absolutely loved the level of customer service provide by Marc and the rest of the staff. We had breakfast and dinner at the hotel due to the rain, but wet not disappointed by the everything bagel and lobster mac n cheese. Thank you! We shall return!

First a shout to everyone at the Surfcomber. Unbelievable service and experience. Specific shout out to: James at the High Tide for creating a crazy Frozen Rose.  Dale for never leaving an empty beer glass empty for long.  Dimitrius and Theadora for commanding the beach.  Rene’s early morning workout session that enabled us to drink the Miller High Lifes and Frozen Rose.  And Joey for keeping the pool area shipshape Bravo Zulu to the Kimpton Surfcomber!!!!!!

Thank you again Christophe Family Schindler

Overall my girlfriends and I had an amazing experience during my bachelorette party at the Surfcomber Miami Beach this past weekend. The property - especially the outdoor areas - is beautiful and the amenities are great. We loved the pool area and we had such a great experience with our server/hostess Casey during the day we spent at the Ivy Cabana. She was so sweet and attentive and really went out of her way to make our day. She even set us up with chairs at the beach midway through the day and continued to take our orders and deliver our drinks to us. She also provided great recommendations for drinks and evening entertainment. I would absolutely recommend this property and the cabanas for a great girls trip!

We frequent Miami every year and this is our first time at the Surfcomber. Prime location with a nice lobby and overall vibe. Room was a little cramped but the room was clean and had a very comfortable bed. The washroom included great toiletries. Hotel offered good perks such as a hydration station, free coffee, free happy hour, free beach chairs. The pool was nice and well kept and chairs were readily available. The only downside was the staff. Comparing other hotel staff in South Beach, the Surfcomber staff was sub par. They tend to not be as welcoming or friendly, this includes everyone from the front desk, front door, housekeeping and pool staff.

We had a getaway with friends and while we stayed at the Surfcomber everything was great specially the team at the pool Carolina was so gracious and full of energy giving us a great service and recommendations , she just mades us feel at home , James send us the best margaritas We ever tried and Cano brought us our food on time accompanied by good conversation and attention to details ! Thank you guys for making sure our stay was a time to remember !  The only issue I need to address and didn’t like the attitude of a guy named Luis he was rude but other then that thanks Surfcomber !

So glad he worked during our stay, he knew his stuff and we actually checked out the places he mentioned like Wynwood and Brickell. Thanks Surfcomber and Mike, you guys rock!

Mike and Melvin were awesome! Really augmented our experience. Would love to come here again because Mike really took care of us! He was so nice and helpful. He did a great job at taking care of our food and beverages.

This hotel is in need of some serious updates. It's tired and the rooms are very musty / old. The building itself is an iconic art-deco style building on Collins Ave in South Beach and situated on a perfect beach spot. The staff is also very friendly & helpful. Definitely take advantage of the beach area in the morning / afternoons and go early! Chairs / umbrellas are taken FAST on nice days. The beach staff is also friendly & helpful and the drinks / food that you can order to your spot are pricey but fantastic. Despite these definite pros, I would not return to this resort until they did a serious makeover / renovation of the rooms, as there are so many other great and updated spots on this beautiful piece of Collins Ave.

The reception staff (Marc, Mel etc.) and bellboy Luis were very helpful, and the chambermaids did an excellent job every day.

Might hear “noises” from other guests in their rooms (thin walls). Daily resort fee $38 (fine print).

Great location and comfortable beds (Reliable AC). Friendly staff. Walking distance to restaurants by waterfront (ocean Ave). Included amenities: bike rentals (first come, first serve) coffee or tea in the am, glass of wine for happy hour, small gym, hammocks, pool, 2 beach chairs per room and towels (sun umbrella or canopy extra fee). Room rates priced for higher middle income (no broke college students here). Pool closes after sundown (no crazy parties). Bathroom quite small, but doable. Might hear “noises” from other guests in their rooms (thin walls). Daily resort fee $38 (fine print).

Great hote - on South Beach- no need to cross any streets to go to the beach- access straight from the hotel onto the beach. Great bar and food. Central to shops. Nothing beats staying on Collins ave.

We are a couple of locals who would always stay at the surfcomber before we moved to Miami full time. Now anytime we go to south beach for the day we always come back to the Surfcomber because of the great service. The team here takes great care of their guests. Demetrius, Theodora, & Michael took great care of us today and made our beach day amazing.

Flip cup was such a good time with René! And it went to a good cause to help adopt a dog! Everyone should come visit the surfcomber it is a great hotel with great staff. They have different events everyday.

Rene was awesome in getting us riled up for flip cup! He is an awesome activity director getting a bunch of us together to have a great time. Thanks so much for making our stay at the Surfcomber so memorable. TEAM PAWS!!

I went to Surfcomber for my bachelorette party with 9 of my friends. The hotel's view is amazing.The pool and resort are really nice and gorgeous view facing the ocean. The staff was extremely nice and helpful. But the rooms were really small , not what we expected but it was clean and  it looked better in pictures. I would say the location and the view was worth it and i would definitely  go back again. We had an amazing time. We were really and partied hard and there was no noise compliant , everyone was super chill!!  I do however wish they gave us a late checkout especially when we requested one month before but other than that no complkians.

The Surfcomber has been my daughter’s and my vacation for 4 years.  We keep returning because of the staff, the location and all around feel of being welcome.  I highly recommend this hotel.  It’s great for family, singles, Business, everyone!

Everything was fine, but the incredible amount of seaweed around, and in the ocean.  In the sand, it was about a foot high and eight feet to walk through. Not done yet. There was a lot more of it in the ocean that you could not get around. The pool is nice, but the chairs fill up around 10:30. Free water and lotion at the pool, $6 water at the beach.  The seaweed goes on forever, so it probably at the other Miami Beach hotels also. I would guess that the seaweed cannot be picked up because of some abusive environmental reason. The staff here is very nice. The rooms are very small, but ok for the price. Free bicycles.

The breakfast was OK (toasts, breakfast potatoes, scrambled eggs and coffee), but USD 25.00 ??? Well, for next trade show at the Convention Center, I'm staying somewhere else and taking Uber...

I contacted management and even corporate. This was the worst hotel & way over priced. The service was definitely a 0 star & worst place I’ve ever stayed. I was given a dirty room with wet socks, snot on the door, & drugs on my counter in the room. I never felt scared to stay at a hotel where management threatened me about my terrible stay.

Michael in Markel were awesome!  They set up and took care of everything at the beach the drinks and food service is very fast. If you ever stay at the Surfcomber hotel asked for Michael in Markel. Mike at the pool bar is great too.

This is an ok hotel. Bartender great, most employees enthusiastic, etc. They are working for a tip beyond the 20% already included. I would have been more positive, but there was a private pool party today (which had no guests as far as we could tell) & the hotel chose to treat it's guests as 2nd class citizens because of the "party." We not only couldn't use the pool, we weren't even allowed to walk through pool area, & had to walk through another hotel's lobby. No apology, no explanation. What a waste. There are so many choices in South Beach; I would never pick this again. I am a Kimpton member & fan.

The location is great- in the heart of Miami Beach life. On the beach, nice pool. I have stayed in lots of Kimptons and this has one of the best positions. It’s not as smart as some, and brace yourself- the whole of Miami Beach is expensive, but I got what I wanted- great streetlife and the beach. I would come again.

Luis the bellman provided impeccable service. He went above and beyond to ensure our stay was pleasant. He was kind, and eager to assist with all of our requests. Thank you Luis!!!  Surfcomber location is ideal for everything you want to do on south beach. It is in walking distance to Lincoln Road and the countless shops and restaurants.   The room size is average, but the bathrooms are very small. It is time for a few minor upgrades.  The pool area is good for the hotel size and beach access is very near....  While is not my favorite South Beach hotel, for the price, location and Luis! It is worth checking out.

We had a great stay! The location is awesome, clean rooms, good food and wonderful staff! Toni, Michael and one other team member saved my phone when I left it at the beach under towels... I thought it was gone for sure. Thank you!!

We booked 20 rooms for 3 nights and were well attended to from start to finish.  The sales team was excellent at communicating and accommodating.  Only glitch was a few rooms weren't ready at check in until after 5pm, but they were fully booked the weekend prior.  The conference room, catering and A/V services completely met expectations.  We found the people who were there so helpful, authentic, of service and beyond accommodating.  Yeah Joe and Fouad!

We celebrated my husband’s birthday here and were mostly pleased by the property.  The staff at the High Tide and at the beach were outstanding. Theodora and Michael were quick to make the beach experience awesome.  The food and beverage selections at High Tide and the hotel restaurant were very good. We are three meals in the property. We enjoyed the free wine hour, too.   A few negatives: our room was not ready but an hour early although we asked for an early check in in advance.  But, our suite was big and very nice.  Also the party next door beginning Saturday night lasted until two in the morning. Lastly, the bathrooms are small and have community toiletries-bring your own.

We have 5 girls, so our mental health getaways are very important. We’ve stayed all over Miami Beach, so we ventured out and tried the Kimpton Surfcomber Hotel, and couldn’t be happier. We stayed in a one bedroom suite overlooking Collins Ave. it was a nice sized room. Our shower had a low water pressure, but that would be the extent of our complaints. Some of the furniture is dated but otherwise clean and well appointed. Room service from the Social Club and High Tide Bar & Grill was always fresh and delicious. This hotel is outdated and dirty. Don't let the photos fool you. Basically, it looked as if Kimpton bought a fixer-upper and tried to make the hotel look trendy by putting modern furniture in it - except the furniture is run down and has stains all over.   You can tell it's an old hotel by the old molding, sticky carpet, used furniture, etc. The staff also don't clean (see photo). The lobby had trash all over it.  The walls and windows are paper thin. We heard everything throughout the night.   Great location on the beach, but I would not recommend this overpriced hotel at all if you care about cleanliness.

We were vary happy to stay in Surfcomber. The rooms are comfortable and also they have a beautiful beach with nice crew. Katerina was our server on the beach and she was amazing. The drink orders were delivered quickly as well as food orders. We can definitely recommend this place.

I read great reviews about this hotel. We were very much looking forward to our stay. The location is great, the room is ok but the room has the window looking to a blinding white wall. It’s shocking they offer such a room to their client. It’s so claustrophobic. We are very disappointed.

Absolutely terrible! This "boutique hotel" is more like a roadside motel. The dump hosted a pool party the night we stayed and announced it would be over at 11 pm, which it was.  But from (at least) 3 am - 6:30 am construction crews were outside our room demolishing the stage. The front desk informed us (at 3:30 am) that because Kimpton did not contract with the crew, there was nothing they could do about the noise.  A lot of $$$ wasted on a room that allowed for no sleep, had lacking ocean views, and was not well kept.  I've genuinely enjoyed my experiences at other Kimpton properties but after this experience I will avoid them entirely.

We went for a long weekend trip to escape winter. The rooms are little bit dated and small but everything else about this hotel is amazing from their pool to lobby. Customer service is as impressive as I have seen. Big shoutout to Tracey and DIonee for making our stay amazing!  The pool area is beautifully landscaped and one can just walk to the beach from there. They also provide free bikes in the morning. Highly highly recommended!!!

We stayed here for a night on our way to the islands. The location can't be beat. It was very enjoyable to sit out front and have a drink while watching the "show" pass by on the street. We were also able to walk to one of my favorite restaurants for dinner and even walked to do some shopping.  The rooms are pretty small and the bathroom is very small. Nothing that truly stands out regarding accommodations, good or bad. We arrived too late to enjoy the pool and outside bar due to a flight delay which was a bummer. The grounds looked lovely, lots of beautiful plants.

Came here for a few nights following a business trip in Miami Beach. We both thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. The staff was friendly, courteous, and very helpful. Despite the additional "resort fee" of $39 a night we appreciated the complimentary wine hour with delicious eggplant hummus on grilled french bread, complimentary beach cruiser rentals, delicious morning coffee and assortment of fine teas. Mel is a great host and went above and beyond to make sure we were well situated. I'd prefer the pillows weren't goose filled and instead hypoallergenic but that's a small request.

We had a nice big room on the second floor, with a furnished balcony overlooking the pool and towards the beach. Ideal location for walks along the prom and/or beach and down to Ocean Drive. Also an easy walk to Lincoln Road mall where there are plenty of restaurants. Bathroom was rather compact, but shower was efficient. Adequate storage space and reasonable wifi. Hotel had a nice feel to it. Free drinks at Social Hour is a bonus. Restaurant is adequate, but nothing special. Main gripe was the constant (and frankly awful) music played throughout the day and into the night, which intruded into our room and was quite annoying. Otherwise, a decent hotel - a bit expensive, but I imagine pretty much on a par with similar class hotels on Miami Beach.

The hotel room and bathroom is small (but clean).  There is no way around the fact that it's a tight squeeze when you're in the room and the views aren't good.  However, if it's more about the amenities and location (after all, you're not visiting Miami to see its hotel rooms), then Surfcomber is very good.  It's a got a great pool and excellent access to the beach where you can reserve umbrellas and get towels.  The staff and service are fantastic --- always willing to help.  We also had breakfast at the hotel restaurant and it was excellent --- the kids will love the fresh made donuts and the adults will enjoy the eggs benedict or if you are health conscious, the avocado toast.  Location is also very good with a short walk to Ocean Drive, Espanola Way, and Lincoln Road.

I really enjoyed my stay here.   During the check-in process, the staff made me feel like a VIP.   Very personable and they gave me a nice upgrade.  The hotel is very well decorated, with a fashionable take on mid-century decor.   Beds are very comfortable.  Hotel location is excellent - right in the middle of everything South Beach has to offer.  My only knock on the hotel is that the bathrooms are small - this reflects the hotel's original architecture.

The location can’t be beat - in the heart of south beach and right on the water. Lobby was nice and had a fun notifier hotel atmosphere. Rooms were underwhelming and hallways were dimly lit. All-in-all a decent hotel, but you’re really paying for the location.

Great location, front desk team pleasant and professional - welcoming to say the least.  Pool staff very accommodating.  Restaurant very good.  Be sure to have a beverage a the pool bar where Carolina and Michael will treat you like family. Great location close to Lincoln Road.

The Surfcomber is a sweet boutique-style hotel perfectly situated ocean-side, but near everything SoBe has to offer.  The staff is very attentive and friendly and the rooms are nicely appointed.  What made the 4 night stay so special was the pool-side yoga class offered by ‘Yess’, a very skilled and knowledgeable yoga instructor.  Lying on the grassy area just beyond the pool with the ocean breeze lightly swaying the palms, created an ideal place to practice yoga.  If only the pool staff would have turned down the thumping techno music (at 10am) as requested, it would have been the ultimate tranquil space.

Older vintage hotel modernized and right on the beach, parking is by valet as everything is tight and crowded.  We walked into a wine tasting at 5-6 p.m. every day.  Nice start to the night.  Rooms are smallish, elevator really small but the place has a charm and tons of restaurants near by to walk to.  By now, you have concluded that you do not want to eat here per many bad food reviews.

Food was great, a very creative menu.  If you want a boutique hotel with lots of personality, a staff meeting all your needs, in a beautiful beach, this is a great choice.

Booked a quick one night stay with kids. Nick at check-in did a great job getting us settled. Joey at the pool was very welcoming and dionne and jersey did a great job at checkout. Valet was quick and responsive and the fellow at luggage check helped us out. Very well situated, cozy, all the staff had a smile. Room was small and could use some cosmetic enhancements. Pool was nice clean and HEATED!!! yay and they have complimentary sunblock. Beach service was a bit disappointing totally empty yet they wouldn't give us towels for an extra chair.  All the staff at the hotel smiled and was helpful. I would stay here again...

We had a short stay here but wa very pleased with the customer service and overall cleanliness. Chris, at the front desk, was extremely helpful and greatly improved the enjoyment of our stay. This hotel is very busy with a lot going on so the personal touch from reception was welcomed.

This was booked for me as part of my recent site tour for work around the USA for my visits through Florida as we use IHG hotels globally.   While the location is good and the hotel is stylish there are a few things to note. All rooms come with resort costs that are mandatory and really not cheap, especially if you are on business and not using the hotel's services, just staying.   The room I had was nice and with a good amount of space, and really clean and fresh. The shower room was a little small thou.   Everything comes at a price thou, and more than your usual hotel prices. Start counting the dollars for a bottle of water and beyond.   I wouldn't stay here again, simply it was the right type of hotel and everything is intended to be added on.

Nick at the front desk was AMAZING! I appreciate his help in making my stay comfortable plus efficient. He went above and beyond my expectations. His great attitude and smile helped make my day great.

Loved this hotel! It was right on the beach, and everyone was really helpful and accommodating. Demetrius and Gladis on the beach staff were so friendly! The rooms were clean with plenty of space and a king bed. Daily complimentary coffee and wine were a bonus!

Angel and James are excellent and the food is great! Try the crab tostones, they’re awesomely delicious! Drinks are good too- have James make them for you! I had the ‘spritz on the beach’ made with grey goose and strawberries.
