While you are in the thick of things at this property, it is still is ideal for business travelers as it has a beautiful laid back, lounging pool that does not cater to the same day pool parties as neighboring properties.

Kimpton Surfcomber is located right here on South Beach and one can literally just walk around to a lot of places! So, full points for the location. The rooms are not that spacious particularly if you are three people sharing. Moreover, the rooms do not have electric kettles, either; so you have to go downstairs to the reception in case you need some tea or coffee. We also encountered a clogging issue with our toilet; it was, of course, solved when we reported the same. We had an average experience at Kimpton and would possibly try out another hotel on our next visit.

First Time at the kimpton, staff very welcoming and check in was quick. Front desk made us aware of morning coffee at lobby, happy hour at pool, beach resort, restaurant. We spent most our time on the beach resort,met Christopher who assisted us with our louges and shading. He also introduced us to gladis, she is very kind and brought our eazyO. Both would check up on guest,providing everyone the same service and offering samples of great drink!

This hotel is nestled between high rises.  It's small, trendy, the staff is extremely helpful and friendly. Our room was very clean and nice.  We had a corner on the street side so I think it was bigger. The only negative was that we needed black out shades on the windows.  I thought it was sunrise all hours of the night.  The location was really good.  We had friends staying at the Loews and they liked our bar and cocktails better and we could watch the football game on the two tv's.  We walked everywhere.  Would definitely stay there and recommend it to friends!

Great Hotel, Great service. From check in to beach service. Demetrius, Enzo and Katerina took care of our Every need on the beach. The beach chairs and umbrellas were complimentary with towel service. Top notch service!

How this hotel has any positive reviews is beyond me!  I stayed here with my family over the festive period and it was awful - avoid it like the plague! The rooms were dirty, the pool was broken, the staff were sullen and rude (and made no attempt to hide it) and charging $3 for one banana is a joke!  The only positives for staying here are the location (but there are numerous other hotels with a great location) and we encountered one very polite and courteous bell boy.  All in all, a very unpleasant and expensive stay for a hotel which is nothing better than a 2* motel. Will not be returning!

Working with Marc, Shawnee & Nick at the Surfcomber has been an extreme pleasure. With all the things on my plate their professionalism, ease of manor and Get it Done style was SO APPRECIATED! Great to know people like you still exist in the industry.

Perfect location in the heart of South Beach.  Steps away from the beach. Friendly staff. Only issue I had was how close the rooms were to each other. I could hear every word of my neighbors conversation and he wasn't yelling or anything.   Putting that aside I would consider staying there again because of the location.

Enjoyed another great stay on our fifth visit to the Surfcomber. Centrally located and always our favorite choice in South Beach. This time we especially enjoyed the free yoga class with Yess. She had a great flow and made the class fun for our entire family. Highly recommended. The staff at this hotel is always very accommodating and ensure a high level of service.

We have stayed at this hotel for years each Christmas/New Years.  Unfortunately, the hotel has fallen apart since being acquired by Intercontinental.  Our reservations which were booked directly with the hotel months ago were not honored at the rates were booked at which is unreal.  The bar and restaurant is totally dysfunctional.  In spite of being empty, you still couldn't get a drink.  The rooms need to be redone.  Our sheets and towels were shabby and dirty which required multiple attempts to call housekeeping to change them.  It's really a shame.  The pool and outdoor area is fabulous, and High Tide is a great spot for day time drinks or lunch.  Unfortunately, the bad now outweighs the good.  My family will be relocating next year for sure.

I came for one night and decided to extend and stay for 6 nights. I had such an unexpected, amazing time at the Surfcomber. I don’t want to leave - I so enjoy this resort.  In particular, I wanted to call out the best part of the whole hotel experience - the staff at the beach. I had amazing experiences day after day with the beach staff who really are the best staff at the hotel and the crown jewel of this hotel. I want to thank Thomas, Demetrius, Gladys, Katerina and Christopher!!!

Other than that we had a great visit.

I love Kimpton hotels and this for sure did not disappoint. Our room was great and the decor was very fun. All the mini bar and snack options are fun.   The pool area was nice and well kept. We rented chairs and an umbrella on the beach. Would recommend.

Visting the kimpton  to celebrate my daughters birthday, its a perfect location on south beach. The hotel looks very nice, front desk was very detailed about what the hotel has to offer. We enjoyed the beach the first days of the year, met Christopher on the beach and he was so polite! Every morning he would help arrange our chairs, privide towels, and brought Gladis over to take care of our order. Both help us enjoy our time at the kimpton.

Ok, the rooms are small by US standards but the bathrooms are ridiculously small. This hotel for me just doesn’t feel like a Kimpton at all. The rooms and the interior were disappointing for the brand. That said it was also the least expensive Kimpton I’ve ever stayed in so I suppose one balances the other out.  The outside areas are pleasant as well as the pool and garden and the hotel backs straight onto the beach.

The courtyard view room was of the walkway to the pool and the other part of the hotel.  Don't bother to eat in the restaurant.  Service is horrible, with long waits. Oh, and if you want to sit by the pool on a sofa, bring your appetite, it costs $100.00 in food and drink to use the sofa.

This is a lovely mid-size hotel right on the beach in South Beach. It is a laid-back place, not too crazy or noisy. The staff are very friendly and helpful and really make this place fantastic, including the front desk, restaurant staff and the housekeeping staff. The rooms and facilities are nice - not spectacular, but really fair for the price. Great location to walk to many attractions, you don't need a car. We enjoyed the complimentary wine in the afternoon and coffee in the morning. For what this hotel is, it does a great job.

Awesome vacation! Great hotel! Wendy the day life instructor was terrific and the kids had so much fun with her! Can’t beat this hotel location on the beach with a great pool.  Staff was super responsive and friendly.

I stayed with friends in late December and we all really enjoyed our time at the surfcomber. The pool set up and ambiance was awesome and the service was great. We loved the food at both restaurants, especially the lunch and happy hour menus. Joey and James at the pool were so friendly and took excellent care of us. Location is ideal and I look forward to coming back!

Hung out poolside with friends while visiting for New Year’s Eve weekend.  Hotel is great, pool, beach side access and service.   Joey and James were so friendly and just good people to be around while we were there. Our whole group had a great time while we were there!

Spent a few days around NYE with a couple girl friends at the Surfcomber, excellent service and great hotel! This hotel has a nice pool and beach front access. The pool and restaurant food are absolutely delicious. And we had excellent staff, Joey and James at the pool during our stay. They were extremely accommodating and made our trip even better.   Would definitely recommend this hotel for a nice stay in Miami!

The staff is very kind but the hotel could do a lot more in terms of the facility, for a luxury hotel. Kind of nickeled and dimed.  Quite a few small things add up.  The water at the lobby always seemed to be empty.  The wicker furniture out front are worn out. No service out front to pick up used glassware.  For the class of hotel, the beds are severely lacking. They’re worse than some Holiday Inn beds.  The front drive is beyond ridiculous. There’s no management of the traffic to get through the turn about.  Room not serviced on last day of stay.  Beach chairs are provided but you’re nickeled and dimed to pay for an umbrella.  On the plus side the bartenders at the pool bar were excellent.

I can’t say enough how amazing, professional and attentive Demetrius was during our visit. I arrived at the beach a little earlier and he was able to get me set up and with a smile - he even remembered my name from the day before. We’ve stayed at a lot of resorts and the staff doesn’t match up to the experience Demetrius delivered. Incredibly friendly and even followed up during the day to make sure we were able to place orders for food and our drinks. The app to order at the Surfcomber was very easy and it was great to get delivery on the beach. Great team of servers as well, and would highly recommend this location, largely due to the wonderful beach staff!!!

The Kimpton hotel was very welcoming for the holidays, Christmas Day we took to the beach to enjoy the water. The beach was very well prep and met Christopher who attended us to a perfect spot with a clear view of the ocean. The beach provides service for food and beverages, Chris help us order with gladis. Both very nice and helpful, thanks for everything.

Very poor customer service provided by the front desk and rewards program customer service department. The front desk at the Surfcomber could not find my families' reservation that was booked through their loyalty points program.  They offered little assistance, instead I had to call the rewards programs customer service number from outside, but they did "offer" me the same room for $800.  I got nowhere with the customer service department and drove home (luckily this was a local trip).  It is unfortunate as I have often stayed at other Kimpton locations but this experience is making me rethink my continued loyalty.  I hope this location is just one bad apple and I may continue my families' relationship with this company in the future.

My friends and I came to south Florida for a mini Christmas vacation to experience the Miami lifestyle. We got a great deal on this hotel, the place its so beautiful and extremely friendly. We had a cabana and my friends and i had a great time. Their food was amazing and the service was great too. Carolina was the server and her service was so amazing. She is so sweet. Cheryl came to check on us and the service, there was a complication with the food, however she was so professional and she came and took care of the problem. This made our stay so much more pleasant. Great service and we will come back during spring for another great experience.  See you here!!!

Wonderful stay st the surfcomber! Dionne, Oscar and Mark were attentive and thoughtful throughout the whole stay. Every time we hit a snag, they responded immediately and addressed it. I can’t wait to return next year. One of the best pools and beach sections on South Beach.

Great location, nice room and staff. Yess the yogini was awesome and a sweet guy named Christopher brought us water on the beautiful beach. People at the desk were very nice as well. Loved the 4:00 wine and morning coffee in the lobby.  Two negatives: we would have preferred a smoke free hotel and were disappointed in Social, the restaurant. Drinks took so long that food came first. $35 sangria was not described as per person and not, as we are used to, in a shared pitcher for the table.  Otherwise, fine, funky hotel!

We visited Surfomber in December 2018. During our stay temperature went down to 18-20C. Hotel management did not even think to heat water in the pool. Ocean water was definitely warmer compared to pool. Prior to making reservation, we called hotel and were told pool is heated. This is our 4th stay in Surfcomber, but we never been here during winter months.  All other hotels we been to SOBE in winter months have heated pool, which is very important if you are traveling during winter time.

Had a wonderful stay here,  amazing customer service.  Christopher and Alex on the beach were particularly accommodating and kind! They really went above and beyond.  The food we ordered on the beach was also above par! Great visit!

I have always enjoyed staying at the Kimpton: clean, classy, lovely hotel but this time around the staff was truly phenomenal. Everyone at the front desk was helpful from bandaids for my toes (damn heels!) to the bus schedule. Melehisedk was at the front desk when we checked in and was so positive and helpful, it really started the stay off right. Props to him! I truly enjoyed the coffee in the AM, the comfy beach chairs, the cold, apple infused water, the kind bartenders, the ideal location, the helpful beach/pool staff, and additionally the large bottles of toiletries in our room was nice and they smelled great. Can’t go wrong with this hotel!

We just had our wedding at the surfcomber and I can honestly say that everything exceeded our expectations by 1,000,000! Cannot say enough wonderful things about this hotel. We are already planning a yearly return trip to celebrate our anniversary. Special thanks to Lewis Angie and Joe who made our stay next level! thank you from the bottom of our hearts for making this an unforgettable experience for ourselves our family and friends.

Although our room faced the street we slept so soundly and comfortably.  The location on Collins Ave is just right and access to the beach so convenient.  The food and drinks including the free daily wine tasting was all delicious.  All of the staff was great especially Alayna at the pool restaurant. She was so accommodating, upbeat and a pleasure to talk to. We look forward to coming back as soon as we can!

Food was great and so was the atmosphere! Some of the best fries I’ve ever had! Crispy and not greasy at all. Ordered the Crispy Shrimp Taco which was very tasty but little spicy. Our server James was very helpful. The restaurant is located in the back of Surfcomber hotel. There’s no music but Hyde Beach next door provided some awesome music for our entertainment. Would return if we stayed in SoBe again.

Katerina and Gladys are exceptional and definitely helped us out! Definitely recommend for future visitors, service is great, drinks were good and we were overall happy and had a good time. Must stop in Miami Beach

We really enjoyed our stay at the Kimpton Surfcomber!  Between the awesome pool and the magnificent beach, this hotel truly has something for everyone!! Christopher does a fabulous job setting up the beach each day, making Surfcomber guests the envy of South Beach! The pool staff makes you feel welcome and is extremely attentive- even bringing our kids complimentary ice pops during happy hour!  Leo served us breakfast and was the kindest, most thoughtful server you could hope for.  Management was attentive and thoughtful- they even did something special for my birthday!  I highly recommend the Surfcomber.  We will definitely be back!!!

Cute vision boarding with Wendy by the pool. Lots of creative fun. We are looking forward to more activities with her at the Kimpton pool. It’s nice how they make the hotel kid friendly and fun for us

Me and the family spend eleven days att Kimpton Surfcomber in November. We had a great time with Wendy during the family Thanksgiving craft-session.  We all made wish boards and the kids loved to be creative and meet new friends.  I can warmly recominga to stay here!

My wife and I stayed at the Surfcomber for a couple nights prior to Thanksgiving. Thank you to Wendy for keeping us busy with the Vision Boards located at the pool side weekly. We had a super and fun time! Thanks to all! We will be back! :)

We had a lovely time at the Surfcomber...the pool and beach bar areas are fabulous with cool vibe music and very attentive staff. The rooms and bathrooms could do with an update but as we didn't spend too much time inside it didn't really matter. The free tea and coffee in the morning and free wine late afternoon is a lovely touch...everything is so expensive in South Beach it actually made a difference! We'll be back.

The Kimpton Surfcomber is a wonderful hotel located in South Beach but slightly away from the main crowds. The hotel features a stylish lounge, cool rooms and a wonderful pool close to the beach. It provides easy access to the sights and delights of Miami Beach on foot or by car. From the charming valet parking team, to the lovely front desk staff, the friendly managers who help out in happy hour, and the ever helpful pool guys, these are true professionals: efficient, super-friendly and so lovely - quite a great bunch of people, who deserve to be applauded and commended. I wouldn't stay anywhere else in South Beach and can't wait to return!! Bravo Kimpton and a credit to the brand!

The hotel itself is charming and well-situated, but the best part of stay was the friendly &  laid-back staff. Everyone we interacted with was surprisingly accommodating to our 3 year old and 18 month old, which was not necessary but greatly appreciated.   Special thanks to Alanna, our cabana server, who was cheerful & efficient with our chaotic crowd; Christopher, a beach attendant who was particularly helpful with our kids one day; and, Tammy, our reception bartender who was as patient as she was fun.

The bar tender service was amazing !! Gabe really out did herself by giving us the best drink and food service ...we had the fish tacos and sangria drinks and we loved it!! She made us feel welcomed and greeted us so kind

I stayed here on business while in Miami.  The hotel was nice (a renovated old Miami building).  It's probably a great place to stay if you are on vacation, but not for business travel.  The courtyard blared music until around midnight.  Additionally, there was a fire alarm at 4 am in the morning (false alarm).  Probably not the hotel's fault, but when I got dressed and stepped out of my first floor room, there was still a party going on in the bar.

The social club team including the manager were very helpful and very friendly.  Staff at the front desk and the pool area are very helpful at all times. The food was very good. Recommend to try the crab tostones they are delicious.

This hotel is dirty the minute you pass the lobby. The hallway is always covered with dirty dishes. It takes them over a day to pick up room service dishes.   The carpets are in rough shape. Covered with dirt and stains. There is a ribbon of sand around the room. I have never seen this in even motels.   Our shower constantly had problems and sink was clogged. They kept sending "engineers" but they had no clue what they were doing.   Hanging bikes from your walls and serving cheap wine won't make a 4-star hotel. The least you could do is provide clean rooms.   I would pay a little extra and stay at Como next time.   Oh, they also charged me for valet. I don't know how because I never rented a car.

The quality of the staff is what pushes this place above the rest.

This is a smaller hotel on Collins Avenue, Dwarfed by the SLS and Delano next to it but retaining all the charms of an Art Deco Hotel. It has a great pool at the back with loungers and cabanas, plus a garden bar with hammocks and table tennis table; the back gate opens onto the boardwalk along the beach.  With happy hour and music it was a great place to spend an afternoon after discovering the Art Deco area.  Our room (suite) is great with a huge, comfortable bed, walk-in wardrobe and large lounge area (with sofa bed made up into a double for our two kids).  We haven’t tried the breakfast yet but it came up on google as one of the best places to eat breakfast in Miami Beach.

Visited for lunch after a walk along south beach - great ambience, food & service from James!  Had peach glazed wings with the fish tacos & fried plus a house-mix pina colada - all fresh and tasty; lime and jalapeño kick on the tacos in particular :)

The highlight was relaxing by the pool because the Service was AMAZING, seriously the staff could sense what you needed just as you thought about it! Special thanks to Lesmar who made us feel like nothing  was too much trouble, felt very well looked after and welcomed. Only criticism of the hotel was the rooms were a bit pokey and underwhelming but the rest of the hotel was beautiful and the service and location more than made up for it.

My friend and I have been coming to the Surfcomber for years now and our expectations have always been exceeded. Our rooms are clean, comfortable, and centrally located. But more importantly, the customer service is exceptional. Marlon is a staff member we have been dealing with since the beginning of our stay and he has been nothing short of exceptional. He is always willing and able to answer our questions and has been a friendly and familiar face welcoming us every time we arrive.

The Surfcomber never ceases to amaze me. The accommodations, amenities, and customer service are second to none. Not to mention, being welcomed by friendly and accommodating staff is the perfect way to start a vacation! If you run into Marlon consider yourself lucky— he’s sure to make sure your stay exceeds your expectations and we are always happy to see him when we arrive!

DC starts to get cold in October, so as soon as the leaves change I start looking for warm weather escapes. Miami is a great destination because of the short, budget-friendly flights, endless food options, beautiful beaches and abundance of parties.   I chose Surfcomber because it carries the Kimpton name and represents the brand well. The room wasn’t amazing, but had what was needed and the amenities were everything! Beautiful pool, fitness center, private beach and an awesome restaurant. Mark Reid and the front office/front desk staff were very pleasant and accommodating with ensuring that we had a great stay. I got an amazing deal on the hotel and look forward to coming back in a month or so. Great job Surfcomber, Kimpton and Miami 😎

I had an excellent stay st the Surfcomber.  I was upgraded to an oceanview room that had an enormous balcony.  The room was clean and well decorated.  Front desk staff were helpful and efficient.  I would definitely recommend this hotel.

We had a friend make a group RSVP, and we tried 3X to change to our name with no luck. The front desk staff was nasty and incompetent. We had issues charging to the room all stay because of this. Rooms are tiny. Pool is dated. 4' lizards defecating all over pool deck, staff would not clean up, only walk by. Don't expect a quiet pool with the place next door playing music so loud you can't think. There are hundreds of places in Miami Beach, I would chose another.

I’ve spent several afternoons lounging by the pool at this Miami Beach hotel.  They’ve got lots of cabanas, tons of poolside chairs and other amenities all wrapped up in a lovely walled garden. Dayle took care of us over two consecutive days ensuring a continuous flow of water, adult beverages and tasty food. There is also access to the beach for ocean lovers to get their fix.  All the hotels on this neighborhood have an Art Deco vibe. I like the Surfcomber because it’s a tad quieter and less pretentious than the SLS right next door.   Worth the visit!

Hotel was gorgeous, clean and the front desk staff as well as the pool staff (Lesmar especially!) was so kind and went above and beyond. The pool area had floaties, pool games and an outdoor sand pit with a ping pong table and yard games. The food at the restaurant and bar was also fabulous. Definitely would go back!

I stayed here with my hubby both of our first time in South Beach.  We were debating to book a larger resort style hotel or more boutique style and we are super glad we landed at Surfcomber as it’s in between!!! Hands down just a skip from the beach, large pool and good happy hour.  Hubby and I chilled by the outside bar hut during Happy Hour with the most chill and friendly bartender ever Mike.  He reminded us of our friends back home, a surfer himself. My hubby and him had great convo while I sipped my fruit smoothie lol Made ya feel like home away from home.  We recommend the vibes and location of this hotel!!!!!!

We had a great time. Cheryl the pool manager’s attentiveness and kindness had us well taken care of. She made sure all of our needs were fulfilled. We really enjoyed it & would definitely recommend. Thanks again!

The hotel was on Collins Avenue a great area for an international feel. The rooms were well furnished and clean as could be. The staff was great and knowledgeable and friendly. The amenities were great and the hotel offered us a few extra as a thank you for being there. The hotel is on the beach and only the pool separates the hotel and beach. The pool area is fantastic lush with a great wait staff to fulfill your food and drink and comfort needs. All in all the hotel is really special and I stay in many. A great experience.

More then I expected. The service from the doorman to hotel staff were very welcoming. The resort fee was high and value was limited. The pool is open 24 hrs however there is no life guard. overall a good stay. Would return to this resort again.

My husband and I stayed at the Surfcomber over the weekend. This was our 2nd time staying at this hotel. We arrived late afternoon on a Thursday and decided to grab a late lunch/early dinner at the High Tide bar behind the pool. The food was delicious; I had the burger and he had the brisket sandwich. The bartender, Jesus, is the best part of the High Tide bar! He was hilarious, welcoming and makes awesome drinks! We interacted with Jesus the entire weekend and he really made our stay a lot of fun, as well as the entire outdoor wait staff! He's a total gem!! Surfcomber, please take care of him!

My family revisited the Surfcomber for the first time in a few years.  We have always loved this hotel, as it is a great location. Everything is in walking distance.  And the hotel is even more fabulous now!  The food from the bar and hotel was always delicious. They have pool-side activities, and chairs with umbrellas on the beach, but my favorite part this time was the pool. Ash and Alanna were always so helpful and attentive. They anticipated our every wish for sure. I cannot wait to go back!

My friends and I were on a much needed bestie’s trip in Miami. We stopped by the Surfcomer Poolside bar by recommendation of a local and I’m so glad we did!  The whole area is very relaxing with hammocks, a sandy area with ping pong and of course the pool. The hotel next door was playing music so you could jam a little but actually HEAR and socialize with each other (versus other deafening outside bars in Miami). Mike and Gabe at the bar are AMAZING, incredibly sweet and make delicious drinks!! My friends and I had such a good time and spent the most time hanging out here of all the places we visited.  Definitely worth the visit!!

Visited Surfcomber beach bar/restaurant with my friends and Mike was a great bartender with quick and thorough service for a large group. Great music, food, drinks, and Mike was on top of it all! If you visit South Beach, Miami then this should be your go to.

Mike made our last night in miami for our girls trip at the surfcomber as he was so attentive, polite and comfortable to talk to and hang out with at the bar. We hung out longer than we expected because he was so awesome!! Thank you Mike!!!!

I wanted to mention Michael the bartender who was very entertaining with some great stories about surfing. Also Carolina the pool server who at one point recommended the Lock On lager IPA. She was very knowledgeable about it and when I tried it, I learned a new beer to like.

My best friend and I stayed a few nights here booking it based on location.  It's walkable to everything you would need to be around on a quick girl's trip.  It's on the beach and close to Lincoln road and the hustle and bustle of Collins Ave (giftshops and restaurants).  Hanging by the pool was fun and they have hammocks by the outdoor bar.  Customer service was really good, the staff are friendly and make you feel welcome.  Our bartender was Mike, for the days we were there we'd go to him and he was the best.  He knew pretty much everything about miami beach and was funny too. He made our drinks quick; and our food during happy hour was so yummy!!! The wings are juicy and the fish tacos are recommended.  Super cute place!

I always have a great time at this place. The bar area by the pool is a great place to hang out and chill on a Saturday and do some day drinking. Mira, one of the bartenders there, makes an amazing mojito. She is super friendly and always remembers me when I come back. Friendly bartenders, great atmosphere, great drinks. Enough said!

Mira was an amazing bartender! Spritz by the beach was a great choice. We had so much fun at sunset at the pool bar. It was so much fun! We will definitely come back to the surfcomber with our friends and family

Since I arrived at the hotel, they welcomed me with warm smiles, I felt at home. All the staff is very good, they explained everything that the hotel has, social club is excellent, I loved the food. In the pool area, Cheryl the manager was very attentive to us, very nice and kind, we had a problem with the room and when explaining it, she relieved the inconvenience with two margaritas. I was fascinated by the floaties in the pool and the good energy of the staff. I definitely will come back soon and recommend this place and service.

I have stayed at several south beach properties. Surfcomber should be on the list. Had a fantastic time at the new and improved Surfcomber. Happy hour is awesome and Jesus pays attention to every detail. Should not be missed!

Honestly this is an awesome place to come if you are on a vacation with your family, or if you come with some friends to enjoy that Miami experience. The food is amazing, the pool has few games that you can play with your loved ones and the staff is really friendly. Cheryl ensured that we were well taken care of by the staff and made our vacation pleasant. My friends and I will definitely come here again.

Spent my day at the surfcomber, the service was great. From the second I pulled up to the valet, jay and the entire staff was amazing. Wendy introduced us to do aqua Zumba, and it was so fun!!! Such a great way to FIT a fun workout into your relaxing day. The music selection makes you even more excited to be involved. The pool servers Dayle and Alanna were extrememy welcoming and kind. And the food is DELICIOUS. The customer service is all around great. Definitely recommend coming here for your stay included Miami.

I recently traveled to this hotel as part of an wedding anniversary trip with my wife. We love the location and the pool area. In addition the staff was VERY friendly and accommodating. I realize the hotel infrastructure is old, but a complete remodeling of the interior rooms (especially the carpets, bathrooms and fixtures) is in order. The dark-colored floor carpeting in the room masked the dirt / grime and the room had a "damp and musty" smell. In addition, the elevator next to the front reception could use maintenance as the doors were scraping as they opened and closed. The valet parking situation is ridiculously expensive (yes, I realize that this is the "norm" in the South Beach area).

Wendy, Aqua Zumba was amazing!!!  My first time experience was so much fun! And the rest of the pool staff is 10/10 with awesome service with constant attention.  Did have a single need for anything because everything was given to me right at my pool chair.

Sharee Awwal personally greeted us and ensured that we enjoyed our stay. Can't wait until my next visit to stay again!

Perfect stay and pleasant staff! It’s located right on Collins Ave in the heart of South beach. Nice pool. We were greet by a Sharee Awwal (Manager) very professional and accommodating . We stepped out to beach right through the hotel. I would stay here again definitely.

Went for my friend's birthday/Staycation and we had a great time! From the moment we walked in, we got a glass of wine and the hospitality of Mel at the front desk, to Jesus and Lesmar at the pool/pool bar and to the beach attendants and Gladys, who made a great beach day fun with great drinks. Really loved the vibe, the comforts and the perks for being there. Comfortable rooms and great food and drinks. Special thanks to the Luis, the bellman for helping us out and making the stay extra special.

Great bar for locals ! I live in Miami and go to South Beach for a drink pretty often !The outside pool bar @ Kimpton Surfcomber that I discovered was really cool !! Open for walk ins ,big veritable of delicious cocktails .. I was there for happy hour and definitely will come back to see Mira ( the bartender) again !!! She is my favorite!!!

The team here are helpful and friendly! Great service, lovely pool, awesome accomodation.   If your here for a short or long stay - this is a great place to stay.  Beachfront location - more mid beach, than south, but still a convenient location!  Had a great time and will return

column3: We have been touring Florida for almost three weeks and have been looking forward to our visit to Miami Beach. The experience is extremely disappointing. This is by far the most expensive and the worst hotel of our trip. They let us wait for an hour in the lobby because our rooms were not ready, they said, while happily checking in other guests. We would still be there if we would not have insisted. By 4.40 pm they finally and reluctantly released one room. The four of us are cramped in a tiny dark room facing the wall of the next building, waiting for the other tiny room to become available. Frustration, anger and aggravation mark our visit to Miami Beach. Extremely disappointing.

OMG - what a disaster. If you plan to stay @ this hotel , make sure to book 1 room per person...double beds are so uncomfortable and what’s worse make sure you check your bill @ checkout.. they charged me things I didn’t purchased from the pool bar / restaurant.. a person in front of me had exact same experience.. I will NEVER stay at this hole again..  For couple hundred $$ more You can stay at the real nice hotels in the same area..

I walked in and the service was greatly instantly. Johanna serviced us and was very friendly and attentive. My husband, the kids, and I loved it and for sure willl return for our next vacation. The beach was clean, drinks tasted amazingly, and staff was very friendly.   Thank you Kimpton Family.

Johanna gave a great service, she made this trip unforgettable for my fiancé and I. Thanks to her, she's the true definition of hospitality. I'd would definitely be back and be spreading the word at home. Surfcomber was a great choice to experience a weekend getaway.

I visited the hotel for a bachelorette party. The hotel was beautiful and well maintained. James Fraser and Ashoka were courteous and delivered awesome service. It was an awesome experience all around !

The staff at this hotel is outstanding. Aaron was phenomenal! He was attentive while I was on the beach but not overbearing and later that evening, he helped me out at the hotel pool, which wasn’t even his workstation.   The amenities and the food are very good. The room was so so, I was looking for a bit of a better room since I’m an IHG member, but oh well, I didn’t spend much time in the room anyway.

Just lounging at the poolside when your purse is snatched up!  Not just one purse either! But thankfully the hotel has security cameras but saddly only for the safety of the thieves! Naturally the hotel cannot access the captured camera information until Monday - long after the thieves have had time to pawn your stuff! Way to go staff! Thanks for  stay hotel!

Upon arriving in our deluxe room, we found that we the one window in the room faced a the wall of the neighboring hotel and partly looked into a bedroom of the neighboring hotel. The toilets were clogged within one use and when we asked management for a room change, they promised one for the next day which never happened. The pool, beach and surrounding were was still not up and running by 10am...and you have to pay 19 USD to use a parasol. Music is blaring from morning to evening - competing with the next door hotel to see who can play the loudest music. To be fair, the cleaning staff are lovely but otherwise, this hotel is overpriced, the management is unfriendly and the overall hotel is neither well designed nor clean.

column3: I had a really great experience here. I only stayed for one night, but Nick at the front desk knew me by name, and went above and beyond to make sure my stay was perfect. I was given recommendations on places to eat and offered a vip card to get into a dance club. The hotel has a cool beach house vibe, and is situated in the middle of a popular street. Just stepping outside you got that "Oh yeah, I'm in Miami" feel. My room had a glimpse of the pool, which is open 24 hours, and you could see the ocean behind it. I'd definitely come back.

If you're ever looking to renew past great experience ~ Kimpton SurfComber hotel is the only stay in town 🕶🙏🏾  They have a Five ⭐️ staff front and back. With service to match ~ it's the easiest spot to return to and the hardest to leave.  I'm already looking forward to my return.💕⭐️💕⭐️💕⭐️💕⭐️💕⭐️😎

My husband and I didn't stay here, but we stopped at the restaurant to grab a bite to eat after walking up the boardwalk from South Beach on a steamy day. The service was very friendly, we both enjoyed our lunches (I had a salad with Mahi Mahi, husband had chicken wings from happy hour menu) and drinks. It was so sweltering, we hopped in the pool for a couple of minutes to cool off before heading back to our hotel. Overall we really liked the atmosphere and service. Definitely worth a visit!

Tracey and Chris were wonderful. Every hotel needs  to have staff like them. They took care of our issues right away. I would love to come back and stay longer. Hotel was clean staff was great. Food good at the pool but pricey

The staff at this hotel is very lively and informative.  Dionne at the check in desk was very nice and helpful.  Kenny the bellman gave us tons of information about local attractions.  Alberto was awesome.

Pool is nice but they seem to allow anyone in.  The rooms are dated. They still have ipod docks. Get rid of them, it's a waste of space and no one uses them! The rooms leak a bit of noise. Can hear the pool music which starts at 10am.can hear the neighbors and they can hear me.   Staff are great and helpful.  Although 11am checkout?? That's unheard of. Make it at least 12pm or 1pm.  The rooms are always cleaned late. 530pm and still not done.   Location is very good. Accessible to everything.  Not sure if this is the standard here but generally wouldn't recommend staying here if you can find cheaper and better.

My husband and I were here celebrating our 25th anniversary. The service we received was outstanding. From the valet to the registration desk. We especially liked the two young men who took care of us on the beach, Justin and Aaron! They made us feel welcome and comfortable with their warm smiles and pleasant dispositions! If we needed or wanted anything, they were on it!!! I hope Kimpton continues to utilize this service as it only adds to the visitor experience!

Hotel is cute, cute, cute!  Staff is welcoming and helpful.  Excellent location on beach. Knowing this ahead of time may better help you plan your visit.

We will definitely be back soon!

I came to surfcomber to celebrate my sisters birthday with my family and friends. Sheldein set up our umbrellas and was so personable, I honestly wanted him to sit with us. Aaron was our server and was extremely knowledgeable about the menu because I am vegetarian and I was happy about that. Veral convinced us to get a cabana instead of chairs and it was the best decision I made all day I was very satisfied and will be coming back! Thankyou so much

The Surfcomber is in a excellent location on South Beach. As you arrive, the Valet greets you and assisted with our luggage, and, got our party all a nice glass of wine 😊. The service, attentiveness, and beauty of the botique hotel is well worth the price. We enjoyed the amenities as well as the outdoor bar by the pool. Michael, the server there, was busily mixing drinks to allow us all to enjoy the World Cup game! Will definitely be back when visiting South Beach.

I stayed in the Surfcomber twice already, and I have to say that you just can't beat this location. Beach is right behind the Hotel, so many restaurants less that 10 min walking distance, but the reason why this place is really awesome are Nikola and Louis!! Louis was there to help us with our luggage, and Nikola made sure that we have everything that we need during our stay, the rest of the stuff was super friendly also, always smiling and ready to give you recommendation of some nice restaurant nearby. Also Hotel is serving free wine at 4:00pm and that just blow our minds, also also the pool is 24h omg I would definitely recommend this place.

column3: Loved the location , the restaurants and outdoor games and music at the Kimpton. The breakfast was delicious at the social club . Thanks for the great room, delicious chocolate dipped strawberries  🍓  for our 25 th anniversary and the champagne 🍾 ! Armando hit it with each recommendation! Thanks team #kimtonmoments!

Overall pleased with my stay at the Kimpton. I could not have been happier with the amenities which included towel service, iced water 24/7, sunscreen, and beach chairs right in front of the ocean. Couldn't have asked for a better staff to serve their customers. The location was prime in terms of being able to take Ubers around $5 each time to where we wanted to get to. The Kimpton is also amongst some of the nicest hotels and is walking distance from some amazing bakeries, lunch places, and main sites. I highly recommend this hotel for anyone who wants the luxury of South Beach life style at an amazing price!!!

My flight was very delayed due to weather. Hoping to make it in by midnight, I called to let the hotel know so my room wasn't given away. Nikola was so kind and left a note for staff. When I arrived at hotel exhausted, and got to my room, I was surprisingly upgraded in room type. There was a handwritten note with a bottle of wine to help me relax. Although, all I wanted was to sleep, the thought was appreciated. The room was clean and quiet, with everything I needed. There for work, i walked the property which was beautiful. Next time I will go back with more time to enjoy the pool and beach. Nikola who I met before leaving went above and beyond for me.

Spent a few days in Miami at the Kimpton and it was great! Room was clean and yard was great, however the highlight was Jesus in the outside bar. He’s a riot, amazing guy and bartender. We are coming back here just to hang out with him!  Mike and Hazel!

I stayed at the Kimpton Surfcomber last week with a large group.  Checking in was a little bit of an issue, however they were able to store luggage until rooms were prepared.  Access to and from the pool/ beach is super convenient.  The staff was very pleasant and willing to help in anyway possible.  With that being said, Mira & Jesus the bartenders at the outdoor pool bar were a shining point of our long weekend there.  They were professional, enthusiastic and welcoming to our entire group.  Their ability to remember everyone's name (w/o looking at credit cards every 5 minutes) was a nice touch. Every hotel needs people like them!   Would definitely come back and see my friends!

Pretty hotel. Loved the modern, but warm and friendly decor. Kind of felt like I was living in a beachfront Anthropologie. Darling boutique-feel. Delicious food and drinks--we ate lunch and breakfast at hotel daily. Cute pool and grounds, even for kids. Ping pong table, hammocks, beach games are a fun touch. I especially enjoyed and appreciated the beachfront service, kindness and weather advice of Yeni and Kristopher!!! This was a fun work and play trip. Good sleep, yet in the middle of lots of night life. Two thumbs up.

This hotel is situated in a great location in Miami Beach and we stayed one night after returning from our cruise to Cuba.   It felt a little more laid back than other Kimptons we stayed in but for one night it was fine.   This was the 3rd time at a Kimpton property we were hit with minibar charges for things we didn't purchase.   We purchased nothing.  I'm not sure what is going on with Kimpton's system these days.   It was a pain in the butt to have to sort out but at least they refunded the charges.   Word of advice - check your bill and also charges that may appear after checking out.

Lovely pool and close to the beach. Rooms are fine, mine had an ocean view but bathrooms are small. Nice touches like ice water by the pool, free coffee from 6-10am and a free wine hour. Helpful staff. But expect to pay extra, such as beach loungers $20 even though you've paid a resort fee. Breakfast menu and service not that great. No tea making facility in your room. Limited movie channels on TV but lots of movies to buy. Fully stocked mini bar but again expensive, Noisy either from canned music or events. There was a wedding on my last night and the noise was just unacceptable but the management didn't care. Would not stay here again.

Not only did I feel welcome immediately, but he greatly exceeded all expectations. Check in was effortless, as well as informative. I highly suggest staying here if you are looking not only for a beautiful hotel, but personable and friendly service. Thank you!

After a delayed flight and a series of events that could have easily ruined our experienxe, Surfcomber at Miami Beach has surpassed expectations. Not only do they have excellent customer service, but they have employees such as Nick who go the extra mile and treat guests like royalty.  The environment and atmosphere is top notch. I would recommended this for anyone looking for a relaxing yet extravagant vacation! Thanks again to Nick and all the staff here at Kimpton Surfcomber who provide a truly hospitable experience!

The room was adequate and the service was adequate.  The food in the restaurant was inedible. The house wine was undrinkable and the service was exceedingly slow. A martini had to be returned and still when redone was undrinkable!  The car valet asked for 20 minutes notice, after 45 minutes, we needed to request again.

We just stayed 2 night prior to a cruise, but we loved the Surfcomber. The rooms are small but if you have stayed and any of the other boutique hotels in Miami these are actually a bit larger. The location, pool and amenities are excellent. Only reason I didn’t rate 5 stars was outside bar service and restaurant was very very slow and quite pricey for what we got once food did arrive. But with that noted we would definitely return. Bartenders outside were excellent!

We used to always stay at The National Hotel when visiting SOBE.  Lately, after a bad experience, we decided to try something new.  We were not disappointed! This caliber of professionalism and service can only be found at a hotel like this! Ten stars all the way!!!

The pool is heated and open 24 hrs which was a treat!  Ps:Their burgers are very delicious! I will be back!

We stayed for one night with a family of four in a double room. The room was rather small, but clean and quiet and all staff we met were friendly and helpful. The pool was fantastic and valet parking worked fine. We had breakfast at the hotel restaurant and we all liked it. The location is great, with many shops and restaurants around.  So why no 5 points then? Because we arrived at 5 PM, just to hear that the room was not ready. We had to wait for another 20 minutes until we got the keys. But otherwise everything was good and I would stay again at this hotel.

Anyone coming here expecting to find a Kimpton-level hotel will be very disappointed. There is nothing elegant or luxurious here and the lobby and rooms with their closet-sized bathrooms suggest more of a motel 6 that someone bought and renovated. In fairness, it's an old Art Deco structure with the space limitations that brings. But make no mistake: what you are paying for here is the location behind the beach, and the nice pool area ("nice" as long as you're ok with constant music and the loud ultra scene often booming in from next door - even after the Ultra festival is over.) For 20 somethings looking for a central SoBe location and a great March rave, this would be the place. For adults looking for a bit more sophistication, best keep looking.

Based on some of the reviews we read we were hesitant about booking a room here.  However, we’ve found this boutique hotel to be very well maintained with a great location. We can view the ocean and beach right outside our window with a beautiful pool/waterfall and plenty of room to lounge beside.  Nikola greeted us at the front desk when we arrived and made us really feel welcomed.  He was AMAZING!  Also, the Social Club restaurant adjoining the lobby serves a very good breakfast...we’ll try the bar later this evening.   Overall , we’re having a great time.

We took a couple of days mid-week to get rid of the winter blues and this was the PERFECT place. It's an unpretentious, hippie-chic boutique hotel with top-notch service. Chase, the front desk guy, was helpful and accomodating and pretty much upgraded our whole experience. Ralph , the beach guy, made sure we had everything we needed to relax on the beach. Jesus, the outdoor bartender, was a drink mind-reader and great entertainment! Everything from 4pm wine to bikes to sunscreen is included, so you can just RELAX. The breakfast/ brunch is fantastic and the coffee is free, so no need to even leave unless you're ready to go out to dinner. Perfect location, so no need to have a car. Yes, the bathrooms are a bit small. Who cares?!?

This hotel was in the perfect location to celebrate with friends. Our room wasn't ready when we arrived, even with a guaranteed check in, but they more than made up for it, with complimentary dinner and breakfast the next morning.  Our room turned out not to be what we had originally reserved and immediately they remedied the issue and offered a Cabana for the weekend which we were able to enjoy our last day when the weather was friendly to do so.  The accommodations were comfortable and the hotel scenery was beautiful.  We will certainly return, as we were impressed with how they went above and beyond to please their guests and the location was convenient to enjoy all of south beach.

Especially we would like to mention Maria at the beach who made us feel welcome and took great care of us when we spent the day there. Yet, the hotel was a quiet oasis and very enjoyable stay.

I had recently had knee surgery and was stuck inside for almost a week. Stir crazy I decided to try the Kimpton for a night. I stayed Sunday night of President’s Day weekend and enjoyed the property. It is a small boutique hotel and does not appear to be more than four stories tall. I stayed in a wing stretching towards the water with a view of the courtyard. It was a short stroll to the pool from my room.While the hotel is technically on the beach the beach is so wide but it is quite a hike to the surf. My only challenge with a bad knee. The room was small but well-equipped. The front desk was very accommodating. I’ll come back.

We’ve just returned from a ten day break at the Surfcomber and I’m struggling to find fault with our stay. We did have a small glitch with charges appearing on my credit card but Armando sorted it all out very quickly. Top service really is about how you deal with a problem and not about passing the buck, which I’ve experienced in the past. Armando went far beyond just sorting out the problem and looked after us very well.  We weren’t met by one member of staff without a smile on their face and a “good morning” greeting for our entire stay and you really don’t get that everywhere.  As others have mentioned, the place could probably do with a lick of paint here and there but in many ways that just adds to it’s charm.  Fantastic!

Booked a last minute getaway and have stayed at other Kimpton's before. This hotel followed suit of our previous enjoyable stays and then some. A nice view of the beach by the pool, enjoyable food from Social club, and all within the heart of South Beach. Walking distance to many eateries and local hot spots.  The service at the front desk is superb along with the complimentary happy hour associated with this chain. We were happily upgraded to a room with a view without any hesitation as it became available(midweek). I would gladly return for another stay, hopefully a little longer. Thanks Dionne !

Not to mention the fact that despite request and verbal confirmation that we would have a kingsize bed, which was not accomplished, rooms are small, old, poorly decorated and worn out.

This is our fourth time at the Surfcomber and we will come again. We absolutely love it. The hotel is beautifully decorated and well taken care of. The staff aims to please and meet all our needs,especially Victor on the beach. He sets up the loungechairs with a smile and is a great asset to the hotel.

You have a lot of options in Miami Beach/South Beach and there's really no reason to choose this hotel. I've had some amazing experiences at Kimptons throughout the country, but this one fell flat. On the positive side, it is in a great location with direct beach access and a really nice pool. The bar area is a lot of fun with ping pong, yard games, etc. However, the rooms are tiny and extremely loud. My room was basically next to the club at the SLS...blasting music 24/7. Nickola at the front desk was also kind enough to help us research dinner options for local pizzerias when were had a craving (the margarita pizza from Spris was amazing!). The location can’t be beat either... on the beach and walking distance to Lincoln Road and the Museum of Ice Cream! Our server for breakfast at the social club was great as well... always a favorite place to dine when we are in south beach.

I would definitely recommend this hotel.

From the minute we stepped in to the moment we left we felt at home. Chase, the concierge was great. Knowledgable and attentive at every moment. The wine hour was superb and a nice touch. The service by all staff was spot on. Rooms were clean and well appointed!

I was happy with the service, lobby, pool, wine, coffee, and location.  Once I entered the room its a different story - dirty stained sheets, dated furniture, small room.  It should be rated about 3 1/2 stars.  I would suggest that the hotel purchase new linen and change the laundry services.  Train the cleaning staff to identify dirty sheets that should not be used.

Spent a few days here again.  As always great servce at a nice property. Hotel is a nice smaller size but with great beach access. Service makes the differnce. Kudos to the concierge staff especially Chase, bartender Xcioma and beach attendant Victor. They all conspired to make our trip special.

We liked everything except the rooms. Lobby was hip and cosy, Social club had great breakfast and dinner, heated pool was a pure pleasure for the kids even though the weather was crappy. What we didn't like was the double room - it almost had no space to open luggage, carpet was dirty and had weird spots, bath was clogged up and it felt more as a dorm than 4-5 star hotel. Left with mixes feelings.

My boyfriend and I come to Miami every year for New Year’s Eve, this was our first, and last stay at the Surfcomber.  The hotel was extremely understaffed.  Everyone was pleasant but overburdened.  It took us 10 minutes to get our bags from the bellhop, an hour to get beers on the beach, and some times the resort ran out of towels or cushions for the beach chairs.  A $36/day resort fee is fine if you’re getting good service, but this was so far from that.  Each day we had to request our room be cleaned.  One day it wasn’t even touched by 4:30 PM.  That’s putting aside that the rooms were worn, our carpet had several stains when we arrived.  Given the price and the Kimpton brand name we were disappointed and won’t be back.

Beautiful boutique hotel with incredible staff. Everyone was extremely nice from the minute we walked in. Front desk staff were very professional and always happy to accommodate. You were greeted with a smile wherever you were on property. Pool and beach fantastic, and Victor and his beach staff work hard to make you happy-“A plus” all the way. Marie took fantastic care of my family for food and drink at beach, always hustling and extremely kind.  We will be back!

Those ladies went above and beyond to ensure we had everything we wanted quick and with a smile. In short “Pampered” is how we felt. We will be returning very soon to KSC!!

I love Kimpton properties and make it a point to stay with them during any trip I take. Usually, it's business and/or pleasure and with someone. This time, I took a solo trip to relax and get away. The resort has amazing food, drinks, and staff that I never felt I needed to leave! The service, smiles, and sunshine are missed every day. I am looking forward to planning my next trip at the Surfcomber, very soon!

We just completed a great trip to the Kimpton Surfcomber. We’ve stayed at many places in the area over the years but the Surfcomber has a unique combination of a beautiful setup at its pool (including a mini-beach and lawn with a hammock and Adirondack chairs) very nice decor and rooms, excellent food and most important,  incredible staff (with none of the rudeness displayed by some other places in the area). For us it’s all about the beach so also want to give a special shout-out to Victor of their beach operation who was very attentive and helpful.

We enjoyed our stay and really felt that all staff did their best to make it the very best stay ever.  this is our second time at the surfcomber- and everything was as we remembered.  hotel is a great pick in just the right place on the beach. plus points: trendy decor, yummy smelling bathroom products, very nice pool area, super staff, perfect location. the only minus was that some rooms are very noisy (airco on roof or street noise) so you need to ask for a quieter room but the staff will accommodate. and no coffee in the room (but downstairs, but only in the morning!)  unexpected super tip: the beach burger and fries.  really great!

My wife and I stayed here on the last leg of our honeymoon in Florida. We had saved up what we thought would be an amazing last few nights in a highly rated hotel in Miami. On checking in we were told we would be upgraded for free as it was our honeymoon which we were chuffed about. However, our room wasn’t overly great so not sure what the most basic rooms would be like? Decor appears a little tired and nothing gives that special feel about it. After quite a long drive from Tampa we wanted to get a nice shower and head out for a nice meal; unfortunately there was a power cut so we ended up eating doughnuts and drinking beer in a dark room. Obviously no backup generator on site. In general I don’t rate Miami and won’t be visiting again, this hotel didn’t help my feelings on that.

The room was gorgeous, really felt like I was in Miami, luxury beach hut vibes.  The facilities were excellent, including the free happy hour, free wine or cocktails which we were able to take out into the gardens which was lovely. The pool when we used it did't have any space for us but then it was August. But I'm pale so I had to find shade in the Miami heat and the floor was way too hot in a swimming costume and bare feet, maybe have mats down for those walking a distance to the pool, or provide flip flops?

We would recommend the hotel without a doubt

I would highly recommend this bar for a casual fun place near the beach!

This time I decided to “give a second chance” to Surfcomber, but it was a bad idea. The hotel air conditioning system does not work properly.  It’s not possible to cool the room. I complained about it. I moved to a different room, but the problem remains. In a city like Miami Beach, it’s a real problem! Unfortunately I prepaid my whole stay...I’m still at the hotel at room 231. So, if you are planning a trip to Miami Beach, Loew’s is a best option.

We also made use of the bikes for an early morning bike ride  .  Loved the time round the pool plenty of  loungers  and an easy walk to the beach

I generally adore the Kimpton hotels. This hotel, however, did not live up to the understated elegance and smooth service of the brand. Service was indifferent-I was ignored at the check-in desk for fifteen minutes while the young woman flirted with an already registered guest with a dog, instead of checking me in. The pool was average and the beachfront claim is a bit of a fib, since the hotel is really on the main road and the beach is way down on the property with no real ocean views. The bathroom was dirty, with a cracked floor and mold on the shower tiles. South Beach is teaming with boutique hotels, many of them are gems loaded with character, such as The Betsey. With all there is to choose from, no need to spend top dollar for a sub-par accommodation.

Made reservations 4 months ahead thru Secret Escapes (my first mistake!).  Did not realize that reservations were non-refundable.  Because of medical procedures that will be beginning at the time of the reservation, we will not be able to make the trip.  Secret Escapes said that they could not cancel the reservation and that only the reservation manager at the Kimpton Surfcomber could do that.  We were informed that the hotel would not do that.  We will have to eat the $300 at a time when we will be under a great financial burden.  It is still 2 months out from our reservation.  So much for customer satisfaction!  After my treatments I will make sure to look for a different hotel in Miami Beach were there is some consideration for the client and not just the money.

I stayed at the Surfcomber in Miami. The rooms were clean and comfortable. However the staff was exeception. I felted as if I had round about service! Barbara checked on my daily to accommodate any room needs. Luis not only took care of my luggage upon my arrival and departure but he also greeted me daily. Luis also made sure I had ice in my in room daily after I asked him once to get ice for my room. He also offered some must see city stamples. Laz, made my lazy days at the beach relaxing. He took care of all my beach needs such as drinks, towels and umbrella setup. The staff made my stay enjoyable with a waves of exceptional personal services!

Very nice hotel, well located on South Beach with a direct access to the beach and the seafront walk to Ocean Drive.  Beautiful poool, excellent breakfast restaurant.  A few down points : freezing corridors toward the room, a bit noisy late evenings, the concierge advices were not really reliable.

We recently stayed at the Kimpton residence. Very much to our expectations we were 100% satisfied we made the right choice. The hotel layout is very welcoming and the rooms offer value for money. Staff at the hotel were also very helpful. Heading back in a few months.

We had a great get away with my wife. The staff was exceptionally attentive to our needs and concerns. Anything that we needed in the slightest the staff delivered. Thanks to omar at the social club and Gabrielle at the pool amazing staff. Location is perfect right in the heart of south beach.

After lunch around the corner my friend and I were walking along the beach boardwalk when we saw Happy Hour @ 4 pm sign. As it was 3:59 pm we decided to take a seat. Nice pool bar at the back of the hotel overlooking cyclists, joggers & walkers taking advantage of the beach. Drinks were good, big selection & frosty cold.

I had a wonderful time with my two teenage boys.  This was an excellent location and we couldn't have been more satisfied.  The staff were more than friendly and went out of their way to make us feel welcome.  The hotel offers free coffee in the morning and whatever newspaper you desire and a free wine and sangria hour.  They offer two chairs and towels at the beach but charge for an umbrella $19.  There is free sustain lotion, towels music and water and toys at the pool.  The room is small but clean and upgraded. The location of the hotel is great because you can walk to everything in south beach yet it's far enough away from the rowdiness.  You can walk along the peaceful beach path. It's really a pleasant place.

We did not stay at this hotel but had full access to the swimming pool during the day as the pool at the Epic hotel was closed. We loved the location and how cozy it was! I want to leave a big compliment to one of their pool staff, Cano, who took great care of us and provided great customer service! :) we will definitely stay at this hotel the next time we are in Miami!

We had a great stay here as part of my friend's birthday celebrations. Pool is great, location is superb with most of Miami in walking distance! Service was friendly and welcoming. Big bonus was the wine and happy hours which always got our evenings off to a flying start. Only tiny snag was the key card stopped working on occasions which happens everywhere, just annoying in a hotel of this size especially when you've walked 3 flights of stairs.  Would certainly not deter me from going back!

Knew this hotel would be a little gem when i booked it friendly and homely nothing is too much trouble friendly reception efficient check love the text message service. Great location restaurants and shops all around. Rooms are spacious comfy beds everything you need is here. Pool staff are attentive and friendly and gabrielle and the team are also great around the bar food is lovely burgers are to die for the breakfast is also good. I took part in a free yoga session with lisa which certainly stretched me out after my 9 hour flight. Love the little touches in the hotel brollie in every room free tea and coffee in a morning and free wine in the afternoon thanks for looking after me and my family I would certainly recommend this hotel to my clients and we will be back

This is the second time that I have stayed at the Kimpton Surfcomber. Love it.  The staff are attentive, friendly, and welcoming. Location spot on just by the beach and walk paths. I go there to relax and unwind. Staff are attentive and will attend to your  every need.  The food is delicious.  Lots of activities yoga, beach, pool, walking paths, near Lincoln Road for shopping. It will feel like home away from home.

Kimpton doesn't disappoint at the Surfcomber. My sister and I had a great, relaxing stay where we felt like we were staying with friends. Even though we had a snafu with our room on our 2nd day that was quite inconvenient, the Surfcomber team did everything to make it right and everything was fine. Most importantly our room was crisp, clean and comfortable. One thing to note is that the resort fee includes sunscreen, towels and chairs at the pool AND two chairs on the ocean just feet from the hotel which was great. The staff delighted us during our entire stay. The front desk crew that included Mark, Vanessa, Xavi, Katie and Camilla to Foxy at the pool to the amazing Braylin that took care of our door situation for us. We can't wait to come back.

This is a proper South Beach experience. Fabulous hotel with amazing staff all really helpful and willing to assist. A great spot to be around the pool and just a 2 minute walk to the beach. Close to restaurants and shops. Eat here if you can , the food is really very good, not cheap but really good. If I went back to South Beach I would have no hesitation in staying here again. Wine Club each day is a really nice touch. Stayed with my wife and 3 children and we all loved it.

We stayed just for a day after returning from a trip to the Caribbean and we we're not disappointed. Most of our day was spent on the beach and it definitely was the right choice. Nayla, Jordyn, and Marie were so fun and attentive it almost made us wish we stayed in Miami for the past few days instead! And the food was amazing as well, highly recommend the wings and yuca fries. My compliments to the chef! If we're ever back in Miami Beach we will for sure be returning to the Kimpton! Thanks for the great time everyone

I would love to come back to the Surfcomber next time I'm able to visit Miami. The pool and beach areas are beautiful, and they have a great poolside bar. The staff were very friendly and went completely above and beyond to make us feel welcome. They offered great recommendations of businesses in the area. Laz and the beach staff were excellent. I would definitely recommend this hotel to others!

The customer service and treatment of guests at this hotel is AWFUL! Please don't stay here. Immediately upon arrival we dealt with a concierge, Katie, who was extremely rude, snobby and of no help when we inquired about the pool being closed, king-size bed upgrade, and other inquiries as our stay continued. Throughout our stay we dealt with a pool staff member named Foxy/Foxi. He was snippy, impolite and belittling to my friend when asking for towels and chairs. After bringing this up to the concierge, this seemed to be of no concern. Finally, each day our rooms were NEVER cleaned until 5pm and only were ever cleaned upon request. Overall, I found the staff to be so unprofessional, and unwelcoming, that I have ZERO desire to stay at a Kimpton again let alone recommend to anyone.

Stopped at the hotel bar for a few drinks! Amazing selection and atmosphere. The bartender, Andres, made a delicious lychee cocktail, White Moon so refreshing. Food was really good too. Would come back and recommend to others!

We stayed at Surfcomber hotel twice on our recent visit to the USA - overnight before we went on a cruise to Cuba and then for a weekend before we ventured down to the Floriday Keys. Although our trip included a lot of fabulous destinations, staying at the Kimpton Surfcomber was the highlight.  The hotel is close to everything but just far enough to be away from the maddening crowds and riff raff.  The hotel has a beautiful pool area and the beach is just beyond that  and absolutely fabulous. The staff are amazing, the décor and rooms are "art deco" as you'd expect and all in all a wonderful experience

I just returned from the Surfcomber for the second time. I had great memories of my previous trip there a few years ago, and this time was even better. After staying in quite a few hotels in South Beach (including some 5-star), I can say the Surfcomber definitely has the best costumer service. The staff is attentive and friendly. The room was beautiful, clean and comfortable. Laz at the beach is the absolute best! He remembered me by name each day of my stay and was kind and helpful with whatever I needed on the beach. Even being on the beach in the rain was pleasant with the excellent amenities the Surfcomber provided. The resort fee is well worth it. Thank you for another great vacation, and I look forward to returning!

We only stayed for one night, but it was great. Nothing that you don't expect from the Kimpton brand. Check in was warm, friendly, and quick, and the pool and beach access were wonderful. Our room was also lovely, as was the hotel itself. Located in a vibrant neighborhood with many good restaurants and nightlife to walk to. We'll be back!

Great looking hotel, good staff, beautiful rooms. But hidden extras are a real turnoff, 45 dollars to park a day, 13 dollars a day!!! just for WIFI. Only 2 chairs on beach allowed per room, we were a group of 6 so got 4 chairs for our 2 rooms, no use to us!! Pay for a parasol 19 dollars, really?? When the parasols are there and are a necessity. Final let down, we got very sun burned having sat under our very expensive parasols for a few hours, they are dangerous and do not provide shade even though they look as if they do. Sitting by the pool on weekends and Friday's is unbelievably noisy as next door have a beach prosciutto running to compete with Surfcombers music, so sadly so unrelaxing we came back to our rooms to escape noise. Disappointed for the cost.

Hotel was prettier than I expected.  Room was clean and cozy...King size bed was very comfortable....loved the bathroom.  Loved the bar in the lobby. The size of the hotel was perfect.....not too small....not too big...felt like personalized service. Pool/beach area was beautiful.

We go out of our way to stay at Kimpton hotels to begin with, but this service team was exceptional even for Kimpton standards. The entire concierge team of Camilla, Mark and Chase provided high touch, friendly, and genuine service from check in to check out. Olivier Gil and the rest of the beach team were attentive and friendly, making our beach day beautifully comfortable.   Beyond the service, the smaller size of the hotel and the location south of the larger properties gave the beach a more intimate feel, and the on-property food and beverage was fantastic.  We cannot wait to return!

At first sight, the hotel looks a bit dated. But a second look reveals interesting decor details and a very cosy environment.  We really enjoyed our stay here with the family (children 6 and 8). As with every hotel in this area, the rooms are a bit cramped. But you don't spend much time there, so it is quickly forgotten. The pool and beach access are nice and clean.  The service, however, is what makes this hotel stand out.  After two days, the hotel almost feels like a bed and breakfast where the staff know and treat you on a very personal level.  We really enjoyed our stay. 10/10 would do again!

Stayed here for about a week with my boyfriend our 2 girls and 3 additional girls. Rooms were average size, bathroom was average. Mini bar was stocked and snacks for purchase in the room. Prices were only a dollar or two more than in the store which is great for the convenience. Pool is open 24 hours which was a huge plus with direct access to the beach. Foxi at the pool was great getting us whatever we and our girls needed.

Wow, I was so pleased and impressed with this hotel from every aspect. My girlfriends and I couldn't agree more that our experience at this hotel will only lead us to come back to this one. They provided the most top notch service and had extremely friendly staff. Everything was clean, the food was delicious, the drinks were amazing. We had a cabana on the beach everyday and they made sure we had the best time and we sure did because of them! I Will never stay anywhere else! So impressed with this hotel from head to toe.

We came here for a bachelorette party over a long weekend and had a flawless stay! The location can't be beat- right on the beach and in the heart of all the Miami hot spots. Rooms were impeccable, front desk staff was extremely accommodating, Social Club for brunch was delicious...but most thankful for the amazing staff on the beach since this is where we spent most of our time. Laz, Neyla and Oliver were our BFF's by the end of the trip with our drinks and cabana ready to go before we even sat down. It was hard coming back to reality after this trip, so need to start planning my next trip back ASAP!

First time at this hotel. Friendly staff.  Resort is generally tidy.  Rooms are pretty average and don't have a view. Bathroom absolutely tiny but everything worked ok. Comfy beds.  Room service was just a joke - amongst all of us staying at the hotel, no-one ever got what they ordered: wrong food, incomplete order, no cutlery etc. Bar and restaurant are nice enough. Pool area is pleasant, good cabanas, direct beach access. All of the main shops and bars/restaurants of S Beach are on the doorstep. It's a good value hotel so don't expect much "wow" and you'll have a nice enough stay.

We stayed here for a week in March, and we just loved the location on the beach, but also close to the Ocean drive and the hustle and bustle South Beach is known for. Even though the hotel is in middle of everything, we did not find it noisy. We had a suite, and the room was perfect for us four. The pool area is nice and casual, and the kids loved it. Good breakfast, especially the waffles. We also loved the burger in the pool bar. Free wine for an hour in the afternoon is a nice and social gesture you shouldn't miss. If we go back to Miami, we will choose this hotel before Fontaine Bleu. Good value for money and very helpful staff!

We had the best time! Amazing service, loved the pool area, free wine at 4pm and the restaurant was also so yummy! It was very central spot in Miami Beach - I would highly recommend. We spent alot of time by the pool and it was so relaxing and drinks were served to us along with a great menu of food. The staff were also so friendly to provide suggestions for local great food and drink off the tourist path which we enjoyed immensely. We will be back!!
