Not knowing Miami I researched Tripadvisor for hotels and Kimpton looked like a very good choice. The Kimpton is a quaint boutique hotel with lots of charm and a relaxed atmosphere with pleasant an attentive service. We had 2 courtyard rooms which were both spacious and had easy access to the pool. The pool areas is very appealing with free sunbeds, towels and sun cream, and if you enjoy the beach you have instant access and also sunbeds available. The hotel is located very centrally on Collins Avenue with easy access to Lincoln Road, Ocean Drive and other interesting places. Each day the hotel has free wine tasting at 4 pm or you can enjoy happy hour at the Pool side bar. We stayed for 10 days and will must certainly use Kimpton Surfcomber next time we are in Miami

This was our second time to Miami Beach and we had stayed in this area before and wanted to try somewhere new. We are really happy we stayed at the Surfcomber!!!!! It exceeded our expectations. We were able to book an affordable rate, had a basic room but that is all we needed. The wine hour is very cool, make sure you are there for free wine! The grounds are very nice, especially the beach. It was nice to have towels, beach chairs and servers. We had the food from the outdoor bar the first night and it was very good. The location can't be beat though. Minutes from Lincoln Road mall, trendy restaurants, bars, and the boardwalk to Ocean Drive!! We would stay here again in a heartbeat!

Our second stay will try this brand of hotel in the US this month. Great consistent standards again which we really enjoyed Barbara welcomed us very well, Kate helped us when we asked to move rooms, the front rooms have a great street view but very noisy all through the night and I mean whole night, it's Miami and party time so be warned ! Much quieter at back of hotel rooms 171 was better than 150. Bedrooms modern comfy and quality beds and linen  Pool was always busy so get there early, pool bar was brilliant thank you Jesu, Gabriele and her lovely sister! Beach 2 minute walk with very comfy sun loungers, included for hotel guests. 19$ for an umbrella- why?  Would recommend the hotel  Great value for money and excellent experience  Thank you guys

We stayed here for 1 night before going on a cruise. Staff was very friendly, rooms were clean and comfortable, and the location is fantastic. We didn't get to use the pool or beach facilities, but it looked like they were great. Would definitely stay again.

After reviewing many hotels in South Beach my boyfriend and I decided to stay at The Surfcomber. Upon arrival we were instantly happy with our decision! The decor is amazing! Fun and fresh, colourful and rich and full of amazing art to keep you eyes and mind amused. It is in a great location close to everything and also right on the beach. The staff were always very friendly from beginning to end. We will definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

We stayed here for 1 night before going on a cruise. Staff was very friendly, rooms were clean and comfortable, and the location is fantastic. We didn't get to use the pool or beach facilities, but it looked like they were great. Would definitely stay again.

After reviewing many hotels in South Beach my boyfriend and I decided to stay at The Surfcomber. Upon arrival we were instantly happy with our decision! The decor is amazing! Fun and fresh, colourful and rich and full of amazing art to keep you eyes and mind amused. It is in a great location close to everything and also right on the beach. The staff were always very friendly from beginning to end. We will definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

5th or 6th year staying here and forgot my cigars at home so ordered some with express shipping. I called to see if they had arrived and we greeted with a warm welcome from Nora (I believe that was her name). She explained everything to me as far as the handling of items shipped to hotel and welcomed me and my friends back again and all of this and I'm still at the airport. If customer service is important to you, stay here..

We arrived at the hotel to find that our Oceanfront balcony room, that I booked in advance was not available, and we would be downgraded to another room.  I've been upgraded on quite a few occasions, but this was my first downgrade.  We decided to make the best of it, until the power went out at midnight....on July 4th....in sweltering heat.  Needless to say, we weren't able to sleep due to the heat.  I then had to hike down three flights of stairs with two large bags, the next morning.  I will pick another hotel on my next visit to Miami.

I don't ever write reviews but I just stayed at surfcomber for three nights and me and my girlfriend had the best time ever ... also have to give a shot out to Mira bartender at the outside bar she was the best ,made great drinks , good convo and her service was untouchable ... I can't wait to go back and we will not stay anywhere else... kimpton just got two new karma members

The hotel os really nice, though the rooms are very small. Everything is expensive, they write you get a complimentary breakfast. What you get is fruit and a Croissant. But they have wine hour, wine hour is 1 hour of free wine. I noted that 3-5 staff members where standing guarding the wine and when approaching them to get a glass they seemed as you annoyingly disturbed their internal joking. Free wine is nice, but why use 3-5 persons to disguise it? It seems the hotel owner should consider that the staff number is to high if so many persons have time to guard the wine for one hour.

Never stayed at this hotel in south beach before and I am so glad we gave it a try.  Excellent service by far.  Friendliest staff and extremely accommodating  to our needs.  Loved the music around pool.  Having games was also alot of fun.  The tiki bar outside was perfect for either lunch or an awesome frozen concoction.  The restaurant inside was amazing too. Can't wait to go back again!

While this hotel is older style it has everything you could ask for.  If you want 5 star don't go but what it lacks is more than compensated in the hotel staff and location.  Couldn't recommend the staff highly enough.  The hotel is located adjacent to the beach so it's just out the gate and a few steps and you're on the beach.  Situated amongst a vast array of restaurants and central to everything.  Would definitely stay again.  Loved it!!!

Love this hotel!!!  The pool service was the best we have ever had!!  Foxi took great care of us from beginning to end  and our waitress Julia was so attentive and tooksuch great care of us!!  We love this place and will definitely be back!! Nice relaxing day!!

Our family (including my 60-ish parents) and our two kids (12 and 2) visited in April. Absolutely loved the pool scene. Friendly staff with nice extra touches - flavored water and sun protection products. Late afternoon wine was also a super nice surprise! Beach service is awesome. Can't wait to return sans kiddos.

This is my second time to the Surfcomber Hotel and it won't be my last! Wine hour is something to look forward to each night. The staff is personable and attentive. Our room was clean and comfortable. I love the pool at this hotel, many chairs with cabana options and lots of sunlight! Having extra sunscreen for guests and cold water is such a small, but nice touch! The location is amazing-on one side you have South Beach and on the other you have Lincoln Rd (Shops, Restaurants, Nightlife) Also, a short walk to Ocean Drive. I never had to Uber while I stayed here because everything was so close. Overall, awesome experience, friendly staff, and location is prime. I look forward to returning next year!

We arrived on the busy Memorial Day weekend. My car was handled efficiently and kindly as was my reservation. I was greeted by name and a follow up text asking if I needed anything. The room was quite comfortable. All staff greeted us with a smile and were helpful. The property was beautiful with unique decorative touches throughout the property. What really made the vacation was the attentive and sincere service from all staff memebers from the room attendants, pool staff, restaurant staff and reception team.

The staff is super kind and accommodating. Food and drinks were incredible, and the location of he hotel is perfect! The pool area was very relaxing and clean. I will definitely be staying at the Surfcomber whenever I travel to Miami!

Stayed here for 3 nights for a girls weekend. Very clean. Great food and drinks. Foxie at the pool was extremely helpful and nice. Great location.  Only downside was the loud music at the hotel next door. Very odd that the halls to the rooms are so dark.

This hotel is perfectly situated in Miami Beach. You are on the beach on one side, and have restaurants and shopping on the other side.  The rooms are a bit small, but you're not staying in your room when you're in Miami, so who cares.   The staff was friendly and helpful. Breakfast was good. The pool area was beautiful and tropical.  As I said earlier, your right on the beach. The hotel has free sun beds for its guests.   I would definitely come back

First the good.  The hotel staff are amazing. The concierge and everyone else were great! The problem with the hotel is it's dated. Kimpton tried to polish this old Ramada as best they could but it still comes off like a polished Ramada.  Rate was very good though and I am not complaining.

I just returned from my birthday weekend at the Surfcomber, what an incredible experience this chic hotel had it all including a 24 hour heated pool. From the front desk which included superstars Nora, Lacey,and Vanessa along with Chase our fantastic concierge. To Jesus at the pool bar Hightide ,making refreshing passion fruit mojitos.to my fantastic bday dinner at my new favorite spot the Social Club( thank you Andy)  the staff really went out of their way to make it a special occasion. Last but not least Valerio, Nayla and Patrick at the beach made it the spot to be at. GREAT HOTEL ,GREAT location. Thank you Surfcomber. Even got to meet Sean the GM .GREAT Team! I will be back.

This was a fantastic experience from the moment I valet my car, to the excellent front desk assistance and support to the meeting of numerous kind employees !! I will most definitely stay at the Surfcomber next visit. Thank you to the entire staff for accommodating me without a room reservation. AWESOME EVENING !! Best Regards, Byron Malpass

We stayed for three nights and had a great time. Chase, Katie, and the rest of the concierge staff made sure we were taken care of and were always happy to recommend food, drinks, and places to see across Miami. The pool and beach staff always found us and our friends a great spot even at the busiest times.   We were lucky enough to land a room with a huge, private sun deck attached, which was absolutely worth it and we cannot recommend it enough.   Also don't forget to sign up for the Kimpton rewards program because it's free and you get some nice freebies when you check in.

We stayed here one night on the way back from the Keys.  We wanted to stay in a vintage hotel in SoBe and are Kimpton fans to this was a good fit.  It's an interesting building with a great pool and beach area.  Service is up to the Kimpton standard with nice bars and food.    We were let down by some building problems that required a different room type than originally booked, maybe part of the joy of a vintage building.  The front desk did find an okay replacement, still a nice room, and properly discounted the bill.

Free Wine Hour! Great Happy Hour! Quiet rooms facing inward towards jungle walkway. Beach party on Saturdays! Great staff especially Mark at the front desk and Cano at the Pool! Get full umbrella at beach for 25 dollars for the day it's the best. Outdoor area has great activities like ping pong. Great choice to be on beach but not pay for the ritz. We would definitely go back. It's was so much fun!

Hotel was overhaul good, what let it down was the dirty stained mattress and the top sheet the duvet was in (it kept falling out during the night and I would wake up with the duvet that everyone else had slept with on me. We had upgraded to a court yard room. The hi tide pool bar/restaurant was great and had a few really good lunches there and cocktails. You can also use the beach as you get free beds from hotel and there is service down there. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel bar service was good and although we never ate in the restaurant we were told by other guests that it was good. I think it is more of a young peoples hotel than families.

Chase, Katie, and the rest of the concierge staff made sure we were taken care of and were always happy to recommend food, drinks, and places to see across Miami. The pool and beach staff always found us and our friends a great spot even at the busiest times.   We were lucky enough to land a room with a huge, private sun deck attached, which was absolutely worth it and we cannot recommend it enough.   Also don't forget to sign up for the Kimpton rewards program because it's free and you get some nice freebies when you check in.

We stayed here one night on the way back from the Keys.  We wanted to stay in a vintage hotel in SoBe and are Kimpton fans to this was a good fit.  It's an interesting building with a great pool and beach area.  Service is up to the Kimpton standard with nice bars and food.    We were let down by some building problems that required a different room type than originally booked, maybe part of the joy of a vintage building.  The front desk did find an okay replacement, still a nice room, and properly discounted the bill.

Free Wine Hour! Great Happy Hour! Quiet rooms facing inward towards jungle walkway. Beach party on Saturdays! Great staff especially Mark at the front desk and Cano at the Pool! Get full umbrella at beach for 25 dollars for the day it's the best. Outdoor area has great activities like ping pong. Great choice to be on beach but not pay for the ritz. We would definitely go back. It's was so much fun!

Hotel was overhaul good, what let it down was the dirty stained mattress and the top sheet the duvet was in (it kept falling out during the night and I would wake up with the duvet that everyone else had slept with on me. We had upgraded to a court yard room. The hi tide pool bar/restaurant was great and had a few really good lunches there and cocktails. You can also use the beach as you get free beds from hotel and there is service down there. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel bar service was good and although we never ate in the restaurant we were told by other guests that it was good. I think it is more of a young peoples hotel than families.

Beautiful location, so central, fantastic garden open to the ocean, the staff is so helpful and friendly staff. Food is excellent too, but as it is dynamic, young, one cannot expect total stillness.Thank you

We had such attentive service and such a great time at Surfcomber. Jessica on the beach was one of the shining stars taking our trip from great to awesome!  She was on it, accommodated our needs and requests, and was just fun to hang out with while we were celebrating our friend. Much love, and props to Jessica and the serving staff at Surfcomber!

This is one of the best hotels along the Miami Beach with lovely swimming pool and cabanas to rest also direct access to the beach, it is not a private beach. A luxury hotel and some good food also family friendly.

Couldn't even stay at our own pool because it was over taken by a raging party for outsiders all weekend. We stayed out on the boardwalk and rented their bikes all day, which was my highlight of the hotel. Rooms are small. Have stayed at a few Kimptons before. Wasn't the best one.

Girls trip to Miami was a hit thanks to this resort and the staff. Rooms were average but it's Miami so it's okay!!! The location, pool, beach and service was top notch! Happy hour is pretty generous too. Special shout out to the concierge, Chase Mitchell, who was lovely in helping us sort our car rental & beach bed :) and to all the beach folks who hustled out there in the Miami heat. Thanks for the stay Kimpton, we'll be back :)

The Hotel is situated in South Beach right on the Beach it was wonderful very nice resorts and beautiful pool bar and pool and Cabana the rooms were Excellent and service was very good all staff very friendly from door man to waitress in restaurant the pool bar the servers were excellent the pool attendants were amazing so friendly and they make you feel like home. All staff were wonderful the Wine Cocktail was amazing very nice and the location was perfect I would strongly recommend this Hotel either for Business or Leisure .

The reception, especially Katie was so welcoming and helpful. The amenities from beach loungers with umbrellas to having sunscreen at the beach and the pool was great. All the employees are so gracious and helpful. We ate at both the outside cafe and in the restaurant and food and service was good. Bikes are available at the hotel. The daily wine reception was appreciated.

The Social Club has excellent food, and we loved our server Kristina! Would definitely not hesitate to return :)

I love that I'm greeted at the door by Jairo, Gorgeous Dorgis and their crew with smiles, welcomed at the reception desk with an exuberant hello and no matter where you are on the property it's "how can I help you?". Stayed for a long weekend. Nice clean Hotel.Two low wings of rooms on either side of the property form a nice manicure corridor from the lobby to the pool. Picturesque pool and surrounding property.  Sunscreen provided a great Plus as we did not check any bags on the airline. Beach is right across the boardwalk where there are ample chairs and umbrellas. Lunch drinks and snacks can be delivered for a fair price. Lunches are excellent.  What sets this hotel experience apart is the friendliness a efficiency of the staff including the outstanding concierge and front desk service, the pool and Beach attendants as well as the restaurant staff. All were very nice and very helpful.   Will certainly be back

I couldn't ask for better service. Will definitely have future team meeting here.

Hotel with excellent location. Comfortable room - staff very courteous and attentive. Walking distance from shops and restaurants on Lincoln Road and direct access to beach and boardwalk. High marks for front desk (Katie and Mark), concierge and parking assistant (Camilo).

Location, staff, room, cuisine, outdoor amenities, layout, are all A pluses when it comes to the Surfcomber MIAMI in my book I!!  Have been to this location many times, because of the convenience of getting to the beach and other areas, the friendly professional staff and the great drinks and food that they serve.  I will be back...

Wonderful and helpful staff. Clean och good standard. Nice pool, you get complimentary sunscreen, towels by the pool and beach chairs on the beach which is only like 100m from the pool area. Close to beach and Lincoln rd, also only a short walk from ocean drive. You can borrow bikes at the hotel, free of charge and between 4-5 pm there is social hour with free wine for the hotel guests. Only downside may be the breakfast, which is often complimentary but it only consists of toast and a small amount of fruits +coffee/Tea. Would however highly recommend to stay at this hotel!

This property had an old California beach side vibe. The rooms were  updated but still didn't feel fresh, the hallways were dark(like most Kimptons) but it seemed in contrast to the beach scene. The main ares did not have the typical relaxing Kimpton areas- they felt contrived. I think the staff are overwhelmed by the amount of traffic and at the pool we had to ask for beverage service and never had a second because by the time we could reconnect we wanted our bill. The pool scene is more 20 something than luxurious.

Excellent hotel near beach. Nice pool and bar Good rooms, nice area, valetparking. Excellent staff. Free coffee in the morning and wine in the afternoon. On the beach. Good price/ quality. In the nice , art deco part of Miami beach

The cabana for my friends and family was amazing. The food was delicious and having the beach right there made the experience memorable. The strawberry mojito pitcher was soooo good. The pool was fun and clean and the games were enjoyable.

Total bliss! Had late lunch at the Restaurant and cabana service on the beach. So relaxing and very accommodating staff; makes for an incredible experience. Make sure to order the burger from High Tide - so much flavor and is sure to satisfy!!

The "superior" room had a huge noise from the restaurant's hood (it sounded like there was a helicopter inside the room), horrible showers, unprepared staff, the concierge did not solve problems or assist with anything (always with the speech "there is nothing I can do, sir "), the carpet was constantly wet and smelled musty, the phones did not work properly. The impression is that they hired young people only to give an air of “joviality” to the hotel. However, you must deliver a minimally decent service to a hotel of that level. High point was the location, the maintenance staff always helpful and efficient, though expensive, valet service. A disappointment.

lovely hotel with the best staff I have ever encountered on a hotel stay.  Every member of staff was helpful, attentive and pleasant. They left us a lovely bottle of champagne to celebrate our 24th anniversary.  pros - great location, superb staff, great garden and pool area with direct access to beach, great wine hour in evening and coffee in morning. cons - small bedrooms, small cramped bathroom and very dark hallways. Our room room looked directly onto a wall so no view at all and I also found hotel prices extremely expensive - $23 for two bottles of beer and $12 for two small bottles of water while relaxing in the pool bar.  would definitely stay here again though!

What a fantastic hotel and lovely staff. They went above and beyond our expectations. We were given our rooms early, treated like royalty for the weekend trip and felt very welcome.   The rooms are updated and very modern and clean as is the whole hotel.   The pool and beach are steps away and exquisite. We celebrated a friends 40th birthday and had a fantastic weekend.

Ordered yogurt granola and a side of fruit to go ( so we could sit outside) this is what I got!? No bowl, no side of fruit?! These are little condiment size cups...not impressed, would not hurt to go a little out of your way for guest.

No complaints really.  We loved our room #243…balcony with ocean view (they don’t have many balconies).  While the ocean view is minimal, the room has a very large deck with 2 lounge chairs and 2 rocking chairs (see pictures attached).  And I loved that I could smoke out on the deck.  Bathroom is small but manageable.  It’s a great hotel if you don’t want any pretentiousness.  You feel comfortable here and not out of place like some of the other swankier hotels.  All in all, we were happy.

This hotel was great.  Staff was amazing very helpful.  Chase and Katie at the front desk were amazing.  The hotel was very clean and everyone was very accommodating  The water with the fruit in the lobby and by the pool was very refreshing.  Lucas in the restaurant was the best waiter.  Very attentive.  The pool staff was also great.   The hotel is in perfect location.  Walking distance to all the shopping and restaurant's  including Lincoln Road.  Also this hotel is right on the beach you go out the back door and there you are best of both worlds the pool or the beach.  HIGHLY RECCOMEND THIS HOTEL

The Surfcomber is one of the top hotels on Southbeach.  This is my second year staying there.  The staff is phenomenal.  They go out of there way to make you feel welcome.  All my requests were fulfilled and with a smile.  The restaurant was awesome.  The waiter Lucas was prompt and very polite.  I'm booked at the same place for next year and can't wait.  It close to Lincoln an easy walk.  Close to Ocean drive another easy walk.  All restaurants are close.  A big Walgreens just a stones throw away.  All the comforts of home.  Did I mention they have a happy hour with free wine?  It's a win, win.  Families with children are welcome.

Great outdoor tiki bar at the Surfcomber. Had a blast with Jesus and Omar the bartenders outside. Stayed at a hotel a block away while another couple with us stayed here and we preferred their tiki bar better!

Very stylish hotel; extremely friendly! Comfortable beds. Bathroom was on the small side but did have a place to put your amenities. The pool is very nice. My only recommendation would be to have an extra person helping the guy down at the beach. We had to wait a while to get help for getting our chairs but he was very nice. You could clearly tell he needed some help.  He was working as hard as he could.  Our refrigerator was iced over and all the items were hot. We called downstairs and they quickly sent someone up to help us and replace the refrigerator. I am not sure of his name but he was SO friendly and had such a wonderful attitude. He was from the Turks islands. 😊

We loved everything about this hotel. The staff was amazing!! Katie and Chase at the front desk were were a pleasure. In fact every staff member there seemed to be genuinely committed to customer satisfaction.  When it comes to the location and the hotel appeal, it just cannot be beat.  I highly recommend this hotel if you want the true South Beach experience.  The hotel is a perfect blend of historic beach hotel with contemporary comforts.  We can't wait to visit again!

I won a nights stay and dinner at this resort as part of a silent auction for charity.  When I contacted them, they assured me that regardless of the expiration date that they would honor it.  When I came in and discussed it with them once again they said they would honor it.  When it came time to book, they very rudely dismissed me and refused to honor the certificate that I paid $350 for.  This was an enormous waste of time and money, I even had email proof of my correspondence with the past manager.  Not just poor customer service, but a lack of living up to an obligation to a charitable cause.  Pretty shameful.

Hotel employees at front desk are good but as for hotel, really nothing to brag about. Rooms are plain, except for lobby and bar there's really no where to go in hotel. Location is great. I don't think I will ever stay there again unless I get some great last minute deal. You can stay somewhere else for half the price and enjoy twice as much. By the way "management" it wouldn't hurt to get someone to open a door as people drag their luggage in.  On a more funny note, a question for other guests...."How many times did you drop things in the toilet because of those horribly designed bathrooms??" Lolololol!

We love Kimpton properties and the surfcomber did NOT disappoint. Despite being under pretty significant construction (part of the pool, and some of the grounds); our stay was great.  Kimpton staff cannot be beat. Chase, their concierge was particularly helpful. We had a great breakfast at the restaurant and their bar tender was hoot. We will be back!

I had a wonderful four-night stay here.  When I was first given a room that smelled like smokers had been it, they immediately changed me to a room that was better laid out and that smelled fresh. The lobby is open and airy with a large common area where they offer free coffee in the morning and complimentary wine in the afternoon.  The patio and pool area are wonderful venues for relaxing and enjoying personal time or group activities.  There is a beach section with chairs, towels and umbrellas available. The staff was very helpful and eager to be of service. It is within easy walking distance of many attractions besides the beach: Lincoln Street Mall, Espanola Way, etc.    I thoroughly enjoyed my stay here and would definitely come back.

This hotel is great.  The staff is fabulous .  We love Luis at the bar and Sabrina.  They have a great happy hour.  $5 cosmos  What could be better. This is a boutique hotel so it is very intimate but has a lot of amenities Beach chairs, complimentary sunscreen and water at the pool. The beach is awesome There is a resort fee but it is worth it The rooms are small but comfortable You feel welcome here inline some very snotty hotels nearby like the Delano and the SLS Do. Not eat or stay at the Delano or SLS We love love the sisters at the pool bar too

The staff is extremely friendly in this hotel. The amenities are great and location is perfect. Marlon was friendly during check in and check out as he helped us with our bags. Olivior was very accomodating and attentive at the beach, and recommended a few great spots. Mark and Chase were the first two to greet us when we checked in and set a very warm and welcoming environment. Overall a great success! Will be coming back in the future!

What an awesome hotel. Great pool, room, and vibe. Staff was above and beyond. Marlon was AMAZING  and helpful with anything and everything we needed. Foxi, the pool man, really made us feel at home and helped us with whatever we needed related to sun, fun, and beyond. Thank you for a great stay!!!!!!!!!!!!

Can't say a single bad thing about this hotel. We stayed here during spring break with a group of 15 girls and the hotel did everything they could to make us feel welcome. The rooms were good, the atmosphere was fun, but the staff members really made this hotel so great. Gladys always gave us great recommendations on places to eat, party, and visit. She even got us VIP passes to one of the clubs (thanks Gladys!!!). Of course, all of the other staff members were also extremely friendly and accommodating. The hotel was in a great location and we were able to walk to most places. If I ever find myself back in Miami I will definitely be staying here!

The hotel has a laid-back atmosphere. It was nice beachfront hotel with easy access to restaurants and shops. Very convenient location, minutes from Lincoln Road Mall. This amazing art deco boutique hotel is one of my favorite get-aways.  It's in a prime location of South Beach so that you can walk to most any attraction.  Located directly on the beach.  Super clean property with helpful and friendly staff.  It's priced much better than similar hotels that are just next door.  The pool is a perfect place to spend a relaxing day with an attentive staff to pamper you.  If you want to venture down to the beach, again the attentive staff will setup your beach chair and deliver cocktails.    The restaurant in the lobby has amazing breakfast and lunch meals.

Mark at the front desk was exceptional  Katie was also very sweet  The guy from Josh --- MAybe from NC  Was Amusing too  The hotel itself great location  Clean rooms  Pool was excellent and chairs on the beach and beach staff were also very helpful  Jordan was great too Cheers

Great place to spend a trip to Miami Beach. My second time here for a girls' weekend and I can't wait for a third! Beautiful pool (loved the swan float!), brilliant location, good service, clean rooms. Loved the wine hour as ever, and then how this segues into Happy Hour 5 for $5 which we enjoyed every night. Shout outs to Chase and Camila on the fromt desk who were super helpful and charming, and as last time to Foxi by the pool. The touches are so sweet - iced water everywhere, free coffee in the morning, free bikes and sun screen and the gorgeous green tea scent in the lobby. IKt feels homely and special at the same time and that is a rare combo. Thanks to the Kimpton! We had a riot again and can't wait to come back.

Loved the pool, attentive service and nice amenities.  Would definitely return.  Location is prime and hotel is in great condition.  Room on the smaller side, but beautifully appointed and large bathroom.   Foxi took great care off us!

I really like the Surfcomber. It is located right in the thick of the South Beach scene, but it is a quieter, more laid back place. The rooms are small but very cute, decorated in 1950s furniture. The pool and beach were gorgeous. And the pool attendants had awesome customer service.  Overall, it was very comfortable place to stay.   My only complaint is about the on-site restaurant. Service when we went there was exceptionally slow, and it was expensive for its quality. I wouldn't worry about this too much though, there are plenty of better restaurants in easy walking distance.

Stayed here for a few nights. Small rooms but bery clean and very well appointed. They offer a wine selection at no charge every afternoon for one hour in the lobby. The staff is super friendly. If u valet ur car here make sure u give them plenty of time to retrieve it. It took almost an hour on one sunday afternoon. The restaurants are featuring excellent food. The pool and pre beach area is well staffed and the service includes sunscreen of varying degrees SPF. Neat little detail in case one forgot that stuff in the room or at home. Great music poolside and near the beach, not too loud, just right.

While enjoying the amazing pool we were wowed constantly by Carolina! She was outstanding and made the trip even better than before, particularly for my wife who is a fellow Peruvian. The gal needs a raise! She hustled back and forth all day and that smile of hers (along with her perky attitude) never faltered! We will be back to stay at the Surfcomber next time we are in town, purely to be closer to this gal!

I stayed a couple of nights at the Surfcomber and was very happy with the property, location, cleanliness and, especially, service. I was made to feel at home from the moment someone opened the front door, to Katie checking me in (kudos to Katie--great attitude, friendly, funny). The facilities were very clean and comfortable. Access to the beach was great. I would definitely return and recommend this hotel for anyone who wants first class service in Miami Beach.

I was so impressed with my stay at the Surfcomber! Right on the beach and in the heart of South Beach. I was especially impressed that I received a text after my arrival asking if there was anything I needed and just text. I was walking to a restaurant and forgot the name. I texted and they gave me the name and directions. It was a fantastic place. Everyone cheerful and very helpful. I will be back!!!

I highly recommend the Surfcomber for a fun, eclectic getaway destination. Great location and very accommodating. We had three rooms for 11 of my best girlfriends! The hotel is so fun and different with their decor and amazing yellow rocking chairs. Camilla went above and beyond to make our experience this weekend an unforgettable one. Beds are comfortable and rooms are clean, everyone that works their is very friendly and helpful. I can't wait to go back.

Extremely friendly and helpful, and happy, beach front services, cabanas,  loungers, food, drinks, etc.  Olivier Gil and Nara were especially great!  And, we were staying at a neighboring hotel, and they treated us like their own guests anyway!  Cabana was great fronting the ocean, full service, awesome.   Also Olivier gave honest and thoughtful recommendations for our night out.

She is so professional, friendly and is paying a perfect attention to all of her guests! You can be happy having her in your hotel! Her warm smile makes the day!

I would definitely stay at the Surfcomber again. The location was great!  Shops and restaurants were within walking distance. We were there celebrating my husband's birthday and it was our first time in Miami, the staff was awesome Chase & Camilla were very helpful with suggestions for restaurants and things to do.

I would definitely recommend the surf comber over any of the seemingly similar hotels in this section of south beach.  The service is better, with very friendly and attentive staff.  There's a free wine tasting every night, there's bikes you can borrow for free any time, and the pool is superior in layout/size/sun exposure to many of the next door properties.  Overall, if you're looking for an upscale south beach hotel without traipsing into the $4-500 a night territory, Surfcomber will deliver a noticeably better experience than the competition.  We just booked our second trip here in March.  Can't wait!

We stayed here for a night before leaving for a cruise. The hotel is in the heart of South Beach, with easy access to the beach and has a great pool area. It wasn't too busy during the week and easy to get a chair. We love staying at Kimpton hotels and this hotel didn't disappoint. Gladys at the front desk went the extra mile to make my fiancée's stay wonderful!

Super Service on the beach! And in general the staff is very friendly, helpful and welcoming!  My favourite servants so far are Neyla, Patrick and Jordan!   The location is perfect, directly on the beach, Oceans Drive and Lincoln Road close by.   Perfect for party people as there is always some music playing. Especially the hotel next to Surfcomber has often very loud music.   The pool area is awsome with many different chairs and lounges and many games to spend some lazy days.  Rooms are quite small but nice and clean.  All in all great hotel!

Great lifestyle hotel right on the beach. I've been here a couple of times and it's always been perfect. The standard rooms are quite small but really nice and trendy. Suites are great with a generous terrace. The pool are is nicely decorated, there are always enough sunbeds and cabanas for groups. The food in is good everywhere, but rather pricey. At the beach you get free sunbeds (umbrellas 25$), wifi and they serve drinks and food. We always enjoyed great service at the beach, especially Neyla and Patrick are very welcoming, kind and always with a smile :) thank you very much and "hasta pronto :D"

Great welcome, nice hotel. Perfect south beach location with direct access to beach. Around the corner from the Lincoln Street Mall. Free Wifi all over. Free wine hour. Hip staffmembers which try to assist in every possible way and helpful. Comfy rooms, small bathrooms but strong water pressure in the shower. Expensive minibar. Real party hotel with lots of young guests which enjoy their South Florida vacation. On the noisy side, hotel infrastructure poorly sound-proofed  and loud volume party music are common. Had a very pleasant stay and felt comfortable at all times.

Had a great 4 day stay here. Location is the best. Beautiful pool. Attentive staff. Chase at the front desk was especially helpful. Happy hour food and martinis are really good. Direct access to beach here is sooo much nicer than anything on Ocean. Free loaner bikes are great. Highly recommended.

The Surfcomber is all about location. The hotel facilities are nice but nothing special. The pool are is nice and big. The hotel was very nice. We did have an issue when we first arrived as we requested city view and went to our room and saw the next hotel wall over. We returned to the front desk and with a little arguing and having to prove our reservation of a city view room we finally got one but had to wait for it.  I found the rooms overpriced for what we got. The staff everywhere on hotel grounds were absolutely great and very friendly. I found the hallways extremely dark and the elevator very slow.

The Surfcomber Hotel staff including front desk people Katie, Mark and the two mangers were super friendly throughout our stay.  Property is clean and is located in a prime section of South Miami Beach. The swimming pool area and beach are within steps of your room.  Restaurants and shopping on Lincoln and Collins Avenues are real close.  The rooms were very modern and clean.  The 1 hour complimentary happy hour is always great time to meet other travelers.  Best of all, the hotel loves dogs!

Valet parking available, nice Concierge, and good service. The hotel is perfectly located in Miami Beach; close to Lincoln road, with swimming pool area, but also its beach, to enjoy Miami Beach. The staff is very friendly, the food is good. No laundry through night service, but board and Iron (steam making) are available in each room. The concierge can with pleasure propose you what you forgot at home (if any). Beds are perfect. The only negative point is the view if you don't choice a room with view on the sea. For the same reason, the rooms are dark.

No matter your reason for visiting Miami Beach, please consider the Surfcomber.  From the front desk staff to housekeeping to restaurant servers, we felt truly welcomed and appreciated.  We had a comfortable king room with all of the amenities and anything we needed was easily found.  The pool area is of special note.  Gorgeous, relaxing and fun are just a few comments.  The grounds are great for singles, couples, and families... everyone will enjoy! The location is perfect for whatever you want to do while in Miami Beach.  Don't miss it!

I traveled with my husband because he had a conference. We brought our small dog because the surf comber is so dog friendly! Every morning I had to get up early to walk the dog and Lacey and Keith were always there with a smile on their face to welcome me; even at 3:30 or 4:00 in the morning. Our dog loved walking in the secluded tropical courtyard which has grass and sand surfaces. The beach is right there as well as the boardwalk. We even went for a swing in the hammock, which was very relaxing.

There are probably nicer hotels on the strip  for a lot more money, but the location is perfect and the accommodations are more than adequate. Cool bar and walking distance to any of the other hotels you might want to visit.

Our family loves Kimpton and we really love the Surfcomber!  Thank you for a great visit in December.  We especially loved meeting Luis in the pool area.  He was fantastic giving us great dinner ideas and chatting about Cuban food.  Excellent customer service.

We spent a few nights in this hotel, together with members of our family and we really enjoyed it. The location is excellent, near the beach and Lincoln Road for good shopping. There are lot of nice restaurants in the immediate neighbourhood. The hotel itself offers spacious rooms, preheated swimming pool, playground,, free wine tasting in the afternoon, free coffee/tea in the morning and hot chocolate milk in the evening. The staff was very friendly and helpful. We will be back for sure.

Stayed at the Surfcomber for our first time to Miami.  Glad we stayed here as its beautiful out by the pool, tiki bar and not overcrowded at the beach area, which had lots of space between seats unlike next door.  Rooms have small windows with updated furniture but hard to see the outside from most of the rooms on the whole street because of the old buildings I believe.  We spent most of our time outside.

Great hotel and great service!! I completely recommend it. I would only add that the few rooms with view to Collins Ave. are too noisy at times. Otherwise evrything was excellent. The decoration is nice and cosy though for some reason the corridor of the 2nd floor had a funny smell.

I love the Kimpton Hotel chain.  I was stuck overnight in Miami this past May due to weather delays on a flight so searched for a Kimpton with an available room.  I ended up staying at the Surfcomber and although it was a brief stay I had a great time.    The room was comfortable and had everything I needed.  The desk clerk heard my awful travel story and gave me a coupon for a free drink from the bar!   I love the Kimpton touches like the yoga mat in the room.  The staff goes out of their way to be accommodating.    I had brunch in the restaurant and it was great.  The beachfront and pool areas are really fun.    I'm looking forward to staying here again.

Like Art Deco? You'll love this place. Great location on Collins Avenue, easy walking distance to shops and restaurants. Nice pool, right on the beach. Very helpful staff. Nice rooms. Although a tad expensive, overall a wonderful experience. If you drive your own car (or rental), beware. Overnight parking at the hotel is about $42/night. Ouch. If you fly into Miami, take a shuttle to South Beach, save some money.

We stayed here after a lot of research and it was one of the cheaper options in south beach area. We were very impressed!!  The grounds were VERY nice.  Complimentary wine hour as well as comp bikes for the path between the beach and hotel grounds. Tons of restaurants nearby. Park at public parking on 16th ave for $16 for 24 hours. It's about 2.5 blocks away. 2 great bakeries/sandwich shops on the walk (la Provence and Rosetta). Older property that has completed great renovations. Would definitely recommend!!

We came for one night.  We called in advance for early check in, used AMEX  Fine Hotels and Resorts, FHR.  At check in the FHR did not show up, they asked me to call AMEX which I did, and they still did not show it in our reservation. As a "gesture of good will" they decided to honor it with a 3PM late check out and 75$ food credit.... What happened to 4 pm and breakfast for two plus the credit, sorry is all I got.  Room ready at 3:59 PM, so no early check in.  Room very small with "a view" of the courtyard which was some tree branches.    Room carpet, sheets, stained. The bathroom tub stained.  Really gross.    Pool very nice, location great, staff at the entrance and pool excellent.  Overall I am really trying to be generous with a 3 and really a 2.5.

We just returned from a relaxing mini-cation at the Surfcomber which has a great vibe and unbeatable location.  Friendly staff, beautiful pool area with lots of lounges and seating options -- even at high season -- makes this a great choice.  Evening happy hours, morning coffee are thoughtful touches.  Drawbacks are a very slow kitchen with orders coming out at different times, incomplete servings, hallways so dark you cannot see when you come in from daylight, and an elevator that is beyond musty.  We nixed happy hour because the 'wings' would take 45 minutes (read one hour).  But it's a place where you can kick back and relax, and the staff is wonderful. We would stay there again in a heartbeat.

I love this hotel every time I stay. The atmosphere is so relaxed and everyone makes you feel at home in their sunny playground.  We have two young girls and the pool area is amazing.  They put towels on chairs for you, food service and a lovely heated pool.  Luis took care of us each day by the pool.  Making sure we had fresh towels and anything else we needed throughout the day,  he even found ice cream for my girls, that they don't even have it on the menu.  This makes vacation with family actually relaxing!  Gold to me.  Delicious Food and drink by the pool.  My girls stayed in the water pretty much all day. Ahhhhh

Our only issues are with the restaurant and the need for a bit of maintenance/updating of the property.

In general, Kimpton does a great job... keep up the good work!

Surfcomber provides good value and friendly service in a prime location.  The pool and beachfront are definitely the highlight- trendy but not overcrowded and always had plenty of friendly bartenders and waitresses available.  The hotel itself is a low rise art deco building, with a cool vibe in the lobby, restaurant and pool area.  The rooms are small but tidy.

I live near this hotel and my family and groups of friends come here almost every year for winter rest and relaxation.  I don't review every time but I can honestly say every time the place is great.  Every staff member is friendly, from check in to background maintenance workers met on the elevator.  We spent a lot of time at the pool, staff member Luis took great care of us every day whether we needed sun or shade.  Foxy was also helpful.  As was the High Tide food staff.  This is a great place to stay right in the heart of south beach.  Thank You Surfcomber!!

Thanks Maria Fancucci,  Foxi, Matt and Andy for treating us like royalty!  We loved our cabana on the beach,  the delicious food and excellent service.   Our rooms were perfect and the staff was gracious.   We will be back!

We stayed at the Surfcomber in summer 2014 and when we planned our trip to Miami Beach for December 2016 we immediately booked Surfcomber again as we had such a great time before. The hotel is still great with its amazing pool and access to the beach, and the lobby and restaurant are still cool, well designed spaces...  ...but the rooms and corridors to the rooms are getting a bit tired and, during our visit, the hallways smelled really badly of fried food. Service at the front desk was OK but the guys at the pool were amazing and couldn't have been more helpful. The free coffee in the morning was very welcome and was great quality. Overall still a great property but to continue justifying the price the rooms and hallways need a refresh.

Excellent visit to Miami and the Surfcomber Hotel. Luis took care of all our needs. Family reunion with 16 people can be challenging but he handled it with such ease. Set up the cabana and chairs for everyone and made sure we were comfortable and all needs were met. The oceanfront suite was the perfect size for people to hang out before dinner. Wine hour and bikes were a really nice addition. Kids enjoyed the beach and pool. Nice to get away from the cold temperatures in TX.

The hotel was quite nice, except that the air conditioning units on the roof weren't enclosed and soundproofed, and constantly emitted a loud, siren-like noise. It could be heard with the guestroom windows closed (forget opening them and enjoying the salt air), and was particularly loud in the courtyard. A light in the bathroom that wasn't on the same switch as the fan also would have been nice.

We stayed here in Dec 2015 and were so pleasantly surprised by the level of service and amenities that we re-booked nearly immediately. Unfortunately a year later some of my most favorite touches were no longer offered. In 2015 we were offered a welcome glass of sparkling wine upon arrival (so needed after a rough week at work!), and enjoyed the lively pool atmosphere each afternoon with the happy hour cocktail special and fun music.  None of this existed anymore. Such a bummer.   The rooms were still great, location awesome and super-friendly staff, but I think next time we'll explore other options with the hopes of finding some other signature touches.

What a disgusting place!! Chipped paint , filthy, gross. Filthy tub. Kimpton should be utterly ashamed!!! The room reeks of smoke and mold.Wish I could put no stars!!!! They lied about the room and refused to fix it stay away from this place at all costs!!!!!

Her recommendations regarding menu and drinks were spot on. Yuliia significantly added to our experience. My partner and I really enjoyed our time there.

Beautiful hotel! Nice decorations all over the place!! Well maintained inside and out. Room was small but quite and clean, great atmosphere!! good food at the restaurant by the bar!! and vine hour every day! All staff was great!!! Yuliy by the pool was very nice and helpful!!

This hotel is great located in Miami Beach. Very nice pool area and comfort Beach beds on the private beach area.  On the pool area you have quite cool toys to play around.  So the hotel is designed very nice, yet it could need some kind of updates as still offering an old iHome alarm clock with apples old 30 pin connector.  The highlight of the hotel is the entire staff!  Very friendly and always helpful through all areas!  Definitely will return when going back to Miami.

The rooms, pool and common areas but what really makes this hotel stand out are the great staff members.  They are all very helpful and outgoing.  If you are looking for good local recommendations, be sure to find Kate at the pool and ask her for ideas, she took the time to find out what we liked and then gave us an exceptional list-- above and beyond!  Eddie, Luis and Jose will also make your days at the pool feel pampered.  At the inside bar, look for Carr to get you the best seat in the house and set you up with an amazing cocktail.  But beware of the bottomless mimosas.... they are dangerous ;-)

We would highly recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to Miami looking to stay right in the middle of things.  We were close, walking distance to South Beach restaurants and nightlife and right on the beach path, which was beautiful.  The hotel staff was extremely helpful and friendly with whatever we asked.  The rooms and outdoor areas were clean and well maintained and the extra amenities like the coffee bar in the morning and wine hour in the evening really made this hotel a standout.  I would definitely stay here again!

Lovely hotel in the middle of South Beach. Beautiful decorations. Great customer service. All hotel staff were very nice. Room in good condition. You can dine inside and out. Pool was very nice. Our pool server Ylia was very friendly.

Breakfast is great at the restaurant and either of the bars work well for a nightcap.   Location is really ideal and the beach couldn't be prettier.

The location is perfect for those of us who love SoBe without too much glitz or noise. The staff at the front, at the pool, everywhere are friendly, helpful, and super courteous. They are supreme customer service staff. Kudos to Kimpton.   Our double beds were too soft and the pillows too hard. The room's fridge was overstuffed with junk and booze and furniture you will never use which takes up valuable space (3 adults in a room with 2 double beds). We had to ask for more towels, toilet paper, coffee, coffee maker (supposedly comes with the room but we had to have it brought to the room), and cups. But you can overlook the little things because the pool is magnificent, the drinks and food come to you swiftly and with a smile.  We cannot wait to go back!!

Makes you wonder if the specials are worth it! The hallways in the hotel are painted black and it's difficult to see where you are going-plus outdated decor, and freezing cold temps.

The corridors in the hotel is very dark, the staff a little bit to formal, not personal. But the location is very good, with large pool area and the large beach just outside the backside of the hotel.

Good location, walkable to Ocean Drive and Lincoln Rd. Young and handsome crowd enjoying chill lounge tunes by the pool. My second stay here and it still holds up.

The hotel was clean and fresh. The rooms were clean and fresh. Everything smells great has this fresh lemon smell. The faculty and staff were super helpful and always available for questions. Marion was especially great :-) Always friendly and available.

South Beach is usually the last place I refuse to stay. The Surfcomber definitely changed my mind. The experience staying here was awesome. Staff was very welcoming. Ambience of hotel was very nice. As for the room, the were very comfortable and clean. Really clean. The food was good too.  Everything is in walking distance which makes things very convenient. I would definitely stay here again.

Good hotel, great pool area and very friendly, welcoming staff.  Well located near to Lincoln Rd and just next to the SLS and Delano.  We found ourselves going out to eat rather than eating in the in-house restaurant.  Courtyard rooms have a much better view than the standard rooms which look into the wall of the neighbouring buildings.  Beach beds being included is a plus and nice that the hotels backs right out onto the beach walk.  A comfortable place to relax.  If you're coming to party then you're near enough to the action staying here, although Ocean Drive is a bit of a walk (20 mins).

Stayed one night in Miami. Rooms were very small, we barely fit in with our luggage.  no view. The pool area was rather small, but beautiful with complimentary sun screen, pool towels etc.  Location is excellent, in the middle of the Art deco district, by the ocean. The hotel has a private beach with beach chairs (2 per room). There is an extra charge  for umbrellas. Complementary wine reception in the evening was a very nice surprise.   Charge for using internet at business center very strange.

And access to the beach.  Great location, nice bar and restaurant. Eat inside or out. Really good food. Nice staff. Clean and updated room but super small. Ok for one person but book the larger room for multiple people.  Our view was the building next door.

We stayed here for a few days and it was great. The hotel was clean and bright with wonderful staff. The hotel itself is there on the beach and if you are not a beach person the pool area is lovely. In the hotel lobby every evening there was a one hour happy hour - free wine cannot beat that. In the morning there was free coffee/ tea to start your day. We decided that we will go back to that hotel when we are in Miami next year.

The hotel is in a nice location, only a couple blocks from the Lincoln mall.  Centrally located, with plenty of restaurants all within walking distance.  It had a nightly wine hour with free red or white wine.  We stayed on the 3rd floor in one of the handicapped rooms even though we didn't request/need it.  The shower was wheelchair accessible and had no lip so water went all over and made the floor slippery.  The lighting in the hall way is almost nonexistent so they are very dark.  Not a bad hotel, a bit pricy but it is Miami Beach.  Also it is only a block from Walgreens so that was nice for snacks/drinks to include beer and wine.

This is by far my favourite hotel I have ever stayed in. Our 3rd visit to this hotel and every time I am more and more impressed. Our flight landed very early and we arrived at the hotel at 9:30am and our room was already ready, which meant we could finally have a nap. One of the hotel workers noticed I had a bad cold and brought waters and cold medicine to my room without asking. I could go on and on about how wonderful the hotel and staff are at the Surfcomber, but I would be here all day. I will continue to choose Surfcomber for all my future trips to Miami.  Tip: The hotel offers bikes free of use you just have to sign them out at the front desk! Very fun.

My 2 friends and I ( the 3 Scottish Ladies called Mandelaine LOL)  stayed at the Surfcomber in Sept 2016 and the staff couldn't have been more helpful. We had an issue with our original room, in that it was too small for the 3 of us ( travel agents fault!) , so Lacey on reception sorted this out for us and we ended up with 2 brilliant rooms which made our break in Southbeach. The hotel is excellently placed near Lincoln Rd mall, Ocean Drive etc. and its right on the bus route to Aventura Mall ( approx. an hours drive) if you don't have a car.  The pool area is lovely too and its right on the beach if you prefer to go there. All in all we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Surfcomber and would like to go back again.

My girlfriend and I came to Miami Beach for a day and ended up at the Surfcomber beach. We were very happy and surprised when we were told  we are allowed to purchase chairs and umbrellas without being guests at the hotel. Not too long after a young gentlemen I believe Devon, greeted us and although we didn't purchase any food or drinks he still kept checking up on us, giving us ice and more lemons for our drinks. He was the most friendliest person we met on our stay and he was so knowledgeable about everything we asked and recommended an AMAZING lounge we ended up going to that night and had so much fun. Can't wait to come back!

Great time at the Surfcomber!  Great room – quiet on the coutyard, clean, comfy bed.  Great staff – at reception, doormen, housekeeping, pool side service, and beach chair service.  Great location – on the beach and near great restaurants and Lincoln Rd shops.  Loved the beautiful beach, clean water, and gentle surf.  Cedrick on the beach staff remembered our name whenever we went there.   We were there in late September so the rates were not outrageous.  Was a little disappointed that the $30 a day activity fee (which covers beach and pool towels and chairs) does not cover beach umbrellas which is another $20 a day, but still highly recommend it.

Stayed here for our 10th wedding anniversary.  Hotel & staff were fantastic, very helpful & friendly people.  Th beach boys Cedric & Dyvon made us feel very special. Their service & friendliness was top class, they clearly love what they are doing.  We will be returning next year.

It was our second time in this Hotel. I really can say that you feel at home. From the front desk to the pool. I have to say for example Luis that worked on the pool service always did an excellent job finding a chair for us. Wine hour is the best, please keep it always. This is the best boutique hotel in the area.

Nice hotel, simple, perfect location, walking to everything... Lincoln Rd. is one block away... Comfortable simple lobby with people in and out all the time. Decent place to eat with a very limited menu, Pool area is nice enough but be aware that kids are part of the deal. Rooms and bathrooms are very small which is typical of this type of hotels in South Beach and although are not fancy, they have all the basics. Walls are very thin and hallways are long. This place, like most hotels in the area, doesn't have parking and they charge you a nice chunk for it.

We staid in this hotel with my friends! Great location, right in the middle of south beach. One min walk to the beach! Great customer service by front-desk.   Rooms was nice and clean. All people who works there are very helpful and very nice! They have a restaurant inside and bar outside! We loved Happy Hour by the bar! Tacos was great! Mojito outstanding! Pool was nice not to many people around! they had a nice cabanas around! Service by the pool was fast. Yulia pool server was very nice, she was taking care of us for a couple days.   Great place to stay, We had a good time in miami!

Very nice lobby and friendly staff, room was comfortable with nice bed and soft linen, ask the staff for direction to restaurants, and shopping, lots to do close by, All of the staff was very friendly and quick with service.  Room was quiet and bathroom clean and large.  Pool area outstanding just beautiful it was during the week so no crowd. I enjoy my stay I will be returning soon.

This place, like most hotels in the area, doesn't have parking and they charge you a nice chunk for it.

We staid in this hotel with my friends! Great location, right in the middle of south beach. One min walk to the beach! Great customer service by front-desk.   Rooms was nice and clean. All people who works there are very helpful and very nice! They have a restaurant inside and bar outside! We loved Happy Hour by the bar! Tacos was great! Mojito outstanding! Pool was nice not to many people around! they had a nice cabanas around! Service by the pool was fast. Yulia pool server was very nice, she was taking care of us for a couple days.   Great place to stay, We had a good time in miami!

Very nice lobby and friendly staff, room was comfortable with nice bed and soft linen, ask the staff for direction to restaurants, and shopping, lots to do close by, All of the staff was very friendly and quick with service.  Room was quiet and bathroom clean and large.  Pool area outstanding just beautiful it was during the week so no crowd. I enjoy my stay I will be returning soon.

Overall I really liked this hotel. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. The lobby was really nice and had unique decor. My room was just right.The hotel had a bottle of wine waiting for me when I walked into my room. The linen was pristine and extra white! The bathroom was small but really clean (and the shower hot wate/ cold water handle was mislabeled in my room). There is free wine in the lobby during happy hour time! The pool area was really nice and the crowd was really chill (so if you are looking for a spring break turn-up kinda pool party this may not be the place for you). The pool staff was great especially a gentleman named Foxi he was really attentive. I had a great stay at this hotel and if ever I'm back in Miami I will stay at this hotel again.

We had a wonderful stay at Surfcomber. It is a fantastic hotel on South Beach. Great pool and access to the beach, good location and friendly staff. The wine hour they have each day is also a great way to start the evening.

The location was good. Room was clean and tidy. The service and food was also very good. Pool handy for kids. We booked well ahead and paid for a few upgrades including late checkout and breakfast. However upon check-in we were told "not sure how you got that deal but we can't honour it". I even had the booking with the inclusions printed out. They said "our screen says something else". Anyway tired and hungry, we argued with them for a while before they gave in and agreed to honour what we had paid for. That was the only let down. The breakfast ended up being very disappointing. A coffee, a bagel and small bowl of fruit salad. Anything more you had to pay extra again.

I had a awesome vacation down n south beach miami🌴!!!! Stayed @ kimpton surfcomber and it was a lovely n sweet hotel with especially wonderful staff...Elivette Rodriguez and chase was very nice n especially kool too!!!

Awesome hotel! Awesome staff! Elivette, Gloria, & Chase were super nice & helpful with any request we had! Room is very clean, neat, & modern! Whenever I come back I will definitely stay at Surfcomber!

5 Star all the way!  From the second we checked in, to service on the beach everyone was amazing!  Always a "hello" or "is there anything you need" and smiles everywhere!  Hotel was super clean and updated, right on South Beach's beach and lots of great restaurants and clubs near by for the night life, and everyplace in the hotel made you feel invited, like one of the family, loved it!  We stayed for 3 nights and that never changed, we were simply WOWED!   Thanks everyone (doormen, restaurant and hotel staff!) for an incredible stay, we will be back!  Don

I always stay at Kimpton hotels when I travel if they're available. The Surfcomber on Collins Avenue was another wonderful Kimpton experience!! Although our room was not ready at 3pm and the suite was a lot smaller than other Kimpton hotels I've stayed at, they made it up to us!! Nora at the front desk and Sean, the general manager were exceptional. Not only did they take care of my friends valet parking, but offered free drinks for all of us and a late checkout at 2pm. Kimpton never disappoints!!

I had stayed at Surfcomber on business and found that this hotel offered everything I needed and then some! From the delicious food on property at both restaurants, to the incredible customer service, and more. My room was super comfortable and stylish, and all of the Kimpton perks that came along with my stay were impressive! Like the yoga mat I used every morning before work and the umbrella I used when it rained that were both provided in my room at no extra cost and without me having to even ask! And the complimentary coffee every morning and free wine every night after work--it was truly a home away from home experience. Great pool and perfect location in South Beach!! Will definitely be returning to this South Beach gem!

My husband and I are recurring clients at the Kimpton Surfcomber. This time, however, we had a cabana and Luis C. and Luis G. took incredible care of us. They made sure we had beds to lounge on by the pool, we had great food and were able to truly relax.

Stayed here with my sister last weekend and had a great time. Boutique style hotel, stayed in the king deluxe room. Room itself nice size, bathroom small but very modern. Hotel staff very friendly and accommodating. Hotel is quiet. Pool and beach area clean and spacious. Complimentary sunscreen and bug repellent was great. Location is perfect, blocks away from Lincoln road. Complimentary wine hour a plus. Special shout out to Devito and Chris for helping us to print our concert tickets/ Chase for giving for giving us club passes/Luis, Jerome, Kareem who took care of us at the pool everyday. Great service and hospitality. Would definitely stay here again and recommend to others.

Got to the hotel at 10 am or so and surprisingly our room was ready. Check-in was great and the staff were knowledgable and pleasant. The best part was the beach of course. My partner and I had great service. Cedric and Edwin were our servers if you will the entire stay. Funny and tentative. Great guys overall out there comforting everyone.

Stayed here for a long weekend with the girls... And it was the best! The hotel is conveniently located to pretty much anything you'd like to do in SoBe. The room size is typical for the area, but well appointed...We had enough space for three. The absolute best part of the hotel is the customer service. Not only is the staff friendly, but they are always at the ready... Small things like anticipating our needing a table for three in the quaint restaurant, without having to complete our walk to the host stand... They were Ready.  From warm greetings, requests for extra towels, to printing concert tickets, they delivered. I will definitely be coming back.

I would come back just to see all of them! Everyone was so friendly and wanted us to have the best time possible for our friend's 30th birthday weekend. Would recommend this spot to everyone!! p.s. Great frozen drinks and delicious food!

I took my 6 year old on a mini vacation and every staff member spoiled her to pieces. Genuinely heart felt care for the small and big ones in all areas of the hotel. Breakfast in the restaurant was amazing, my little one said the pancakes were the best pancakes ever.

A quirky hotel in an excellent location with friendly and helpful staff and some nice touches (wine hour, morning coffee and free bike rental). Take a bike and cycle along the beach - it is worth the effort.  The Surfcomber is a nice size - not huge and faceless - this combined with the charming staff and stylish design made for a characterful stay. We also had a great brunch at the Social Club.   It's a shame that the beach supplement does not include umbrellas, which are vital for a comfortable beach experience. Apart from that, no complaints whatsoever.

This is a great small hotel. I would definitely stay here again. The hotel staff was super nice & accommodating. Room was clean and comfortable. Great location on South Beach. I love the fact that there's a resort fee & tipping is included for beach staff. A guest still needs to tip bell hops, housekeeping, & valet. If I had to complain about something... the halls are really dark. It could be because I'm old. Although the beach staff was super friendly, it did take a long time for a waiter to come around & take my order. It was the same for my beach neighbor. Once I ordered- the service was fine.

What a treat it was to stay here! The character of all the decor without any of the pretentious feel of a lot of other South Beach hotels was perfect. The brunch was out. of. this. world. The pool area was great and the beach of course was gorgeous. Everyone we talked to was happy to help us with anything. We met the manager, Sean, and he was really helpful with some restaurant suggestions on the beach. Can't wait to visit again!

I stayed at the surf comber hotel while on vacation here in Miami. I was having a horrible day until I went to the beach to relax. Upon a very cheerful welcome from all the staff at the hut, I was set up- very comfortably- with a chair and umbrella. Not too long after setting in I was greeted by a young man named Dyvon. He explained how the beach service works and I thought it was so amazing and unique how it worked. I ended up having  lunch and one too many drinks per his recommendations! It was absolutely an amazing time. The food was great and drinks were amazing, Dyvon was such a kind and attentive server and person. Definitely recommend!

From the moment i walked in their seemed to be confusion. I was checked in by someone who was training and seemed nervous which is the norm, but at a prime time maybe she could've used a little bit of help. After all of the confusion which still was not cleared up until today 1 week after check out. I'd have to say this has not been my best stay at a kimpton location, I prefer the NYC Ink 48, they have superb service without confusion and great accommodations. I would've loved to stay here again just not deal with 30 phone calls and being charged after check out, $600 for one night.

My group of 5 women had the most excellent time with our bachelorette at the Surfcomber. Their pool service by Paul was perfect and the concierge Camila gave us great suggestions for brunch and dinner that the whole group thoroughly enjoyed. We loved the fruit infused water every day and the coffee/tea in the morning.  The rooms were very clean and had great amenities. Checkout was a breeze with Keith and Jason's help. They made sure that everything was squared away so we could have a smooth trip back home. We all appreciate the staff and services at the Surfcomber and we all agreed that we will be back again for sure!  Thank you!

It was my bachelorette party and all of my 10 plus guests raved about their stay. The Surfcomber isn't as large as other MIA properties, but that is what I like about boutique hotels- the staff knew us and took special care of us every day, from making reservations, bringing us a glass of wine or a fruit late upon check-in,  we all felt special, and when asked why they were bringing the extra robe, or late night snack, time and again, the response was "Because we are a Kimpton hotel, and that's just what we do." Kuddos to Chase and Camilla at the front desk. I will  definitely return !

Just got back from a long weekend at the surfcomber.  Great service, great food at the high tide and great location.  Gladys at the front desk was wonderful!!!  Happy hour has good deals and the free wine hour was a plus.  Can't wait to return!

Stayed here for 3 nights before heading to Key West and I didn't want to leave. Everything from happy hour, brunch, lunch, dinner, pool, and beach access was readily at my disposal.  Glady's checked us in and was very accommodating. She gave us drink vouchers and upgraded hour room! She was the real rock star! Everyone in the hotel was also very nice.  This is definitely my new go to in Miami Beach and I've stayed at almost all hotels with the exception of 4- by choice.

Great hotel and in my opinion, the location is the best in Miami beach.  The staff are all friendly and helpful, the rooms are clean and the pool is nice. There is direct access to the beach from the property.  You will have use of the beach chairs, but have to pay rent for an umbrella ($25 per day -  I think).   It was a pleasant stay.

I went with a group of close girl friends for a get away weekend to Miami. The highlight was when Chase at the Surf Comber helped us set up a pool day with a cabana on Saturday. He was fantastic and was so accommodating. Once we got there, we were shown right to our cabana and immediately helped by Dani. She was so attentive and so friendly compared to many of the other places we went. Definitely ask for Chase and Dani if you go! It was the perfect pool day with friends. The pool was beautiful with fun music, great drinks, and delicious food. I hope we have many more girls' weekends at the Surfcomber in the future!

The only problem we had was with checkin and it wasn't the hotels fault. Getaroom.com didn't send our reservation to the hotel. The hotel worked hard to get this corrected. They also gave 4 drink coupons and sent a bottle of wine and a fruit platter to the room. Our corner room was pretty big with a view of the courtyard. Beach assistant was excellent! He made sure that our chairs were set up and the umbrella was great as well.  Drinks from the bar were fresh and strong.  Hotel staff was very accommodating and pleasant. Great stay!!

We stayed as a couple at Surfcomber. We flew from Mexico to Miami, thus the quiet ambience of this place was both subtle, blessing but got a little boring as well. But then we stayed on week days, so we had to move out of the hotel in evenings for some other party places.  Overall a nice family hotel with a great pool, small pool bar, perfectly located on the beach and also provided amenities like free beach towels, chairs, free sun screen for the ladies ;)   Our first experience at a Kimpton property, and we liked it.

Great south beach location. Walkable to Lincoln Ave shopping and to Espanola Way. Nice pool and beach accommodations. Unique resort touches like cold infused water in the lobby & poolside plus free wine happy hour every night in the lobby. Bikes available for use as well.  Friendly staff.

Just returned from Surfcomber and would highly recommend everyone to visit. Excellent position for beach, shopping and nightlife. All of the staff were very lovely and couldn't do enough to help. Rooms were clean and modern, bit small for 4 of us in a dbl deluxe, but no different to any other hotel and we only slept there as too busy exploring south beach on the complimentary bikes, relaxing in the complimentary cabana and champagne, drinking wine by the pool in the free wine hour and eating the great food in the social club! Would definitely stay here again as we intend to return to Miami as all of our family loved it.

My stay at The Surfcomber was extremely amazing, the staff was very friendly yet professional and very knowledgeable of the city and was able to inform me of the popular local places and hidden places in Miami and i was very glad to stay there and the rooms were amazing spacious,clean and amazing views of South Beach, if you guys every stay and encounter Angelica or Camilla ill guarantee you'll be pleased with your stay.

column3: We stayed as a couple at Surfcomber. We flew from Mexico to Miami, thus the quiet ambience of this place was both subtle, blessing but got a little boring as well. But then we stayed on week days, so we had to move out of the hotel in evenings for some other party places.  Overall a nice family hotel with a great pool, small pool bar, perfectly located on the beach and also provided amenities like free beach towels, chairs, free sun screen for the ladies ;)   Our first experience at a Kimpton property, and we liked it.

Great south beach location. Walkable to Lincoln Ave shopping and to Espanola Way. Nice pool and beach accommodations. Unique resort touches like cold infused water in the lobby & poolside plus free wine happy hour every night in the lobby. Bikes available for use as well.  Friendly staff.

Just returned from Surfcomber and would highly recommend everyone to visit. Excellent position for beach, shopping and nightlife. All of the staff were very lovely and couldn't do enough to help. Rooms were clean and modern, bit small for 4 of us in a dbl deluxe, but no different to any other hotel and we only slept there as too busy exploring south beach on the complimentary bikes, relaxing in the complimentary cabana and champagne, drinking wine by the pool in the free wine hour and eating the great food in the social club! Would definitely stay here again as we intend to return to Miami as all of our family loved it.
