my experience was excellent, as soon as I went in I was greeted, and they made sure my check in was as fast as possible.  One of the Managers Alex Batista, came by and welcomed me to Hotel, and gave me suggestions.  this property is from the 1940's but it has obviously been remodeled inside to look like a shining star.  The  rooms have a cousy feeling, and the staff is very kind.  The pool area is super fun, with cabanas and chairs, and of course the beach is just a few meters away.  This Hotel is definitely a RePeAt.

This is a decent hotel right on the beach on Miami Beach.  The structure is old, but it is well keep and clean.  The room is not that big, but it comfortable and the same with the bathroom.  It is in a good location and the restaurant in the lobby is good. My only complaint is that the hall way are very dark.

This was our third stay at the Surfcomber.  We stayed for a week in June.  We won't be going back.  Asking the pool attendant for help moving the umbrella was very unpleasant.  He was clearly put out by it.  It was actually so uncomfortable that we just got towels and chair covers ourselves, but he didn't like that either.  There were A LOT of people at the pool who weren't even staying at the hotel.  Favorites on the menu were unavailable the whole time.  It lacked the personal feeling that is expected from a boutique hotel.  Also:  the pool is really, really in need of maintenance.  It once had a beautiful waterfall, but the mosaic tiles were falling off and it looked nasty.  To compete with the other beautiful hotels in South Beach, they have some work to do.

Stayed here for a boys weekend, service and room where top notch !! Gorgeous pool, beach access and wine hour!! Rooms where incredibly clean and well appointed. every staff member I encountered was very pleasant and seemed genuine

The staff go out of their way to make your stay as pleasant as they possibly can. They let us check in early and when they found out it was our first visit to Miami put free drinks and popcorn in the room and gave us a free movie to watch - a really nice touch.  The rooms although a little small for four (we also had 4 large suitcases) were really comfortable.  The pool was great and the sea is right on the doorstep. The best thing about the hotel are the staff who were so friendly and made us feel really special and at home. I am not at all surprised to see a high rating for this hotel and would recommend to others without question

I've stayed at the Surfcomber many times, since before the Surfcomber became a Kimpton Hotel. It's my favorite hotel of the several I've stayed in in Miami Beach.  It has great access to the beach, huge, well maintained pool, comfortable lobby. The location is right on Collins, close to the action on Ocean Drive, the Lincoln Drive pedestrian street, and the convention center. The service is very good.    The entire staff is cheerful and accommodating. One employee, Ghulam has helped me many times through the years, including resolving a crisis when no one could find my laundry.  He always seems to be swoop in to help without being the least bit overbearing.  I'll continue to stay at the Surfcomber every time I stay at the Beach.

As always i look for the hotel that has a beach front and this was it!! Located on Collins Ave it offers u the beach as your backyard, very cute hotel too!! And elegant, the only problem is they charge u a parking fee and also put on hold a security payment which I don't find necessary! Other than that i would totally recommend this hotel!!

I live in Miami and decided to do a staycation here per a friend's recommendation.  I loved the staff's dedication to customer service.  It exceeded my expectations! The food & drinks are great at The Social Club and access to a 24 hour pool made for a perfect summer nights.  In addition the staff helped pull off a birthday surprise from my friends and the staff continued to contribute to making my birthday a great one!

The Surfcomber is a great small hotel in South Beach Miami. The rooms are quite small but very nicely decorated. The bathroom in our room was spotless, but also very small.  The free wine and cheese in the lobby at 5pm every day is a nice touch.  It has a good sized pool, and a gate at the back of the large garden leading onto the beach. Walking distance to almost everything in South Beach Miami. The staff were friendly and helpful, however the small reception desk gets pretty overrun during busy times, we had to wait over 20 minutes to speak to someone to check in.  Only downside is it is very expensive.

This hotel is absolutely wonderful. We had an amazing time here and the employees made it top notch. From Nora and sweet sweet Gladys at the front desk, to Ima and Edwin at the beach, the employees are caring and informative and fun. It's those folks who made our experience truly wonderful.

Went with a family of 5. Surfcomber staff was excellent.  Very professional and kind. It's in a great location. You can walk to Lincoln road and Walgreens, cvs,liquor stores. We ate at Docle food was good.  Food bill was astronomical. Everything in South beach you get charged for. Parking,automatic gratuity, beach chairs,resort tax and anything else they can think of. Beach and hotel are very nice. Be ready to drop some $$$$'s there. For a family of five hotel and food and all extra charges averaged  $800 + a day. They're better and cheaper places to visit in Florida.

Great Hotel. Right size and not filled with crazies and close enough to walk to Ocean drive and Lincoln Rd but far enough away to not be overwhelmed... Attentive and helpful staff. Room was nice, Restaurant, lobby bar, pool area and beach all were also very nice and well maintained and also serviced by very attentive, friendly and respectful staff. And happily no unruly guests or screaming kids. So it was a very nice stay with no unexpected issues and stress free. ( Have to complain about something so will complain about the $42.00 a night parking but I guess it's south beach and the mosquitoes in our room.... And could have used Uber and called the front desk...)

The good: Friendly staff, especially at the bar.   The bad: the room really smelled like a flooded basement. Was only staying for one night so figured it wasn't worth it to ask to move, but I should have. Maybe I'm overly sensitive to the smell of mildew but it actually woke me up at night. Gross. Also, wi-fi isn't included which just seems ridiculous these days.

Love the attention to details!  Foxy and Dani at the pool are quite attentive and kind.  Paul - pool manager was stellar!  Patrick (at the beach) was working so hard in the heat and yet super professional.  Summer, the High Tides bartender yesterday was perfunctory- and not typical of all the other welcoming staff here. Food: lechon sliders & Yucca fries are amazing!  Tip- the cabanas - are like an oasis.

I love South Beach and also love returning to the Surfcomber. The staff is great and the vibe is relaxed, warm & friendly. The guest rooms are well appointed and the beds are super comfy.  I was there for 2 days on business and attended a meeting at the hotel. The meeting experience was perfect! The food & beverage was excellent. The Chef even popped in to greet the group and asked how we enjoyed lunch, that was above and beyond.   I can't wait to come back, but next time I will bring the family to enjoy the pool & beach.

There was only one elevator. Hallways were very dark. The hotel seemed understaffed. The food from the restaurant was delicious. Daily parking was expensive. Rooms are small. There are better hotels in South Beach for the money.

We had a very enjoyable experience at the Surfcomber.  Great environment and exceptional staff.  The pool had music and a wide variety of food and drinks.  The private area for the beach was also a perk.  Would highly recommend this hotel whether you want a relaxing getaway or a fun weekend with you friends.

A wonderful hotel with a great location in the heart of South Beach.  A fantastic staff willing to help you enjoy every aspect of your visit.  Our dinner at the Social Club was sublime!  Chef Blair was amazing and fun too!  We enjoyed the pool party and beach access was perfect. This is the place to stay!

Great people they helped us out a whole lot would always go back. Rooms was very clean everyone was friendly and very down to earth. I told friends and family about this place when I got back to Philly

First time visiting Miami and I must say I did a good job at choosing this hotel ! The rooms were a little on the small side but the hotel itself was beautiful specifically the pool area which is open 24/7.. We definitely took advantage of that and went swimming every night after hitting the club! The service was exceptional everyone is very friendly and professional... The restaurant was very delicious and gave us complimentary watermelon mimosas which were so good ! Oh and not to mention complimentary drinks almost every day during social hour !! The hotel is also in front of the beach which is great and near other restaurants.. Would definitely stay here again!

My friend and I visited the Surfcomber Hotel for her birthday celebration.  From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the level of service at this place! Shout outs to the bar manager (Carr), the pool attendant (Foxi), the beach attendants (Robert, Edwin and Giovanni), the Concierge staff, the bar/wait staff and even housekeeping! These people embody friendly and professional service.  Whatever Kimpton is doing to keep them happy, it should keep doing it. Recommended!

It was my first time visiting Miami with my friends and we enjoyed staying at Surfcomber in South beach, great location and atmosphere. Great staff. Definitely will be back the next year.  Thank you Julia and Sean you guys were the best! We hope to see you again. Irene and Michelle

My stay at this hotel was great. The front desk staff of Gladys, Sherece, Jason, and Kieth, has helped me with any questions I've had, and made sure my stay was as comfortable as possible. The pool at the hotel is heated, and open 24/7. The hotel also gives free beach chairs and towels to you when decide to go to the beach. The "Social Club" restaurant in the hotel makes great food and the employees make sure you're satisfied. I would recommend this hotel to anyone.

column3: My friend and I visited the Surfcomber Hotel for her birthday celebration.  From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the level of service at this place! Shout outs to the bar manager (Carr), the pool attendant (Foxi), the beach attendants (Robert, Edwin and Giovanni), the Concierge staff, the bar/wait staff and even housekeeping! These people embody friendly and professional service.  Whatever Kimpton is doing to keep them happy, it should keep doing it. Recommended!

It was my first time visiting Miami with my friends and we enjoyed staying at Surfcomber in South beach, great location and atmosphere. Great staff. Definitely will be back the next year.  Thank you Julia and Sean you guys were the best! We hope to see you again. Irene and Michelle

My stay at this hotel was great. The front desk staff of Gladys, Sherece, Jason, and Kieth, has helped me with any questions I've had, and made sure my stay was as comfortable as possible. The pool at the hotel is heated, and open 24/7. The hotel also gives free beach chairs and towels to you when decide to go to the beach. The "Social Club" restaurant in the hotel makes great food and the employees make sure you're satisfied. I would recommend this hotel to anyone.

The surfcomber was the cherry on top of a great experience in Miami. The staff is great which is what I enjoyed the most about my stay. In particular Lacey at the front desk was kind and always quick to help me with anything I needed. Couldn't have been better!

The hotel was so nice and the staff was very helpful. We were sitting on the beach with our dog and Victor Duarte, one of the beach staff, came up to us and handed us an unexpected gift. He gave us a carry on bag for our dog and it was a very sweet gesture of him. This shows how professional and caring the hotel and staff are especially Victor. Thank you for this wonderful experience and of course we will recommend this hotel for our friends and family.

While I'm not a guest at the hotel I had a wonderful experience with the concierge, Chase! He helped me arrange for a birthday surprise for a best friend's special B-Day and he was super helpful, funny, sweet and lovely! Now I really want to stay at the Surcomber!

As always the kimpton associates were at there best. Clean rooms , nice welcoming surprise in room  , fruit , cheese and wine awesome !location is easily to and from the beach . Pool is always a nice time .

Recently dined at the Social Club inside the Surfcomber and was blown away by their impression dishes.  Not only beautifully plated and presented to the table but the incredible taste each dish had.  To start we had the calamari and the burrata--AMAZING.  Each entree was to die for and to finish off the meal we had their incredible doughnuts, I'm not usually a sweets fan but I'll be dreaming of those doughnuts.  The service we had by Louie was great, he's such a nice guy and was very attentive.  The bartender, Andy, made us delicious cocktails from they bar menu, each drink sounded amazing it was hard to pick one.  Andy, the manager, made sure we were well taken care of from the moment we walked in.  Overall amazing experience and I will absolutely be returning.

I have always been a fan of the Kimpton chain and this location did not disappoint. Their customer service was fabulous. I told Angelica, who checked us in,  about a situation that happened to me with TSA, and she listened to my stupid story. She left a little gift in my room to let me know she remembered. It is customer service like this that makes Kimpton always my first choice!  The only thing I would recommend is that if you want your room cleaned early, I would let them know. One day, our room was not cleaned until late afternoon when we were back from the beach and trying to get a quick reset before going out to dinner.

Had an awesome time at the Surfcomber. Angelica and Sherice at the front desk were amazing.  From the day we checked in until the day we left, these ladies made my birthday week getaway a very special one and definitely a memorable experience. The service that these ladies rendered at the front desk was simply excellent.  As always we throughly enjoyed the Surfcomber wine hour. Thank you again Surfcomber for a wonderful visit.

Stayed here a few times and have always had a great experience. Rooms are great for south beach standards (and fairly priced) and the pool area is amazing even at night, but it's the service that really stands out. All of the staff is great and the front desk staff (especially Gladys, she was awesome!) is super accommodating. Will make an effort to return and request this spot on future business trips.

We've just spent 5 great days at the Surfcomber and had a great time, very relaxing after a few hectic days in NYC. Check in was quick and easy, the room was spacious, clean and well furnished, and the beds comfortable. The bedroom, on the 3rd floor was well insulated from outside noise and noise from other rooms. All the staff were extremely helpful and friendly, with a special mention to Patrick and Victor on the beach and Omar at the bar. They were all fantastic. We will certainly recommend this hotel to those visiting South Beach, and will return ourselves on subsequent visits. Thank you!

We had a great time at the Surfcomber Miami South Beach! Although our stay was short (1 day) it was lovely! We wish we could have stayed longer and will definitely come back whenever we visit Miami. They made sure we had everything we needed while we waited for our room to be ready. Their fun and welcoming personality made a huge difference! Along with the high attention to details throughout the hotel.

I decided to take a little trip to the Surfcomber this weekend with my family. I have one word to describe the service: PERFECT! I've been to many other properties on Miami Beach and I can say that this is the first one I've been to where I haven't had to get up from my lounge chair once. My family and I felt more than relaxed! Edwin was very helpful and full of fun! Always made sure we had a drink in our hands to stay refreshed and even went above and beyond to bring us some sunblock! He always made sure he passed by to check on us and make sure everything was good. All this was done with a big smile on his face! I can say it was an absolute pleasure and I will definitely be back! THANK YOU EDWIN!!!!

We stayed at the Surfcomber in June for a girls weekend and had the best time. The staff, the décor, the pool, the beach, the room and the location were all fabulous. I have rarely stayed in a hotel; where I have felt so at home. All the staff go out of their way to ensure your comfort - special props to Sean, Luis, Jose, Edwin and Crystal. Great cocktails, loads of space by the pool, as well as awesome seating scattered all around the hotel, the fantastic location and super friendly and groovy atmosphere makes this place feel like a glorious hideaway right in the heart of SoBe. Not to mention free wine hour every night. We will be coming back next year for sure!

I just recently returned from a 3 day trip to Miami (over the 4th of July weekend), and it was perfect! We were celebrating a bachelorette and they treated us like queens. The pool and beach were very relaxing, and the food at the restaurant was very good. The location was perfect! Highly recommend.

column3: We stayed at the Surfcomber for a Bachelorette Party this 4th of July weekend and it was a wonderful experience. The concierge gave us complimentary champagne for each room when we checked and a special treat for the Bride's room. They were very helpful with anything we needed through our stay. Also, the pool and beach were wonderful and the restaurant had a great breakfast! Perfectly located on Collins Ave it was a quick walk to most places. The rooms were clean and spacious and we couldn't have asked for anything better. I would definitely recommend staying here!

we went for a bachelorette july 4th weekend and had the BEST TIME!! The staff took care of us, the rooms were very clean, room service was quick and food was amazing. there was plenty of room for 12 girls to have our own space at the pool and beach. GREAT service!

I had so much fun these past 2 days. I'll be staying at the surfcomber from now on  Thank you Victor you are the best.

Such a friendly staff, lovely wine hour every day, clean rooms, great location!  We plan to return for sure!

The rooms are great, clean, and decorated in true Miami style. Bed was really comfy! Lobby and overall decor was fun and inviting. Had the best Cuban sandwich and Mojito at the outside bar, would go back just for lunch. Overall, top score to all. See you soon!!! Special thanks to Darius, Lacey, Jason and Angelica.

If I hadn't spent so much on a room advertised as "ocean view," I would have liked this hotel.  But not only was there no "ocean" view, there was no "pool" view because the room was in the corner of the hotel -- and there is NO view of anything from that balcony unless you are standing. In other words, you cannot sit and enjoy any view.  A hotel should not advertise its room as "ocean" view when there is NO view much less a view of the ocean  Also, the corner room was privy to the staff conversing in the alley where I believe the trash was-- and one night, we couldn't sleep because a staffer was on his cell phone yelling at what ostensibly sounded like his girlfriend or wife...

Stayed 2 nights on a family vacation (2 adults + teenager) before continuing up to Fort Lauderdale. Just wanted to relax and adjust to the timezone after flying from Europe. Stayed in 3rd floor junior suite (city view), which had a king bed + pull up sofa, nice spacious room and not too much noise from the collins avenue. Pool area very nice and didn't feel too crowded. Easy access to the beautiful Miami Beach. Used the complimentary bikes both days (nice to drive around miami beach) and enjoyed complimentary glasses of white wine the other day. Not cheap, but felt like a good value for money. - and yes, would come again some day.  Ps. Nice jogging at the boardwalk early morning hearing the waves crashing and getting some nice breeze from the ocean.

South Beach is its own place of wonder and architecture and beach and nightclubs.   When you go, and you know you need to go, stay at the Surfcomber - wonderful staff, amazing location, perfect accommodations.   The bar is great, the lobby and lounge are right out of F. Scott Fitzgerald. The pool is to die for with a waterfall and plenty of seating.  Make sure to reserve your umbrella for the great people watching and weather.   Access to the beach is steps away, and when you are done, there is amazing room service, or hit the town and see the amazing architecture lit up as the town comes alive!

We've been staying here for years, and this time it's gotten quite pricey.  That said, the small room and tiny bath are very nice, recently updated.   On top of the room price, you are charged a $27/day resort fee which covers 2 beach chairs and towels.  An umbrella is $19/day and another chair is$19/day.  Parking is extra (no surprise).  The beach is easily accessible behind the hotel (no need to cross the street as with hotels on Ocean Drive).   2 free drink vouchers are not valid at the pool or beach.

From the time we entered the hotel, the service has been excellent. The employees were very friendly. Got checked in by Angelica late in the evening and was given a free upgrade because i told her we were on our honeymoon. She has such a great attitude and was so genuine. Keith was very friendly and offered to deliver our luggage although we were able to manage  the 2 pieces. We had an amenity delivered the next day. The entire staff definitely made us feel special, whether it was Jerome at the pool, Gladys during turndown or Keith remembering us at night when he opens the door. We will definitely be back to this gem of a hotel.

This was our second time staying at the Surfcomber and I can guarantee that there will be a third. Location is great...rooms are small, but just what we need, being that we are never in them except to sleep.  Service was great...we enjoyed Luis' service on the front patio for breakfast every morning.  Dorgis, in the lobby, was ready to accommodate our every need accompanied by his witty humor and, last but not least, was Kate.  She waited on us all, hand and foot and took awesome care of us by the pool.  Simply cannot wait to go back.  No complaints whatsoever.  We'll hopefully see you all soon!

column3: Stayed 2 nights on a family vacation (2 adults + teenager) before continuing up to Fort Lauderdale. Just wanted to relax and adjust to the timezone after flying from Europe. Stayed in 3rd floor junior suite (city view), which had a king bed + pull up sofa, nice spacious room and not too much noise from the collins avenue. Pool area very nice and didn't feel too crowded. Easy access to the beautiful Miami Beach. Used the complimentary bikes both days (nice to drive around miami beach) and enjoyed complimentary glasses of white wine the other day. Not cheap, but felt like a good value for money. - and yes, would come again some day.  Ps. Nice jogging at the boardwalk early morning hearing the waves crashing and getting some nice breeze from the ocean.

South Beach is its own place of wonder and architecture and beach and nightclubs.   When you go, and you know you need to go, stay at the Surfcomber - wonderful staff, amazing location, perfect accommodations.   The bar is great, the lobby and lounge are right out of F. Scott Fitzgerald. The pool is to die for with a waterfall and plenty of seating.  Make sure to reserve your umbrella for the great people watching and weather.   Access to the beach is steps away, and when you are done, there is amazing room service, or hit the town and see the amazing architecture lit up as the town comes alive!

We've been staying here for years, and this time it's gotten quite pricey.  That said, the small room and tiny bath are very nice, recently updated.   On top of the room price, you are charged a $27/day resort fee which covers 2 beach chairs and towels.  An umbrella is $19/day and another chair is$19/day.  Parking is extra (no surprise).  The beach is easily accessible behind the hotel (no need to cross the street as with hotels on Ocean Drive).   2 free drink vouchers are not valid at the pool or beach.

From the time we entered the hotel, the service has been excellent. The employees were very friendly. Got checked in by Angelica late in the evening and was given a free upgrade because i told her we were on our honeymoon. She has such a great attitude and was so genuine. Keith was very friendly and offered to deliver our luggage although we were able to manage  the 2 pieces. We had an amenity delivered the next day. The entire staff definitely made us feel special, whether it was Jerome at the pool, Gladys during turndown or Keith remembering us at night when he opens the door. We will definitely be back to this gem of a hotel.

This was our second time staying at the Surfcomber and I can guarantee that there will be a third. Location is great...rooms are small, but just what we need, being that we are never in them except to sleep.  Service was great...we enjoyed Luis' service on the front patio for breakfast every morning.  Dorgis, in the lobby, was ready to accommodate our every need accompanied by his witty humor and, last but not least, was Kate.  She waited on us all, hand and foot and took awesome care of us by the pool.  Simply cannot wait to go back.  No complaints whatsoever.  We'll hopefully see you all soon!

Our overall experience in the hotel was good. It was clean, good services and good amenities. My only complaint is the room size (too small, almost like as a Paris hotel) and the view from the window was the next door building's wall and trash (about 6 ft distance between window and wall). Not that I was expecting an ocean view, not even the pool, but at least the sky or maybe a tree. The best part was the location, close to everything (Lincoln Rd, Espanola Way, restaurants, etc). Overall we had a great time and I would stay again but I will definitely request a room with anything other than a wall view.

I stayed at the Surfcomber with 3 of my friends (all males mid 20s). This place was perfect. The pool is great - the beach is just beyond the pool. Wine hour is a nice touch every night. They have an amazing brunch in the hotel lobby (bottomless mimosas)! The food there was also very good. The hotel is also located perfectly to walk just about anywhere you'd want to go. Really close to Ocean Drive. I would absolutely suggest staying at this hotel if you're considering.

Amazing experience at the Surfcomber- this was my first time visiting and we will be coming back.  The staff at the hotel was everything especially the beach staff.  We spent most of our time by the water and we were treated like royalty every time! Edwin Resto, thank you for your hospitality, time, and attention! We'll be coming back!

great location, great motif (love the LeBo art and funky cows etc), great outdoor lounging options (not just lay back chairs, lots of couches and adirondack chairs with ottomans on grass near the cool sandy chill area and the outdoor bar).  Camilla and everyone working for this hotel work hard and try to make everyone have their best stay, and it makes a huge difference! Rooms are obviously small, and i was a little sad about some of the metal on the windows being a bit rusty, but that would be a serious overhaul i assume they will do on their next facelift. Overall this place is amazing, and our choice in south beach.

Loved the hotel, the free bikes and complimentary champagne was awesome. The hotel restaurant food was delicious. When we got there the receptionist was so lovely and patient. Great beach access and would stay again.

Room was good. Pool was good as well. They have free breakfast, and open bar every afternoon. Their backyard leads you right to the beach. The food however could be better. Alternatives to pork is a must!   The hotel staff is very receptive, your treated like family. Gladys in the front has a great way of welcoming people! Felt like I knew her for a long time within 5 minutes!  And free wifi!

People make this hotel, staff are super friendly and accommodating! Rooms are small but perfectly formed, cool looking and comfortable, air con works great. Free wine hour at 5pm is great with Peach Bellinis too, free tea and coffee 6am-10am, citrus water all day and iced tea and lemonade over lunchtime makes you feel really valued as a guest. Pool is a good size with nice spacious lounge area. Hotel backs onto beach with free loungers. 5 mins walk from Lincoln rd where majority of shops and restaurants are located. 15 mins walk to Ocean Drive along the Beach walk at back of hotel.

We stayed here over the weekend with a group of 8 girls.  The hotel itself is nice and in a great location.  The staff was great, specially Foxi, Luis, Alejandro and Keith, super friendly and helpful.  The only complaint I would have would be the beach food/drink service.  Other than that we enjoyed our stay!

I stayed on a business trip in May 2016 for a couple of nights.  The place, service and location cannot be beaten. It is in Collins Ave and 17 street walking distance from Lincoln Road, so if you want you do not need a car to move around. This is my preferred hotel in Miami Beach and I return every time in Miami. Excellent to stay, great pool and best service ever. This hotel whilst not the cheapest really does go the extra mile in terms of the service and setting. The restaurant serves excellent food.  Great care and attention has been placed on the decoration and details within the rooms, as well as the external areas which host sculptures and artwork.

We got to the hotel at 11:30 but couldn't get into our room until 5:30pm which was pretty late. The room is tiny, looks out on a wall and the bathroom door hits the toilet when it opens.  Nice people but cramped room that leads to less relaxing experience. I suspect there are better places in south beach for the price.

I recently stayed here during my vacation with friends ...The hotel was nice and comfy but being that I wasn't from the area i inquired about fun things to do in the area...Gladys was so helpful in pointing me in the right direction...not only did she suggest great places to grab a bite to eat but also cool spots with fantastic music and cocktails...I had an awesome time and will be back again!

A friend and I spent five days in Miami in June and stayed at the Surfcomber.  The hotel was great and the staff was extremely friendly.  The location was perfect with Lincoln Rd just one block away and Ocean Drive about four.   The hotel and staff were very nice and the concierge provide several good dining suggestions.  The beach was amazing! It was so convenient, very wide and the beach crew was really friendly and accommodating.  If you are looking for a nice, fun and central place to stay when visiting this area of Miami, the Surfcomber is a great choice.

Amazing property! Great location, wonderful staff. Valencia, Camilla, Jim, and Edith really made our trip very comfortable and pleasant. Highly recommend this place, you won't be disappointed! Cheers!

We just returned from a long weekend at the Surfcomber. We cannot wait til we can go back. The hotel itself was beautiful; clean, great amenities, etc. The location is the best. What made our stay most memorable was the outstanding staff; chase and crystal at the front desk, but especially Camilla who went out of her way to make us feel special. Gabrielle, a pool server was delightful and friendly and Magdalena in the restaurant knowledgeable and delightful. We will definitely return as soon as we can.  Nancy and Harvey Philadelphia

Chase was incredibly helpful my entire stay. Not only is he extremely handsome but, he was so completely helpful. If you are looking for a swank hotel then stay at the Surfcomber and if you need anything Chase is your man!

Visited this hotel with two girlfriends and it was wonderful.  I borrowed the hotel bike and rode to a nearby Publix, lounged on the beach, devoured a delicious salad with grilled shrimp, and just relaxed.  This is a great hotel and I am looking forward to bringing my husband back.  I'd love for us to stay at the Surfcomber.  My one and only complaint is that our double room had a tiny bathroom.  We couldn't open the door completely - it was stopped by the toilet.  Tight space!   Lastly, ending on a high note, let me say - Emma, the beach attendant was AMAZING.  He was attentive, accommodating and friendly.  (I neglected to give him a tip.  How can I remedy this situation?  I feel awful!)

Despite lovely waitresses poolside delivering delicious food and nice drinks,  the Surfcomber managed to rate only "Average" for our stay last October. Why? A few reasons actually. 1. Despite arrangements to the contrary, they booked us in a handicapped room. 2. Music at the pool was too loud. 3. Poolside service was really, really slow at times. This was really a shame because the looks of the hotel in the first moments was so promising! Still the location is good , but next time we are trying the Marseilles!

We loved our stay at the Surfcomber.  Sean and Katie at High Tide made sure we enjoyed ourselves and never wanted for anything.  Excellent black bean hummus with lovely fresh veggies, fish tacos, yucca fries.    The sunscreen variety and flavored water at the pool was a really nice touch.  Coffee in the mornings from the lobby was lovely.    The in house social club restaurant was very nice.     Everyone went out of their way to welcome us and make use feel like they genuinely cared that we enjoyed our experience.

The Surfcomber is such a great place: ideal location, cool Miami style design and awesome service!! Gladys at the front desk was so welcoming and helpful. Thanks a lot!! It was my first time there but I will definitely come back!!

I was stranded at the airport while heading West and I called Kimpton and got a room at the Surfcomber. When I checked in Gladys, Anjelica and Camilla were wonderful checking me in and providing recommendations. Everything went so smoothly I was able to get to the beach, walk around South Beach and have wonderful dinner during my one-night vacation. Thanks ladies!

The surfcomber exceeded my expectations. Their rooms (although a bit small and no view) are nice, clean and comfortable. The direct access to the beach ( for free, unless you want an umbrella) is amazing: the beach is pretty calm, the food is great ( but sometimes it takes a while to arrive) and the staff is really nice ( Edgard!!) ! The location is GREAT! In the heart of south beach, you are steps away from the SLS hotel, which has two amazing restaurants, and walking distance from lincoln road. I did not really like their breakfast but there is starbucks 5 min away so it didn't really matter. It's a great deal for the price, so go for it. This weekend will be my third time staying at the surfcomber!

column3: The Surfcomber is such a great place: ideal location, cool Miami style design and awesome service!! Gladys at the front desk was so welcoming and helpful. Thanks a lot!! It was my first time there but I will definitely come back!!

I was stranded at the airport while heading West and I called Kimpton and got a room at the Surfcomber. When I checked in Gladys, Anjelica and Camilla were wonderful checking me in and providing recommendations. Everything went so smoothly I was able to get to the beach, walk around South Beach and have wonderful dinner during my one-night vacation. Thanks ladies!

This weekend will be my third time staying at the surfcomber!

David the pool boy was hella fine and such a sweetheart I'd go back just for him. Went to the beach everyday and they were all so nice and helpful. They suggested some great restaurants to go to. Overall an amazing experience would go again in a heart beat

I had a great time at the beach eating amazing food with spectacular service! Edwin Resto was our server and he was very attentive and extremely sweet!! If you are having some drink and food on the beach Edwin is your man!!! Besides that, the food is amazing!!

Had a great time with friends as we stayed for the opening of the Formation World Tour. Chace, at the front desk, was soooo helpful, nice, and professional. He answered my questions and got anything I needed. Would definitely stay here again because of our interactions. Rude hotel staff is a turn off and I was pleased that the interactions I had were nice.

I was very happy with this hotel as I got a great rate on kimpton.com and my room was pretty clean. The view from the window was of an ugly courtyard and there was mold growing all over the outside of the window. Needless to say I kept the curtains closed but aside from that I had a comfortable stay.

Great location but terrible service except from the pool bar and beach staff. An hour an a half wait for pancakes which didn't arrive??? Different front of house staff so no consistent message when asking the same question 4 times, we almost didn't get married because of their incompetence, a real lack of care and concern for their customers. However the pool cocktails and food are very good, the location and the rooms were great.

I had a wonderful experience and stay at the Surfcomber , Miami. Although the rooms were a little small for my liking , the staff and amenities made it all worth it. Poolside, Gabriella and Luis were friendly, attentive and gave great service . At the beach were were attended to by Emma. He was fantastic. Had a million dollar smile along with 5 star service even in the heat. Great service makes all the difference when staying somewhere. I would definitely stay again , especially because of the friendly staff....great job Surfcomber.

In the heart of South Beach, the location is perfect for walking to all the best places at night. We used a poolside cabana for my bridal shower which was perfect to relax out of the Miami Heat. Definitely ask for/search for Kate to help at the pool. She's absolutely fabulous and took excellent care of us - even during a severe afternoon shower. Foxi was a big help claiming a good pool spot each day! The free wine hour that Kimpton offers its guests is nice while getting ready for dinner. Don't miss the hot wings and Cesar salad at the pool. Delish!

Very happy with our stay . We loved the pool area. Stayed on south beach many times in the past year. I will for sure be back .  the rooms were small yet so cute. The décor is so pretty. The pool was fun and the staff was amazingly nice me and my boyfriend were treated like royalty. I would recommend this hotel and would stay there again .

My stay at the Surfcomber was excellent. The hotel location was fabulous and I had a corner room with a view of the ocean. The hotel staff were all very friendly and helpful, including the front desk and staff you meet throughout the hotel. I had a particularly great experience at the Social Club restaurant on site - the wait staff had perfect recommendations and anticipated our needs. Thumbs up! I was in town for a meeting at another larger chain hotel and found my experience at the Surfcomber to be superior. It was like a home away from home!

We loved the Surfcomber Hotel for our recent girl's weekend.   Location is great with everything within walking distance. Beach service team is amazing.  Axel is wonderful, with plenty of cool drinks and a friendly smile..   Walter and Patrick were great with towels, umbrella and chairs.  The front desk staff were very attentive and made sure to greet us with a smile and hello.   The food and staff at High Tide were also amazing.  LOVED the black bean hummus, which we had three days straight!  Rooms are very clean, spacious and modern.  Truly loved everything about our stay and would highly recommend to anyone looking for a wonderful vacation in Miami.

Loved our stay.  The location is perfect -- right in the heart of South Beach (about a block from Lincoln Road).  The beach is at the back door and the beach staff are friendly.  Rooms are spacious and modern.  Bartenders were friendly and knowledgeable and we enjoyed the afternoon wine hour.  Great and reasonably priced spot.

Stay for two nights after a trip to Cuba and enjoyed all of the comfort that Kimpton is known for. The front desk staff is great and the concierge Carmilla was outstanding. The location in South Beach gives you an energy boost.  Rooms are small but fun and funky. Great pool and beach.

Room 264, small but with 2 queen beds.  Small but adequate bath.  Good A/C, very friendly help.  Pool is lovely and has plenty of service.  Although, they were cleaning the pool deck at 11am on a Wednesday morning, which was noisy and very disruptive, could they have picked a better time?  Beach has service, not cheap to lounge or eat there, but helps to be a frequent stay club member. Full restaurant on premises, but noisy being on Collins ave, and the help seemed a tad frazzled.

This was an absolutely stunning place! From the customer service to the views! Couldn't have stayed at a better hotel! It was clean, the room was well air conditioned. The staff were always happy to help and took the time to speak to you. They gave such a personal touch to the experience. 1000% better than English hotels. Would love to go again and DEFINITELY. recommend it.

Me and my friend used to use this hotel as a beer stop on the way home from the beach, what an amazing find, the staff were fabulous and very helpful, including Jason and Kate ... They had bucket of beer deals and one night we had wings too, which were so tasty , would recommend , loved this place xxx

The staff is very friendly and service minded and helpful. They truly love pets. The staff is very attentive whether you are at the beach, by the pool, at the reception or in the restaurant. The daily wine hour is a great addition. The atmosphere is relaxed and friendly. A great place for all age groups.

We stayed here 4 days and it was amazing.  The pool service was unbelievable, especially Luis. He did everything for us, he was always around, whatever we needed he got for us - towels, chairs, umbrellas, water even guacamole that we couldn't find in the bar's menu:) . We didn't have this kind of service even in the most expensive hotels.    Thank you so much Luis!!!

Our party arrived late Friday night, from SFO, after the complimentary wine social hour so we were given two complimentary cocktails in the lounge.  Nice touch! On Saturday, we found that we could not use the pool facilities due to a scheduled wedding, closing the entire pool area and beach access. Although the "resort fee" of $28.50 per day was waived for us, the inconvenience factor deserves my "poor" rating. The hotel did provide an alternate pool on an adjacent property but we didn't want that.  All future guests need to question whether a "special event" will close the facilities. We have no intention of returning to this hotel.

Had a great time at Surfcomber. The hotel was nice but the service was great. The manager Edwin was so welcoming at the beach and just a joy. His team David and Emma were super attentive. I highly recommend the passion fruit daiquiri and great salads.  Beach rocks.

I loved staying at the Surfcomber! We came down to Miami for a bachelorette party and had a great suite with plenty of space for our group. The staff was friendly and really went above and beyond our expectations. The cabanas by the pool were really nice, with good food and drinks, and there was great and easy access to the beach. It's centrally located in South Beach, with restaurants and shopping all in easy walking distance. I highly recommend this hotel!

Long time gone since I had  been in Miami Beach but 24 degrees and snow in chicago on april 12 motivated my wife and i there for an easy flight and drive to the beach within  3 hours of takeoff out of Ohare. Another world- and a look into how the world has changed over twenty years. Hotel was very good, seemed to try hard to be cool and hip to stay current. Rooms were small but clean and modern. Housekeeping was excellent everyday and was an outstanding feature. Beach facilities good but expensive, as were the 15 dollar drinks ( plus 18% tip). Food was excellent, as was Paul James , one of the managers, and both were the real highlight of our stay. Paul,,we WILL see you again.

Great location close to the Lincon mall . They have bikes to ride around town on or hire 1 at the next street corner. They have a fantastic outdoor pool area. A big plus is the over all great staff. I would definitely return. Special mention to Chase on the front desk and Kate by the pool/outdoor bar.

My friend and I had a great long weekend in South Beach, thanks in large part to Marlon, Jerome, Manuel and the rest of the staff here. They have personality and are super helpful. I would definitely visit again.

Thank you so much Edwin and David Pina for such an amazing mothers day weekend.  If it wasnt for your excellent service and amazing hospitality this weekend would of not been the same.  I thank both of you guys from the bottom of my heart for making my moms mothers day a memorable one!

column3: Long time gone since I had  been in Miami Beach but 24 degrees and snow in chicago on april 12 motivated my wife and i there for an easy flight and drive to the beach within  3 hours of takeoff out of Ohare. Another world- and a look into how the world has changed over twenty years. Hotel was very good, seemed to try hard to be cool and hip to stay current. Rooms were small but clean and modern. Housekeeping was excellent everyday and was an outstanding feature. Beach facilities good but expensive, as were the 15 dollar drinks ( plus 18% tip). Food was excellent, as was Paul James , one of the managers, and both were the real highlight of our stay. Paul,,we WILL see you again.

Great location close to the Lincon mall . They have bikes to ride around town on or hire 1 at the next street corner. They have a fantastic outdoor pool area. A big plus is the over all great staff. I would definitely return. Special mention to Chase on the front desk and Kate by the pool/outdoor bar.

My friend and I had a great long weekend in South Beach, thanks in large part to Marlon, Jerome, Manuel and the rest of the staff here. They have personality and are super helpful. I would definitely visit again.

Thank you so much Edwin and David Pina for such an amazing mothers day weekend.  If it wasnt for your excellent service and amazing hospitality this weekend would of not been the same.  I thank both of you guys from the bottom of my heart for making my moms mothers day a memorable one!

Thank you Edwin Resto for a great service and delicious veggie burger with yuka fried you recommend to us. Gorgeous view, really comfortable beach bed, the whites and softes towels. Highly recommended ask for Edwin......................................

They are the bomb, thanks for making our stay special.

I love the location of this hotel. Right on gorgeous Miami South Beach! I recently ate at  High Tide located outdoors by the pool. The food was delicious, especially the black bean hummus and grilled chicken sandwich. The staff is so friendly and accommodating. The service on the beach is also outstanding. I enjoy the positive energy and friendliness from the team at the Surfcomber. Thank you. I will definitely return!!!!

We just returned from three great nights at The Surfcomber.  The hotel staff were all very friendly, the other guests were very varied in age with some families, some singles, some couples.  There were even a few guests with dogs!  People all found their space because there's SO much space available:  the wonderful beachfront, the pool area, the sand area -there is literally a place for all to sit or swim and enjoy the weather, the sounds.  The food is very tasty and very reasonable for the quality.  The service in friendly and understated.  The rooms are very nice.  All around we cannot wait to return again.

THE ABSOLUTE BEST! In all of my years of traveling and the countless number of individuals I've come in contact with in those travels, Sherece, Angelica M, and Keith have been exceptional. Truly. One of a kind. It's rare to find such a fun group of employees truly dedicated to the service they provide. I can't get over it. They. Are. AWESOME!!! We came a long way and we were hot and bothered and they were such a breath of fresh air I NEEDED to mention their outstanding quality. This is my first time visiting Miami and I am SOLD on the Surfcomber because of the wonderful care I received when first entering the hotel. Incredible. I will be returning. Please continue your excellence. It is not going unnoticed!!!

Every single person we encountered went above and beyond to help out!  It was a really warm and friendly environment with beach yoga, nightly happy hours and really nice facilities.  I can't wait to go back next year!  Brunch was awesome and the watermelon mimosa was fantastic.

This hotel is in an amazing location-- right on South Beach. The staff was very friendly, although sometimes it took a while to get service. They have beach chairs and service out on the beach, but the food menu is limited.  The wine hour is lots of fun. Our room was on the street, and it was a little noisy, especially in the day when the hotel next door was hosting a day club.

The Beach staff, particularly Kenneth, David and all staff, are so kind, courteous and helpful. They offered to carry out bags, make sure that the umbrellas are giving us enough shade and were generally fabulous! Bravo to All involved! The place is beautiful and with close by parking spots.

We would show up every morning around the same time and the crew would greet us with towels and a prime spot to sit and ask us how are stay has been so far. David, Kenneth and Ed you guys made our trip so enjoyable!! Thank you!!

Had the opportunity to spend a day at the surf comber. The outside pool area is just amazing. An outside bar that served drinks and food. The pool is quite large and the perfect temperature. A lot of seating, from lounge chairs to beds to even cabanas. Just a beautiful atmosphere. Throughout the area there are huge displays of cows and sheep. A novelty. We ordered food, let me tell you the chicken wings were probably the best I have ever had, seriously. The yucca were delicious,and they will also do sliders for children. Staff was great. Leo was wonderful and our waitress Nicole was really nice and effecient checking on us all the time. The front had a nice sitting area, and like all kimptons fresh water in lobby with cut up citrus. Had a great visit .

The rooms are somewhat small (you learn to expect this in Miami Beach I guess) but this hotel is right on the beach.  We had a little bit of trouble with Housekeeping knocking early but outside of that the staff was very nice.

I would highly recommend this hotel to any of my friends thanks to the great service from Gladys and Edwin!   - Brian

My hubby and I had one extra night after my business trip to use as we pleased and we were thrilled to get an oceanfront premiere king room at this Kimpton hotel. The room and service were quirky and fun, as is always the case with Kimpton Hotels, but nothing compares to the service we received from the fabulous beach staff. David, Kenneth, Emma, and Edwin made us feel like movie stars hitting the shore after a week on our yacht, when we're really just a regular Joe and Jane. We can't wait to come back to South Beach and we plan to stay here mainly because of these great guys! The included chairs and towels are awesome, but if you feel like splurging, rent a cabana at the beach. You won't be disappointed! Food and drinks rocked, too.

I was amazed by the incredible experience at Surfcomber hotel. From the fast and very welcoming check-in to comfortable rooms with yoga mats (I love meditating:) to excellent service of the staff - everything was created to add to the overall experience and amazing memories of the vacation. Amazing location, fantastic ocean view, smiling faces around.  I especially enjoyed my time at the pool. Our server, Yuliia (always happy and smiling) provided not just excellent service, perfect service (and I am not exaggerating). She was always there making sure that were well taken care of. The bartender Sommer made us delicious drinks (the best mojitos in South beach). The service was wonderful. Definitely, I am coming back

The hotel looks really nice. We took a illegal cab by accident from the airport. Keith from the hotel sented de taxi driver away. Keith is really good and was really helpful.  He made us felt really welcome.

My husband and I stayed at the Surfcomber for a couple of days. It's so relaxing - very cozy hotel, nice atmosphere and most importantly great service! Most of the time we spent at the pool, thanks to the server Yuliya who was so friendly, prompt and always with a smile and the bartender Summer, who was making delicious mojitos. The food was good too. We will definitely come back next time we need a break.

David, Kenneth, Emma, and Edwin made us feel like movie stars hitting the shore after a week on our yacht, when we're really just a regular Joe and Jane. We can't wait to come back to South Beach and we plan to stay here mainly because of these great guys! The included chairs and towels are awesome, but if you feel like splurging, rent a cabana at the beach. You won't be disappointed! Food and drinks rocked, too.

I was amazed by the incredible experience at Surfcomber hotel. From the fast and very welcoming check-in to comfortable rooms with yoga mats (I love meditating:) to excellent service of the staff - everything was created to add to the overall experience and amazing memories of the vacation. Amazing location, fantastic ocean view, smiling faces around.  I especially enjoyed my time at the pool. Our server, Yuliia (always happy and smiling) provided not just excellent service, perfect service (and I am not exaggerating). She was always there making sure that were well taken care of. The bartender Sommer made us delicious drinks (the best mojitos in South beach). The service was wonderful. Definitely, I am coming back

The hotel looks really nice. We took a illegal cab by accident from the airport. Keith from the hotel sented de taxi driver away. Keith is really good and was really helpful.  He made us felt really welcome.

My husband and I stayed at the Surfcomber for a couple of days. It's so relaxing - very cozy hotel, nice atmosphere and most importantly great service! Most of the time we spent at the pool, thanks to the server Yuliya who was so friendly, prompt and always with a smile and the bartender Summer, who was making delicious mojitos. The food was good too. We will definitely come back next time we need a break.

My family and I visited the Surfcomber in April and we had a great stay. The hotel was in a great location, it had a nice pool and easy access to the beach. The staff was fantastic and very helpful (A special shout out to Foxi who always made sure the kids had a shady spot to sit near the pool - he definitely went above and beyond). The only complaint about our stay would be that the cost of the beach umbrellas isn't included in the resort fee, they cost extra.

Surfcomber is a boutique hotel, well organized and just in front of the beach. the hotel staff was always kind!  The room is spacious and clean.  A special thank to LOUIS the pool guy who had always satisfied any need !!!        I really suggest you this hotel if you are looking for a relaxing stay.

Luis very best person. Very kind and polite. The holidays have been beathiful  And the Service of Luis has help the quality of holidays. The hotel is cool and very nice. In general the Services are nice but the pool is special.

My daughter and I had a fabulous 4 day stay at the Surfcomber. First and foremost, the staff was amazing. Crystal at the front desk was so helpful as we explored how to rent bikes. Foxi and Kate took awesome care of us poolside. Thank you to the staff for providing us with an amazing experience. The decor is hip, relaxing and comfortable. I felt like I was transported to a small surfing community in California. We definitely look forward to returning!

Oceanfront delight. We had an excellent stay with friendly beach and poolside service. Our rooms were immaculate and stylish. As usual, Kimpton goes above and beyond when it comes to guest satisfaction.

Excellent service, spotless room cleaning. Wine hour was a wonderful bonus. There's something unique, elegant, but also really fun about this hotel. Access from the pool straight to the beach was great. Even when I didn't want to be in the water, there were plenty of other activities at the hotel that kept me occupied.

I stayed here for a 5 nights in April.  My room was originally on the main road, when I asked for a quieter room I was moved to a courtyard room which was fabulous without any hassle. So much quieter!! The rooms were lovely, the staff were all very helpful and friendly.  The pool area was great again all the staff were very welcoming.  Would definitely stay at this hotel again.

Absolutely loved this hotel! Food was spot on. I recommend trying the breakfast sandwich! Their drinks were delicious, great happy hour deals and wings for $1. Pool and beach set ups are great, service is great, they sent up a complimentary bottle of champagne on our first night. Free coffee in the morning and wine hours every day! So impressed! For the price, this place is a steal! Loved it and would definitely come back.

This is the fifth visit to this hotel which is ideally situated behind the beach a short stroll to the noisier end of,the resort. The rooms are a good size and kept spotless and the pool attendants particularly Foxi and new recruit Lewis can't do enough to make you comfortable. It would be nice if they got some new loungers with padded cushions similar to the ones on the beach. Lovely pool and very good beach bar. We only had breakfast in the restaurant but it was very good. Only negative was we wished they would have turned the music off at the pool but that is probably because we are older.

Lovely, clean hotel. Travelled with our 20 month old and I would say it is not massively family friendly but all the staff are welcoming and helpful. The rooms could be better sound proofed as our neighbours liked to watch law and order until 4am which was very frustrating. Also the additional fee to have an umbrella on the beach is just crazy, couldn't spend a lot of time there as a baby with no shade is absurd.

If you are looking to have the quintessential South Beach experience, this is it. The Collins Avenue was busy and even getting into the hotel driveway was hectic. We arrived early and were able to check-in after not waiting too long. The beach was beautiful and the staff both at the front desk and at the beach were very helpful and pleasant. The room was small, but had everything needed and was roomier than I thought it would be. The burger at the bar with the bacon jam is insanely good as well as the brownie sundae. The bar staff was very kind and there is even a cocktail hour complimentary at the hotel with wine and food. Everything was within walking distance. Overall, we loved it.

We had a fantastic stay in this hotel  It offers everything in a relaxed way  Access to the beautiful beach , good pool area  Bar staff (Kevin) really friendly and helpful  Rooms are a bit small if you are a family of three , there was nowhere to put your clothes or swing a cat  But this is a brilliant place to stay

I cannot understand how people have had good experiences with this hotel. My family and I went on vacation here in March and were so disappointed. It was surprisingly bad. We've stayed at Kimpton Resorts in Chicago and they have been wonderful, so the low quality of the Surfcomber was very unexpected. We were unable to change hotels, so we were stuck here and it was not fun. The rooms were very small, gross, and dated. The bathrooms were even worse. We could have stayed at the Ritz-Carlton or the Delano for the same price we paid for this hotel. The food was horrible throughout the hotel also and the wifi was really really expensive. However, the beach was great. Not that they can really take credit for that...

I came to Surfcomber for a quick trip with my girlfriends from NY. The room was perfectly designed, quiet, and spacious.  It was such an amazing trip, from the pool, to the beach, to the people, and the delicious food in social club. Well done Surfcomber!!  Will be back soon. Thank you so much!!

We planned a last minute getaway in Miami and couldn't be happier about our hotel choice. We arrived before check in time and Crystal was very helpful! She helped us get our bags checked and sent us to the pool and beach to relax while we waited for our room. Edwin, Kenneth, Axel,Patrick and David from the beach team were amazing! Special shout out to David who was really accommodating. Marlon helped us get checked in and was so helpful. Louis took our bags up and gave us great recommendations. It's obvious they care about putting the guests first here! I would definitely come back.

Thanks for making our experience awesome! We were a huge group (18 girls!) in a cabana and we were SO well taken care of by Kate and Gabe! They remembered our names and orders and were so on top of things. The drinks were great and the food was delicious (especially fish tacos and fries). Thanks, ladies!

A special thank you goes to Angelica at the front desk. She was very helpful and professional. A gentleman by the name Keith great guy,always smiling,helpful full of information about the hotel and area. Management was great too. The hotel stay was great food and drinks.

I have been going there for 10 years and its always great, I am always surpized by the upgrades and its always great. And the restaurants there are great. Go to the outside bar and have a drink on me.

My wife and I stayed a night to enjoy the beach after a weekend in Miami. The staff was very accommodating, especially marlon. He was helpful in getting us checked in, through a few little hiccups and to having a good stay. Good spot on the beach and just far enough above the crazy stretch at 11th street.

Everything from the customer service in the hotel to the food and atmosphere of the restaurant was amazing at the Surfcomber. Gladys at the front desk was super helpful and friendly as well as all of the bellmen eager to help. Our waiter Michael had great menu knowledge and helped make our brunch a lot of fun! Thanks everyone and I highly recommend this hotel/restaurant!

Surfcomber was an excellent hotel with a friendly and accommodating staff! Manny and Gladys were especially wonderful! :-) Be sure to check out the beach if you can't find a spot by the pool. Also, the breakfast in the hotel restaurant was great.

After we prepaid for their sister hotel, Anglers,  we were sent Away because they said they couldn't see it in their system. They shipped us on a cab to the Surfcomber. The Surfcomber took care of us right away. They put us up in a room with no problems. They also gave us some nice comps for our inconvenience. This included free drinks, breakfast and parking. We also got to enjoy the beach with beach chairs. Great job by Gladys and the manager Jim.   Anglers.... 1 Star Surfcomber... 5 Stars  PS  Beach is very nice. Two chairs included, umbrellas for rent. Breakfast very good at restaurant. Happy Hour with free wine once a day!

Stayed 4 days here. The staff is very friendly and helpful, especially Kate and Edwin R. who were pleasant and accommodating. The food at high tide is delicious and the weekday happy hour is totally worth it. The beachside service is especially wonderful. All of the umbrella guys were friendly and hustling in the heat.  The service at high tide and the beach really made the stay at the hotel for us.

Came to south beach with my husband and kids. I have a 9 year old and a 15 year old. We stayed here during my kids spring break vacation. This hotel was great. The staff was very nice from the time we checked in all the way till we checked out. They took very good care of us. Our room was clean and the house keeper came every morning and took care of our rooms. My kids loved the pool and the amenities. The hotel is also close to restaurants and shopping. It's walking distance from ocean drive and lincoln road. If your not interested in the pool you just have to walk to the back and step right into the beach. Wonderful! Next time I go to miami I will be staying at this hotel.

Spent a long weekend in Miami South Beach for both of our birthdays. Nestled between some big hotels on Collins Avenue, the Surfcomber was a great pick. It's so close to the Lincoln Road area and on the beach. Free wine hour ever night and great front desk staff! I needed something and the woman at the desk gave it to me from her purse! We popped in for lunch at the High Tide restaurant, not knowing what to expect. Our server Gabrielle immediately made us feel at home with her friendly style.  We chatted and she told us of her path back to the service industry.  She is a natural professional who should go far.  We really appreciated her attitude, helpfulness and friendly nature, She is 5 stars!!!

I just returned from 4 days at The Surfcomber with my 19 year old daughter. We absolutley loved every minute.   The room was comfortable (Maybe new pillows would be in order)and clean and had everything you needed at the ready. The check in staff were lovely and welcoming. In fact everyone at the hotel was warm and charming. Special shout out to Manny at the pool. He was so busy making sure everyone was taken care of and he did it with humour and professionalism. Actually thats true of everyone at the hotel.  The pool is gorgeous...we did not want to leave it at all. The beach was well kept comfortable and lovely.  We ate all our lunches at the pool bar and were impressed with the food at every meal.  I am booking the same place for next year!

The hotel is very expensive! Staff is great and friendly. Rooms are very small and not very clean. The corridor is very cold, don't know why they put the air conditioner that high. Pool area is ok. Will not come back.  Having a hotel two blocks away from the beach is much cheaper. The beach is public anyway

Our second visit and we will return. Miami Beach as it is now, yet the hotel room (with outside balcony) was fine as long as you expect the beach and island level of style. Very good service and enough amenities to make this as good as it gets in this location. Manager first class at resolving a minor issue. If you want the beach and many places to eat don't hesitate.

My husband and I stayed here in December during the holidays and we had the most wonderful experience. The room was decent size for Miami hotels. We lounged at the pool most of the day both days we were there. We didn't eat at the restaurant inside but the poolside service was quick and the food was casual and delicious. The hotel is a sidewalk away from the beach which is just about as close as you can get in Miami. The hallway was dimly lit and a bit spooky but our room was near the elevator so we didn't mind. Valet was quick and the people at the front desk were extremely helpful checking in and recommending places to eat. Will most certainly be back!

We stayed here recently on our honeymoon in Miami. This is a really pretty hotel. Immediately you notice the gorgeous decor and inviting bar area. The staff were very helpful and the concierge gave us loads of ideas of what to do on our short visit to get the most out of our trip. The rooms are clean and pretty, but our view was of the wall of the building next door, not ideal when I'm sure the beach views are stunning.  The pool and outside bar area is lovely and has cosy couches and rocking chairs dotted about, and the beach is 2 minutes away. It'a situated on Collins avenue around lots of other hotels and within walking distance of lovely bars, restaurants and shops

Location, location, location. Well, that, plus a really beautiful beach. This is what you will be paying for. The rooms themselves are OK; make sure you ask about noise; the first rooms we got were facing the back of another building, and the noise from that building's mechanicals made it impossible for us to sleep. The bathrooms are very tiny. Service is slow; our rooms were never done before 2 or 3pm.  The pool is nice; our kids loved it, and it's a great place to enjoy Happy Hour. The restaurant (Social Club) is decent, but the menu is fairly small.

We came here to grab some lunch by the pool. Had a wonderful waitress - Gabi Gianninoto - she literally was there whenever we needed her! The food and drinks were delicious too. Try the portobello burger - so filling and definitely worth the stop!!

Everyone who passed by us greeted us throughout our entire stay. Really rare to find such nice staff in the south beach hotel areas unless you're spending $600/night. Amenities were great. Happy hour at the pool bar and hotel bar were great. $6 for sangria, mai tai, margaritas. Overall great experience and definitely would come back here. Rooms are nice and clean. Beds are amazing.

Love this place! Katie was our server and after a long day of travel she was very refreshing and hospitable, great meal and drinks and an amazing location just beside the beach. Would've loved to book the hotel as it seemed very nice and happening.

The beach is stunning and the hotel has its own private loungers and parasols. The hotel also has staff on the beach who set you up with these and also towels. They will also take orders for food and drink on the beach. Overall the people I was with thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Surfcomber and would definitely recommend it !!!!!!!

We've stayed at a number of hotels in Miami for many years but we loved the Surfcomber because of its amazing, relaxed, and attentive staff. After a grueling commute to get to the hotel, the lobby and front desk staff made sure to take care of us from the moment we stepped out of our car. Gladys at the front desk was especially helpful. She was so friendly and warm, and she made sure the special requests we had were taken care of without any hesitation--in fact, she seemed genuinely happy to be able to accommodate us.   The location is perfect, hotel is beautifully designed, beds are cozy and comfortable, pool is open 24/7 and large, and room service is impeccably fast. I'd definitely recommend the Surfcomber to anyone.

Very clean.  Friendliest staff I have ever experienced in a hotel.  We enjoyed all the amenities. The pool staff could not do enough to make a day in the sun perfect. An afternoon bike ride with bikes available anytime. Then start the evening with a happy hour with all the wine you can drink.  We were planning an end of week bachelorette party and the staff did everything to make it a perfect weekend for the girls. A special shout out to Sherrise and Marlon and the pool staff that made us feel right at home.

Very grateful to manager Jim for accommodating us on short notice.  As usual, we enjoyed The Surfcomber immensely--Thank you. Thank you also to Car who was managing the outdoor restaurant that day. Peter took such good care of us, was always smiling and always had time to address our questions no matter how busy the front desk got. Thanks for a great and memorable stay at your hotel. I'll definitely be staying here again!

Hotel bar & food "the social club" also comfortable and good service, breakfast is good. Get a room with a balcony ... Big with comfy furniture room itself is good, bathroom is small... Minor negative: Probably getting close to a refit a quick paint job would be good. Staff are just great & and a very low key style, not at all the arrogant hipsterish attitude we have had elsewhere. We have stayed in many places in Sobe and we love this place we have stayed here twice now. Location is superb no car needed

Tremendous experience.  Great location with an amazing staff.  Elivette with guest services made our stay perfect.    We enjoyed the sun by the pool and beach during the day, ate at nearby restaurants at night.   A day of shopping at Lincoln street mall, all about 3 minutes away.

We booked one of the higher end rooms beach view and balcony.... You are set to far back from the ocean to have much of a view.  When we arrived the room was not ready, but we got the run around as to when it would be ready and because every time I asked a new person was there the answers where different. I would just think from a customer service stand point you get housekeeping in there early knowing that people are waiting.... After we finally got the room, there were vacuums and carts, dirty dishes in the hallway, there was tape left hanging inside our room.... Just average for the price of the room. I would probably pick a different hotel if I go back.

Stayed for two nights during a meeting.  The room was very small, looked into the next building.  The shower did not have hot water; the engineer came but did not solve the problem.  The front desk staff was friendly but not effective.

Surfcomber has a unique, cool and relaxed vibe that in contagious. When walking along the boardwalk everyone looks into Surfcomber and wants to join in the fun. If you are lucky enough to have Camilla help you with your stay you are in for a treat. Camilla made my daughter's birthday personalized and memorable. The food at High Tide and Social Club was the best in South Beach. We will be coming back soon to have the Cypress Creek Alligator, Charred Octopus, Burrata and Espresso Hazelnut doughnuts again. Thanks for a great and memorable vacation!

If you don't know the Kimpton name you should start looking to add it to your list of hotels.  1st time for us and we were quite impressed.  Super friendly and knowledgeable staff and location was perfect!  Although the room was a little tight(4 of us) it didn't seem to really matter as we spent most of our time outside.  Amenities were plentiful.  The bar doubles as a great restaurant.  While we did not use Room Service or the Mini Bar, prices were not outrageous.  We had a meal at the pool bar.  Same again here.  Great service and food.  There were a few families with younger kids who seemed to be having a great time too.

I've been coming to South Beach for over eight years (multiple times a year), so I've tried most of the beachfront hotels, many of which are nice, but the Surfcomber blew me away with their professionalism and incredibly friendly staff. Not only did they receive and log packages I'd sent to the hotel (so they could be tracked), they delivered them promptly to my room with a smile (and there were 17 of them!). Also upon arrival I missed the free happy hour wine, but they happily offered to grab me a glass to take to my room.  When you add the uber helpful staff with the nightly complimentary wine and morning coffee, it adds up to a wonderful hotel with phenomenal staff. I'll definitely be staying here again!

This is my favourite venue for pool parties during WMC. Never actually stayed in hotel so cannot comment on rooms etc defo got the Miami vibe stunning view onto south beach. South beach Art Deco feel. It always sells out fast to stay here at this time of season

Came into town for Valentine's Day weekend and my girlfriends birthday.  Hotel is great, but the room we we're given was not the best for a special weekend for my gf. Gladys at the front desk was understanding of my needs and promptly arranged an appropriate room for a special weekend.  I stay at a lot of hotels and not many would do that on a holiday weekend.   Thank you Surfcomber & Gladys, we'll be back for sure in the future!

She is smart, eloquent, charming and tells great stories.   Do it!

The room was directly next to kitchen and restaurant, was very noise,  Safe Deposit Box wasn't working, small bathroom, but with excellent assess to beach, free bikes to use. My husband likes they offer wine for happy hour. Size of bed is huge but too soft.

Surfcomber is in a great location, right on the beach. The one thing i didn't like is that you had to pay an extra $25 a day for the pool and beach. They did wave that fee since we were with a wedding party that negotiated a deal. The bar was great and they had free wine hour every day, pizza and Bloody Mary's another afternoon. It was cold and so they had a fire that you could roast marshmallows over. Walking distance to Lincoln Rd where there is tons of shopping and restaurants. Great walk on the beach to outdoor restaurants for breakfast.

That was an absolutely amazing experience. I loved everything about this hotel. I really liked the stylish decoration of the hotel lobby from the the first minute. The location is most convenient - the beach is literally 2 minutes away from the pool. The Lincoln road and all the shops are quite nearby. All the staff members at the Surfcomber were most friendly and helpful at any time during our stay. We had a dinner at the hotel restaurant on the night of arrival and didn't want to go anywhere else the following evenings - the food was absolutely superb. I would also recommend the social club and their famous brunch.

This was a great stay for my first time in South Beach. It is in a great location within walking distance to lots of shops bars and restaurants. It is on the beach side of the strip and the boardwalk is right behind the hotel. It has free use of bikes during your stay. The restaurants and bar have great service and food. The high tide bar is out by the pool and has happy hour with food and drinks. The pool area is fantastic and has private gazebo's available. Beach loungers are available from the hotel shack on the beach for a fee and they do supply food and beverage service from the high tide bar down on the beach. The staff at this hotel are top notch and the ambiance is perfect for a Florida vacation.
