My husband and I just returned from a 2 night stay.  We had a great time.  We arrived at about 1pm and our room was ready.  We were treated to a glass of champagne while we were being checked in.  We had a king, ocean front view.  It was not as clear of a view as I'd hoped, but it didn't matter.  We dropped of our bags and headed straight to the beach where we had chairs reserved in our name.  Patrick, the beach attendent set up our chairs and made sure we were comfortable.  We spent our days bouncing between the beach and the fabulous hotel pool, where Foxi took great care of us.  The pool and beach servers were prompt and coueteous.  The front desk staff was accommodating and helpful.  Lastly, the location can't be beat.  I'd highly recommend a stay here.  We will be back.

I'm writing this review pretty late, as I spent two nights here in May 2015, but I have to say, staying here was great. I have no complaints at all. Comfortable night sleep, kind receptionists, early check-in, beautiful pool and bathroom. Can't really ask for more! The only thing I would say, if people aren't that familiar with the area, is that the beach is literally a few steps behind the hotel, but further away from the strip of restaurants near Ocean Drive.

This is a good place to stay for a short visit but would not want to stay long term. The hotel is ok but super small fitness center with only two treadmills which makes working out in the mornings impossible. Rooms are ok but very small. Bathrooms are tiny! No place to put cosmetics or other personal items. The good part is that the location is perfect for walking to restaurants and night life attractions. The pool is adequate and the walk to the beach is short.

Enjoyed the free wine happy hour.  Hotel was kept at a temperature akin to an abbatoir or a meat locker which we felt was too cold.  Be aware of the fine print in your reservation that the hotel charges an extra $28.50 per day not included in your room rate which they will add to your bill without telling you for the use of their beach facilities.  To my mind, this borders on deceptive marketing practices.  During the five days we were at the hotel, the weather was in the 50s, windy, cold, and frequently rainy.  Not exactly beach weather.  We protested the mandatory beach charge for facilities we never used and had it refunded to us.   Nice room, pleasant small bar with a limited menu.

I hosted my niece's bridal shower in the restaurant facing the pool. Kudos to the  entire staff from Catering Manager with the planning, the Chef's beautiful and delicious food to the excellent Wait Staff all who contributed to creating a memorable event for my friends and family.

My husband and I went here for the second year in a row with another couple and had a great time.  This hotel is located close to everything you need.  You can easily walk to Lincoln, go out the back of the property directly to the beach walkway.  The staff was very courteous and helpful.  Kate, a server at the pool, was especially sweet and helpful.  Our flight was cancelled coming home, and the management was able to accommodate us for the extra night in the same rooms.

Two years ago we arrived at the Surfcomber after being robbed at our first hotel. We were exhausted by the incident, but we were greeted by the most gracious staff upon arrival. We explained what happened and Keith ran over and got us two mimosas and welcomed us warmly. We had a great stay. This year we knew we'd be back to the Surfcomber for another weekend of great service. We ran into Keith again and reminded him of the story and how grateful we were for his kindness and gesture. An hour later there was a knock on the door with a bottle of champagne and a note from Keith thanking us for coming back and recommendations for evening activities. The Surfcomber is such a fabulous spot with the best service ever for a girl's Miami getaway. Thank you, Keith!

We've stayed at the Surfcomber many times since it has been a Kimpton property, and it just keeps getting better.  As others have mentioned, the location is perfect.  Right on the beach and a short walk to Lincoln Road as well as great restaurants.  The pool and beach area at the Surfcomber is perfect.  Tons of seats in the shade and sun.  The staff by the pool, especially Car and Kate, go out of the way to deliver the best service and make the experience really special.

Keep in mind that most hotels in this area of Miami Beach in South Beach are converted mid-century properties so the rooms tend to be more traditionally sized (IOW, smaller than the norm), however in Miami you are rarely in your room so this shouldn't be a negative. The sun, glorious (heated!) pool and blue ocean waters await you - all just steps outside of your room. The fact that this hotel is now owned/run by Kimpton and that  they truly welcome dogs was why I selected the property to begin with however the service, comfort and amenities is what won me over.

From the time we pulled into the driveway we were received with extraordinary service. The check in was expeditious, the room was clean and had every thing in it necessary for a comfortable stay.  The location is the "BEST"! Off the Beach, close to Ocean Drive night life and Lincoln Road. We were able to move around easily and were welcomed back so nicely when we returned to the hotel. I loved the pool area and the staff most.  The food (fish tacos) and beverages are fantastic. I will be returning very soon. The General Manager Mr. Donte Johnson greeted us as we left to ask how was our stay. This place has awesome attentive and knowledgeable staff.    In addition, their uniforms are fabulous!

Right at Miami beach Kimpton offers a very nice beach hotel. All nice Kimpton features like the wine hour are present and as always they provide individual style paired with very good functionality and mostly attentive service. Great service at the pool and beach with towels, chairs, etc.

My husband and I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Surfcomber and had a wonderful time!  Not only was the property eclectic and fun, but in true Kimpton fashion, it's all about the service.  Our reservation was mistakenly made for the wrong day, and Front Desk Manager, Alex Antokal, was eager to assist - getting us in promptly and with a smile.  Having both worked in the hospitality industry, we know that accommodating such a request is not always an easy task, but it was more appreciated than I can express.  Peter, the Concierge also recommended a fantastic restaurant, which was exactly what we needed to end our trip on a high note.

In all fairness, the Surfcomber is a cool hotel, but I just don't think it is worth the money.  The rooms were tiny and the location is great, but other than that I wasn't particularly impressed.  With all the choice on South Beach I think they really need to up their game.

Gladys made check-in was smooth and easy. She even delivered glasses of champagne to each us as we were unwinding from our long day of traveling.  Everyone was very helpful and friendly.  The rooms are a bit small but since we were only there  overnight it didn't seem to be a problem.

column3: Right at Miami beach Kimpton offers a very nice beach hotel. All nice Kimpton features like the wine hour are present and as always they provide individual style paired with very good functionality and mostly attentive service. Great service at the pool and beach with towels, chairs, etc.

My husband and I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Surfcomber and had a wonderful time!  Not only was the property eclectic and fun, but in true Kimpton fashion, it's all about the service.  Our reservation was mistakenly made for the wrong day, and Front Desk Manager, Alex Antokal, was eager to assist - getting us in promptly and with a smile.  Having both worked in the hospitality industry, we know that accommodating such a request is not always an easy task, but it was more appreciated than I can express.  Peter, the Concierge also recommended a fantastic restaurant, which was exactly what we needed to end our trip on a high note.

In all fairness, the Surfcomber is a cool hotel, but I just don't think it is worth the money.  The rooms were tiny and the location is great, but other than that I wasn't particularly impressed.  With all the choice on South Beach I think they really need to up their game.

Gladys made check-in was smooth and easy. She even delivered glasses of champagne to each us as we were unwinding from our long day of traveling.  Everyone was very helpful and friendly.  The rooms are a bit small but since we were only there  overnight it didn't seem to be a problem.

I stayed for two nights in December.  A family friendly hotel, the rooms were clean and nice.  A small but decent gym.  Very nice beach club, pool area.  Great value for the money.  Would be pleased to stay here again.

Exceptional customer service!  I don't recall a better arrival experience.  We loved the small scale nature of the building, original charm, no high towers, all rooms easily accessable.  Very comfortable bed and nice rooms.  The hotel is located within walking distance of all the South Beach action, yet far enough away to be a peaceful retreat for pool and beach time.  Breakfast food was just average.  Lobby and hall decor could use a makeover - clean and new, just not in tune with the deco hotel architecture.

Extremely helpful and friendly staff. Offered to stored luggage for us while we were using the pool area. Pool is very clean with cold beverages available. Throughout the day they offered cold flannels with aloe vera, which was a nice touch. Definitely recommend going, as it's suitable for everyone.

Well of course the Kimpton Surfcomber is right on the strip of classic Art Deco in south beach. But the hotel lacks Kimptons signature. The lobby is stylish but the rooms are minimal and on the border of tacky. "Breakfast included" rates are a downright fraud (toast with a small cup of fruit), and cocktails top $17. Poolside is lovely, but there's a sense of shabbiness including a bags of laundry in the hallways. The staff is nice, but finishes lacking. At $400 a night, we were disappointed and will likely quit the Kimpton brand entirely. Sadly.

Best service! So friendly!! They came to check up on me and my friends and told us they had our back if we had any problems. Shout out to Kendrick, Patrick, Patrick and David! Thank you for your hospitality and welcoming, warm personalities! -Jamie, Lauren and Memi

I had an amazing time at the Surfcomber, especially my time spent at the beach. Patrick greeted my family very kindly. Considering we were a party of 14 I was extremely impressed and overly satisfied with the service the beach attendant Kendrick delivered for us. Each day including busy days he made sure we had our chairs secured and ready for us. The servers were excellent as well. David,Patrick and mark all delivered amazing service. I would love to come back upon my next vacation, the beach staff made the entire stay worth it.

Great choice of hotel. Centrally located and close to all the action, this is a charming boutique hotel that I would definitely go back to again. All of the staff are professional, courteous and very friendly.  Amenities in the hotel are excellent as well, as is the food they serve for breakfast, lunch or dinner. They have some great perks like wine hour every day from 5-6 where you can have as much free wine as you like and they occasionally serve appis as well. Pool area and access to beach are good. You can't really go wrong with this choice of accommodation.

This will be our go-to South Beach hotel!  Great location, great service, great value.   We really enjoyed our stay - every aspect was top notch - from the moment we pulled in until we left.   The front desk staff were excellent.  Talk to Peter he has great suggestions on thing to do.   The restaurant was excellent, and it was great to be able to sit outside and watch the parade of interesting people go by on Collins.   The daily wine tasting created a very friendly atmosphere and we met some very interesting people.   The pool and beach were great and it was super convenient to walk to nearby bars and restaurants.   Can't say enough about how the hotel staff made for a great trip to Miami.

The hotel in general was nice (the rooms are a bit small) but what really made our vacation special was the staff on the beach. Patrick, Kendrick, David, and Marius  made our stay so much more fun and enjoyable. They were friendly, kind and polite. They set up our chairs and umbrella promptly each day and did so with a smile. They kept the drinks flowing and went above and beyond to make this trip fun for me and my boys. I would recommend staying at this hotel for those guys alone!

A couple girlfriends and I visited Miami and stayed at the Surfcomber which had been recommended to us. This hotel has by far the nicest staff, so friendly and willing to help out with anything. We spent most of our time out at the beach--literally so luxurious! The beach attendants Marc, Matias and Patrick and manager, David, were SO nice and kept making sure we had everything we needed. We got a couple chairs and had a perfect view of the water. The food was also awesome, especially the burger and the drinks were great. Probably the best piña colada I've ever had. We chose this hotel because we had heard about how great the service is and it is absolutely true!! So glad we went and can't wait to be back again.

Overall I gave them 4 stars because of the great reception and service - esp. Peter and Camila (thanks), being close to the beach, beach services, on the path that runs along the beach for great walking or running and near Lincoln Rd. Mall with its shops and restaurants.  However, the rooms were very "cozy" i.e. small and for me nothing special.  Bathroom also very small, though they take advantage of every inch.  Rooms have no views and the single window is very small, not offering much light.    I would stay there again for all the reasons I gave, but don't plan to do much other than sleep in my room.

Second after a pool attendant was extremely rude she went out of her way to make sure our trip wasn't ruined, with complimentary champagne. Her calm manner and friendly attitude made us feel incredibly comfortable and welcomed. 5 star rating for her customer service. Very happy customers :)

Recently had 5 nights at Surfcomber and thoroughly enjoyed the experience.A glass of champagne on arrival was a nice touch as were the 1 hour hosted wine tastings in the lobby. Peter and Gladys in reception were so helpful with restaurant recommendations to organising basketball tickets. Bedding was very comfortable. The only negative would be the size of the bathroom. It was very small. The location is ideal. Walking distance to Lincoln Square. The pool area is adjacent to the beach and promenade. Would be happy to stay here again.

We left another hotel and found the Surfcomber- yay us! Lower price, bathroom smaller and less modern, but had a great experience. The beach staff in particular really did a great job...food, drinks, set up. Everyone was friendly and attentive.

We have been here for the Christmas vacation. The location is perfect-in the middle of the main street and beach. Great staff and quick service. The room was clean and comfortable. The only annoying thing was that we reserved our room via Hotel Tonight application and we were told that umbrellas and chairs for the beach are included on the price. When we checked out they charged us more $50 when we asked for what they charged us $50 more we were told that it is for 2 day beach chairs. Though we went to the beach only once. If you are planning to stay at this hotel, pay attention to this issue.Whatever, we enjoyed our 2 day vacation in Miami beach))

Very Unique - we got a lot of really fun photos!  The service was not great - we had to argue at check-in because they had the wrong information about our dates, and they tried to charge us extra. In the end it worked out. But found that the overall attitude of employees was very different at this location compared to other Kimptons.  We did have a great room location - with view of pool and view of the ocean - so a really great sunrise!   The room next to us had a party until early hours - so we got zero sleep. No soundproofing in this hotel.  But check out our photos - for WHY we were glad to come here!

One outlet did not work in the room and there were very few outlets. generally. Made a request for another pillow and it took then 30 minutes (and 3 calls) for us to get it.  Elevators were very slow We usually love Kimpton but this one brings down the Kimpton brand.

I stayed here with my parents, sister and kids, and my husband and two kids. Every member of the family loved the hotel from my 22 year old to my 80 year old father.   The hotel is very clean and well maintained. The bathrooms and bedrooms are definitely compact but have everything you need. It is in a great location that is walking distance from many great restaurants and shops. It is also right on the beach and has amazing beach access and running path. The pool is also very nice. The staff have been nothing but friendly and accommodating. Additionally, the breakfast at the hotel was really great and well priced for hotel food. Overall, a really great stay that I would highly recommend.

The hotel was very nice we got out of the car and a friendly man took out our bags to take to the room. If this is a romantic holiday or way to get away as just a couple then don't worry as the hotel has a lovers Pleasure kit for sale!!!!!(which my son found funny) The pool is relaxing and its relaxing to be able to sit outside and have a drink from the outdoor bar and they even have sofas and music and fans outside in an upstairs open area which is comfy and relaxing. Also there is easy access to the beach which is great and good views. The hotel also offers bikes for free (If you take back!!!)

Location is fantastic - walkable to restaurants, beaches, nightlife. Pool, amenities and rooms are top notch. And the concierge, Peter, is incredibly helpful and was kinder than kind to my daughter.  I"m a huge fan of Kimpton hotels overall and the Surfcomber did not disappoint! I'm already looking forward to going back.

I LOVED this hotel.  Wine hour was great, the staff were so friendly and helpful, I did not come across a single member of staff who was not friendly. The beach was fantastic the attendants there were super helpful too. The room was huge and spacious plenty of hangers, powerful hairdryer, room was light and airy, there were plenty of little extras like free magazines at the pool and even free lip balms they even had hair straighteners you could borrow if you forgot yours!  I will definitely be using kimpton hotels again

My friends and I are visiting from Philadelphia and he are the happiest guests at the surfcomber. We are all very happy we choose to stay at this hotel because the service, food , rooms, BEACH And pool services are the best of the best. Juan, David and Patrick way to go guys!

I recently visited the Surfcomber hotel's beachfront property and I had such a fun time! I was nicely set up with a beach chair and towels right in front of the beautiful Miami water. I highly recommend the fish tacos and mango madness! Everything was delicious! All of the staff were so friendly and the manager, David, was especially thoughtful to any accomadations I needed like fixing my umbrella to keep me in the shade throughout the day. I felt so relaxed!! I would recommend this beachfront service to anyone wanting to enjoy South Beach with luxury!!

While the front desk reps were as nice and helpful as could be and the location is great, the hotel itself is a dump; if the room we were in was truly "renovated" I shudder to think of what it was like before. The room was tiny, poorly decorated, poorly lit, just extremely basic and cramped. Maybe all of South Beach is overpriced, but in the past I've gotten great deals at the South Beach W, which is one of their flagship hotels and while usually pretty crowded, is nonetheless clean and beautiful with stunning rooms.

Although I was not a guest at the hotel, I was lucky enough to find myself on the Surfcomber section of the beach. I visit Miami every December with a friend, and this beach day has been our best to date! We rented a queen size bed and ordered food and drinks throughout the day. We are particularly taken with how pleasant the staff & service were-- Patrick didn't MISS A BEAT when it came to checking in with us throughout the day & making sure that our experience was nothing less than top notch! He also provided some great guidance on cooooolll places to go & things to do! ALL IN ALL a great day was had & I look forward to my next visit to the Surfcomber!

My husband and I decided to come down from Canada and enjoy a fabulous cruise in the caribian. Afterwards we stayed at the Surfcomber to relax and enjoy everything Miami has to offer. I would like to start by thanking Juan, David, Patrick, Mr. Jaylin and Elias for servicing us at the beach. Beach Personal has really stood out  for excellent service. I forgot to include Paul and Roman they also did a great JOB.

Front desk attendant was respectful and made great recommendations. My room was always clean. The pool  service was GREAT! I wanted to stay at the bar for ever out bartender made the best drinks ever. Juan, David, and Patrick worked hard to meet my expectations. Overall had a very good experience.

From New York in Miami, FL. My family and I are so happy to have enjoyed our self at the surfcomber . For starters the food is exquisite and the waiters were all very friendly. My room was kept very well and couldn't be happier with room service. Juan, David, Patrick provided great services and made us feel at home.

I had the pleasure of working with the concierge service at the Surfcomber.  The issue was of urgent matter and from the very beginning it was obvious that Teddy and his team were going to deliver a first class experience.  yes, this hotel is excellent but should you ever need the help of the good folks at the concierge services you will be glad to know you have the A team on your side.    many thanks to the management for putting such a great team in place.

This was our second trip to the Surfcomber. The occasion was my birthday.  The extra amenities offered by this Kimpton for the big day made the whole experience very special.  A special shout out to Peter, the Concierge, for the 5-Star Service. You and the Staff made this birthday a very memorable one. Thank you for doing an excellent job of providing the high level of guest services at this lovely boutique hotel on the beach.

I can just as easily copy and paste my last 5 reviews of the Surfcomber Hotel. This being my fifth consecutive stay was as good as the ones in the past. Friendly staff and warm environment throughout the hotel. Its nice being greeted with a smile. Aside from the transportation the most important aspect of the stay is the safety and security of the hotel. I felt both safe and secure. Looking back, I should have upgraded my room. I had a feeling, sooner or later, I was going to get assigned a room with no view. Still not a problem. My room had a view of the adjacent buildings wall. Hard to tell if the sun was shining or if it was raining. If your are looking for a safe, comfortable and affordable stay...look no further.

Love the Surfcomber in South Beach.  Great boutique hotel, very clean and updated. Entire staff is extremely friendly and accommodating! No need to rent a car as you can walk to lots of great shopping and restaurants. The eating and fun spots recommended to us by the concierge have been fantastic. Jalen & David on the beach today were the best!   Mary Dunfee

As an inner circle member i love to go to Kimpton hotels because the service is very personal and the Atmosphere  in the hotels is usually great. I went to this hotel a few months ago and i highly highly recommend to give this hotel a try. For me this is one of the best, maybe the best hotel at the beach if you take price/quality in account.  I stayed in their biggest suite and just wow! Huge, huge and nice design. The room was super clean and upon arrival i got a very nice amenity and a personal letter from a manager. I highly recommend this hotel and if you want to try a big suite, try it hear. Its amazing!

column3: I had the pleasure of working with the concierge service at the Surfcomber. I can just as easily copy and paste my last 5 reviews of the Surfcomber Hotel. This being my fifth consecutive stay was as good as the ones in the past. Friendly staff and warm environment throughout the hotel. Its nice being greeted with a smile. Aside from the transportation the most important aspect of the stay is the safety and security of the hotel. I felt both safe and secure. Looking back, I should have upgraded my room. I had a feeling, sooner or later, I was going to get assigned a room with no view. Still not a problem. My room had a view of the adjacent buildings wall. Hard to tell if the sun was shining or if it was raining. If your are looking for a safe, comfortable and affordable stay...look no further.

Love the Surfcomber in South Beach.  Great boutique hotel, very clean and updated. Entire staff is extremely friendly and accommodating! No need to rent a car as you can walk to lots of great shopping and restaurants. The eating and fun spots recommended to us by the concierge have been fantastic. Jalen & David on the beach today were the best!   Mary Dunfee

This was our 2nd annual Thanksgiving visit to the Surfcomber. We went again because last year's visit was great. This year did not disappoint. Just a perfect little gem on South Beach with great staff throughout. Especially Jordan and Jim Front desk Managers. They provided us great rooms - as promised. We had Thanksgiving dinner at the Hotel and it was terrific. Also a special shout out to pool bartenders! I would recommend to all that want a perfect South Beach experience without all the hype and some very quality time.

Camilla, from guest services is absolutely amazing and made my stay at  the hotel a pleasure.  She's a very special person and was able to answer every question and help me with anything I wanted to know.  The hotel is very convenient to the convention center and Lincoln Road.

I had a wonderful experience at this hotel I was greeted by Elivette she was very professional and knowledgeable and you can tell she love her job I was with friends I can honestly say that I don't do reviews but this one I needed to do she made me feel at home away from home.

Set up chairs, offered to order food for us, made excellent suggestions from the menu and made us smile with his kindness and great sense of humor. Thanks Foxi for making the weekend great!

We stayed at the surfcomber for 3 nights. The hotel was on Collins Ave which is central to every thing we were easily able to walk to dining and shopping areas. The beach was steps away. Hotel staff were friendly and helpful. They do complimentary coffee every morning which was nice. We didnt have a view from our room we stayed on level 3. Beds were good, bathroom was very small. Nice hotel for a quick stay.

The champagne and fruit was great at book in. The staff were so helpful that we felt welcomed from the start. Brad & Camilla helped us with eateries & local attractions that kept us busy. Rooms are Retro and great. I give it 5star. Brad & Camilla thank you. Regards Peter & Estelle

I love the Kimpton hotels, love love love!!!  Lovely beach!!  Lovely staff.  The rooms are small as it is an older hotel.  Very clean, nice products in bathroom. Could have used a coffee or tea maker in the room.  The staff all were wonderful, definitely an emphasis on customer service.  The restaurant was delish!!!  Lovely breakfast and lunch.  The salmon/lox and everything bagel was the truth!!    I would definitely stay there again!!  Can't say enough positives.  Only negative as the room is small the hallway noise can be excessive at times

I stayed here for 6 days on a business trip from San Francisco. Elivette at the front desk is the BEST EVER. Late night fried chicken room service is the greatest Miami has to offer. Location is great for going out and tons of awesome shopping & restaurants nearby. $9 room water was a bit expensive, but I still drank 6...YOLO!

Perfect location at the beach and close to everything. We stayed here with school aged kids, and enjoyed our stay very much, although the hotel is best suitable for young adults. Nice pool area and access straight to the beach. Comfy beds, pool and beach towels provided. Good service. The two double -room was good size for a family of four for a couple of nights, room very clean and well equipped.

We were looking for fairly small hotel with private garden and private beach right near the sea and found Surfcomber. Great value for money!  Reception staff was really wonderful and helpful, though we have not seen a maid in 2 full days (we stayed 3 nights).  Has nice and tasty café at the ground level and great bar in the garden near the pool. On the 2nd day they had pool party but area was open for hotel guests.  Also serve drinks at the bar station at the beach. If you are not American and are not used to it - be careful - they ask for ID to check age at beach bar even though I was there with 2 teenage kids!) - carry at least a copy. Our room had 2 nice wide beds and enough storage space.

I am a loyal Kimpton member and have stayed at Kimpton hotels thought the country, Surfcomber is by far my favorite.  I love everything about this hotel.  Location is one block from Lincoln St. and the endless shopping.  24 hour pool. Complimentary nightly wine happy hour and morning coffee and tea bar. But what really makes this hotel special is the staff.  Everyone treats you like family.  Ryan at the bar.  Dale and Chris the servers.  Eddie and Odie the hotel managers.  Everyone seems to enjoy their jobs and all the staff go above and beyond to make you feel welcome.   I can't forget to mention Patrick on the beach.  He went above and beyond to make our beach time enjoyable even though the weather was not typical Miami sunshine.

Vacationed with my sister here and we had a great stay. Had to have our room moved because of the street noise in the evening, but thankfully that was no issue. Right on the strip with the Ritz and other high end hotels so we felt very safe. Pool and beach was great - felt the service for the $25 resort fee per day. The restaurant food was out of this world.

Listen folks...this is the most best value in Miami Beach . Right now I am sitting at beach with free wine enjoying great service. My room is huge.  To be fair I am an inner circle member. Camilla gave me a wonderful welcome  with free champagne and free smile. My only negative is still the bar. They really need help understanding the customer relarinnship . There is one bartender..so sorry I didn't get his name..tall African American with great people skills. ..the other team really are lacking. The pool and pool bar super. If u find yourself in Miami Beach please stay here.  No brainer  if inner circle ..thanks team

I came here for a quick getaway with two friends and was so impressed with how well taken care of we felt at Surfcomber. The facilities were great; funky and lively lobby, huge pool, and comfortable rooms. But what really stood out was the the service. Everyone, front desk, pool, doormen, housekeeping, was so friendly and helpful. We really felt at home for our few days there.   Other great things about Surfcomber: free and delicious morning coffee, daily happy hour, proximity to the beach, and free use of their beach cruiser hotels.   I completely recommend this hotel.

For Miami Beach, this place was affordable. Note there is an extra fee to use the resort beach and it is $39 to park your vehicle overnight. The elevator didn't work for our entire stay, but we were only on the 2nd floor. The beach is beautiful and convenient. Right off the boardwalk. Tons to do on Collins street!

We are using this hotel for a seminar and I am a breastfeeding mom who is not a guest. I needed a place to pump so asked Gillian the sales manager. She immediately took me to a private office. On top of this I forgot my ice packs for my cooler and she had someone bring ice right away.   Her team has also been amazing for our event, making sure we had everything possible right away, helping with everything and attending to all the tiny details. Highly recommended!!!

After a lot of research, we decided to stay at Surfcomber on Miami Beach for an anniversary get away. The Surfcomber did not disappoint! The hotel grounds are absolutely beautiful! The location is perfect. Close to shops and restaurants at Lincoln Road Mall. The beach was steps from the hotel and included lounge chairs with our stay. The staff both at the hotel and on the beach were extremely pleasant and very accommodating.  I cannot say enough about this hotel. We will definitely  be back!

Every member of staff we encountered during our 5 day stay was exceptional - pleasant, friendly and helpful. Nothing was too much trouble.  The facilities were excellent value for money and comparable with much pricier options within the locality. The public areas were well maintained and provided an interesting decorative perspective while the bedrooms were functional with all amenities provided. Early morning beverages in the lobby and wine happy hour were great innovations and provided additional social interaction with other guests and staff.  Kate's Miami walking tour was thoroughly researched and fascinating, providing insights which do not appear in the guide books and is definitely worth going on.

Been to South Beach many times but this is my first stay at the Surfcomber. Great location, wonderful staff. Not like your oversized hotel where it seems that the staff does not know your name. My interactions with the staff and other guests were great. the staff knew my name and made me feel very welcome and safe, especially as I am a woman travelling alone.  Great location, great food and the evening wine tasting is definitely a plus, It is the people who work there from guest services, housekeeping, guys at the front door, pool and beach that make this hotel well worth it.

We had excellence service from all staff members especially Chase Mitchell of guest relations. The facilities and amenities were in first class condition. The property is located within walking distance of the restaurants and the convention center. Beach service is provided by the resort staff on the most beautiful part of South Beach. The pool is large enough to accommodate all persons using the lounge chairs and then some. The pool bar is staffed by servers who patrol the pool deck so you never need to leave your lounge. Excellent property.

Went with Girlfriend in July 2015 as a quick getaway to South Beach. We wanted something in walk-able to Collins Ave so we picked this lovely hotel. The one thing that blew our mind away was the pool settings as it was superbly clean. As a cautionary tale though, be very careful if you're looking for Wifi as you have to join the hotel club to receive it absolutely free. And another to note is that the resort fee is a little bit on the steep side. Besides this, a great place and within walk-able distance to some clubs and restaturants!

Sufrcomber is a nice hotel in a great location. The pool is lovely and we sat out all day with excellent service service from Angie, Manuel and Jonathan. Good drinks and a very nice lunch. Rooms are small but well appointed.

Just returned from a trip to Miami Beach.  We stayed at the Surfcomber Hotel and I can't say enough great things about this place.  Staff was friendly and attentive.  Our room was very nice and clean.  Slept great on the wonderful mattress and awesome pillows!! Yes, the hotel is expensive.  But, it was worth every dime we spent! The location was perfect - within walking distance to great shopping and food.  A special shout out to Patrick and Andy down at the beach!!  They were wonderful "hosts" and treated us as if they had no one else to take care of.  We had a great time!

Andy and Patrick are the best attendance I've had on the beach in a long time and that's saying a lot because I rent about 15 hotels a month...  when going to the cabana make sure you request Patrick or Andy

This is the first review I've written on TripAdvisor but I needed to start one. I visited the surfcomber recently to meet up with some friends from out of town. I love the pool area. It's beautifully set up for everyone to enjoy whether you're young or old. I had Angie as a waitress and she was very sweet and made sure we had everything we needed. Me and my friends were playing with the beanie sac game which was so much fun and Angie would come to check on us and helped us enjoy the game because we didn't have to waste time and stop playing to look for a waitress for our drinks. I'll definitely be returning with more friends.

Room was decent but had no view. Service was excellent and loved the staff sense of humour especially the reception staff. You wont need a car as everything is within walking distance. Lincoln Drive, Ocean drive and the beach are close by. Would recommend if just staying in south beach for the beach.

The pool area is large and has many cabanna's and a great bar. The beach is very clean and well tended.   The bed was comfortable and, even though the hotel was packed, I never heard anything and slept like a rock.

My girlfriends and I had an awesome experience in this clean and comfy hotel. The food and drinks were great.  I don't think we ventured more than 5 blocks from the hotel.  There was no need as everything was right there.  We ordered food for breakfast and lunch.  Get the Bacon jam - it came on the burger and the egg sandwich, it's awesome! Kate our waitress at the pool was excellent, she gave us great restaurant recommendations that we followed all weekend, saved us lots of research on a quick weekend trip. We would definitely come back here, service was very nice.

The hotel is nice and very clean. Our room was right on the street so it was extremely noisy. The staff is friendly and helpful. Everyday they have a managers wine hour which is free wine from 5-6pm so you can't beat that! We originally booked this hotel because we were told they throw awesome pool parties but when we got there we found out it only happens from March until I believe August so we were pretty disappointed. Fortunately they are next door to the SLS who does have a pool party every Saturday (rooms are more expensive there) and the public has access to it (highly recommend going). Overall, we enjoyed our stay here and the location is fantastic. Everything is within walking distance!

I'm new to trip advisor but i had to write a review about this lovely hotel . My family and I had a lovely stay at the Surfcomber everybody made us feel we were  welcomed. The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful. Manny the pool attendant treated my family and I like royalty always making sure we were okay and provided us with anything we needed.

THe sevice was excellent-all the staff was very friendly and helpfull especially  Cammila and the boys at the vallet parking. The room was very comfortable , clean and in very  good condition and well maintained..The bathroom was a bit small but  modern and the I liked very much the ammenities and the fine towels.   The decor of the whole comlex was very charming! The swimming pool and the gardens were lovely- a lot of space around with lots of seats and good service around! The Wine  at 5 pm was very tasty and it was very pleasant to seat in the comfortable seats and to drink the good wine! The location is  excellent!!!!! Loved it enjoyed  very much!!!! Would definietly recomend it to all my friend arriving to MIAMI BEACH!

We were a group of 10 and spent 2 nights at the Surfcomber in early October prior to going on a cruise in the Caribbean.  The location of hotel was great, the pool was great and stayed open till late (they even show movies in the pool some evening's), very good access to the beach, they also had complimentary push bikes which had very comfortable seats and happy hour with complimentary snacks. We had been communicating with Brad the concierge for many months prior to our visit and he went above and beyond our expectations, I can't compliment him enough, from room upgrades to recommending great restaurants, a tour of the Everglades and organising all of our transfers. Would certainly recommend staying at this property if you are visiting Miami and want to stay at South Beach.

The location of hotel was great, the pool was great and stayed open till late (they even show movies in the pool some evening's), very good access to the beach, they also had complimentary push bikes which had very comfortable seats and happy hour with complimentary snacks. We had been communicating with Brad the concierge for many months prior to our visit and he went above and beyond our expectations, I can't compliment him enough, from room upgrades to recommending great restaurants, a tour of the Everglades and organising all of our transfers. Would certainly recommend staying at this property if you are visiting Miami and want to stay at South Beach.

Had a great stay here for a quick birthday girls trip despite some sort of sad weather.  The vibe is hip and chill with no signs of the sometimes SOBE pretentiousness that can make those of us who are not uber cool feel a little out of place.  The staff was all around great.  If there was a problem, it was fixed immediately.  But almost everything was always in place.  And super bonus that the pool is 24hrs. We had great service at the pool and beach and managers went out of their way to make sure fun was had by all.

Came to Miami with a group of friends for our annual Columbus Day weekend getaway. Surfcomber was a great choice. Quieter part of South Beach, beach staff quick with helping set up chairs and umbrellas. Large pool area with great bar-shout out to Car the bartender who went above and beyond with our group. He gave awesome suggestions which we happily took and was spot on with what we wanted to do. Thank you Car! Loved afternoon wine hour-nice touch before dinner. Would definitely stay here again when in the area.

I loved this hotel, we went for Easter and had a week in Miami. Had previously stayed at the Miami Beach Resort further up Collins and basically the sun gets hidden by the building at about 2pm. Here at the Surfcomber you can enjoy the sun all day along. Also it's not too crowded there is plenty space around the pool and bar area and lots of seats for lounging around with a beer or cocktail. They have free sun cream and wine at 5pm. Lots of lovely touches and the staff are all very friendly and chatty. Much recommended as also close to Lincoln Road,  Way and Ocean Drive, plus there are free bikes so you can take a ride on the sea front in the morning. Only think I didn't like was the cost for a brolly on the beach and the bathroom was  Small

We were celebrating our 5th Anniversary and hadn't had much luck with Palm Beach so decided to try South Beach.  The Kimpton is a great spot to park your car and never have to get back in until you leave.  Unfortunately there is a hefty parking fee but all hotels in cities seem to charge that now.   We had an ocean view room with a balcony and it was perfect.  Close to the pool and beach.  The wait staff was very attentive by the pool.  Kate was wonderful with great suggestions about things to do and see. There is a $25.00 resort fee but you don't feel bad about paying it with such beautiful grounds. Teddy at the front desk sent us a bottle of champagne for our anniversary which was much appreciated! Overall this hotel is worth every penny... We will definitely be back!

We had a great 7 night stay at the surfcomber. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Food was good at the pool and inside the restaurant, although a little pricey at the pool for drinks. The hotel has 6 bikes (I think) that you can take out for the day free of charge, we took them out a couple of times . All the added extras made our stay very enjoyable!

Enjoyed 9 nights here. Very welcoming staff. Patrick & David on the beach were brilliant!  Would definitely go here again  One downer though was that despite staying NINE nights we had to pay for late checkout. Would have been a higher rating but for that which spoiled our last day there a little :(

My wife and I went on a working vacation. Met at the door with welcome after a long day of mismatched travel.  This hotel is among a row of chic SOBE hotels. There is no attempt to compete with pretentiousness, only great service, funky vibe and a great location. We stayed in an upgraded room with a balcony overlooking the pool area. Though the room wasn't huge, it was appropriate and plenty of room for us. Much to our surprise it was not noisy at all and the great pillows and mattress made for a great sleep.  The meeting area and food service, though priced SOBE-appropriate (read expensive), were again welcoming and delicious. Did I mention the staff was great?  The bar was chic and the barman skilled. We also enjoyed the evening wine hour.  A great place to stay.

We were just in for a wedding last weekend. I have to say that the $179/day that they put on your card for "incidentals" is quite excessive in my experience. That is not for the entire stay, but for EACH NIGHT booked. Obviously that can add up quick. Had a ginger ale brought to the room $25/ day resort fee includes 2 chairs on the beach, but another $20 if you let them open the umbrella that is next to each set of chairs. Complimentary Coffee, mimosas in the lobby, but if you are sitting down in the lounge and order either, you'll be charged. Overall, clean, great staff. Just have to watch for the charges. 19% gratuity is added to everything except the $40/day parking so keep that in mind too.

We spent a long weekend at the Surfcomber. The hotel is so cute and the amenities are great. Beyond that, it is a great value compared to other local, beachfront hotels. We loved the beachside service. The speciality cocktails were hit or miss. We ordered at the beach, pool, and the bar but eventually my husband just resorted to ordering straight up scotch. Overall, I would stay here again.

Stayed here for a weekend and I can't say enough about this hotel and there staff. First day hung out at pool and Sean and Angie were great and attentive. Next day went to beach and David was so friendly. The customer service here is top knotch. Definitely will stay again

Loved our stay at the hotel.  It has a total Miami vibe, which is exactly what we were looking for in our brief stay in town.  The pool is well-maintained, with tons of chairs and cabanas.  The reserved areas at the beach--with included chair rentals complete with chair covers and towels--made us feel like VIPs throughout our stay.  The staff was super attentive, from check-in to the beach attendants to a property manager named Chase who showed us around the hotel and gave us a tour and lay-of-the-land soon after we arrived.  His energy and care for guests' needs were very evident.  We'll definitely be back.

We were at the Surfcomber for a Urology meeting. The meeting rooms were nice, as was the pool. It was great to walk out onto the beach. The staff was most helpful--especially Najja and Ellvette who got plane tickets figured out for us. They worked the desk all night and were still cheerful in the morning. Also, lots of good restaurants within walking distance

Arrived and was checked in by the most professional and courteous staff member. Hotel is a fab. Location, foyer is spacious and funky. Outside pool area is marvellous and is right on the beach. Plenty of large umbrellas around the pool. Rooms area a bit tight, however they are very comfortable and adjacent hotels are double the price. Free bicycle hire which is perfect for south beach to explore. Good wifi reception throughout including pool area. Free wine at 5pm which is just a lovely touch. Staff are just so friendly and polite. I have visited 85 countries, this is one of the best....The staff made it.

This was my first experience at a Kimpton Hotel and I have to say they set the bar really high. The Surfcomber Kimptons staff was beyond helpful, friendly and accommodating. The grounds are immaculate. The pool was great, very relaxing atmosphere. The complimentary aloe towels, frozen grapes and mango margharita samplers were an incredible treat. My only complaint would be I wish there was music in the pool area. I know they throw incredible pool parties usually but I guess I stayed at an off time. Overall my experience was wonderful. Wine hour every day from 5-6pm didn't hurt either! I'd absolutely go back and look forward to staying at the other Kimpton locations.

Went there to spend Christmas. Very nice but minimalistic rooms. Pool area is great and the pool is top class. Service also very good. Close to the beach and close to shopping. Good value for money (if possible in Florida). I would recommend this hotel for others (and already have)

Visited this cool hotel  in July and absolutely loved it, no regrets whatsoever.  It's based right in the middle of the main street, Collins Ave. The hotel has direct access (4 mins)  and facilities on south beach/miami beach which is great. They have a huge pool in the grounds as well as lounge chairs set up.    You can walk everywhere you need to get to from the hotel, the main shopping street is about a 5 min walk away, and the Havana street is about 10. Ocean Drive is also walking distance.    They have wine-o'clock everyday from 5 -6 which was appreciated as well :o)   The staff were amazing! They helped organise dinners for us, car rentals and gave us perfect recommendations for our short trip in Miami.

Great decor in the lobby. They had fresh orange and lime infused water. Our room was decently spacious for being on the beach. I wasn't a fan of the tiny bathrooms. I thought the beds were comfortable but too many decorative pillows with no space to put them. We were in room 356 and it can get a little loud being by the elevator.   The staff was very helpful. Beautiful pool and ok fitness center. FYI the pool is next to the SLS pool which plays its music super loud.

I stayed there with my best friend for 4 nights in July.  We had a really lovely stay here.  The pool was very busy so we spent a lot of time on the beach which was perfect and quieter!  We had an Oceanfront balcony king premier room which we paid extra for but was well worth it.  We had an amazing view from our balcony and it was nice to be able to sit outside on the loungers.  I loved the artwork around the hotel, and the little touches (so different from the corporate hotels).  The wine hour was a real bonus and such a great idea, the food and drinks we had were all great.  Reception also very helpful.  Would definitely stay again.

Coolest little hotel on SoBe! The location cannot be beat. It is a 5 minute walk to Lincoln Road and 8 minutes to Espanola Way. The hotel is located beach side and you just walk through the gorgeous private pool area to get there. The lobby has spa water at all times, a coffee/tea bar in the morning, complimentary happy hour, and even had a workshop on making margaritas. The rooms are small, but that is overlooked by the cleanliness and the cozy beds! We were so lucky that our room was ready at 9 AM when we arrived. The staff was prompt and courteous. I will definitely be staying here again.

We stayed at the Surfcomber for 3 nights, the staff were friendly and the pool area was really great with a nice atmosphere (families, couples, groups). The food at the pool bar was also amazing- the Cuban sandwich!! The room was plain and simple but nice enough, the hotel is a short walk from Oceans drive. Would definitely recommend and stay here again!

I'm a big fan of Kimpton hotels so the Surfcomber was a natural choice when booking accommodation in South Beach. The room was small but comfortable and the location of the hotel is perfect. It's far enough away from the real mayhem of South Beach but still pretty central. The pool area is clean and well maintained (open 24/7). Spent most of my time there as it was EXTREMELY humid. We booked a massage in the hotel's spa suite. However, this is just a small hotel room. If booking a massage or spa treatment I would recommend asking for it in your own room. Overall the therapists were great. I will definitely be returning!

We stayed here on 23 & 24 August and the only disappointing thing about it was that we could not stay longer. Whilst there my daughter celebrated her 21st birthday and the staff made it an unforgettable occasion. The rooms are not large but they have everything that you could need and are the perfect base for exploring the south beach area.  The pool and beach areas are great but what really makes this hotel special is the staff. I have never stayed in a hotel that has more friendly and helpful staff and they make you feel very welcome. We hope to return next year and it will definitely be for a longer stay.

It was exactly what I had in mind for a quick miami weekend trip. I will definitely be coming back! Thanks Chase!!

My wife and I just stayed here and couldn't have been happier.  The front desk was a joy to work with as was the pool staff.  The pool itself is very nice and the resort is basically right on the beach.  The rooms are small but just fine for the two of us. Lastly, the bikes were an unexpected bonus as we love riding around town.  Overall this hotel is very well done, the service is fantastic, and the location is right in the heart of SoBe.

I had two friends from DC come to visit Miami and they stayed at the Surfcomber. We spent all our time at the pool being entertained and taken care of by the beautiful Chase. The hotel is gorgeous, the pool was beautiful and fun, and the staff were all gracious and hilarious and helpful. Special thanks to our new buddy Chase!!

Loved the location and the style of the hotel.  Pool area nice and access to the beach.  Food delicious in the restaurant.  As a family of 4 in a 2 queen bed room it was a bit cramped and the bathroom was very small.  Very helpful concierge.  Definitely recommend.

We were impressed with the cleanliness of this hotel. All the staff were accomodating and polite. I would recommend this hotel and will stay here again. We put our car away for three days as we could walk everywhere we wanted to go.

The surfcomber is a modern but relaxed hotel with a really chilled atmosphere, it really helps you unwind.  The rooms are trendy, clean and everything works.  The hotel is right on the beach and has amazing views, the pool and beach sections are very clean and tidy and the staff are very good at their jobs.  The social club is great, food is amazing and the staff are top draw.  Finally reception, everyone from the front door to reception is brilliant at their jobs. Well trained, well mannered and genuinely nice people.  My only criticism is that you have to pay to use the computers, make them free Kimpton.  Great hotel!

The Hotel is ideally situated. The staff are all pleasant and helpful. A special thanks to the following staff members who went the extra mile: Shercee, Gladys and Keith. The Hotel was clean and the air-conditioner worked well, as it was extremely hot outside. I would most definitely stay at Surfcomber again. Great Hotel and Staff all round.

Great Hotel Great location Great service  Nothing else to add, rooms are small, if u are in Miami and Surfcomber, u only go to your room to sleep, stayed there more than 4 times no concern of noise complaint neither from neighboring rooms nor from outside It is the feeling of resort but u are less than 5 minutes walk to Lincoln road with more than you can imagine of restaurant options.  Thank you Kimpton one more time.

Outstanding customer service from everyone that enthusiastically helped us. Excellent location and nice private beach. The food from the restaurant was good and we enjoyed having dinner served to us by the pool and the nice courtyard area between the pool and the beach. Thanks to all those at Surfcomber that made this a great family-friendly experience. Tip: Become a Kimpton rewards member online and enjoy perks when staying at any Kimpton property.

My boyfriend and I stayed at the Surfcomber Miami for three nights and we could not have been happier!  This hotel simply has the best staff of any hotel I've stayed at.  From the front desk check in to the staff at the pool and the staff at the beach, they were amazing.  Always cheerful and ready to get you anything you need or want.    The pool area is very nice and while it seemed a bit crowded here and there, the service never suffered.  The beach was amazing and you didn't want for anything while there either as the staff was on top of everything.  The free cocktail hour everyday is a big plus.  We've already started planning our next stay at the Surfcomber.

I was a bit disappointed with this hotel given all of the positive reviews on tripadvisor.  We stayed here for two nights as a weekend getaway.  The bed was uncomfortable and the pillows were very flat.  We could hear everything going on on our floor.  Doors slamming, drunk screaming and loud televisions.  For a kimpton property this was disappointing.  Pool was great.  Know that the pool is open to the public as well.  Drinks are a bit pricey, but it is Miami south beach.  Ask your server for any type of specials. Elevators slow and small.  Resort fee only includes chairs at the beach an umbrella is an extra 20 dollars.  We would not stay here again.

Great staff, front desk person told about us about one of the better Haitian restaurants I've visited (Tip tap). Good Location and gorgeous pool. Room is on the small side as is often found with hotels on Collins Ave. I loved the happy hour at the pool. It was a pleasant and FREE surprise. I would stay here again.

Great place to stay and well located on south beach. Excellent service by all staff at reception, bar, pool, restaurant,.... . Comfortable beds. Direct access to the beach from the back of the hotel via the private pool. Excellent and relaxing hotel.

Aziza & Gladys on the front desk were some of the friendliest and most helpful reception staff I've ever come across. I'd come back just for them. But the rest of the hotel was great too. Everyone is upbeat, approachable and a joy to interact with. The building is very pleasant and food surprisingly good.

We had the best time at the Surfcomber hotel! Came to celebrate my friends bachelorette party and we had a blast! Chase, David and Andy really treated us like we were the only people on the beach and made us their top priority. Thank you so much for the great hospitality, we will definitely be back!

Nice and clean hotel, cosy and nice pool area, practically close to the beach (has it's own beach area), close to Lincoln Road and Art Deco District - very friendly and helping staff, all the way around, specially the guys on the beach, helping you with the chairs and umbrellas, and serving you with cold beverage (thanks a lot Patric, Mathias, David, Edward and Mark).

Loved this hotel! The staff was excellent! A special shout out to Najja at the front desk for taking special care of us. We needed to change our room upon check in and it was done with a smile. Car at the beach bar was a truly enjoyable bartender who made GREAT drinks. Last but not least "king" Edward was on the beach setting up chairs and umbrellas quickly and efficiently. He was a real charmer. The rooms and hotel were small but the made up for it with lots of charm and comfortable beds. The only problem we encountered was with service at the hotel bar/lounge. Service was VERY slow and I felt like I was dining in the lobby.

Even before we arrived at the hotel, Aziza and Alex assisted us by fielding requests we had for our stay, and delivered on each and every one! They made our stay that much more enjoyable! I would definitely recommend them to anyone wanting to stay in Miami! The pool was awesome (you can order food by the pool, and they had complimentary flavored water) and the beach was right behind the hotel, just on the other side of the boardwalk!  My wife and I ordered the Bacon Cheeseburger which was delicious! Breakfast was also great (I had waffles and bacon for breakfast one time, but I can't remember what my wife had, but she enjoyed he meal as well)!  Overall, it was one of the best hotel stays I've had ever! We stayed from Monday - Friday.

The only place to stay in Miami. This hotel is the best in of Miami. Every hotel should be run like this. Alex Antokal, Brad, and Najja made sure we were having the best time. Alex made this trip memorable. This is what customer service is all about. This hotel is where it is all happening. How many times do you go to Miami and PITBUL  shows up? Well, he showed up! The succumber is the only hotel I will ever stay at when in Miami. Friendly service, prompt service, exceptional service, clean, The concierge, Brad was completely hands on. Very attentive and pleasant. Check out the barista/waiter/juicer Ryan. He will make you forget the Starbucks.  This hotel has the best of the best.

This small expensive hotel has its private beach, private pool and luxury gadgets in the room, as well as a great location. It also has a European flare, which is probably why it felt homey. Most importantly, they allowed us to take our Golden Retriever with us and they treated her very well. Their staff was amazing with customers, kids, dogs. Totally recommend.

I stayed at the Surfcomber for my bday this past week and it was the best time ever! the staff were all awesome! From the FOH to the Engineers! Everyone was helpful and very polite. The 24hr pool was a BONUS!!!! Sherese, Alex, Jordanne, Chase, Brad, Grace and everyone deserve a shout out for there excellent customer service! I will definitely stay here again!

Surfcomber is a smaller boutique style hotel, nothing fancy but it's in a great location and right on the beach.  You can walk to anywhere from the hotel!  The service and employees were all very nice and helpful, five stars to all of them!  The room was tiny, around 200 sq ft, the hotel lobby wasn't overly fancy but it's nice and very comfortable...The food and cocktails in the social club were good...I would say the one thing we wish was a bit nicer and larger was the pool, lots of kids and it's small but again the atmosphere was nice and relaxing...If you want a nice and comfortable place to stay with great people and are not worried about the pool area this is a great place for the value, if you want to spend a lot more money, book a room at SLS next door!

Hit the beach for our resort beach chairs, Dante set us up in a great location and umbrella for protection all day long. The nice breeze today really helped. The beach location is just steps from the hotel with both off the boardwalk.

The hotel is very comfortable and it has great decoration. The resort fee is a little expensive (25 dollars/day), but it includes good wi-fi, coffee, milk and tea in the mornings and drinks and wines at happy hour daily. It also includes pool chairs, towels, sunscreen and fresh water to drink at the pool area. We needed to do late checkout at 4 pm and we paid more 150 dollars for it. The hotel has good service, a wonderful pool and easy access to the beach. At the beach, the hotel offers chairs and towels, but you need to pay for umbrellas to protect from the sun. It has very good location and we could walk to Lincoln Road every day. It was a good choice!

For location and price... I recommend this hotel however few issues: 1. we noticed several times was that the female bartender at outside pool bar was not friendly or helpful. She's quick to ignore customers and make you feel unwelcome. Trying to spend money either buying food or drinks, bartender is unnecessarily busy and making customers wait.  Having said this, avoid outside dining or drinks. 2. While your sitting by pool, you would think hotel staff would walk around and ask guests if they would like drinks, no, your on your own.   Overall not a bad place to stay.

The hotel itself is very stylish and we loved the decor. The rooms were also very nice but hadn't been cleaned very well. There was a lot of dust that had been missed in places particularly obvious all over the mirror. Our glasses in the room were also never replaced and we had to ask for this to be done twice.  The pool area is lovely and you can order food and drinks from the comfort of a sun bed. Flavoured water available for free at the poolside. It was very relaxing. Overall a nice stay but wasn't quite worth the amount of money we paid.

If you want to stay on South Beach but don't want to spend money on something expensive like the Delano right next door, the Surfcomber's a great hotel with an excellent price point. Other hotels at the same rate I've stayed at on Collins are tired, a little dated.  But the Surfcomber's still hip, up-to-date, clean, and the rooms are great. Some might say the rooms are small, but I think it's to be expected for the art deco building and the price. The sheets were still very comfy and a high quality. The temperature-controlled pool was perfect and had a great vibe - neither too trendy nor too family. It's my preferred hotel when I'm in Miami for work travel. I rarely look forward to staying at a hotel, especially on business, but I do have a soft spot for the lovely Surfcomber.

The staff were excellent, the pool and surrounding area was top notch, throw in location, free beach beds and free wine in the afternoon. What's not to love?  We stayed here as a family of four for 3 nights before setting off on a cruise.

Forgot to add these pics to my earlier post.  These nice gentleman served up our "grown-up" root beer floats.  Just one example of the wonderful service we experienced at the Surfcomber during our quick get away.  Oh and the round of free drinks and other goodies took the edge off of nearby construction noise.  After a few strong coladas, what noise!  Can't wait to return!

Great hotel with amazing service epically the beach staff (Edward Patrick david and Andy).   The restaurant is worth checking out as well. Good for breakfast and dinner.   Only takeaway from this place was the construction being done on the property.

My 2 girlfriends and I just got back from a long weekend stay at the Surfcomber.  The location is perfect, we mostly walked to all of our destinations.  The hotel was super cute, we especially loved the free wine happy hour everyday! Great food and great drinks.  Perfect place to stay.  The best part about the hotel was the staff, especially the manager Alex.  He did everything possible to make our stay the very best it could be. Would definitely recommend the Surfcomber Hotel.  We loved it!!!!

We liked this hotel a lot. The Art Deco architecture and deco inside are superb and so is the service. Add the great location and fantastic beach with good service and this is a great option.   Some nice touches like free wine in the evening and free coffee in the morning.   Only quibbles were fairly minor: They include two beach loungers in the hotel price but then charge $19 for a beach umbrella.  Was served the worst cappuccino I ever had at breakfast. They need to train the staff how to use the coffee machine

I loved this hotel. It has the typical Kimpton fragrance as you enter the lobby (which I think is delicious). Our room was spacious and clean. It had a great view of the pool and beach. The pool area is fantastic: plenty of comfortable chairs/beds, good mix of music, pool water the perfect temperature, the hotel offers balls and floating donuts for the guests, great wait staff, free sunscreen, free chilled and flavoured water...  The beach are is also wonderful! As a guest you get free beach chairs (though an umbrella costs $19 to rent!). You can order food and drinks too.  Special mention to Mattias who looked after my husband and I really well - ask him to take a special photo for you and he will!   Overall a very pleasant stay!

We have stayed at Kimpton Hotels and have always been impressed.  Surfcomber was no exception.  The friendly staff made check in easy. The location and accessibility to all the South Beach activities makes this a perfect location.

Really attentive staff and a lovely chilled out vibe to the hotel. The interior and the quirky style of the hotel almost makes it feel like a gallery as well as a hotel. Lovely pool area and quick access to the beach where you can use the sunbeds. If you heading out, speak to reception as they have lots of local recommendations and offers. Great location (nxt to Delano) and nice places to chill out nearby. I would definitely go back and have already recommended to friends who have stayed there and loved it! Thank you Surfcomber!!

The room was nice but it wasn't cleaned in the daytime. We informed reception and they took some money off the bill but the receptionist didn't seem too bothered. I had a massage which was very expensive for what it was! The food by the pool was ridiculously expensive and the tip was already added on which was frustrating as the service and food were not great. I would recommend for the lovely pool and the location is good, but I wouldn't come back.

my wife and i were impress right from the beginning with Najja at the front desk,, from the first day till we left she went out of her way to make us feel special, which was nice considering it was my birthday gift from my wife. the next day when we were at the beach my wife got heatstroke and Mark and Clyde jumped into action to help me with her. they called 911, got the lifeguard as my wife had passed out from the heatstroke. we cannot say enough of the staff at the Surfcomber while we were there

The Surfcomber Miami is a wonderful oasis located on a great spot on the beach. I was with a group of six celebrating our friend, a bride-to-be and not only was the staff welcoming and friendly but they were extremely helpful. They secured an excellent location for us on the beach to enjoy and celebrate, all towels were clean and the drinks were fantastic! I highly recommend Surfcomber for anything from relaxation to a celebration and plan on going back. -Alexandra S.

The surfcomber was easy to book and a great location for our stay. We could walk to mostly all of our destinations. The staff were so extremely helpful and accommodating. Special shout-outs to Chase, Sean and Andy!!  The beds were comfortable and even though the rooms are very small, they're efficiently built and it was no problem for 4 of us to share.  The maids change the thermostat in the room daily which I did not like.  I had to turn it back down to my preferred temperature each time I entered.  Also the wifi is extremely slow and we all had issues with internet and cell service while we were there. All of this is OK in the grand scheme of things, because hey you're in Miami to see the beach and enjoy yourself, not spend the whole time on your phone.

I stayed at the Surfcomber for 2 nights in July. I chose Surfcomber based on all of the great reviews on TA.  I cannot give it more than an average rating because I did experience all of the amenities the hotel advertises during my stay.  The pool/cabana area was under construction and had a negative impact on my experience there.  I did express my disappointment to management and I must say they responded and genuinely cared about what I described to them.  I especially want to thank Jim Entrican, Assistant General Manager, who reached out to me personally.  He completely took responsibility for the poor experience I had and took steps to compensate.  Because of his efforts, I would return to Surfcomber if ever the opportunity presents itself.

I especially want to thank Jim Entrican, Assistant General Manager, who reached out to me personally.  He completely took responsibility for the poor experience I had and took steps to compensate.  Because of his efforts, I would return to Surfcomber if ever the opportunity presents itself.

Chase and Andy made our day the absolute best!  National tequila day.... Okay! Love this place will definitely be back!! They treated us like such a priority and waited on us hand and foot! Would recommend to any group that wants excellent service

I'll be honest- coming from Chicago, I wasn't that excited about the Miami vibe.  Surfcomber completely changed my opinion of this city.  This hotel has, without a doubt, has the most attentive staff that I've ever seen.  Chase and Andy- MADE our experience.  We didn't have to move a finger...they completely took care of us.   I'd come back here over any other warm destination in a heart beat!!!!

To be honest I loved it! Very good service and some of Yalls reviews were not true! Very sweet assistance! Donte was the sweetest! I'm coming back for sure! That's all I can say! I would really recommend you to go there with family, friends or even alone! Haha

The location is great! Just jump off the airport bus and walk a few steps to the hotel. The beach is steps away, quiet. Minutes from Lincoln Road Mall and good eats.   The room was simple but fine. Had a king bed and there was more than enough space to move around and unpack. The toilet, sink, and faucet were the most annoying part of our stay.   There was construction by the pool but it didn't take away the pool experience. You can still swim and chill.  The staff is great! Very accommodating and helpful! Just relaxing place to stay at.

The Surfcomber is nice if you are not looking for a quiet place to relax and if you don't go with kids. We went with a 7 year old and we had to shut her eyes and ears several times by the pool. People were drinking inside the pool all day long, which led to loud cuss words and inappropriate behavior by most of the adults there. And there was a loud electronic music, played by DJs all day, that annoyed us a bit. We also had to change to another room, because the one we were at first had something like a loud engine motor sound coming from the window, very noisy (staff said the noise came from the generator of the neighbor hotel). But, if you are in the mood for party and you are traveling without kids...it's a nice hotel with a lot of amenities for guests.

Stayed for 3 nights with family and it is clearly not the best option to squeeze 4 people into one tiny room. Modern decoration, but rip off parking is not worth it when a public parking is available a mere 2 blocks away.  Friendly staff at times seeming too inexperienced.

We had a great time at this hotel. The décor is art déco with a modern twist. Our room was tidy and we had a great view of the pool and beach. Loved the service. Everyone was courteous and hospitable from the moment we arrived to the moment we left. We ate at the restaurant for breakfast and had the omelet which was great! With our stay, they included two lounge chairs, beach towels and cover for the chairs. We added an umbrella for each day outside. The crew on the beach and at the pool were wonderful. They took care of us each day and made our experience amazing! It was a glorious weekend on Miami Beach with breeze and invigorating water. We would definitely stay there again!

We stayed here for a 4-day break in Miami after enduring the long hard week in New York.    As a frequent travelers, we were really impressed with Kimton Surfcomber as we had been with Kimpton Palomar in LA. Staff is second to none ... so friendly and helpful.   It's a beautiful hotel, with nice grounds, a great location (sort of quite but still close to all the buzz) and most importantly - the best service!  It's a little thing, but come to the lobby at 5pm for a glass of wine on the house ... meet new friends and share experiences.  I can highly recommend this hotel - we stayed four in one of the double-double courtyard rooms. We were very pleased :-)

South Beach has a lot to offer, including the Surfcomber Hotel. The hospitality, the accommodations, and its location make it an ideal destination hotel. Walk onto the beach, or sit by the pool, the service provided by an attentive staff keep you cool in the shade, hydrated, and well looked after. I recommend this hotel.

So I can't emphasize how much I dislike the beach... I was going on this mini vacay  for the sake of my family. I am beyond happy that I chose the Surfcomber. The manager at the beach was very helpful and made the experience so much more pleasant for me (my family is fine as long as there on the beach). Andy convinced us to get a bed, and it was the best decision we made. I'd definitely let people know that is the place to be... And to make sure to ask if Andy is working. Oh and to order food I don't know who works the kitchen but that is the best beach food I have ever had.

Great Hotel, Friendly Staff, Awesome Management. My room was ready as soon as I arrived. The hotel is located steps away from the beach. They have a 24 hour pool that I enjoyed every night. The food is delicious...especially the French fries and chocolate chip cookies. I would definitely recommend this hotel.

We were treated like royalty by Najja upon checking in late because of missing our flight in MIA last evening.  She greeted us with smiles, champagne, and a great room.  She's a real asset to the Kimpton brand hotel chain!  The entire staff was extremely hospitable, from the restaurant servers, pool and beach staff, and housekeepers.  The Surfcomber Hotel went far beyond our expectations; spotless room, beautiful linens, pool, and terrific amenities.  I'm so glad we missed our flight, because we just found a new favorite hotel to return to on our own for a much longer stay😘
