OMG!!! I've been to Miami several times & never stayed in a hotel like this...the customer service, houspatality was great! The food was good,  I really enjoyed the pool, didn't even make it over to the beach! Very clean, comfortable bed too,I will definitely be staying here next yr. O,they also give compliminary Champaign for a couple of hrs. A day too!! LOVED IT!

Perfect vacation in the perfect spot.  We usually stay at the Loews and decided due to pricing that we should try something new.  We were not only pleased with the accommodations at the Surfcomber, but the staff - especially the beach staff-- We could not have asked for a better vacation.  Andy made our days on the beach a time to remember! Everyone was helpful and friendly.  We will definitely make this our new go-to South Beach hotel!!

I've visited Surfcomber twice, most recently 4th of July weekend. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay each time. The staff is superb! They are really alert and available to the guests. Whenever I needed a cab, uber, directions, ANYTHING, they were there to assist me. The staff is always so very pleasant, no matter the time of day! Not to mention, the atmosphere is really warm and inviting. So diverse and fun! They definitely have a lot to offer those that get the chance to stay there. I will definitely be visiting Surfcomber more in the future.

Everything about this Hotel shouted class. The staff could not have been more helpful and special mention has to go to Brad the concierge who organised our car hire for us before we had even left the UK. Nothing was too much trouble. The rooms were small but very comfortable and the pool, complete with food and beverage service, was just superb. The beach is within shuffling distance and the whole atmosphere simply radiated style and sophistication. There were numerous shops and restaurants just on or off Collins Avenue so picking up some breakfast or dropping out for an evening meal elsewhere is easy. A great place to smaple South Beach from. We loved it.

Awesome!!! Best in Miami beach!!!! Surf comer best ever!! Treated us like queens every day!!!  Met our every need! Very attentive staff! The cold towels by the pool, wait staff were all awesome!!!!!!!! Only bad part was we had to leave!!!!!!

Our family of four spent two nights at the Surfcomber and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. We loved the property and spent quite a bit of time in the lobby at the wine bar and out at the pool. We immensely enjoyed the facilities!  The room was a bit cramped and small, but it was tastefully decorated, and we didn't spend much time in the room  anyway.  The bathroom was tiny too.

The beach staff Andy, Joe and Marc are really accommodating and always there to help!  Quick to get a chair and umbrella set up and the towels laid down.  I came late in the afternoon and they hooked it up!

We enjoyed our stay at the Surfcomber. The beach access and service were outstanding. Great breezes under our beach umbrella with drinks or food available from their attendants. Short walk to shops, restaurants and bars in South Beach. Only one complaint would be the late night party goers coming in at all hours with the noise filtering through the walls of the room too easily. We will return but will request a room away from the elevators.

Stayed at the hotel for four nights. A nice hotel with convenient location and very friendly staff. The beach is just a stroll from the swimming pool at the back. The warm water of the pool and the beach were very inviting, in particular our four year old grandson who could float around without fear as there were no divers due to the shallower depth of 5 feet at the deep end. The room size is good for double bed but for two beds can be a bit crampy. The showers would have been better with some power. Being only three floors hight, the hotel is relatively small and attractive. The weekend can be a bit noisy due to revellers invasion attracted by the happy hours. Overall we enjoyed our stay and would like to come back.

column3: Our famiky celebrated the 4th of July weekend here at the Surfcomber and had a great time. The staff was very accomodating to our family needs and made us feel right at home. The beach crew Andy, David and Matias did a gret job in getting us all set up and made sure that we had clean towels. Any requests that we had in getting beverages and food was done in a corteous and timely manner.  Thanks to all for a wonderfull time The Madariaga family

My wife and I enjoyed the long 4th of July weekend staying in a third floor (top floor) queen room. The staff makes a big difference at the Surfcomber.  The hotel was very clean and well maintained. It wasn't any nicer than the Delano or Shoreclub but the staff is exceptionally good. They were very courteous, helpful and attentive to the important details. The beach service is especially good. Kimpton must have a great hiring process as the experience has been similar with every Kimpton we've enjoyed. Great stay. Highly recommended.

Overall I was pretty satisfied. The front desk staff is very friendly and happy to help. The rooms are clean, regular sized. Nice bathrooms. The lobby restaurant is actually pretty good and not overpriced. Good selection of miami/american staples. The pool area is okay. There aren't enough seating areas, and the back end by the beach has potential, but they just don't use that space well enough. Luckily the beach is right there. There is no onsite gym, but you will have free access to the Lowes Hotel gym which is actually pretty good. That is like 2 blocks away.

The king size bed was so comfortable with its puffy pillows that it was a struggle to leave it but sunny South Beach called.  Staying at the Surfcomber, a Kimpton hotel, with its ideal location, heated pool and beach access was a real pleasure.  Very pleasant service. The hotel has a really cool modern design, fun pool scene, and it's own section of the beach where you can rent pool chairs. I worked with the hotel's concierge services, specifically Brad Low, to set up dinner reservations and to get passes to clubs. Brad was great! He was so helpful and knowledgeable and really worked to make our stay memorable - definitely use the concierge/front desk for reference, they know what they are doing!! Will definitely be staying at the Surfcomber again on my next visit to Miami :)

I've stayed at the Surfcomber twice, once for business and once for a long weekend getaway with my girlfriend.  The locations is great as it is located on the beach, a few blocks from Lincoln Road, and a short walk to Ocean Drive.  The hotel staff were extremely nice and accommodating.  It was a great experience for the price - particularly at the low season beginning in June.  Couple tips - ask for a garden view room if possible and sign up for the (free) Kimpton Hotels reward program in advance of your visit.  You will get free wifi, a voucher for the mini bar, an possibly a nicer room.

I travel a lot with family and business.  This hotel is amongst the very best.  From the staff at the valet, to the receptionists, to the pool staff, and finally but not LEAST, the beach staff.  They go out of their way to ensure you are stay is memorable.    Quick note - Go relax on the Surfcomber's luxurious beach setup.  The staff is amazing.  Andy's staff who includes Edrick, Tavio, Dante, David, and Mank each ensured that our beach visit was top notch!! (I am not good with remembering names, so that should tell you something).  We will be back again!!

Excellent stay and fantastic beach staff!!!Thank you to Tavio,Dante,Mark,David,Andy and Edrick. You made our time here very relaxing and well taken care of. Service was prompt and super friendly. Will be back for sure. Thanks again!!  - Jimenez family

We stayed at the Surfcomber this weekend for my sister-in-law's bachelorette party. The hotel is on the smaller side, but the common spaces are well laid out and our room fit four of us comfortably. The front desk staff were pleasant and accommodating, but the beach staff went above and beyond and made for a fantastic experience.  Edrick, David, Andy, Tavio, and Dante were incredibly friendly and fun, and their service was impeccable. I generally like to stay at different hotels when I visit a city more than once, but would return to the Surfcomber because of them.

I had a great weekend stay at the Surfcomber, largely in part due to the fabulous beach staff. They made sure that my time on the beach was relaxing and enjoyable. Their positive attitude and friendliness exceeded standard professionalism and courtesy, and Edrick's management was super. I would without a doubt come back to the Surfcomber because of the fabulous experience provided by Edrick, David, Dante, and Tavio. Thanks guys!

me and my wife came to surfcomber on a weekend trip to Miami Beach. My wife who is normally pretty picky about rooms was pleased with the room and the bathroom. The bed was extremely comfortable with crisp sheets. The stay was really nice.  We particularly enjoyed the beach. Beach staff was awesome. Thank you mank David Dante tavio and managers Andy and edrick!!  You made us very comfortable.

Oh my god!!!! I didn't want to leave this place. The service is awesome. The staff couldn't be better. The area is superb, you really feel that you are on holidays. And the room is perfect, not too big not too small, well decorated, and have some heavenly bed!!!!

Since we have walked in the staff has been nothing but friendly and accommodating. Smiles and Service! It's right on the beach is wonderfully decorated. The beach manager and his staff and so great! Overall, the hotel has a very lively atmosphere and is just what you expect from a trip to Miami!

I visited the Surfcomber for a bachelorette weekend and had the best experience. Nice rooms, great location, friendly and helpful staff...Dante and David and Mark and Edrick and Linden were all super helpful and accommodating on the beach. I would highly recommend the Surfcomber. Would definitely go back again!

Here celebrating my sisters bachelorette with 11 girls and I can't say enough nice things about this hotel! The thing that sets it apart in my mind is the service. We have been treated like princesses the whole time. From Brad, the concierge going out of his way to help out with last minute party plans, to Lynden and Donte at the beach making sure we had the perfect beach chair location to David and Mark keeping the Black Crush drinks flowing, every single employee has made our stay five star. All of this while they have had huge events going on for DJ Irie weekend. This is the perfect place on South Beach for an amazing girls weekend!

I've been to many a south beach hotel, including the Mandarin and Ritz Carlton hotels and I am absolutely impressed by the service!   On the beach: Dante', Edrick and David attended to our every need. They were informative and attentive. Cabana's, drinks, and food.  At the pool Manuel was great!  Definitely coming back! Renewed my faith in South Beach!   A +++++

Amazing staff at this hotel as everyone was extremely attentive, friendly, and helpful.  Everyone from the valet, bellhop, door greeter to the front desk, bartender, waiters and cleaning staff was professional and helpful. Our room was very clean thanks to Lucienni.  It is a very dog friendly hotel as my girlfriend brought her dog on our trip. The beach was amazingly beautiful and clean.  They even offer a free wine happy hour in addition! We had just one charge on our bill in error, but thanks to Elivette it was quickly taken care of!  The room was small but comfortable and very clean.  I would recommend this hotel as Kimpton does a fabulous job all around!!

Arrived very early and was greeted warmly by the front desk. Room wasn't ready but I didn't expect it to be at 11am. And it didn't matter, of course. My destination was the beach, and I headed straight there. Andy set me up with my chairs and umbrella; Edrick hooked me up with tanning lotion; David's been supplying the food and drinks. I've spent the day doing what I've wanted and have been treated very well so far. Great service

I flew into Miami to spend Mother's Day with my daughters. I arrived on Mother's Day and left on Tuesday.   From the moment I walked in the door I was warmly greeted by everyone from the valet, the front desk  and even the GM, Donte Johnson!  We spent a lot of time by the pool and the service was great.  The concierge Brad was outstanding!!  The hotel is in a perfect location, walking distance to so many restaurants and beach access. I've stayed at Kimpton hotels before and I always have a good experience.  The Surfcomber was right up there with the rest!!!  Thanks to the entire staff for making this one the best Mother's Day ever!!!    Momma from the "D"

Amazing hotel and staff! The front desk staff were attentive, friendly and helpful. Everyone from the bartender to the doormen to the GM were really fantastic. Our room was lovely and we were even sent treats for Mother's Day! If you stay anywhere in S. Beach, it has to be the Surfcomber!!

A fantastic boutique hotel with all the amenities you'd want in Miami Beach; lovely pool, direct beach access, central location.  The hotel staff is incredibly friendly and attentive and as a Kimpton brand hotel, has lots of opportunities for upgrades and bonuses to add to your stay gratis.  Hotel decor is bright and cheery and as a small hotel, it's nice and quiet, even at the busiest times.

I visited the Surfcomber last week for my 30th with a group of girlfriends. It was our first time staying there and we all had an amazing time. I was so impressed with the hotel - what a great experience! The lobby was beautiful, the room was clean and very modern and chic looking, the restaurant (The Social Club) was delicious, the pool and beach were awesome, and above all else, the service was phenomenal. The concierge, Brad, sent champagne and a card to the room the day we arrived. He also helped us plan our entire weekend and we were not disappointed once. Thank you Brad and the Surfcomber for making my birthday weekend so special! I will definitely be back!

I really enjoyed my stay ,they had very clean rooms and very comfortable beds.the staff was very helpful and made me feel at home. If you want to feel a part of the action this is the hotel to be. I really enjoyed the pool and there  very discrete oasis in the back I was able to sit back and relax and enjoy my vacation and the next time I come back to Miami this is the hotel to be my home away from home..and very good food,two thumbs up

Stayed here for a long weekend for my friend's wedding and had a great time.  The pool and beach were great.  The staff were all great people, especially Edrich and Andy at the beach.  Edrich hooked it up with some well located chairs on the beach and Andy kept the beers coming at a steady flow!  The hotel is well located with a variety of great bars and restaurants a short walk away.

I am a returning guest of the Surfcomber and like last year it was the perfect stay for my trip that was both business and a weekend day of pleasure. All the staff from Valet over front desk to pool and room service are super friendly and attentive. The hotel is facing the ocean, has a beautiful pool surrounded by palm trees and the hotel beach is just across the beach road where you can go for extensive jogging along the Miami Beach skyline. Plus the highly frequented Lincoln Road with restaurants and shopping is in walking distance, same as some of the best restaurants and clubs of Miami Beach. I can recommend this hotel to anyone. Make sure you get a room that is facing the courtyard or the ocean right away, it is worth the extra money.

Great Hotel!  The customer service was grand and the location was really convenient. I loved the personal touch that the staff used. Little things like an on time wake up call or having my favorite wine delivered to my door goes a long way. Even the general manager of the whole property Donte made me feel like I was the most important guest in the building. Qualities like this in hotels are rare which is why I'd recommend others to consider a stay.

From check in to check out this hotel was hands down fabulous. We arrived Thursday evening and was treated by Aziza, who was just marvellous. Dorgis took care of our luggage and just made us feel so welcome to the hotel. Pool was amazing, Sean, Manuel and Roxi were second to none. After check-in we were asked if they could do anything further and we asked for sunshine, well Aziza and  guest services sent the sunshine to our room, picture attached.  It was an amazing place to stay made even more pleasurable with the top notch customer service. Surfcomber was a fabulous place to stay, great location, great staff and we cannot wait to go back. Thanks to all for making our trip so special. You are all awesome, thank you

My wife and I stayed here for 6 nights in May and had an excellent stay. We were there to celebrate our wedding anniversary and my wife's birthday, and the staff couldnt of been more helpful if they tried. We were treated at the beach by the wonderful staff, spoilt at reception and upgraded to a balcony room, plus the wine tasting at 5pm each day we thought was a great idea. We would definitely recommend this hotel.

I usually travel to miami since i used to live there. But this was my first staying at The Surfcomber in South Beach. What an amazing staff. Great service from the front desk to cleaning staff.  Specially the pool staff. The Manager Chase, make sure you well taken care off. He is absolutely the best. Along with co-workers Joseph - Andy and Mark they all would make sure your beach experience is 100% the best. Truly hardworking people. Crystal pool waitress (you wont miss her- Shes a gorgeous girl wearing a big hat) Amazing Service Thanks a lot Guys!! Coming back again in July. Cant wait

column3: I've stayed at the Surfcomber a few times and the staff is always so pleasant! They remember all of the little details which makes every stay personal.   The rooms are extremely clean. The staff is awesome. The beach is directly behind the hotel. It's the perfect piece of paradise!

From check in to check out this hotel was hands down fabulous. We arrived Thursday evening and was treated by Aziza, who was just marvellous. Dorgis took care of our luggage and just made us feel so welcome to the hotel. Pool was amazing, Sean, Manuel and Roxi were second to none. After check-in we were asked if they could do anything further and we asked for sunshine, well Aziza and  guest services sent the sunshine to our room, picture attached.  It was an amazing place to stay made even more pleasurable with the top notch customer service. Surfcomber was a fabulous place to stay, great location, great staff and we cannot wait to go back. Thanks to all for making our trip so special. You are all awesome, thank you

My wife and I stayed here for 6 nights in May and had an excellent stay. We were there to celebrate our wedding anniversary and my wife's birthday, and the staff couldnt of been more helpful if they tried. We were treated at the beach by the wonderful staff, spoilt at reception and upgraded to a balcony room, plus the wine tasting at 5pm each day we thought was a great idea. We would definitely recommend this hotel.

I usually travel to miami since i used to live there. But this was my first staying at The Surfcomber in South Beach. What an amazing staff. Great service from the front desk to cleaning staff.  Specially the pool staff. The Manager Chase, make sure you well taken care off. He is absolutely the best. Along with co-workers Joseph - Andy and Mark they all would make sure your beach experience is 100% the best. Truly hardworking people. Crystal pool waitress (you wont miss her- Shes a gorgeous girl wearing a big hat) Amazing Service Thanks a lot Guys!! Coming back again in July. Cant wait

I didn't want a big chain hotel, I wanted a more intimate boutique hotel but I didn't want to lose on services and I didn't want to pay through the roof either. I have achieved both! It's quirky in finishes, location is outstanding, beach superb, rooms well above average but what separates this hotel is its staff! They have trained them well and they are collectively very good. They really have focussed on their customer service and so they deserve all the praise that's due to them! I can only find a small annoyance which was when we stayed the gym was being upgraded so it was closed. But they had thought of an alternative and the hotel a short walk away with an amazing gym was available at anytime! Do treat yourself you'll not be disappointed

The hotel is very nice and very clean. The staff are very polite and helpful. We arrived around 3pm and were told each room had 2 sunbeds on the beach; when we went to the beach around 4pm, the chap took away the sun umbrella as we had to pay $19 to keep that! The room was very noisey due to the air conditioning units in the court yard. We didn't go into the pool as there were groups of youngsters in there with drinks and were being loud. Wouldn't go to Miami again, wasn't impressed. However, the location of this hotel is good as you are not right on top of the 'action'.

We arrived at the hotel at 4 pm and so did other members of our wedding party the next day and the rooms were still not ready.   The gym was closed down and we were sent down the Street to use the gym at another hotel.  They blare throbbing rap music with incessant drums pounding all day long with no break by the pool and throughout the lobby.  Many of us asked for a break every hour for just twenty minutes to read or rest peacefully and management refused. They claimed to have turned it down but it was relentless no matter where we sat.   Dont stay here if you're lookbg for a luxurious place  to relax and unwind!!!

We had a drink and dinner here last year with guest's of the hotel and were suitably impressed  to book when we came for a conference. The staff from reception through to the bar and restaurant are excellent. The room was well appointed although I would ask for a room away from the pool area as service people start early to work and guests can be heard wheeling their trollies to reception when checking out early. The breakfast were great every day and the evening one hour of 'complimentary' wines was just the tonic after a busy day. I say 'complimentary' as it was advertised but this was billed when when we checked out! Very naughty and a real downside to ever returning!

We have stayed at the surfcomber on multiple occasions it is our favorite hotel on south beach. This weekend the weather was beautiful and Chase helped us get a prime spot with a "beach bed" where we spent the majority of the weekend. His customer service was great and he was very friendly and entertaining. We will definitely be back for another stay and highly recommend this hotel. Also, thank you to Leslie,Allie,foxy, and manny at the pool!

This was our first time at the Surfcomber, but not at a Kimpton hotel. The Surfcomber has all the amenities and style that you would expect from Kimpton. The free WiFi and nightly wine tastings were both great. Our room was really nice with a courtyard view and a king sized bed. The food at the hotel, while a bit pricey, was excellent. We ate most of our meals here, as it was easiest, because we were travelling with our 3 year old. The best part about our stay was the beach and the beachfront amenities.  We got free chairs, a free umbrella and free towels on the beach. We also ordered food and drinks to the beach which was fun. The beach staff were really friendly and personable.  I would love to stay here again when we are back in Miami!

The staff had champagne waiting for us in the room for our anniversary, the staff was amazingly helpful, friendly and made us feel like VIPs. The pool was beautiful, clean and fun without being too rowdy. Beach access was easy and it was great to get the chairs included with the resort fee. We stopped by a lot of hotels for drinks or dinner during our stay and none had the warm environment the Surfcomber had. We will definitely be back!!

Had a great time Andy and team at the beach were very attentive. The service at the hotel was great and the food is amazing.  The rooms are nice and neat and comfortable.  We would definitely return here again!

It was already our third trip in Surfcomber and it was the best. Top friendly service, with free morning coffee & tea and free wine for aperitif. Clean, quiet and dynamic, well placed and easy style.  Pool or Beach are excellent places for relaxing. I love Kimptons.  I have never been disappointed.  Until now.   The room was tiny tiny tiny.  I felt claustrophobic.  The bathtub had paint splattered on it which gave it the appearance of being dirty.  There was a long dirty stain on the inside of the bathroom door.  The bellman tried to tell me how to save money by using the mini bar and replacing the items myself.  Not much loyalty in staff there.  There were old cigarette butts under the lounge chairs on the pool deck.  I voiced my concerns to the Front Office Manager who called the next hotel on my stop which was a Kimpton and made sure that I didn't have an disappointments there.   Management tried very hard to correct the problem.  I wouldnt stay at this hotel again  Too many other options in Miami.

First off all, i want to say that this was one of the place well treated places i ever been. People in the Surfcomber were so nice, it worths every penny. The happy hour from 5 to 6 pm is a nice thing. We stayed already in the past on Pestana South beach and Lowes, but in my opinion this is far better in global. One great thing is the free sun beds, everywhere in south beach you have to pay for them.  Next time i will come back to the Surfcomber. People say that the bathrooms are small, but for me thats not an issue.

This hotel property is excellent and the service is wonderful. My only two issues are that there is a 25 dollar a night resort fee and for the room rates they charge they should just add 25 dollars per night to cover that cost. the other issue is the bathrooms are very small and there are right next to the bed making it not quite as private as one might hope. That being said this place is very relaxing and is a gorgeous property with excellent service. If you stay here you won't regret it. I could have stayed another few days.

Stayed at the surfcomber for a night while visiting Miami prior to going on a cruise to the Bahamas. I have to say that the hotel surpassed my expectations and wish I could have stayed for longer. Rooms were very well appointed with very comfy beds and rain showers.The pool area and beach are lovely and compared to other hotels nearby it was far more relaxed with music at a sensible volume, having a signature cocktail while lounging under the palm trees watching the parrots was great! If your staying in Miami and want to be just the right distance away from ocean drive then you won't be disappointed with the surfcomber

Since my friends and I arrived the staff was very nice and friendly! The hotel is beautiful and the pool is a nice size! I love the beach service! We had a weekend here and it was just ok... Yes the location is good on Collins but the service second rate. We know that at times it's hard to keep up but it was universally slow and at times downright rude. We left the bar because the bar man asked us to move ... We were standing at the bar waiting to be served !!  Very overpriced for the overall experience. Much better alternatives on Collins.

Only negative point the extra charge of 19 USD for one umbrella on the beach side.

Stayed here with my boyfriend for a long weekend get away. Steps from the beach but the pool was really great too! We hung out there all day and drank mai tai's! The service everywhere was great: front desk staff helped my boyfriend with dinner and nightlife reservations, bar staff was really friendly and pool staff were quick and attentive.  The only thing is my boyfriend got suckered into paying $25 more per night for an ocean view, which you could just barely see a tiny corner of. A little misleading but they have to upsell so I understand

Visited with family for one night. Hotel in excellent location in South Beach with valet parking. Hotel backed onto the beach - take advantage of the resort deal for beach loungers or stay in the hotel grounds to enjoy great food and drinks and delightful cabanas, which were useful for young children. Take advantage of the free drinks at five in the hotel lobby before heading out. Breakfast was excellent but service slow and not particularly attentive. Reception and the concierge service were particularly attentive. Recommended and would return!

I stayed here as i was attending a conference in Miami for four days. It is in an excellent location in Miami South Beach, a short walk past the pool onto the beach, the resort fee entitles you to two seats on the beach. The pool is great and the ambience is perfect. The service is good, although can be slow at times - the price is a little higher than average but still manageable. The front desk are very friendly and helpful. Rooms are interesting, very clean and the bathrooms have all amenities that may be needed.  Would definitely recommend.

From Aziza at the front desk to Chase Mitchell, director of Daylife Services, they took care of us from check-in to check out.  They gave us champagne upon check-in (for my birthday), champagne upon the announcement of our engagement, a bottle of champagne in our room and a cabana on our last day!!!! They even called the restaurant we were going to the night of our engagement to let them know the good news. Food was amazing, all of the staff were wonderful. This property is within walking distance of Lincoln Road Mall and Ocean Drive.

Spent a long weekend at the Surfcomber with my husband.  The hotel is exceptionally clean and comfortable.   The staff was friendly and accommodating is with an early and late check out.  The Social Club restaurant/bar was excellent.   If you are lucky to catch Dan bartending, you're in for a real experience.  He's at the top of his craft.  If you don't know what to drink, he will ask you a series of questions and create something amazing.  He's a must visit!  The pool is one of the nicest on the strip.  The vibe is fun with music playing all day.  There's a real nice mix of people from families,couples and singles.  Anyone would have a blast here.  The beach is well kept.  Beach chairs, towels, water and sunscreen come with your stay. You're taken care of.

Enjoyed our stay at the Surcomber.  We had free wi-fi and free drinks and nibbles at happy hour.  The rooms were not huge but big enough for a 3 night stay before our cruise.  Nicely located near plenty of shops and restaurants,  All the staff were very friendly and helpful and the hotel had a nice friendly atmosphere.  Nice pool and seating area, which is next to the beach.  We ate at the pool and the food was very good, although as usual for hotels a little pricey.  We would stay at this hotel again if we visited Miami.  Room was clean, staff excellent, good location.

We had a very nice stay at Surfcomber, especially for the two weekdays of our 4 days.  On weekends, however, the neighboring SLS blasts pounding rock music that makes it hard to talk, much less read and relax, at Surfcomber pool OR the beach.  Still, Surfcomber is attractive with reliably with-it Kimpton service.

Staying here whilst on way to South America. Fabulous food - tasty, good portions and fresh ingredients. Staff can't help you enough - great people. Upgraded to Oceanview Suite and its huge - would be great for a family. Shower is lovely rainfall style. Very happy!

Great location. Walk to Lincoln Ave shops and restaurants. 1 mile to south beach restaurants. Near action but not on top of the South Beach noise. Free bikes on property. Complimentary wine 5-7 in the lobby. Nice, clean pool. Nice cabana's. Lounge chairs at the beach.  $19 for a daily umbrella. Good menu for pool and beach. Nice pool bar. Very personable pool waitresses. We stayed in an oceanfront room on the 3rd floor.  We could see the ocean atop and thru the palm trees. Don't know if you can see the ocean from a lower floor. All in all, a very good value!  Hotel parking $39 per day, but local parking is very difficult.

We just stayed 3 nights at this hotel that feels like home.great location.,great food, exceptional pool and beach. But the staff are even more marvellous.Dargolis was so nice.. Kimpton treat their guests as true guests.

Great little hotel in a perfect location. Very friendly staff and great to have the beach and bars within walking distance.  Great wi fi made business very easy (even on the beach and pool area).    The bar was very friendly with good service and great styling. The only issue was that the rooms were quite small and the bathroom was very cramped. Could do with coffee/tea in the room though!  Will return if in south beach for sure!

Spent two days at at the surfcomber after a cruise, location fantastic so were staff however bed linen dirty see photo and drinks very over priced especially soft drinks-shot of vodka in sprite was the same price as sprite on its own Disappointed by lack of shower facilities for guests who are staying in the day due to evening flights cost 130 dollars to keep room for 5 hours.

The location of this hotel can't be better - by every resto, hotel bar and shop on Ocean, Collins or 17th.  The pool and beach scene are both scenic and cushy. Poolside drinks and fare were good and quick too. We were there during a VictoriaSecret pool party and yes, the party was loud but guests were allowed to attend or if upset (which there were some old fart guests that were) could be set-up at the beach. Get over it people!!! It's South Beach on Spring Break - it's loud and there are almost-naked people everywhere. Rooms are comfortable, not huge but if you're in them all day you're a loser anyway. Wine hour is great In addition to free coffee and tea in the lobby in the morning with soy milk, raw sugar, and all the other amenities you may want! Win win.

We recently stayed at the Surfcomber during Miami Music Week and we loved our stay. From the moment we arrived at the hotel the service was top notch! Camilla at the front desk was great great great! We love our courtyard room. Yes it is busy and loud during the week but that is why we were there. We have stayed at several south beach properties and this is now our absolute favorite! Next time we are in Miami we will stay at the surfcomber!

We stayed here for a couple of day this month on a recommendation from a friend. The public area was lovely but the room a little underwhelming. Two days in I realised the door opened without a key!!! The bathroom was tiny but the bed was very comfortable.  When we reported it to the staff we were upgraded straight away and they couldn't apologise enough. This room was nicer but the bathroom was still tiny and it was interesting trying to close the door.   The staff were amazing. So helpful and friendly.  It was the music festival and we weren't told in advance. Not a huge issue but a heads up would have been helpful as the pool area was a building site.   Would def go back. Great location.

Bob made calls and is the nicest gentleman I ever rented a room from. He is a super professional thank you Bob Jones of Ft. Lauderdale. Jones was so friendly to my wife. He was quick to get us settled, made sure we were satisfied and a pleasure to have as our point man.

This Kimpton property offers a great option for those put off by the larger luxury properties like the W or Ritz-Carlton. Here, you will get friendly personalized service and feel right at home. The room and decor may not be opulent, but the entire property is attractive and luxurious, in its own way. As with all Kimpton properties, there is a complementary wine hour from 5-6. Afterwards, there is a very decent Happy Hour with small plates at the bar, which is not a bad thought if you need something to tide you over until dinner. Both venues are are a great opportunity to chat with young, hip travelers (and old, hip travelers like us) from all parts of the world. Pets are welcome, too, which is helpful for those who can't leave Fido at home.

If you like a fun hotel that's beautiful, unique, and has great staff, the Surfcomber is your spot!  The location is awesome and within walking distance to SoBe, Lincoln Mall, and of course the beach!  The drinks at the bar are awesome also!

After this trip we will always look for a Kempton property, it was lovely! What really made our stay was the staff! They made sure that all of our needs were met, especially Chase! He went out of his way to make sure we had a great time! He told us somethings do to around Miami and gave great suggestions. Thank you Surfcomber for a great experience in Miami and thank you Chase for making a difference in our stay!

the staff was amazing here, we got in late from the airport and they were super helpful we were in our rooms and able to change in a speedy check in, we stopped down stairs at the restaurant bar, was not too busy but the bar staff was friendly and the cocktails were good, the pool was nice clean and plenty of chairs the next afternoon, the passionfruit mojito was just that, good but expensive!! they really add up quickly, overall a great place to stay and close to so many other places we were heading.

We decided to have a last minute team meeting and decided on a South Beach location.  The staff at the hotel were extremely helpful, even with a number of last minute changes.   They also helped us arrange several team building events that went on without a hitch. The rooms were clean.  The food was great.  The morning and afternoon beverages and bites were a wonderful treat.  The meeting room was small, but worked well for our group.  We've had several staff members return to the Surfcomber since we held our meeting.

The hotel was clean and beautiful.  The wrap around balcony room was wonderful especially in the evening when it cooled off a little outside.  Beautiful view of the pool and beach.  The pool was great.  The dine in food was delicious and high quality a little pricey, $200 for and entree and desert and a drink for 2 adults and 2 children.

The Surfcomber was a delight. The service was impeccable starting from he moment we drove up in our car. Room was clean and well-appointed. Resort amenities are varied and top notch. We enjoyed the pool  area (showers, lounge chairs, ping pong and cornhole) and the beach services (chair/umbrella,drinks).  Perfect. Location is walking distance to Lincoln Rd Mall and Ocean Drive/South Beach, but far enough away to have a chance of some quiet. We prefer a sophisticated  hotel, not pretentious, with a distinct personality and the Surfcomber meets that for us. Will definitely stay here anytime we are in Miami Beach.

This hotel is a great boutique hotel.  The pool is kept warm and the rooms are plenty nice.  It is certainly geared towards the younger crowd, this isn't the Four Seasons or Ritz but the service is equal.  The happy hour free wine is fun, they even gave us a goldfish in a bowl in our room as this is a pet friendly hotel.  If you're younger looking for a great hotel, with top notch service, including at the beach and pool go no further.  Great location on Collins not far at all from Ocean and Lincoln road.

Very pleased with our stay. Staff could not do enough for you. Pool was lovely and direct access to the beach. Close to Lincoln Road and Ocean drive. Rooms were clean and comfortable. Complimentary wine hour was a nice touch. The art deco style is lovely.  One downside was the mandatory 'resort fee' of $25 per room plus tax which you are charged just to use the hotel facilities. I understand this is common in Miami. In Europe when we book a hotel (and it is not cheap to stay in this hotel) we do not expect to be charged extra to use the pool!  However would recommend and stay here again for the good facilities and great location right on the beach.

Location perfect Rooms bare and not pretty. Decor could do with a more warmly and welcoming feel. The lobby always smelt funny. Perhaps it was food. But it was the first thing I noticed and was there throughout. At first it felt sickly then I suppose I became immune to it.   The staff were the best thing about the hotel So polite and always smiling and willing to help  Thank you surfcomber.

The wine was off and the tables were reserved for ghosts in the food area !   The food was very average and the ribs were cold.   Not my style or standard  Location good right next to the breach spoilt by the food   I expected average for the price but the wine and cold food no excuse.

I don't know where to begin, I was here for 3 days after the crazy cold back home. Finally got to Miami and was told about the surfcomer.  The second  I arrived, Lateef the valet, greeted me with a smile and said " WELCOME TO THE SURFCOMER," check in was great by Camilla, Azziza, Mercedes.  I'm trying to tell you, These ladies ROCK!!!!!  The night agent  (with the pretty green eyes can't remember her name)  the smile... YES YES.... The pool was relaxing the food at your restaurant, great, our server ( with the long hair who worked outside) warm and professional.....the bellman Gulliam, was outstanding .  whatever it is your doing please continue to do so.... Thank you , I will be back sooner rather than later ....

Nice boutique hotel. Right on South Beach but the hotel is quiet. Perfect if you want to have access to the hustle and bustle of south beach but also want calm time by the pool. I can see people walking by as I peacefully eat breakfast at their resturant in the lobby. I'd recommend it. Pools 24hours!

Stayed here for a business trip, staff here is friendly and courteous. Aziza and Jordan at the front desk are pleasant and professional. I misplaced my item in the hotel room, the housekeeping manager, Jodi, went out of her way to help me locate my item and ensured I got it back at no time! What a excellent customer service!!  Property is well maintained, I definitely recommend this hotel and look forward to be back again!

I was recently a guest of The Surfcomber for a girls' winter getaway weekend, and it was really so lovely.  We had a great time.  The service is overall excellent, as expected at a Kimpton.  Mercedes at the front desk and Dan at the Social Club really made an impression -- they were so great!  The food/bar at the Social Club was superb, too!  You barely need to leave the hotel at all if you want a getaway weekend because the restaurants, the beach, the pool, and the rest of the grounds are so perfect.

All hotels on South Beach are really expensive, so this was in the middle to top end at just over £200 per night, not including breakfast or the additional$25 per night "resort fee". However it is a lovely hotel, the staff are warm and helpful. The pool area is great and the private beach chairs etc are plentiful and service excellent. We had a supreme king room, which was average size but the bathroom was tiny, with the wc squashed against the sink which was squashed against the shower. This was disappointing for the price we paid. Well located on Collins Avenue.

We stayed at the surfcomber over the boat show weekend. The prices were very steep for the size and quality of the rooms. We have stayed at the Epic in Miami for the same price on the concierge level and had a far superior experience. The positive things about this hotel are the front staff, valet staff and management. The cleaning staff failed on two occasions to clean our room and restaurant service was poor. If the price was $175/ night maybe but $600 not a very good value. Perhaps its just South Beach???

The best staff and atmosphere. Marlon, Manny, Brian, Wendy, JeanCarlo & Mercedes made my trip extraordinary & special. The hotel has a beautiful pool area & outdoor sitting area, plus it's a Short walk to the beach and key locations - Ocean Drive and Lincoln Road Mall.

Had an amazing time at the Surfcomber for my bachelorette party! Chase made our stay so much more memorable, always making sure we were enjoying ourselves! Also love the wine hour and the breakfast wrap at the social club!

Hotel is an older hotel, I felt I could've done better once I saw the other area hotels / resorts.  Rooms were very small, not my taste ... pictures of hotel/rooms upon booking were nicer than actual room once we saw them.   1st floor/lobby layout not very smooth flowing, people walking through restaurant area to get to elevator ~ weird.  Noisy at night (near bar).  I felt the hotel "nickel & dimed" us, telling us things were included in our package upon making reservation, then when we arrived it was a different story - charged us for more than we expected.  There's no hot tub on premises, most other places that we looked at while visiting had one.  Pool was "average" at best.  Next time I go to Miami Beach, I'll be staying somewhere else.

Surfcomber has a perfect location, as it is a beach front hotel with a singular and casual atmosphere. The pool side and grounds are very nice, also loved the hotel lobby and its single decoration. Another strong feature is the staff, they are all so kind, nice and friendly. The only downsize of this property was the room size, too small for 2, modest amenities. Nevertheless is was a great choice for South Beach

Lots of perks and chances to upgrade by booking directly.  I loved the complimentary wine and coffee hours.  They welcomed us with champagne and sparking cider for my daughter.   For her 15th birthday, they gave us warm yummy chocolate chip cookies and milk.  Great location away from Collins trashy bars/restaurants but walkable to Lincoln shopping and Art Deco district.  Heated pool made swimming in 60 degree weather possible.  They also helped me out with toiletries I forgot.  The beach and boardwalk are easily accessible from private entrance out back.

For a Kimpton, this was on the funky bohemian side with tiny rooms and pricey breakfast.  Nice pool and access to boardwalk.  Nice hip young staff welcomes you at all hours.  Noisy near the bar at night.

Had a wonderful time. We loved the casual but upscale atmosphere. We have stayed at several Kimptons but I might say this was the best. Maybe that fact that we we're blessed with great weather helped!

Overall, we had a great stay at the Surfcomber.  The grounds and pool area are perfect - exactly what you'd want in a South Beach (but fairly low-key) hotel.  They also feature the nice Kimpton perks of daily happy hour, coffee in the AM and pet friendliness.  Great restaurant / bar as well!  The big downside was the size of the rooms.  With two people, it felt quite cramped for a beach trip.  The rooms (200 sq ft) were comparable in size to what I get in New York City and I definitely would prefer more space on this type of trip.  They don't offer many larger room options, unfortunately.

I was in Miami celebrating my good friend's bachelor party when we strolled in (as an avid fan of Kimpton Hotels) when Chase Mitchel, the director of day life made us feel so welcome. He set us up with a prime spot and paired us with one of his best staff members, Ally!  Had a great day and recommend stopping by and asking for Chase or Ally!

This was my second time staying at this nice hotel.  What impressed me this time was the staff.  Someone "accidently" absconded with my pricey sweater during free happy hour in the hotel lobby.  I reported it missing to the manager.   I thought I would never see it again.  When I arrived home I had a message from the manager that a maid had found it and turned it in.  I am so impressed!!! Honest people doing honest work.  God bless them!

My friends and I had an amazing experience at the Surfcomber this past weekend. A special thank you to Laz and Raees who made our day at the beach a fun and memorable one. They went above and beyond to make sure we were well taken care of and happy, setting us up with an awesome cabana, chairs, and umbrella right by the water, and ensuring that the drinks kept coming. Perfect location and place to stay for a fun and relaxing getaway!

I reported it missing to the manager.   I thought I would never see it again.  When I arrived home I had a message from the manager that a maid had found it and turned it in.  I am so impressed!!! Honest people doing honest work.  God bless them!

My friends and I had an amazing experience at the Surfcomber this past weekend. A special thank you to Laz and Raees who made our day at the beach a fun and memorable one. They went above and beyond to make sure we were well taken care of and happy, setting us up with an awesome cabana, chairs, and umbrella right by the water, and ensuring that the drinks kept coming. Perfect location and place to stay for a fun and relaxing getaway!

Overall the service was phenomenal. I would like to make a special comment to Laz at the beachside service. He went above and beyond to make sure our needs were met. Can't wat to book my next trip! I came down from COLD Illinois with two friends and met many great people. Our plans were to hit the town and site see, hit the beach and just have fun. Well...fun was had but we didn't have to leave the hotel! We ended up eating, drinking and partying at the hotel all three day! Wonderful atmosphere and experience! Pretty in Pink is the best drink! However, mojito's at the beach were amazing as well! Best mixologists on the beach!

We loved everything about the Surfcomber!!  Location is ideal, walking distance to everything.  Hotel bar has mixologist more so than bartenders, so be sure to order a specialty drink.  The beach service was perfect, comfortable chairs and great food and cocktails.  Laz made our day so much fun.  We cannot wait to come back.

Decent place, outstanding staff but I was in dozens of other places like the SLS, Delano (obviously higher price points) and many more in the same price range that I've heard (not stayed myself) are a better value.  Walls thin, rooms very small, bathroom/shower tiny.  Pool area and lounge nice.

Good hotel.  Rooms are average but clean.  Breakfast at hotel is pricey for what you get.  I would recommend walking down the board walk to Ocean Blvd.  better breakfast choices there.   Hotel is located right on the beach and close to all South Beach has to offer.

The walls and ceilings are paper thin in this hotel. Book this hotel if you enjoy listening to cleaning ladies chat about new bikini wax they had done or if you enjoy listening to your neighbors from upstairs having sex. Rooms are very small and definitely not worth $400+

By far, the most friendly and helpful staff we have ever encountered while staying in SoBe.  Went for a long weekend to get away from the cold of the Northeast, and had a wonderful time at this hotel.  Great location - very easy to walk anywhere.   Room was nice, cleaning staff was on top of it's game, the bathroom was a bit small but fine.  Free coffee and tea in the lobby in the mornings and free wine in the evenings made the lobby area busy and festive.

My husband and I came down to Miami to escape the cold of New Jersey for a weekend getaway. The surfcomer was reasonably priced so we chose it. We loved everything about the hotel. The customer service is great. The food is great. The entire staff is very accommodating. We will definitely be back!

This is an old hotel that has been nicely renovated.  As a historic hotel, the rooms are very small.  Our room had a queen bed and there was limited space for luggage.  The room reminded me of a Paris city hotel.  There was no balcony in the room.  The room was very clean and bright, but some may find the decor a bit stark.  Great pool and beach access.  You pay a "resort fee" which covers a bottle of water, wifi and towel/chair at beach.  Short walk to South Ocean drive and Lincoln Mall.  No in room coffee maker (likely no room for one anyways) but they serve coffee in the morning in the lobby.

This was my first time in Miami and I felt so welcomed by the staff! Chase and Laz were so very wonderful. They made sure we were taken care of every day and remembered us by name! Car the bartender made us great drinks and was a ton of fun. The hotel overall is beautiful, located perfectly in south beach, & has a fantastic pool & beach lounging areas.

Loved my time at the surfcomber!! I am obsessed with Kimpton and this stayed true to what I expect from kimpton. Chase at the pool and Laz on the beach were outstanding. They both remembered us by name and were very attentive to anything we needed. Also, Car was so much fun to hang out with at the bar and makes delicious concoctions. Definitely coming back. THANK YOU CHASE, LAZ, AND CAR!

This hotel was nice for the price and location. I really liked the pool area and the staff at the pool was very attentive. The lobby and bar area were very nice. Very eclectic decorating but I liked it. My only complaint was the room. Our City view was of the old building next door. The bathroom is so small the door does not open all the way. It seemed clean but when the air conditioner went on it smelled musty.

This updated and authentic, yet understated historic hotel shines brightly next to it's neighboring big boy beach brands. Kimpton delivers another great example of their commitment to service by continuing to improve this property. I have stayed here at least 15 times in the past few years and it just keeps getting better. Perfect location to everything one would want to do in South Beach yet I didn't feel like I even wanted to leave. Beach access, nice pool, cabanas, wine hour, updated rooms, Kimpton beds - it's all here. And everything else you might want to do is just a few steps away. I already booked my return visit in just 3 weeks. I'd be honest and say if something went south, but for me on this trip - it was perfect.

Hotel very cozy, good service, good sound, flavored water all the time by the pool and at the hotel lobby. It is super close to Lincoln Road and Collins Avenue that are cool streets with lots of restaurants and good bustle. Another difference was the receptionist and hotel valets that all the time are friendly and helpful, especially Martin who always welcomed us with a good glass of champagne at night when back to the hotel. Only smal inconvenience is the size of the room to host 3 people, from our pont of view it is too small... In overall very well recomended.

This is small hotel but the staff make it five star.  Everyone from the valets to the bar tenders could not do enough for us.  A big thanks to the front desk staff.  Alex was very helpful.  Location was perfect.

Just got back from a conference at the Surfcomber.  From the minute we arrived the staff could not have been more accommodating.  Alex at the front desk was awesome!  Our room had a beautiful view and was spacious given the art deco hotel.  Great stay!

This is a relatively small hotel directly on a beach in the heart of South Beach. The restaurants on Ocean Drive being just a 7 minutes walk away from the hotel. I wouldn't call the hotel fancy per se, but is a very nice beach hotel with a genuine South Beach atmosphere. We had an ocean-view room, which was quiet in the night. We always had a good sleep. It wasn't cheap but I really loved those 5 days at the Surfcomber.

column3: Finding something really special on Collins/Ocean Drive is hard - they meld in to one. This really is different. Low rise in a sea of concrete and glass, within the architectural Art Deco splendor our room with a deck was facing the pool/ocean and was fabulous. The welcome from Wendy, Brad and all the guest service and concierge teams was exceptionally warm - nothing was too much trouble. Paul the opps manager was super at helping us get the very best from our visit. We used bikes, hung out on the beach (thanks Andy and team ) and loved the wine hour, the morning coffee and special treats in our room. We are loyal to Kimpton and this fabulous experience reminds us exactly why this group is do special.

Stayed here for 3 nights at the End of our Vacation. Fab Hotel, Nestled in Among all the Big Hotels on South Beach, This Hotel scores 10/10 in Every Department for Me, We Loved it here. Staff are super, Customer service Fantastic, Pool Area just Great, check out the personal Cabanas with TV and sockets for charging phones etc- Perfect when traveling with Teenage Boys !!  Fantastic Vibe in this Hotel. Rooms are very Comfortable, Kept Spotlessly Clean Daily. Superb Location. Not too big, so you get the feeling of the Personal Touch here. I would highly recommend this Hotel . Thank you to everyone at the Surfcomber - We Loved our stay :)

We stayed here for a couple of nights on our way down to Central America and loved it.   We've both stayed at a number of hotels in Miami and Surfcomber is up there with the best of them, especially for the price. While still cool and trendy, the lack a 'scene' was actually a plus for us.   The room, while small and basic was just fine for us.   The staff really differentiated the hotel. We arrived around midnight and were greated by Najja (sp?) who answered our questions and even offered us a glass of complimentary champagne. All in all a great way to start our vacation!

Stayed here for 3 nights at the End of our Vacation. Fab Hotel, Nestled in Among all the Big Hotels on South Beach, This Hotel scores 10/10 in Every Department for Me, We Loved it here. Staff are super, Customer service Fantastic, Pool Area just Great, check out the personal Cabanas with TV and sockets for charging phones etc- Perfect when traveling with Teenage Boys !!  Fantastic Vibe in this Hotel. Rooms are very Comfortable, Kept Spotlessly Clean Daily. Superb Location. Not too big, so you get the feeling of the Personal Touch here. I would highly recommend this Hotel . Thank you to everyone at the Surfcomber - We Loved our stay :)

We stayed here for a couple of nights on our way down to Central America and loved it.   We've both stayed at a number of hotels in Miami and Surfcomber is up there with the best of them, especially for the price. While still cool and trendy, the lack a 'scene' was actually a plus for us.   The room, while small and basic was just fine for us.   The staff really differentiated the hotel. We arrived around midnight and were greated by Najja (sp?) who answered our questions and even offered us a glass of complimentary champagne. All in all a great way to start our vacation!

I love the Kimpton chain, and the Surfcomber did not disappoint.  Rooms were a little smaller than in other Kimptons I've stayed at, but it's an Art Deco hotel that's been updated, so that's understandable. Soundproofing between rooms wasn't the best, but it's a small quibble.  Customer service was outstanding, as always at Kimpton.  Pool was great, beach was just a few steps beyond. Would definitely stay there again.

We stayed 3 nights in december. Had room over looking the pool and beach with a big patio. The food in the restaurant was very good. Everybody that works at the hotel was very nice. The hotel is in a great location. Can walk everywhere . Will be back.

My friend and I visited for 3 nights at New Year and I can definitely say we will be back. The hotel staff have been the nicest I've ever experienced in a hotel. I have to say the guys at the beach, especially Goog and Danny, were superb and didn't stop running after us all holiday. Nothing was too much trouble and they were fun and helpful. Brad at front desk was great at giving us ideas of where to eat and have a little drink and made all our reservations. The hotel amenities are great and I'll miss the food for sure! Hopefully be back again later this year. Pricey at this time of year but inline with others of a similar rating.

I visited Miami  beach and it was like paradise. Visited both during the night and day. It was sunny and in the peak of the partying hours. The views are undescribable plus plenty of shopping also personalized tshirts while in Miami, good food, nice cars and not much expensive.

We have booked 3 Nights over new year in this hotel. On our check in we are informed that the room is not ready but that they are cleaning it. I ask for an estimate waiting time, they tell me that they do 't know and a very snappy concierge tells me that it will be ready by check in time at 4 pm. At 4 we asked, the room is not ready, still waiting! For over 600 usd a night, it is not acceptable!  A lot of people in the lobby waiting, the management is absent! The room must be ready at check in time!  I suggest the management a change of job!

I've had such a wonderful time during my week stay.  Lazaro and team on the beach have gone above and beyond - and no request is too big or small.  Whenever I needed something, a towel, a drink, food, sunscreen, even a nice informed and fun chat, they were there to give us some professional attention!  This is my second trip here, and the service was even better this time!

Lovely property. Lovely staff. Beach is wonderful--even more wonderful is the beach staff especially Lazaro and his team. Efficient, friendly, attentive and they treat you like a VIP. We had a fun trip!

Good food. Friendliest  staff ! Small hotel right in the heart of South Beach. Clean. Kid friendly. Dog friendly. Awesome. We had an issue with our room facing a wall and pipes. We also had an issue with that room mysteriously reeking of cigarette smoke and a phone call later we were switched again to another lovely room. Amazing staff made you feel like a VIP! Hotel is chic, clean, and perfectly located. Restaurant at property is superb. Pool area is nice and very accommodating with its staff and amenities. Will definitely go back with my family again!

Our suite felt like it was right out of the '50's, consistent with all the fun art deco architecture in the area. The location is pretty much in the middle of South Beach, and it backs right onto the beach. The pool is nice and, one of the Kimpton touches, came with free sunscreen. Another Kimpton extra is a daily happy hour in the lobby with free wine and snacks. Service is friendly and helpful, and the rooms are nice enough, although not exceptional. The price was quite reasonable for the area.

The Whole hotel smells like a cigar lounge, the carpets stink. Watch your charges. The lift inspection certificate had expired in September, so illegal for the hotel to operate it. Also watch your charges, don't be surprised by charged that you did not sign for. This is the worst hotel I have been to and would not recommend it to any traveller.

Huge Kimpton fan. This is a gorgeous boutique hotel in South Beach. Great pool.  Right on the Beach. Late night Drinks at the bar will kill ya. Food at the restaurant was really yummy. Room had a nice flat screen. Bathroom was modern.

Had a great week at the Surfcomber. Close to Miami Beach, lovely lobby - really pulls off the boutique look well. Our room was good - not the best view but spent most of our time by their great pool or on the beach anyway. The service was terrific. Natalie (poolside) provided us great suggestions on drinks and food. And Laz and Andy (at the beach) went above and beyond - felt like VIP members without actually being VIP👌

Just spent the first half of Christmas week at the surfcomber with a few friends. Loving the experience thus far. Hotel is ideally located surrounded by some other big hotels, the delano and sls. Rooms have adequate space. The wine hour is a nice change of pace.   But the ocean side service is hands down the Bueaty of this hotel. Sat right in front of the ocean with ocean side service ( drinks and food) . Fast and convenient. The new revamped menu has some pearls especially the pork belly sliders. Drinks are excellent. Recommend the medium or large with an extra shot . Worth the expenditure. You'll have a great time at a great price when compared to other hotels . Ask for Laz if you decide to go to the ocean.

I've stayed in Miami a lot and have never had such a great experience like I did this time. The staff totally makes this place. They went out of their way to help and guide. By the time I left I knew all their names  from jordienne Wendi Kenneth and Alex at the front desk. Amazing people. The bar staff Louis and kay to the great staff on the beach laz and Andy. This staff makes me want to book all my stays in you hotel. Thank you so much your kindness  see you soon.

The location is unbeatable for SoBe and the service by everyone -- from the concierge (Brad) to the beach attendants (Andy, Laz and Goog) to the ladies at the front desk were all world class. If that's not enough, there are a ton of free amenities including beach chairs, yoga on the beach, hosted wine hour in the lobby, etc. great value for the money too!

Thank you to everyone at the Surfcomber for making my birthday/graduation celebration experience amazing,  From Mercedes, Brad, Chase, Gilbert, the friendly Vallet guys and everyone else whose name I am forgetting, your kindness and cheerfulness went a long way, especially the personalized birthday card signed by some of the staff, such a nice touch. Can't wait to visit again!!

Stayed here many times before the new owners and remodel. It was nice then, But now its excellent. We love it at Surfcomber. The customer service is excellent. Our room was nice and clean, the intire staff was very helpful and always ask if we needed anything. Shot out to the beach staff as well, Andrea, Andy, Christopher, The Pina Colada's were the bomb guys, Keep up the good service, see you all again in April.  Neeta Berry and Ed Bailey, From Michigan.

I visited the hotel a month ago with a friend, and we really enjoyed the room and the pool. I have nothing bad to say except for the fact that the servers who worked around the pool had to ware outrageous outfits. All the servers were girls in minimal sized bikinis and a see through scarf around the hips. They all looked very uncomfortable and were constantly pulling down the scarf to cover their bottoms. It was sad to see that kind of sexism at an otherwise great hotel.

This hotel is superb. Staff is friendly and consistantly ensured our stay for 4 nights was memorable. Kenneth at the front desk gave us details on the entire hotel and facility while also suggesting a fabulous tapas restaurant down the street. Martin at the desk assisted above and beyond in a pinch of a situation. Goog, Andrea, Laz and the beach service team were on point and never let us feel like we were at an ordinary hotel. They asked how we were doing and if we needed additional food and beverage often. Islande, our housekeeper was so gracious and kind - she made us feel right at home!  Above all - this hotel shines bright and I'd recommend anyone visiting Miami to enjoy its quaint south beach charm. Bravo!

We stayed there in a working trip.  The place is just god for one or two nights.  Next time we will look into TA before. The walls are weak so you have somme problems to sleep. I will  not return. ...... people are nice and helpful.

I had a wonderful vacation stay at this hotel. The customer service was wonderful. Kenneth at front desk was so helpful in booking excursions and suggesting activities. The room was clean, the staff were friendly and full of smiles. The pool area was awsome. I will be staying at surfcomber for my next vacation.

Just stayed at surfcomber and after 3 years in a row  still the best deal in South Beach for location, pool and beach view and quality of service. Deneze and Manuel were each very attentive and Dorgis and Lateef were super friendly.  New management in place and some aspects short staffed but those that are there work so hard they make up for it.  Best kept secret (or maybe not so secret) in south beach.  Surfcomber does Kimpton brand proud.

i am a Kimpton member and have (in the past) stayed at Kimptons selectively.  No more.  The service here is so bad I will NEVER stay at a Kimpton again.  We arrived before the check in time but we're told our room would be ready "shortly".  Here, shortly means 5 hours.  Food was mediocre.  Rooms are mediocre.  Lounge music blasts to make you believe you might be somewhere other than a 3rd rate hotel in Miami.  If you care, try the Setai or Ritz.  Better yet, try local private real boutique hotels and get service from someone who cares.

I have no complaints about this place -- the position is marvelous, the place is super nice, and the staff is courteous to a fault. Hotels can maybe get two of the three correct, but the intimate size of the Surfcomber seems to afford them a great command of what happens on premises. Our room faced Collins Ave., a busy thoroughfare with a lot of pulsing life, but I'm sure you'd rather be facing the beach if possible.  OK, maybe one tiny complaint: The house music the DJ was spinning out by the pool was deafening while out on the grounds, but once in the room we seemed to be well-insulated.

I loved that this hotel wasn't a big hotel. It had a boutique feel with all the amenities of a larger hotel. The pool was great, so was the beach. The hotel also offer free programs like yoga on the beach and bike tours which were really well organized. The bathrooms are a bit small but the room was so nicely designed it wasn't really an issue.

We stayed at The Surfcomber Hotel over the past weekend and it was such an amazing experience! The hotel is beautiful and the accommodations are wonderful. The staff is especially friendly and will go out of their way to accommodate any of your needs. Martin, the concierge, was so helpful and knowledgeable about the area. He gave great recommendations for clubs and restaurants. I can't wait to come back!

Awesome location!  The front desk staff was amazing!  Always friendly, great recommendations for shopping and restaurants, and had an all-around great attitude.  The pool facilities were very nice and comfortable.  The room was great...bathroom was a little small, but I think that is typical in this area.  The bed was extremely comfortable.  The only issue we had was the weekend cleaning staff didn't clean the bathroom vanity one morning.  The weekday staff was great though.  I would go back there in a heartbeat!

A big thanks for the staff at the Surfcomber, you made our stay in South Beach. Every "Good Morning" by our six year old was met with a smile and an instant reply. Breakfast was great, ample choice of strange fruit and vegetable brews. The Social Club restaurant was so good we didn't bother looking for other restaurants in the surroundings.  The room itself was the smallest of our holiday, but that is to be expected if you stay at a smaller art deco place. It was clean though, and quiet.  The coolest thing about the hotel was the courtyard and pool, step out of the Miami heat and lounge by the pool after walking through the small lush street that the courtyard is.  Thanks Mercedes for helping us out with the bike rental and recommending Havana 1957.  See you next time!

The hotel is a small but elegant, romantically lit establishment with EXTREMELY NICE & PLEASANT staff (highly unusual for Miami).  Highly recommended to be near the nightlife, the beach and the luxurious Lincoln road !!!  PS: bring a sweater, the hallways are very cold !!!

You can have the best facilities but it is the people that make the difference.All the staff we encountered were genuinely friendly and helpful and enjoyed being of assistance.We have been fortunate to travel and stay in many hotels around the world,to date the Kimpton experience at the Surfcomber has been the best due to the staff,notable Wendy in reception,Rodrigo,Robert in the restaurant and especially Darnell who was passionate about his job and a wonderful ambassador for the hotel. It was our privilege to make his acquaintance.If all hotels had the"Kimpton Factor" travel would be an even more wonderful experience.

This is by far the hotel with the best service I've ever been too! From the front desk, to the pool boy, the pool waitress, and general staff, everone was very welcoming and nice. We arrived early (10am) and were able to get a room by our arrival. The service offer by the hotel at the pool and on the beach is a great plus (compare to other South Beach hotels not on the beach). The hotel is located steps away from Ocean Drive and Lincoln Roard, so the location can't be beat. There was a pool party on the day we were at the hotel, which was very nice. The decor is very original and unique.

Recently renovated by Kimpton this hotel is well located and offers a unpretentious experience which is sometimes hard to find in South Beach. Staff are outgoing and helpful making you feel very welcome, more of a home than a hotel.

They loved the clean rooms and amenities, ran the boardwalk, walked the beach, and enjoyed the night life. I did not hear anything negative from the 30+ guests that enjoyed the Surfcomber. Jessica Suess (and Elizabeth Postigo) were super helpful in setting up our 60 person dinner - October 2014 in the Private Dining room near the pool.  Jessica was very flexible and accommodating to our ever changing needs.  She never lost patience and was always professional.  Two hours before the start, I told her that we were now going to do assigned seats.  She never broke a sweat, had menus printed for everyone, and even had the tables numbered to make seating easy.  We are very lucky to have had her for our event and all the guests were happy.  I'd work with her again and recommend her to anyone going to Miami.  The food alway received rave reviews so - compliments to the chef. Thank you again for a lovely and seamless event.  Cheers!

I loved my stay at the Surfcomber and I wasn't sure what to expect with the incredibly affordable rate that I found. My room was clean, the bed was comfy and the bathrooms were modern.  I loved the daily free wine hour.  The service was fantastic from the minute I arrived.  Brad, the concierge at the front desk, provided great recommendations and remembered speaking to me on the phone.  The staff at the beach were so friendly. Special shout-out to Kelvin from Memphis at the beach!  His friendliness and positive energy were so welcoming.  I didn't spend much time at the pool (I love the beach) but the music at the pool was great and not too loud and annoying like it is at a lot of other hotels.  The location is also perfectly central and everything is in walking distance.

I recently visited Miami and had an amazing experience with Sufcomber Hotel. The service that this hotel overall outstanding. The view was beautiful, the staff was friendly and they serve us wine EVERYDAY!!!! there were two staff members in particular who were exceptionally helpful.  Urai and Adrian were  so personable and went above and beyond the required expectations of helping us. They provided us with information about cruises, bars, restaurants and shopping places without hesitation. I would recommend this hotel to a friend and I plan on staying again.

The staff was very accommodating.  I appreciated the amenities that came with the resort fee and the daily updates on weather and what was going on at the beach.  Convenient beach access and walking distance to many South Beach hot spots and restaurants.  I would definitely stay here again.

Lovely hotel with really nice rooms, but parking is expensive. If you don't use the valet only service then you need to park in a multi-storey several blocks away and this is also expensive. Great location right on Miami Beach which you can access directly from the pool area. Some noise from the pool party while we were there but it did not disturb our sleep. Resort fee is mandatory, which might be fine if you were staying several days, however as we were only staying overnight we had no real opportunity to use it since check-in is not until 4pm. Recommended for rooms and location.

We had the pleasure of spending the weekend at the Surfcomber... all around a perfect 10... When we first arrived we were greated by Lahteef at the front door who has a smile that is contagious; what a great guy !!!   We then were welcomed at the front desk by Luz & 2 glasses of champagne for our anniversity; talk about arriving in style...  The property is perfect; 3 story building right off the beach in the heart of South Beach... when we arrived at the pool we had the pleaure of Manuel taking care of all our needs... Breakfast at the Social club was perfect & the music by the pool was toatlly perfect !!!

From A to Z...an awesome trip!  The entire staff is so welcoming.  Kimpton hotels have spolied me for all other chains.  They are attentive, fun, accommodating, with great locations and an awesome staff!  Jumbo Jenga during FREE wine hour was so fun!  We won great prizes! Amazing food choices in the Social Club.  Great Beach Bed services.  Such an great time!

A lot of highlights but we would like to mention always smiling Latheef (who took care of our car) and the helpful staff at reception. Hotel is in a great location, right on the beach, close to busy Lincoln Road. Thanks, we had an awesome time at Surfcomber.

I stayed at the Surfcomber for a few nights in September, it's a great location. Staff are very friendly. There is free water aswel as free sun cream. It was very noisy overnight as expected in the heart of Miami but that didn't have any affect on my trip. Rooms are small, but beds are very large and comfortable. Would definitely return.

My group of girlfriends and I had the best weekend ever at this hotel. We all come from hotel management and can't say enough about this place. The hotel itself is absolutely amazing but the staff is what takes it to another level. I want to recognize Lateef for the best arrival experience, Brad for exceptional service and the amenities each night, Kenneth who is extremely helpful in recommendations, Jordan and Marckenson for great guest service and last but not least MARTIN who owns the show and really impressed me. Thank you all for a great South Beach trip!
