I recently Traveled To Miami with a group of friends for my best friends bachelorette party. We recently stayed at one of the best hotels anywhere. From the way the we were greeted before walking into the hotel to every staff member the whole stay. A special thanks to 3 people that really made our trip, Rai, David and Kenneth. Rai and David Personality were incredible always happy and cheerful making us laugh and just enjoy our day. Kenneth gave us the best recommendations for restaurants and the experience with night clubs was out of this world. Thank You So Much! We will def be back for my birthday!

I had the pleasure of first staying at this hotel in September of 2013 during a business trip. After 1 day there I knew I was home!! From the location to the room, the pool and best of all the friendly staff. I fully recommend this location when considering staying in South Beach!

There's nothing special about this hotel besides it being right on the beach(but then again there are MANY hotels around there that are on the beach as well). Came for the end of fashion week and felt like we walked into a club. Staff was friendly but not 100% on point. The room was small as hell and overlooked the walkway to the pool which would get loud at times especially when trying to nap/sleep. I think I'll waste my $ elsewhere next time I am in SOBE, probably airbnb to be honest.. To pricey for what they offer. Btw, they charge you to use the beach even if you are a guest! Scavengers! Like they don't make enough $ as is... Thanks for nothing surfcomber...

I just visited this hotel this year and I was not impressed, the room was so small and it had a view of a wall which they call a courtyard. The bathroom was even smaller with half a shower glass, what a joke! You go to the beach and you hold your beach chairs by the pool thinking that when you go to the beach for a bit your chairs are still there when you come back, well there NOT! This hotel is overpriced, small, and the pool which is open 24 hrs was dirty. I would not recommend this hotel, stay AWAY!

This hotel is in a great location a stone's throw from Lincoln Rd. The lobby was very nicely done and although I didn't eat at the restaurant it seemed  pretty busy. The pool and beach area are very acceptable, the beach attendants were especially jovial and friendly, the bell men were very helpful, I have no complaints about the staff at all they were all very competent and accommodating; the rooms however were another issue the corridors smelt very moldy. The room itself was very small just a square concrete box with a very small bathroom. I really was not impressed with the room considering this is suppose to be a four star hotel, it was rather disappointing.

Great staff, great beach and lovely pool. Did not like south beach but this hotel was excellent. Was on our honeymoon and received a free bottle of champagne which was a nice touch. Join the loyalty programme and you get free wifi. Very comfortable beds and you get free beds on the beach so kind of justifies the resort fee they charge. Bit pricey but would stay again for special occasion. Good general location with access to everything.

Good hotel near the beach and shopping street with bars and restaurants (lincoln road) and very nice people. Parking place nearby at 16 street which will save u some money ;) We will definately come again! Visitors from holland

The exterior decor - sheep and cow statues - is fun (my friend thought the black sheep on the walk to the pool was real! Good for a laugh).

This hotel has free wine nights from 5 to 6 PM and the surcharges were well worth the amenities. Adrian and Martin were so accommodating. Can't wait to book here again!

A few girlfriends and I stayed at the Surfcomber over Labor day weekend for a brief getaway. All we wanted was time at the pool,great chairs on the beach and awesome cocktails. The Surfcomber delivered! Their beach staff was incredibly friendly and eager to please. Although, we knew they were selling us on "upgrades" (a cabana vs. an umbrella, etc.), they were ready to serve us whenever we asked. Check-in and check-out with the front desk was seamless and we were greeted with warm smiles. Overall, if you're looking for a nice scene without the pomp and circumstance of hotels like the SLS or Delano, I'd definitely check out the Surfcomber.

We were taken care of the moment we stepped foot in the hotel! I came with a group of my girlfriends and the staff made sure we had a great time! The staff made sure we were comfortable and went above and beyond to ensure that, always with a SMILE :) . Great customer service, amazing and friendly staff, unbeatable location next to Lincoln shops and Ocean Dr. in the heart of south beach. Truly believe the hotel was a great reason we had an amazing vacation. HIGHLY recommended and looking forward to staying again! Special thanks to Calvin Butler on the beach, Christian, Kenneth & Keith!!

Very nice hotel in the heart of it all, staff were very helpful and friendly. I would definitely recommend this hotel to others. I don't know who teach their customer service class but it should be taught by more companies worldwide. Everyone at this hotel gives service with a smile. Foxy was our favorite an made our stay most enjoyable an above expectations, an for that I thank you. Lahteef greeted us everyday by name with a pleasant smile an conversation. Jordanna & Martin was very helpful as well. The entire staff should be commended on a job well done. The location is perfect, the rooms were small but very clean. The 24 hour pool an beach access is worth the stay in itself. I would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting S. Beach.

The room service guy Adrian seemed to be working every night and boy was I glad that was the case. This young man would have everything I needed ready before I even had time to ask, always smiling and joking around once his work was done. Room was fine and check in staff were okay but once again I need to give it up for Adrian the bellman

My wife is a Kimpton rewards member so we usually favor their hotels. The staff was amazing. Everyone was so friendly. One of the managers Sophia always went out of her way to say hi to us and we enjoyed seeing her during our 5 day visit. We also enjoyed speaking with a young lady named Pat, who was a bartender. Surfcomber is located at 1717 Collins which I think is the best area in South Beach. The Ocean Ave area does not have restaurants or bars that in my opinion can compete with the Surfcomber area. Once you get past 2000 Collins, you have all hotels and Condos and very few restaurants. The Lincoln Mall Road area is also close to the Surfcomber. The daily wine hour was always a great way to meet new people and enjoy great wine.

Foxy was our favorite an made our stay most enjoyable an above expectations, an for that I thank you. Lahteef greeted us everyday by name with a pleasant smile an conversation. Jordanna & Martin was very helpful as well. The entire staff should be commended on a job well done. The location is perfect, the rooms were small but very clean. The 24 hour pool an beach access is worth the stay in itself. I would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting S. Beach.

The room service guy Adrian seemed to be working every night and boy was I glad that was the case. This young man would have everything I needed ready before I even had time to ask, always smiling and joking around once his work was done. Room was fine and check in staff were okay but once again I need to give it up for Adrian the bellman

My wife is a Kimpton rewards member so we usually favor their hotels. The staff was amazing. Everyone was so friendly. One of the managers Sophia always went out of her way to say hi to us and we enjoyed seeing her during our 5 day visit. We also enjoyed speaking with a young lady named Pat, who was a bartender. Surfcomber is located at 1717 Collins which I think is the best area in South Beach. The Ocean Ave area does not have restaurants or bars that in my opinion can compete with the Surfcomber area. Once you get past 2000 Collins, you have all hotels and Condos and very few restaurants. The Lincoln Mall Road area is also close to the Surfcomber. The daily wine hour was always a great way to meet new people and enjoy great wine.

I'm currently staying at the surfcomber for 5 days before I get on a cruise, we arrived late and was welcomed to champagne which was a nice touch. Manuel who works at the pool looked after us today he's a credit to the surfcomber As well as Wendy on reception and deniz who looked after our drinks and food today, and the man Utd fan who works on the doors is a cool dude too, the location is spot on, the surfcomber is a good choice of hotel and I would recommend it to anyone. This morning I went for a run and seen a few hotels I nearly booked and I'm so glad I booked the surfcomber

Efficient and friendly check in staff. Cool decor. Rooms are nicely decorated but very small. Not much fun for a family of four together with four suitcases. My mom, daughter and I spend 2 nights here and we loved it! The guys at the front door welcomed us with a smile and the front desk staff was super nice and gave us a larger room to accomodate the 3 of us. Love the decor through out the hotel and evrything was nice and clean. Wine hour is awesome and got to chat with the Director of Housekeeping- really nice guy :). The pool and beach are awesome! I love Miami Beach and this hotel has the best location, accomodations, ammenities and the best service with friendly staff that is always smiling and willing to assist. Looking forward to staying here again soon!

Service and food are especially good. Great location, between the beach and Collins Ave. Every person that works in the hotel is warm and welcoming; they remember you and every one did their best to please you, I am really impressed with the quality of service. The food is excellent, very original, beautifully presented, great taste; every thing we ate was delicious, some are very original, be it breakfast, lunch or dinner; don't miss eating at the Social Club as the restaurant/bar is named, you will want more. Clean rooms, well equipped, small clean bathrooms. Love the pool and the access to the beach were you have chairs and towels provided by the hotel's personnel. I will go there next time I am in Miami Beach

My dad and I just returned from our delightful, relaxing vacation at the Surfcomber. The room was decorated beautifully and extremely clean. The beach service provided two beach chairs per day--the daily resort fee was worth it! Vinny and Andrea, the managers at the beach service, as well as Juan and the rest of their staff, were always kind and helpful. They checked on us throughout the day and made sure we had everything we needed. We were very pleased with their service and with the Surfcomber in general. We highly recommend this hotel!

We stayed at the Surfcomber in May 2013, for our first time in Miami Beach. It was quite difficult to choose a hotel but we relied on the other reviews and our previous Kimpton experiences, which were always a success. And we definitely do not regret our choice! The location is great, the staff is, as always, extremely helpful and friendly, the hotel stylish, the pool area great (we loved Remi the black sheep), and the access to the beach easy. As in all Kimpton hotels, the beds are so comfortable.... and the bigelow bath amenities are always a great plus! We can't wait to be back!

I must say that I enjoyed my stay and as soon as you arrive you're greeted with smiles and willingness to assist. My experience with Surfcomber was wonderful from the time I drove up to my front desk check in,  my towels brought to me for my midnight swim, to my lunch by the pool in a cabana and all the way to checking out .  great service and wonderful place to relax and be revived. Beach was excellent too.  I loved every moment there..... Thanks Surfcomber's Staff

The worst hotel. I come to Miami 3-4 Times a year and I allready was in the National, the Sagamore, the James and the SLS in south beach. So if you want the most unqualified staff go to thist hotel. Not only the staff is unqualified but the rooms are horrible. First room was just in front of the main street and really noisy so we asked friendly to change. The second room was smelling like garbage (seriously like garbage), the third room the air conditioning made vibrate the room in such an intensive way that you thought it was kind of a massage function. The fourth room in which we are now is ok. It's only smelling like a sewerage. In my opinion the good reviews are 100% fake. Go and look at it by yourself ;).

My experience with Surfcomber was wonderful from the time I drove up to my front desk check in,  my towels brought to me for my midnight swim, to my lunch by the pool in a cabana and all the way to checking out .  great service and wonderful place to relax and be revived. Beach was excellent too.  I loved every moment there..... Thanks Surfcomber's Staff

The worst hotel. I come to Miami 3-4 Times a year and I allready was in the National, the Sagamore, the James and the SLS in south beach. So if you want the most unqualified staff go to thist hotel. Not only the staff is unqualified but the rooms are horrible. First room was just in front of the main street and really noisy so we asked friendly to change. The second room was smelling like garbage (seriously like garbage), the third room the air conditioning made vibrate the room in such an intensive way that you thought it was kind of a massage function. The fourth room in which we are now is ok. It's only smelling like a sewerage. In my opinion the good reviews are 100% fake. Go and look at it by yourself ;).

Great Location! Staff was super friendly and helpful and I would stay there again and again. The pool is clean and the best part were the free flavored water, lemonade, coffee, and wine. The lobby is chic but down to earth and the rooms are simple but trendy. Loved the staff.

Our stay at the Surfcomber was a very good experience.  I would stay there again and I would recommend it to all my family and friends.  Our room was great, the design and ambiance was wonderful!!!!!!  It was very spacious and clean!!!!!  The bathroom was very clean but a bit tight.  My only concern is that the shower/tub needed a door and handwrail inside the shower/tub.  Thank you so much for making our first stay so wonderful.    Kenneth at the front desk was wonderful and very informative!!!!!!!    Andrea who worked the beach for refreshments/meals was great!!!!!  And very informative!!!!!!

I've been to South Beach a bunch of times, but mostly on business trips.  My husband and I went for a long weekend, and I wanted a place on the beach in a good location.  After lots of hemming and hawing over which hotel to pick, I cannot be happier that I picked the Surfcomber.  We visited lots of the neighboring hotels for drinks, to scope their scene, etc, and while there are lots of nice places, we will definitely go back to the Surfcomber again.  Service was top notch!  From the greetings at the front door, to the desk staff, to the housekeeping service, to the beach service (Rene is on his game!  I hope I got his name right?).  It's not a huge place, which I liked.  Location is outstanding, the beach there  is fabulous, and everything is walking distance.

Stayed with friends for a girls weekend! Everything was awesome! We especially loved wine hour and the sangria. Everyone was super nice....especially Lateef at the door and the front desk girls Marcedes and Raia. We will definitely be back to visit!! Thanks for everything :)

Can't say enough good things about this hotel....art deco perfection...great location..good food...pool..restaurants...worth every penny....Kenneth at the front desk is amazing!!!!...Kimpton has the best training program for employees. .am a Kimpton Karma member and they do take care of us!  Thank you Kimpton for always making my stay special.  Love you guys!!!

I can't say enough nice things about Keith, the bellman.  He was pleasant, attentive, and made me feel so welcome. Even his co-workers adore him; Adrian, the bellman he was training, told me learning from Keith means you are learning from the best.  Adrian was also personable, polite, and knowledgeable (even though he had only been there for 2 weeks).   The hotel also has a very nice pool with a waterfall and a little "beach area" with chairs and sand.  I definitely plan to return to the Surfcomber!

This was one of the best vacations we've had! The hotel was nice and clean and the staff was great! From the moment we walked until the day we checked out everyone was very friendly. Jenny, the concierge, was excellent; she made our kiddos feel welcome and they were excited with the surprises she gave them when we checked in. If we had any questions she was always ready to help us. We spent most of our time at the beach and again the service we received from Benny, Andrea and Tom was just great. They were very friendly and always checking in on us. We will definitely come back again, hopefully very soon!

This hotel offers great hospitality and makes you want to come back every year. The people ive met here are 1 of a kind. Unfurtunetly this hotel is always sold out but rest assured i will try to reserve with them every oportunity i get because they are just plainly awsome

For my wife's 60th Birthday weekend, we flew to South Beach and stayed at the Surfcomber for 2 nights. Great choice. Awesome location with direct beach access but even better hotel staff! Rai and Kenneth couldn't have been more accommodating. The entire staff, from doormen to restaurant staff were very friendly and helpful. Our room was clean and more than spacious. Well appointed. Highly recommended. If we return to Miami, our first choice will be The Surfcomber!

When we checked out of our room, I accidentally left my purse in the drawer.  Realizing this 2 hours after we had checked out, we returned in search of my purse.  I know exactly where it was.  I know exactly what was in it (luckily not my wallet).  It was nowhere to be found.  I'm sure this gets rationalized- some dumb rich woman left her Coach purse and she'll never miss it.  I'm not dumb, I'm not rich, and, unfortunately for Kimpton, I do miss my purse. The head of housekeeping was sympathetic but unfortunately was unable to make the purse materialize.  I do trust that he will make note of my missing property and when something like this happens to the next person, he will make changes in his housekeeping staff.

My cousin and I are from Texas and decided to get away for the 4th of July weekend and had a great time! Our rooms were ready and everyone at the front desk were polite. The hotel was clean and everyone who worked there greeted us my our name and made us feel special. The front desk lady (Rai') was very helpful to us. She always kept a smile on her face and had great customer service. Need good people like her in the Lone Star State. I truly recommend this hotel to others and if Rai' is there working, ask for her. Hopefully I'll be back to visit Miami!

My husband and I spent just a couple of nights at the Surfcomber while on a layover between flights. It was our first time visiting Miami, which can be slightly overwhelming at times. We really loved the Surfcomber as it was a relaxing resort that met all of our needs. Unfortunately it rained most of the time that we were there, so we didn't get to enjoy the beach as much as we'd hoped. The pool was really refreshing and we especially enjoyed the hotel restaurant and bar. We were able to walk to some other clubs in the evening, so the Surfcomber was definitely in a great location. Now that we've been to Miami and have gotten a sense of what the city has to offer, we're looking forward to going back and would definitely return to the Surfcomber!

Had the best time at surfcomber this summer. The staff were really nice and helpful, the rooms were clean and nice. There were complimentary refreshments in the morning and also in the afternoon (5pm was sangria time!). During the world cup they had a massive screen placed with seats for people to watch and it was near the beach. The people working on the beach were great too. The lady Andrea looked after us in a superb fashion while we were enjoying our time at the beach. Another guy James as well did a great job! You cant go wrong if u stay here

Everything was perfect.Delicious coffee, tea... wine tastings. The evening bar & restuarant manager was delightful. He helped us with our late night swim orders, and even brought over extra french fries. We rode bikes before work. And did have the opportunity to enjoy our free beach chairs. Beach service perfect! Only problem were late night partiers outside my door. If not for that it would have been perfect!

I hosted eight girls here for a bachelorette weekend and everything was fantastic.  The staff was so accommodating and really went above and beyond to make sure the weekend was perfect.  The pool and cabana area were great for hosting a group.  We never had to leave the pool once we got down there.  The rooms were spacious enough for three of us to stay in one room.  The location is central to dining, shopping and night life.   Great place to stay.

My wife and I just stayed at the Surfcomber and we had a wonderful time!   The reason why we had a wonderful time was the great staff!   They were polite, courteous and a lot of fun.   I’ve been to South Beach and Florida many times and mostly the hotels are all the same.  But what makes a hotel great is the staff and the Surfcomber has an excellent staff.  If you are going to South Beach I highly recommend the Surfcomber!

This was my first trip to South beach in Years.  The Surfcomber was the perfect spot for my trip.  Very relaxed atmosphere, Quiet & clean.  Nice pool, Great hotel, great staff, great service.   could use a better gym..

Great location, but not as quiet as I'd hoped. I had a room next to the courtyard, and every morning before7, a housekeeper or bread an or somebody with a squeaky bread cart rolled down the sidewalk noisily. The reception area is not properly staffed and you spend a while waiting if you want to check in or ask anything. I ended up going to a hotel next door to ask their concierge what I wanted to know.

In the middle of the "South Beach Scene" this boutique hotel gives you all the Chic-ness without all the noise that you find in some of the other more popular hotels. Rooms have been beautifully upgraded, the pool throws you back in time to another fine "Era" of South Beach. The staff is anxious to help and make sure you have a great experience. Can't wait to come back to the Surfcomber.

We stayed at the Surfcomber with 4 other couples and it was very enjoyable.  The beach front location is the best.  It is a smaller hotel which I enjoyed - made it easy to run to the room and back to the pool quickly.  The service we received at the pool bar and the front desk were top notch.  The pool could have been a little cleaner, but overall very happy with this hotel.

Thanks to Alex( front desk) for being so heart warming and wellcoming. Shout out to Andrea at the beach who was there for us every day, we miss your cocktails and your great service. Great job Surfcomber!

I was staying at this hotel for business but nevertheless I enjoyed every moment that I was there.  This boutique hotel is decorated beautifully but beyond that the service was impeccable!  From the gentleman that greeted me at the door to the front desk to even the young man that brought coffee to my room were all so very pleasant! The room rate was great for being directly on the beach.  Highly Highly recommend this hotel to anyone wanting to stay in the area!!

Third year staying at Surfcomber & counting!!! Exceptional staff from Alex (front desk manager) to Rai & Mercedes (check in ladies) to Mr. Foxy (always has us warm towels on our late night swims -:) ) thanks to each & everyone that made us feel at home in Miami!!! This trip was AMAZING !!! The hotel is just as nice as any other, but the staff makes the experience.  David and Kenneth at the front desk made a distinct impression that will stay with me.  The hotel has a great hotel called the social club and there is a waiter there named manny and a bartender named pat.  They were sooooo amazing.  We didn't know where to go for nightlife and the two of them sat down with us and wrote down a whole list.  Everyone there treats you like you are a apart of their family.  Anything they can do to go above and beyond, they are more than happy to help.  it was slightly more expensive than other hotels but the staff made it worth every penny.

Had an excellent stay here. Great relaxed bar, fantastic pool and staff, especially Brad who helped us with restaurant recommendations/reservations, and the guys at the beach who were so helpful. Nothing was too much trouble for anyone. Location first class too.

Had a fantastic stay here!  The staff provided exceptional service.  The room was great.  It's in a central location.  Close to shops and restaurants.  The beach is steps away.  We also took advantage of the complimentary bikes and rode to breakfast a couple of days.  Social hour was great.  Their Sangria's were delicious.  All around great time!  Thanks!

At first I was uneasy when I ended up at this hotel.  However, those concerns were quickly gone after encountering the hotel manager, Kenenth.  He was the most helpful, informative and kind person we encountered at the hotel.  He made an effort to recommend places to eat, shop and hangout.  He asked if we were enjoying our stay and when I expressed a problem we had on the beach he immediately tried to remedy the situation.  He offered different ways to make us feel better and truly made the stay worthwhile.  It was nice to have that type of personalized service in such a big city.  Would definitely stay at the Surfcomber again!

I was very please with my stay at this hotel over the 4th of July weekend. I love the decoration of the hotel, and the pleasant relaxing yet professional atmosphere. Rai at the front desk was very helpful and went above and beyond. The managers David and Lucia made us feel like we were the only guests at the hotel. Def will return.

I had to go to a work conference in Miami Beach (woe is me) and stayed here. It's within walking distance of the convention center and is just a few steps away from the beach. I ordered room service, which was very fast and the food was good. The front desk staff even called me back to let me know that I could get a side salad with my order rather than ordering an entire salad - thereby saving me money! It was very thoughtful of them. I wasn't able to use the pool, unfortunately, but it looked lovely. The front desk staff were all very helpful and had a good sense of humor. I would definitely stay here again for a vacation or if I'm forced to go back to Miami Beach for work again (haha).

Just stayed a couple of night at the Surfcomber - had previously stayed there when it was a Doubletree.  Kimpton has made this property their own with the look and feel of the Kimpton brand.  Service was outstanding throughout the property from the Front Desk to the Pool and Beach service.  Location is perfect, nice beach and great pool area makes this a great hotel in SoBe

We had a group of 23 in for a week of meetings and activities. From Elizabeth who worked with me determining our needs for meeting space and meals, to Brad who found some great options for fun things to do and restaurants to visit,  to Joe who took care of our meeting room  and meal set upmeticulously perfectly every day....it was a fantastic week. Great spot to combine meeting and fun. Thank you Surfcomber staff for making it work!

After our second stay at the Surfcomber we know why we came back. The hotel is beautiful and conveniently located. The rooms are clean, comfortable, and beautifully designed.  The entire staff from housekeeping to the pool to the front desk were extremely accommodating especially David and Brad who truly went out of their way to make us feel welcome.

The hotel was more than we expected. The staff were very friendly and helpful. Right on the beautiful Miami beach and if you don´t like the beach, the pool area was great. The hotel arranged partynights 2days during our visit with discjockeys and bars around the pool area.At first we were worried that this would cause a lot of noise but the parties ended around 9 p.m so it did not bother us at all, in fact we enjoyed it a lot! The hotel offered a glas of free wine every afternoon as a "get together" a very nice gesture. We willcertainly be back as soon as possible!!!!

Very friendly and helpful staff.  Excellent location just one and a half blocks from Lincoln Road restaurants and bars.  Rooms were clean, and have firm comfortable mattresses and excellent pillows.  Low rise building, so rooms do not have views.  Medium size boutique hotel, excellent food, friendly bar.  Rear of property lets out onto the beach.  Free Internet if you sign up for the free Kimpton hotel loyalty program.  Internet station in lobby for online checkin and to print boarding passes.  I will be sure to return here on my next visit to Miami Beach.

I would like to thank the entire staff of the Hotel, front desk, valet, house keeping, etc.  Service was very professional and detailed.  David Trujillo checked us in and recognized my voice (assuming) from a previous phone call.  David was very informative and went above and beyond to welcome us to the property.  I especially enjoyed the valet staff. The amenities were perfect and so was the room.  I will definitely recommend this property to anyone!

If you are looking for outstanding service with great vibe, beautiful decoration and superb location when holidaying in Miami South Beach the Surfcomber is the place to stay! I spent 7 nights with my mum and sister end of June and the staff made us feel like we owned the place, so welcoming and ready to please. Just 5 minutes walt to the popular shopping strip Lincoln Rd and right at the beach we had it all. Also a great place to watch the world cup soccer games either in the lounge or the pool with the huge screen and awesome crowd. I would definitely recommend this hotel particularly if you are travelling solo, with friends, or a partner.

Beach service was consistent every day.  They even had big spray at the front desk for those of us that Mosquitos love!

We come here every year right before July 4, to celebrate our anniversary.  We are never disappointed.  The people, the food, the drinks are all amazing. It is a low-key environment with high-end service.  If there is something that you want that you don't see or have, just ask and it will be provided.

My best friend and I came to celebrate our 21st birthday's in Miami and had a great time thanks to the Surfcomber! Kenneth at the front desk was so amazing, got us hooked up at all the best clubs and made sure we had the time of our lives. He even sent up a bottle of champagne the day of my friend's birthday which was super sweet. The location is perfect, we barely had to take cabs and when we did they were super cheap. This is a great hotel for young people looking to have some fun in Miami, the guys at the front desk make sure of it!

I was given champagne on check in and then a whole bottle was delivered to my room while I was at dinner the first night with a handwritten note from the concierge.  The pool wait staff were fun and very attentive. After my first night, most everyone addressed me by my name and asked how my party was going. I will return to the Surfcomber the next time I'm  in SoBe no matter what the occasion.

It's always a pleasure to enter the hotel and the staff to wish you a good day, or some other polite comment. Small things like this matter, and made my stay at the hotel very enjoyable. Iwill be back. If you've forgotten something the hotel will get it, and the important stuff is free! I live in Miami and like to have some R&R nearby from time to time. We've stayed at quite a few hotels and have never had an experience this great. The staff was phenomenal. Every single employee we met was more than willing to offer a warm smile and any assistance. Most of them remembered our names the next time we crossed paths. We took our 2 (well-behaved) dogs with us and were pleased to find that we could have them anywhere in the hotel from the social club to the pool area. The hotel is on the water and a 2 min walk from lincoln road, the best place to be on the beach. Honestly, i cannot say enough about my stay. It couldnt have been more spectacular. I'm so happy we chose the surfcomber. We'll be sure to return!

I was in Miami for one week celebrating my birthday with friends. We chose this hotel because of really good reviews. And it was even better than we expected! Everything is so neat and clean in the rooms, wonderful swimming pool where everything is served what needed, great access to the beach and delicious food and drinks. Special thank to the guest service agent - Kennet who was very helpful to us, he always smiled so I felt very warm inside. He advised us a lot of good places to go and we spent amazing time there! And all the staff is always smiling, very friendly, you feel like at home or even better! Thank you Surfcomber, we will come back next time!!!

I just want to post how amazing the staff is at this hotel. I was not staying at Surfcomber, but a hotel a few down the way.  A thief came into my hotel's pool and stole my purse.  As I was racing after him, Vinny and Mario from Surfcomber headed him off and chased after the thief for many blocks.  After what seemed like forever, they got the thief to drop my bag and gave it back to me. The cops then caught the thief another ~4 blocks away. If that wasn't enough, I had to stand in my bikini to speak with the cops and ID the suspect.  Vinny took the shirt LITERALLY off his back (he still had a white tshirt on under) and let me wear it while I was standing on the street.  A BIG THANK YOU to the Surfcomber and Vinny & Mario who saved me.

The position is very nice just front line to the beach, while the hotel itself is average, with nice common partes but with quite small and anonyme rooms which in Europe should be considered in the 2 stars range. Im really recommend this hotel. Excellent location. Few blocks from ocean drive. Beach is just there.  Rooms are nice and met the purpose. the hotel people is very kindly. Valet parking Service works very well For sure I will return  José and familia

I recently stayed at the Surfcomber with 4 friends and we had a great experience.  I did however feel that we over payed based on our needs (we are students), but the hotel was in a great location and was a short walk to the beach area and ocean av.  The hotel staff was pleasant and Kenneth and David made our visits to the concierge desk very helpful every time.  They also provided some great suggestions on clubs, bars and restaurants.  When I can afford another stay, I would be glad to come back!

I have stayed at several Kimpton Hotels and they all have one thing in common -  FABULOUS service!! The wine hour and free breakfast do not hurt either.  Surfcomber was situated in the middle of everything, a short walk to Ocean Drive, Lincoln Blvd and everything you'd want to see/visit in SoBe.  My room was CLEAN, trendy yet chic! The hotel staff (everyone from the front desk, housekeeping to my waitress' at the pool and beach) - yes you can have drinks and lunch right on the beach, were all super professional and friendly! Next time I come to SoBe, I'll be staying at the Surfcomber! Thanks so much!!!

Im really recommend this hotel. Excellent location. Few blocks from ocean drive. Beach is just there.  Rooms are nice and met the purpose. the hotel people is very kindly. Valet parking Service works very well For sure I will return  José and familia

I recently stayed at the Surfcomber with 4 friends and we had a great experience.  I did however feel that we over payed based on our needs (we are students), but the hotel was in a great location and was a short walk to the beach area and ocean av.  The hotel staff was pleasant and Kenneth and David made our visits to the concierge desk very helpful every time.  They also provided some great suggestions on clubs, bars and restaurants.  When I can afford another stay, I would be glad to come back!

I have stayed at several Kimpton Hotels and they all have one thing in common -  FABULOUS service!! The wine hour and free breakfast do not hurt either.  Surfcomber was situated in the middle of everything, a short walk to Ocean Drive, Lincoln Blvd and everything you'd want to see/visit in SoBe.  My room was CLEAN, trendy yet chic! The hotel staff (everyone from the front desk, housekeeping to my waitress' at the pool and beach) - yes you can have drinks and lunch right on the beach, were all super professional and friendly! Next time I come to SoBe, I'll be staying at the Surfcomber! Thanks so much!!!

I have stayed at a lot of hotels in South Beach and tried this out on June 9th. I have to stay I was highly disappointed.  I read all the reviews and clearly people have low expectations of a hotel. The color scheme in the hotel is black and hallways very dark.  The room is what others have said very small and that's fine for how long we would be in the hotel.   The pool and surroundings were not the attractive.  It definitely has room for improvement.  It is average at best but priceline has it for a 4 star hotel for some reason to be careful on what you are bidding on.  The hotel is centrally located but in the strip of from that block to like block 11 it is the worst hotel within that block by far.  The staff there seemed to be nice however.

I stayed at Kimpton Surfcomber for four nights here in mid May. I had a great time. The front staff, including the valet to the cleaning person I met in the hallway on my way to my room were all very nice. Working with the front desk checking in was a breeze, and the room was nice. Not the biggest room, but clean and modern. I also worked with their concierge to set up some reservations for rental car, boat trip and baseball tickets, and everything was taken care off.   Great experience and I hope I’ll be back soon.

The hotel is well located on South Beach.Although the rooms are a little small (which is understandable due to the location) , they lack for nothing. The staff are all extremely helpful and friendly , particularly Alex and Brad . The pool is open 24 hours which is a great thing for people wanting to use it at night.overall a great place!

I arrived on a saturday and they welcome me with a glass of wine and a call from the sales director. It was the famous saturday pool party going on and it was great! Alex the front desk manager was very helpful and with an excellent service, the same with Car the bartender. Both créate an amazing experience on my last visit to Miami South Beach. Felicidades y Gracias!

Great service from the moment we arrived. The room was modern, recently redone although small. They have a daily wine hour and tons of lounge space around the hotel and the pool. Staff are ready to bring you any drinks and food you want to order. They also provide chairs and towels at the beach, although you have to pay an additional $20 for an umbrella. Overall we had a great time despite cloudy weather and we would definitely stay again if we came back to Miami.

Stayed here for 4 Nights. This hotel was everything we expected, and Then a little more. Beautiful rooms, enough space, but not big. The pool area was Nice and calmfull. The facilitets at the Beach was perfect and part of the accommodation. The area around the hotel is were you Want to be when staying at the Miami Beach

This was a wonderful hotel with a great pool...just what we were looking for after a miserable Chicago winter. If you're there on Tuesday mornings make sure that you take an Art Deco tour with Chris Mehmel, Surfcomber's director of day life. Chris has a masters in hotel management from Florida International University and adores South Beach. The hotel had a wonderful (and free) Happy Hour at 5pm. This is a great place for couples and for families. We will definitely be back!

Wendy at the desk, Pat at the pool bar and Juju on the beach, were especially great.  The location is spectacular, the rooms clean and comfortable, and catering was beyond expectations.  Can't wait to go back!!

The hotel is in a nice spot and genuinely well designed. Staff is friendly, too. But then there are some things that are simply not acceptable: delivering a fruit plate with rotten/ mouldy grapes for breakfast is not on.Removing T-shirts from a pool stretcher after I asked whether it is ok to put it there and then not having anyone on duty to return is very poor service. Asking the doorman for a cab that accepts credit cards, him saying he will try his best to find one, but then not even asking the cab driver whether cards are indeed accepted is disrespectful. As I said, the hotel and ammenities are genuinely nice, but some very basic stuff is missing. I was there on my own during a business trip. Would I stay again with my wife? No.

I used trip adviser to choose the hotel and it didn't disappoint, the hotel staff were great always courteous and keen to help (the complimentary morning coffee  & afternoon wine was much appreciated). The rooms were clean and of a reasonable size and the beds 'although a personal thing' were comfortable. We didn't use the hotel restaurant in the evening but breakfast sitting out on the veranda watching the world go by was very pleasant.    My son's comment - the hotel looked cool and they did ice coffee in the morning. Daughters comment - pool was great and on the beach in seconds wow!  Wife comment - great central location easy walking distance from Lincoln Av  and Ocean Dr

This was my second time staying at the Surfcomber - I had also stayed last year during a vacation to celebrate my birthday.  We had such an amazing experience last time at this hotel that we knew we had to return again soon!  The service is fantastic, every employee truly makes you feel special and treats you like royalty during your stay.  When you're on vacation, they make it count!

I visited this hotel for a week with my family in Late December. In summary I was very impressed by the hotel. Key points:  - the rooms were well furnished and of a good size -  the people working at the hotel were always eager to help is with all aspects of our stay - the hotel's location was great for visiting the beach and also the various restaurants and bars of South Beach - it was expensive but all hotels in the area are (especially around New Years) and I found it more reasonably priced than other places - the hotel had an enjoyable private section of Miami Beach and a good pool and deck chairs - the hotel gym is quite small but I made a lot of use of it

column3: I used trip adviser to choose the hotel and it didn't disappoint, the hotel staff were great always courteous and keen to help (the complimentary morning coffee  & afternoon wine was much appreciated). The rooms were clean and of a reasonable size and the beds 'although a personal thing' were comfortable. We didn't use the hotel restaurant in the evening but breakfast sitting out on the veranda watching the world go by was very pleasant.    My son's comment - the hotel looked cool and they did ice coffee in the morning. Daughters comment - pool was great and on the beach in seconds wow!  Wife comment - great central location easy walking distance from Lincoln Av  and Ocean Dr

We stayed from Friday through to Monday. In April 2014. We had an ocean view balcony room. The service at the front desk was helpful and courteous on check in and the concierge made  good recommendations for restaurants. What was disappointing was the balcony we had paid a significant premium for:  the plants in pots on the balcony merely served to attract Mosquitos that made the balcony virtually unusable.  As other reviewers have mentioned the hotel is popular with "bachelorette parties". Some of the groups were pretty rowdy during the day and were encouraged to drink cocktails in the pool by staff. South Beach is a party venue and so is this hotel. I wouldn't recommend staying here with young children or if you are looking for a quiet relaxing time by the pool during the day.

Good location, good infrastructure, good rooms, good staff.  Several little things to improve:  1. Don't charge the pool apart, I'd rather pay more from the begining than being received with this annoying surprise after a long trip.  2. Improve cleanliness.  Dirt behind the drawers,  looks like it had never been cleaned. Blankets and sheets were stained.  3. Improve communication. I've asked for local calls rates and they told me it was 10 cents per minute, but the bill was 1 dollar per call. I've asked for the car and had to wait more than half an hour.  Because of this slowness, before going to the airport I've asked for it with 40 minutes in advance, but when I was checking out they took the car again to the parking lot without advice and had to wait another 15 minutes.

I planned a group of friends for a getaway from California, Colorado, Florida, Kentucky, Massachusetts and Toronto we couldn't have been happier with our selection of the Surfcomber for our South Beach getaway.  The concierge Brad was amazing in helping me plan a great agenda of restaurants, sights and activities for us to do while in South Beach.  Great morning yoga on the beach, bike ride along the boardwalk and a daily wine hour are some of the few free amenities that are offered.  Right in the heart of South Beach, this smaller hotel offers all the amenities and great service all around, including Vinny at the beach to help with beach chairs and also some great photo taking.    Looking forward to heading back.

We just spent three nights at Surfcomber and we miss every minute of our stay there. The hotel is modern, comfortable, sophisticated and unpretentious in an extremely good way... The pool area and outside bar are great and our favorite spot was definitely the beach club! We loved spending the days laying at the beach, being pampered by the great team they have there. The happy hour wine time is, as everything at this hotel, a relaxed experience and they frequently add some delicate appetizers that were delicious. Location couldn't be better, AT the beach, close to the bars, Ocean Drive and Lincoln Rd. We slept well, had no problems with noise. Actually, we had no problems at all.

Expensive but it is Miami. Vinny, John, Jessica and Hans were awesome. Very friendly and helpful. Def made our stay are the beach great!

This is an excellent hotel.  The best in which I have ever stayed.  From the first class help to the beautiful architecture and ambiance, it is a winner.  I actually felt bad for people staying in the giant skyscraper-like hotels with which it shared the beach.  You could tell that they were all going out of their way to make this a pleasant visit.  The only negative is the price--but it is Miami beach and it is a national historical site with only three floors worth of rooms. The beach is also excellent and I have never seen people work as hard as the young men working the beach kiosk.  Their manager Vinny has upper management written all over him.  Thanks for a great visit.

The location of the hotel is outstanding. Very close to the beach and the Lincoln Rd. shopping mall. There is a Decobike stop right in the hotel garden. Bikes are a nice way to get around in Miami Beach. The staff is very nice and helpful and the place is clean, but a little noisy, which is not a surprise, after all it's in the middle of a big city and Collins Ave is a busy place! There are many parking facilities only a view blocks away, where parking is available for $ 15-20 per night.  It's a highly recommended place to stay and to enjoy Miami South Beach.

Dorgis the door man is fantastic. The concierge was extremely helpful. The staff was all over it. I love staying at Kimpton hotels and this one in particular was lovely. The beach area is superb. The pool area is picture perfect.

The location is fab! Beach in the back garden and 5 minutes to Lincoln Road with the restaurants and bars.  Wine hour is a nice touch.   This is the hotel to stay in. We'll be back!

Thanks for a great time!!!

Recently stayed at the Surfcomber for the Easter long weekend with my wife and two teenage daughters. It is a nice and comfortable hotel. Clean rooms (on the small side)with comfortable beds and well stocked bathrooms. Free WiFi throughout the hotel. Very attentive staff. The pool area and gardens are nice, but there is not near enough room or chairs around the pool area for guests. Good beach access. The bar at the pool side is good, with, overall, good snack food and lunch items. The service by the beach can be way too slow.  I don't like the fact that they penny pinch you for everything that may be considered "extra": parking, beach umbrellas, resort fee, extra beach chair, etc.

We had an amazing time in this hotel. Everything was done with passion and precision. The room was clean, modern and quite silent . Pool and bar very nice, expeccialy the bar had a great selection. Only negative point the gym that is too small. A special mention and tranks to the staff of the beach (Vinnie, Josh , Jessica and all the others were simply Amazing! )

We had a girls weekend in South Beach at the Surfcomber and could not have been more delighted with all of the great employees.  Vinnie on the beach staff was fantastic!  He saw to all of our needs and checked with us throughout the day.  He is a great asset to Kimpton.  Monty, the supervisor for the Valet/Bell staff, is the best person the hotel could have out front to represent the Kimpton culture.  He is always happy, friendly, and accommodating.  Jenny at the Front Desk went out of her way to see that we had a great weekend.  She always asked us if everything was alright and if we needed anything.  All of the other employees were delightful.  We were sad to leave our new friends and we can't wait to see them again!

I stayed at the Surfcomber in Miami and had the most fabulous time there. The staff is excellent and friendly tending to every need and question I had. A certain staff member named Foxy made my stay so special when he found out I was there for the first time for my birthday. I will always come back to this hotel when traveling to Miami they all left such a good impression on me and the other guests with me.

South Beach is tough. Surfcomber is a recent acquisition for Kimpton from the Hilton chain.  Even an upgraded room is quite small. They just have some figuring out to do. Too much furniture in the rooms. The AC is ok, but the rooms can be a bit stuffy. (and this was in February).  Pool /Beach access is great. Staff is very pleasant.  Consider staying further South however.  At the Surfcombe, be certain to ask for a room facing the courtyard, not the street, otherwise you will be living and hearing Collins Ave 24/7.  Also - before you rrive be sure to sign up for the Kimpton 'loyalty' program- otherwise wifi is expensve.

Positive points: Location, location and location...helpful staff that (mostly) did its best.  Negative points: Noisy rooms, permanent humming sound everywhere, old facilities, thin walls, used, rund down carpets, completely noisy environment, no free of charge business center, broken window frames, the tiniest bathrooms ever, internet (wifi) only available upon registration at Kimpton, beach facilities close a 6pm sharp, slow valet parking, no slippers etc. in room, noisy mini bar. Extra charge of about 20 dollars a day for beach facilities that was mentioned nowhere before...   For the same amount of money you get palaces in Europe and to be honest much better service.

The Surfcomber is a clean, stylish and comfortable boutique option to the mega hotels on South Beach. The service was excellent - Marco at the pool area was super on top of it and ready with whatever guests could need. Chris, the manager, was also friendly and made a point to personally invite everyone to the daily wine happy hour.  There are two free bikes available for guests (I wish there were more!) and also a free boot camp class on the beach that was excellent and as challenging as any class I've taken at my gym. This was my second time visiting the Surfcomber and I hope to stay again soon.

Also - before you rrive be sure to sign up for the Kimpton 'loyalty' program- otherwise wifi is expensve.

Positive points: Location, location and location...helpful staff that (mostly) did its best.  Negative points: Noisy rooms, permanent humming sound everywhere, old facilities, thin walls, used, rund down carpets, completely noisy environment, no free of charge business center, broken window frames, the tiniest bathrooms ever, internet (wifi) only available upon registration at Kimpton, beach facilities close a 6pm sharp, slow valet parking, no slippers etc. in room, noisy mini bar. Extra charge of about 20 dollars a day for beach facilities that was mentioned nowhere before...   For the same amount of money you get palaces in Europe and to be honest much better service.

The Surfcomber is a clean, stylish and comfortable boutique option to the mega hotels on South Beach. The service was excellent - Marco at the pool area was super on top of it and ready with whatever guests could need. Chris, the manager, was also friendly and made a point to personally invite everyone to the daily wine happy hour.  There are two free bikes available for guests (I wish there were more!) and also a free boot camp class on the beach that was excellent and as challenging as any class I've taken at my gym. This was my second time visiting the Surfcomber and I hope to stay again soon.

Great job all-around by the staff on this excellent boutique property.  We got the king room with the balcony.    High points: (1) yucca fries with garlic aoli; (2) beach service (Vinnie took great care of us); (3) cruiser bikes; (4) poolside couple's massage; (5) blackout shades in room.  Areas for (slight) improvement: (1) room wasn't ready when we arrived at 3 pm; (2) balcony has lots of mosquitoes so we didn't spend too long out there.

We loved staying at the Surfcomber! Beautiful hotel, friendly staff, and close to everything, the pool boys were also very cute!! There were lots of activities to do as well. We had lots of fun relaxing and enjoying Miami! Definitely booking here again!

We had a great long weekend at the Surfcomber...great location right in the heart of Collins Ave.  The pool was the perfect size with great service from towel/chair set-up to the very friendly servers keeping our glasses full!  The hotel itself was very cute with a fun lobby especially during the daily happy hour.  We really enjoyed every aspect of our stay!

Great location, right in the middle of all the action that is SoBe.  Rooms a bit dated, but still decent enough.  Went for WMC.  Great pool party, but hour long wait to get in is kind of ridiculous, considering we were hotel guests with pre-arranged tickets. Isn't that the whole point of staying at the hotel? Anyway, front desk and valet very friendly ($38 for parking if I recall - on par with other places).  Would stay here again.

We arrived a little early but they were able to get us into the room within 20 minutes.  We try to stay at Kimpton whenever we travel, because they never disappoint!  We forget the woman's name who checked us in, but literally, she was SUPER nice and upgraded us to a suite.  There is complimentary wine every night , the bar/restaurant food was delicious! We ate one dinner and one breakfast there.  Sunday night we took part in the free mixology course (a little over an hour).  Our bartender, Carla, was very knowledgable and made tasty drinks (we were a little tipsy at the end).  Beach club workers by the pool and on the beach were very attentive and also very friendly.  We did not want to leave!

Fab place for Art Deco architecture coupled with excellent location and amenities!  Staff were really nice and very helpful.  Ask for a room on the quieter side.  Can recommend art deco tours for a 2hr guided trip which starts a 15 min walk from the hotel.

Visited Miami on a stopover to Curacao. Stayed for two nights. First impressions were okay, not luxury but I knew that. We were charged the resort fee even though we didn't use the beach chairs or the pool.  First room we were allocated wreaked of smoke, so we asked for a different room which didn't smell. Bed was comfortable, pillows are flat.  They do complimentary coffee and tea in the morning which is lovely and the location is very convenient to the beach and the restaurants and shops.

We had a very good experience overall, and at a good price, but this isn't quite the polished four star SOBE experience of your dreams. Smallish rooms that are showing their age (maybe 10 well used years?) pool area is a little dated looking and the buildings lining it have some unsightly storage spaces. A lot of work going on while we were trying to relax by the pool: power washing, landscaping.  Highlights are definitely the staff, who were thoroughly great. Lobby and restaurant ambiance very nice. Morning coffee station and complimentary wine hour were awesome. Poolside food and drink prices too high, especially the drinks.  Would go back at the right price. We had a very nice mini vaca.

Great hotel.  A few short blocks from all the action of south beach.  You can easily walk everywhere.  Nice pool, easy access to the beach and pedestrian mall on Lincoln. Took the Art Deco walking tour offered by the hotel.  Our guide was Chris.  Very informative,  great walking tour of the area.  He was able to recommend some restaurants and bars.  Very helpful. Don't forget the complimentary wine in the lobby from 5 to 6 nightly and complimentary tea and coffee in the morning.

We spent a weekend here in March and had a great time.  The property was very clean, the staff gave us helpful restaurant recommendations, and we enjoyed the Happy Hour with wine in the afternoon.  Our room overlooked Collier Avenue and was spacious.  The bathroom was not big but just fine with a rain-shower head.  The lounge chairs on the beach were very comfortable and the beach staff took care of all the details.  We will definitely return.

When staying here you really get what you pay for. Great service,staff, location and awesome pool parties!!! I loved that I was able to check in early and check out late with no fee. I will be going back for sure!!!

Our Miami Bachelorette weekend was perfect at the Surfcomber.  Brad at the concierge made the trip amazing.  He assisted us northern girls with the best tips and suggestions to make it truly a weekend to remember.  He even made the reservations for us.  They provided us with personalized service at a very nicely appointed hotel. The hotel has a great location on South Beach to hot spots and is right on the beach!

Recently, my girlfriends and I stayed at the Surfcomber hotel in South Beach. The location, hospitality, amenities, and food could not have been better!  We spent time both at the private beach as well as the pool, both with impeccable service and friendliness.   Would recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to the S. Beach area - it's definitely the best spot in town!

Just got back from 4 nights at the Surfcomber. Well, we booked based on TA reviews, and they could have not been more accurate. Great location amid the posh resorts on Collins, without the cost or pretentiousness. Staff went overboard to insure all our needs were met. Awesome pool and beach, with attendants eager to please. Complementary Happy Hour every day was a nice touch too.

This was my first time staying at the Surfcomber.  I was quite impressed by the staff and their eagerness to make sure that all guests were happy and well taken care of.  The staff were very friendly and professional.  The hotel is very clean and the beds are comfortable.  Location is perfect for walking to Lincoln Road and enjoying the restaurants and nightlife in the area.  Beautiful pool area and beachfront.  I have stayed in other boutique hotels in the Miami Beach area in the past and this is by far my favorite to date. We had drinks at the hotel bar and the staff there were wonderful there as well.  Drinks were perfect and it was relaxing and truly  enjoyable.

Just returned from Kimpton Surfcomber. Great experience all around would recommend to anyone in a heartbeat. Great staff at the pool including Marco and Chris!! the manager ( a different Chris)  also is on top of everything and made my stay a truly first class experience! I will be back soon!

Everyone was wonderful to our group. Always asking if we needed help with anything. Never had to wait more than 5 minutes for them to get us a cab.  Drinks and service at the pool was wonderful. Our server for the weekend was Chris Smith. He took such good care of us. Marco was very helpful always assisting in moving our umbrellas to help us avoid the sun.  Dorgos at the front was absolutely pleasant making us feel like we were returning home at the end of each day. I called one day for some guidance of where to find a salon so the bride could get her hair done and they connected me to B Dry so I could make appointments.

The Surfcomber was a great experience. ALL the staff is friendly and helpful. The service at the beach was above and beyond my expectations. They have wine hour from 5 to 6pm. Its a great way to meet people and mingle with other guests. And who doesn't like free wine!

Came for Bachlorette party best poolside service! Chris Smith was our server the entire time. So quick with all our orders occasional free drinks for the bride. Very relaxed and laid back pool to take a break from Miami life. Directly across from the beach so very easy access also next door to fun day clubs. Would definitely go back

A large group of us stayed this past weekend for one of my best friends bachelorette party. When we arrived at the pool we were promptly greeted and seated (all 10 of us!). Shortly after we were offered a menu from who would become our favorite server of the trip (Chris Smith). He was so friendly, checked on us regularly, and made sure that my friend (the bride) felt extra special by serving her first etc. We quickly fell in love with the pool and looked forward to it each day. Even when "Smith" was off and saw us sitting at the restaurant he stopped to say hello on his way out. I call that true customer service! You can tell he truly enjoys his job and we truly enjoyed having him as a server! Rooms are small but you shouldn't be in your room in south beach!

Stayed here for a South Beach getaway.  The hotel is lovely, right on the beach, with amazing service.  I loved the pool and especially the beach.  The pool butlers and beach butlers were fabulous.  Especially Hans.  Super attentive.  I felt so spoiled.   The rooms are lovely but very very small so be mindful if you have more than one person in the room. The breakfast staff and food was disappointing.  Parking is super expensive, 37 dollars a day, ouch!   You can walk to Lincoln Road and great shopping and restaurants.   Try Maxine's across the street for breakfast.

column3: Came for Bachlorette party best poolside service! Chris Smith was our server the entire time. So quick with all our orders occasional free drinks for the bride. Very relaxed and laid back pool to take a break from Miami life. Directly across from the beach so very easy access also next door to fun day clubs. Would definitely go back

Every time that I need to go to Miami, I am so happy because I get to stay at the Surfcomber!  The staff is so awesome that you want to keep coming back.  I love the location, the pool, the rooms, the staff, the wine hour, the coffee…all of it!  It is always great and the only place that I will stay on Miami Beach.  Congrats to the General Manager as he has trained/hired am amazing group of women and men.

I can't say enough about how fantastic our stay here was!  The staff became friends!  Chris Mehmel is a gem and so is Sean Flanigan!  Truly kind and generous with their time.  On the beach, we loved Jessica and Hans- they were so attentive and helpful!  At the Social Club- Serena So was just lovely ( and the food is amazing! ). Ryan Dupree was our server and was so cute and funny!  Jenny was super helpful and sweet too!  I will be back at the end of April and I travel for work so I'm VERY picky!! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

He made sure we had everything we needed including our two umbrellas (We got him alittle confused. )  We will definetly come back to this resort. EVERYONE that works here is VERY friendly and accommodating.

My friends and I stayed here for my bachelorette party last May. It has a great lobby, bar and an awesome pool area right on the beach, plus all the standard things that make a Kimpton great such as free wine happy and a raid the bar discount. The rooms were nice and comfortable, although the walls seemed to be a bit thin. The staff was exceptional! They went above and beyond to make this a special experience for me - they truly gave us the royal treatment. Also the hotel was in a perfect location for nearby bars and restaurants.

I recently stayed at the Surfcomber Hotel; The Hotel was great, the pool is pleasant,  we enjoyed the happy hour when complimentary drinks were served. Thanks for all the hospitality and especially to Vinny Ortega beach attendant who made sure that our stay on the beach was convenient and refreshing.

Returned this year after a great stay last year and was not disappointed. This is the best location in South Beach - right on the ocean and an easy walk to restaurants and shopping. The hotel itself is stylish and comfortable without being pretentious and has all the amenities you could want. But the best part is the staff - everyone is super friendly and helpful. A special thank you to Vinnie down on the beach and all the guys on the bell staff but really everyone is great . I would recommend The Surfcomber to anyone.

I highly recommend the Surfcomber. The staff is amazing friendly, helpful and sincere. Everyone from the cleaning personelle to the manager is extremely attentive. The rooms are very clean and bright. The staff went out of their way to make both our dogs and us feel welcome. The dogs were welcome at the pool and in the restaurant. That is unheard of. Loved every minute there!

I had been to Miami 10+ times, but it was my girlfriends first time.  We both loved it very much and it was my favorite stay of all of them.  The accommodations, location, friendly staff, and convenience of the whole experience was terrific.  Everyone was so pleasant and helpful on the staff, especially Marco D, Eric, Chris B, Rachel, Jenna, Pat, CAR, Keith, Lahteef, and the whole front desk with an extra shout out to Chris and Wendy.  Very high level talent and professionalism all around. The beach accommodations were great and the easy of everything was spot on.   Food and drinks were awesome (little pricey) everywhere on the property.  The hotel is right next to SLS, the Delano and Raleigh and close walking distance to the W, Lincoln Rd. and the start of Ocean Dr.  Must go!!

I wish I was back at the hotel as I type this! Lounging at the pool or on the beach is pure relaxation at the Surfcomber.  Located within walking distance of great restaurants and shopping.  The staff was very helpful and friendly. We appreciated the free daily infused water, morning coffee/tea, and happy hour.

Yes, the place is beautiful, hip, perfect location, great price, etc… but it was the awesome people who staffed the desk, restaurant, pool, and especially, the manager!  They were amazing and made us feel like the biggest VIP they've ever had.  They exceeded all expectations and continually delighted us with a friendly demeanor that felt totally genuine.

Cool place. So "Miami" in the best way. First time in the city and had no idea what to do/see and they totally helped me out! Ashley, the host at the bar is awesome.. cool chick with great recommendations  about the city and Tony, is a total sweetheart that just made our stay a dream. 100% coming back!!!!

We have had the best stay here, the staff are literally incredible. We checked in after 26 hrs flying and they were just so easy and lovely. And since then they have done everything and anything to make the day great. Two very very special mentions need to go Tony and the host Ashley, they literally went so far out of their way on multiple occasions to make our stay so great and I have never had service like that before. Thank you and we'll be back always and always recommend you xx

we only stayed for one night and that was enough to have an awesome experience. the beach is amazing and the pool is incredible! Marco out at the pool fixed our chairs for us and was so nice! he rocks! awesome location and beautiful weather. we can't wait to come back!!!

We had stayed at Kimpton hotels before, an simply booked this place on the strength of previous experience. I can tell you that we were NOT disappointed. :-)  The hotel is situated in the perfect location in South Beach. It's within walking distance of all major attractions, and right in the heart of the Deco district. Lincoln Mall is a short stroll away.  The price was good, the food was good (maybe a little pricey), and the staff cannot be faulted for attentiveness and care.  If I'm ever back in Miami, I will certainly try to stay here again!

I came down to Miami for a business trip. I knew from the moment I booked the hotel it was going to be all work and no play.   I didn't expect the complimentary cofee and tea, I really didn't expect the free wine at wine hour; the corny joke from chris put the icing on the cake, and the turn down every night during my stay by Stephanie was wonderful. The staff truly made a trip that was suppose to be strictly business AMAZING

Switched to the Surfcomber after paying more at an SPG property up the street where we were nickel and dimed for everything and finding someone who spoke English was near impossible when we needed help.   Having stayed at Kimpton properties before, I've always been really impressed with their customer service.  Our South Beach experience was everything we wanted/expected after the switch. The rooms are immaculate and the pool was clean and well serviced. We relied on Marco to take care us and again, we were not disappointed. He was all smiles and took care of our every need.   I highly recommend and we'll be looking for availability here upon our return next year.   -Adam

Kimpton had done a really nice job of turning the Surfcomber around.  The service throughout the hotel, from doormen to front desk to restaurant is great -- always helpful without that South Beach "cooler than thou" attitude.  Rooms are a bit small, but priced right.  Highly recommend.

I would like to say the best part of my stay was on the beach. Had a relaxing and enjoyable 4 days thanks to Victor Ortega in charge of all the amenities on the beach. Victor knew exactly what i needed and delivered 100%. Also must give a shout out to Jessica who takes your drink and food orders. Jessica had such a pleasant attitude despite being out in the heat. Once again the beach crew was outstanding.

Hubby and I made a quick getaway to escape the New England winter and chose this hotel for it's location, which was perfect for us.  Everyone was super friendly, especially Vinny, one of the beach managers, who went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable.  Overall we had a great stay and would come here again.  One caveat: walls are thin and noise travels.

The staff here is very nice and accommodating. We are here for three nights and have had a great experience. My family and I spent a week-end at the hotel celebrating a wedding. All of the staff were friendly and professional, and the food was excellent.  The party was carried off perfectly, and I would recommend the hotel to anyone planning an important event.  I particularly commend a server named Carr, who went out of his way many times to make everyone feel like the most important guest at the hotel.  At the pool, we were assisted  by Marco, who did his job very professionally. In all, our memories of a special occasion will be all we could have hoped for.

The Surfcomber has lovely rooms, a beautiful courtyard stroll to a fabulous pool/cabana area and beyond to people on the board walk and pristine beach. And the social Club has great food. But the best part of the Surf is the peeps. They make you feel welcome and at home from the front door through the front desk and at every encounter during your stay. You will feel homesick when you walk out the door where you can catch the 150 Metro to the airport every minutes (a pleasant 30-minute ride to the airport). The Surf's UP in my book!  Noosh

Location walkable to everything. Nice pool and beach. We chose the Surfcomber because it was reasonably reasonable for a hotel on the beach and were very pleased with everything.  Yes, the room was not fancy and the bathroom was pretty small, but who goes to Miami Beach to be in the hotel room?

This is a great place to stay in Miami.  The location is perfect; beachfront on Collins.  The very professional staff was helpful and always available.  The exceptional service from the pool and beach staff made me a regular.  Don't waste time or money w/ any other hotel in Miami.

The Surfcomber is about as good as it gets.  EVERYONE in the hotel is welcoming and polite.  EVERYONE goes out of their way to be helpful.  The room was exceptional as was the service.  Dorgeous the Bellman was extremely friendly and went out of his way to accommodate us.  Vinny on the beach was also over the top kind and friendly, providing us with everything we needed!   Free wine tasting at happy hour.  Breakfast was delicious.  The hotel is exceptional.  I would definitely return and stay at the Beachcomber.   Perfect Location, too.

The location of the hotel is very convenient.  On the beach and a short walk from Lincoln rd.... do not bother to get a rental car. You will not need it! The hotel staff are very accommodating and friendly, and do not feature the condescending way of treating guests that is so common for the über cool Miami Beach hotels.   Nice extras like a free breakfast and free wine during the early evening add a nice care giving touch to the hotel. The free wifi on the beach was also much appreciated.  The rooms are nicely furnished, but mostly do not feature a view beyond the wall of the neighboring hotel.  This hotel tries to compete for the coolest of the cool as guests are concerned, but seems to mostly attract either overly tattooed and/or overly loud and obese people....

My husband and I just took a quick getaway from the cold and had a most wonderful stay at The Surfcomber.  Our second Kimpton hotel to visit and a true boutique style hotel.  The service was impeccable, from the door and bell staff, front desk and the restaurant.  Each staff member made it their job to help you have a wonderful stay.  The pool and beach staff were very attentive.  Vinny, on the beach couldn't have been nicer or more helpful to ensure we had a great beach experience.  Kudos to the management here, you are doing a great job with your staff!  Also, great location on South Beach.  We'll be back!!

My husband and I just returned from the Surfcomber after a four night stay.  This is the 10th year we have come to South Beach for my husband to run the marathon, and our second stay here, since it opened. They did an amazing job for the runners this year, having snacks and supplements available for the runners starting at 4 am. Our room, as last year, was immaculate. We love the location and the pool area as well as beachfront area. I had my first Cosmo Popsicle! A special shout out to Monte and Ghulam for their friendliness and helpfulness, along with the attentive pool staff -- Eric, Leslie, Marco, and Chris.  All in all, a fun stay!

Stayed at the Surfcomber in January for 12 nights. A really great hotel in a popular part of Miami Beach.  The staff is what makes this hotel special, they just seem to try harder than at other hotels. Loved the large pool and beach area in the back. And also a small thing but which made it really nice was the free wine hour at 6 PM, we seemed to take advantage of this every night. We will be back.

Boutique hotel located right near all the action of South Beach and Lincoln Road. Rooms are on the small side but this is all about location and charm. The property is divided into identical wings with a large pool in the rear and a great beach area. Service is excellent without exception, whether at the valet, front desk, pool or beach. Chris, whom we met at check-in, provided us with personal exceptional service, even greeting us by name each day. There is a free wine tasting each day at 5 PM. There is a small restaurant/bar serving very good light food. From the moment you arrive you feel special.

A gem of a hotel find on south beach, a true boutique property. Rooms are a bit on the small side, but more than made up in comfort. The lobby bar restaurant is ok, but the beach service was remarkable. We were served by Pablo Castro, who took great care in insure we had a outstanding day on the beach, and that we did!! Honestly that alone made our trip and guarantees the return!! Looking forward to the next vacation!

The chairs are new and well maintained as well as reasonably priced for the area. We definitely will be using the Surfcomber's chair service the next time my friends and I are in Miami Beach.

My three girlfriends and I meet each your in Miami for a long weekend getaway. We decided to try Surfcomber this year and it was a really good experience. Service was exceptional, rooms were nice (very, very small bathroom). Be sure to get a room on the top floor. We had to move after the first night because of all the noise. Great location with perfect beach access. Pool was very nice, too. The staff (Brian, Brad -- fabulous) gave us wonderful restaurant recommendations. Try Spiga and Catch. Both great. Would stay there again for sure. Loved the nightly wine tasting.

My husband and I are longtime Kimpton Inner Circle members. Part of being Inner circle is you fill out a preference profile and on ours we request an in room coffee pot - most Kimptons miss the coffee pot but the Surfcomber got it! They got every other preference spot on. They were prompt, personal, polite and very professional! The location is great you can walk everywhere! The restaurants in the area are numerous and excellent. Shopping is second to none. We will be back again!

We stayed in a Cityview Suite which was really spacious and very quiet considering it faces Collins.  If you want a smaller hotel that's not overrun with bachelor and bachelorette parties, the Surfcomber is a perfect choice!
