The staff was the most friendly I have ever encountered--always a " hello", a "welcome back" from our jaunts, a "let me help you with that".  They were absolutely wonderful.  We found some really great restaurants within a short walk  and some were farther south, but still walkable. (Taxies are readily available if you're too tired after a day of sightseeing.) My fiancé and I recently stayed at the surf just for a small get a way. The small but yet vibrant boutique was everything I could have imagined and more. The staff was amazing, I have never met a group of people so happy. From the minute you drive up we Got a sweet hello from Monty and Dorgis, Check in with Wendy, and our lovely Turndown service from Stephanie. This just might be where I come back for my hunnymoon.

If you are looking for a small friendly hotel in a great South Beach location, this is the place. Great beach access, with a lovely pool and ocean view. We looked a several others hotels before booking, and made the right choice! Dale, Vinnie and Amanda provided great beach service (not cheap!) and Chris was very nice at the pool. Room 237 has a great balcony with ocean view - if you don't want to get wet you can spend your day there!

We really enjoyed the surfcomber. We felt like it was a great value! The location was fantastic right next to some of the more expensive hotels. The pool scene was a little more low key but we were able to hop to the SLS and the Delano for some cocktails and a pool party. It was the little things that made our stay so fantastic...the free bikes that we were able to take and ride around, the juice bar for fresh juices, the complementary italian ices and wine hour. The guys by the pool truly gave us some great recommendations!

The Staff is EXCELLENT!. From the minute you drive up (Monty) to check-in to bell service. I have to call out our bellman (Dorgis) who we were fortunate to have with both check-in and checkout. His hospitality, outgoing personality and knowledge helped us have a memorable experience in South Beach. Location is perfect and would easily go back anytime when going to South Beach.

The common areas are designed with originality and care and provide an inviting entrée to their fabulous pool area and beach entrance.  The rooms are a bit small but they were working with an existing structure so that is to be expected.  The rare hotel I would recommend both to my snobbish as well as down to earth friends.

We were very pleased with our stay! This customer service was excellent. When we drove up to our hotel we were greeted as if we were family arriving home. The concierge, Brian, gave us great information from the get-go and wrote us a welcome not soon after we arrived. We met Dorgis who also was most helpful and we enjoyed getting to know him and learn about his family. We enjoyed the complimentary wine at 5 PM and met Chris who also sat and visited with us. Someone took our picture. I wish I could remember all the names, but everyone was great. The hotel even has free bicycles to use, and we did. We loved the locations and the amenities. We would definitely stay there again. Barb and Bill (Stayed 8 January-10 January 2014)

Myself and two friends stayed here for a week break. This is an excellent hotel. While the room was a bit on the small side, the rest of the hotel made up for it. The pool area is fantastic with refreshing flavored water available as well as towels and suncream. There are bikes available to rent and the hotel's location right on the beach makes for a brilliant holiday. What really stands out about this hotel is the staff. They couldn't be more helpful. I don't think I've stayed somewhere with nicer staff. Thank you.

The Surfcomber is a very good hotel in an excellent location in South Beach. Everything is in walking distance to the hotel which is great. Our room (a courtyard king room) was very nice and quiet, but a little on the small side. All the expected amenities were there. Service was excellent, from the chirpy front desk staff to the guys in the bar who even kept the bar open for us when we arrived at midnight after a very long trip from Tokyo and felt like a wine.  The pool was very nice, as was having access to the beach, and the staff at the pool serving drinks were very good.  All in all, a great choice for south beach with more a boutique hotel feel than some of the other options (ie Loews).

We stayed for one night at the Surfcomber. Check in was very quick. We did not even have time to finish our free champagne.   We caught the bus from Miami airport to South Beach, the stop is across the road.   The hotel is perfectly located on South Beach within walking distance to bars and restaurants.

I stayed at the Surfcomber during Art Basel. It was a great location and the staff were terrific. The rooms were well appointed and comfortable. The bathrooms were a bit small, we were three women in one room. It wouldn't dissuade me from staying there again though.  We spent most of our time on the beach. The service was a bit spotty, but the staff were apologetic. The drinks were great. There was even a place set aside on the beach for kids. They had all the buckets and shovels there, along with umbrellas, for the kids to build sand castles.  I really only ate one dish there, the hummus platter for lunch, and it was fantastic.

The staff here was great during a very busy time of the year mid july!! Two gentlemen that went above and beyond are Chris Bones and Brian Edelson! My girlfriend and I had an amazing time and we really appreciate the entire staff for all their help during our stay.

The staff at this property is amazing.  From the door man who welcomes you home to the front desk people who are always eager to help to the pool staff who make sure that you're comfortable.  We asked for a room with a view, we were warned that there would be music at the pool until 2am and they suggested we get a courtyard room if the noise was an issue..   We could hear the music but it's south beach and it just seemed like part of the atmosphere.    The pool is nice, the property is by the beach and there are always beach chairs available and staff to get your chairs set up.  I was every pleasantly surprised with the quality of the food at lunch.  The chef accommodated a request for a vegetarian burger that wasn't on the menu and it was amazing.  Thank you!

You will not be disappointed staying here. First off the staff: the valet, Lateef, was super smiley and friendly, front desk personnel, Amanda was a sweetheart, and Curan, brought me tea because I was sick! Amanda helped us with a reservation. She was friendly and such a sweet, sincere person. We rolled in at 3am but she found us a room quickly. She noticed how I was coughing up a storm and had Curan get me some hot tea :)) Curan didnt just bring hot water and a tea bag, he opened the lid let me add honey and closed it for me making sure it was secure! I was taken aback by how nice they were! The decor in the hotel is really laid back, earthy...loved it. I will 100% stay here again.

Great week spent at the Surfcomber, though the weather was not great--too much rain. But Superb location, great wine hour each evening, and amazing and super friendly staff led by Sean: Brian, Wendy, Jonathan, Wendy, Tony, Keith, Doregis, and David. Love the greeting at each return: "Welcome Home."

What a nice place, the nicest hotel I had ever experience in South Beach. A trully friendly staff, I had the feeling that everyone I encountered at the hotel was trying to go an extra mile to make me feel special as a guest. The positive atitude made all the difference. Comfortable and clean rooms, nice pool area, right on the heart of SOBE. Wanna have a great time, don't think twice, this is the place.

The Surfcomber is a great hotel on Miami South Beach with direct beach access and a few minutes walk from all the bars and restaurants on Lincoln Ave. Stylish interior, impeccable service and clean rooms. You really feel welcomed and the friendly staff takes great care to make the stay special.

The Surfcomber Miami Beach is a beautiful hotel strategically located within walking distance of shopping and dining.  This hotel offers a relaxing atmosphere (for those who want to relax) and excitement (for those looking for a night on the town).  Exceptional Customer Service - The staff was courteous and professional, and made us feel welcomed each and every day.  Thank you to all who made our vacation one to remember.

Amazing experience at this place! Although I was traveling for work, this hotel made me feel like I was on vacation. The staff went above and beyond to make my stay a great one, whether I was grabbing a glass of wine at the bar before bed or sneaking in time at the pool between meetings every person I encountered was so helpful and friendly.  They also have a great Art Deco walking tour the events coordinator takes guests on. Would stay there again in a heart beat!

I booked this hotel on recommendation from a friend who has stayed there a couple of times. The hotel is no different to most good 4/5 star hotels but what sets it apart is the hotel staff, who were all exceptional. they create a great relaxed vibe around the hotel and you instantly feel at ease. We were a group of 11 guys on a pre-work trip but this didn't bother the hotel staff and they looked after us brilliantly, even treating us to free champagne after coming in from a club at 3 in the morning! The lobby is really cool and they have a wine happy hour each day between 5-6 which has a great vibe too. Couldn't recommend this hotel enough, we all had an amazing time and will definately book again next time we are in Miami. Special call out to David who was an awesome host!

We stayed at this hotel November 2013, it was absolutely amazing, from the location to the staff and amenities. The hotel had an amazing atmosphere which the staff promoted, which serve to enhance our stay.  Nothing was too much to ask.   Would highly recommend.

We got a great deal on Hotels.com, very good price for the value.  Our service was phenomenal, especially Jackie and Brian!  We loved the location and had a tremendous stay.  The room was a bit small and we didn't have any view, but we didn't mind it because everything else was on par or better, though I'm sure there are better rooms here with nice views.  Definitely recommend!

Beautiful hotel in the heart of Southbeach. The vibe, the music, the ambiance is all there but not in your face.  The staff is super friendly. Wine is offered free to guests in the lobby daily, just before dinner. It's a great way to meet other guests making you feel even more comfortable and welcome.  I filled out a guest questionnaire online upon my arrival. I'm sure they changed my pillow in the middle of the first night to meet my preference. I will be back again.

We recently spent a long weekend (four nights) at the Surfcomber - it was wonderful!  The Staff is incredible and very friendly.  They get to know you by name almost immediately and truly care about your experience.  I was greeted in a friendly fashion without exception and asked, on many occasions, if there was everything that could be done to improve my experience.  The Happy Hour in the evenings was excellent (free Wine!) and afforded a friendly atmosphere and venue to play Jenga and get to know other guests.  The Pool and outside Bar area was excellent.  The Service in both areas was excellent as well.

After some disscusion  I  got money back , but anyway they blocked  500  usd  on my credit card and  I  was waiting 3 weeks to get it back.

I went on this trip for my Boyfriend's Birthday and I must say, I love this hotel. The decor was very fun, chic, and modern. But most of all, I loveddddddddddddddddddddd the customer service that we received. The pool staff was the most amazing that I have ever had in my life. The waiter Robert, whom I called Bobby Boucher, was not only the hottest dude on earth but he treated me like Royalty when I was at the pool. I also loved my other Pool Cutie, Chris, aka Chris Brown, who also provided us with the most premium service. I also loved the Happy Hour from 5-6 in the Lobby. I wish I had four hands so I could give you guys four thumbs up. See ya next Summer!!!!

The pool, the room and the staff were amazing!  Thank you Erhen, Chris, Leslie & Car!  I know I am forgetting some folks and this took a while to complete but thank you for making my stay in September awesome!

On our arrival, we were given Champagne to celebrate our first visit to Miami.    They phoned our room to check that everything was satisfactory. Love the free happy hour from 5 to 6. They walk around and give you top ups on your wine. Gave an excellent recommendation for a Mexican Restaurant. Room was nice and quiet. Pool is quite large, but prefer swimming in the ocean.

My girlfriend and I are, frankly, not SB's sort of people.  We're Chartered Accountants.  From Britain.  This hotel was a safe haven of civility, normality, absolute comfort and excellent service in the midst of SB's seeming chaos!  The room was lovely, the pool was lovely to lounge in the shade (and the staff only too happy to help with moving the parasols to keep the shade) but this hotel's real difference was the staff.  Everyone we met cared and was only too happy to help.  To jaded (British) cynics of American service, there was genuine care and pride in the staff's work.  The hotel also has bicycles which are complimentary for guest use...and which we didn't realise until the staff told us and booked for us.  Would not hesitate to recommend!

The staff are absolutely amazing at the front desk. I was here for an event and they held my bags, recommended places to go. I felt very upscale here. The pool is great here, has a waterfall and a lot of places to lay out. When I come back to Miami, i'll be staying here because great experience.

My family and I stayed at the Surfcomber in late September 2013. The reception, hotel staff were exceptional. Standing out though were the restaurant staff and pool attendants. They went beyond. My son (5) was given added care which I appreciated. They took the time to chat and make valuable recommendations on dining and activities outsider of the hotel. The hotel is well locted in the heart  The room though compact was clean and had the necessary amenities to make it comfortable. The garden area was serene, it may be a good place to serve afternoon tea to leverage on this great space. The bike hub on the compound was not functioning. A note of caution, the taxi taking us to the airport gave us some counterfeit money when providing change.

We stayed here at the beginning of November.  Lovely welcome by all staff after a long hectic journey!  Lovely pool with great pool side service!  Great food and lots of choice for the children. Rooms are compact but have everything you need.  Disappointed that I didn't get a sea view.. however, the hotel and service made up for it!  The sea is across a path from the hotel... the same path that takes you all the way to Ocean Drive full of lots of good places to eat and drink!  Felt safe and happy at this hotel.  First class service!

Stayed with my family there in early November.It is a very nice hotel and  looks new and very comfortable. It has direct access to the beach and all around good food options. All the staff are very helpful and friendly. We had a very nice vacation !

Sitting poolside enjoying another lovely day at Kimpton Surfcomber in Miami.  Our pool attendant jonathan has made our stay fun and comfortable. Friendly service is a hallmark here. Super location to boot.  We will be back next year.

Sorry, but I don't get this property's high reviews.  The Surfcomber has pretty interior and exterior common areas, and it's located on a lovely beach.  Beyond that, it was disappointing.  Our "suite" was really just two regular hotel rooms connected through a door. The furnishings were tired-- stains on carpet, frayed edges on furniture, etc.  A loud thump sounded at regular intervals day and night.  Who knows what that was.  Drinks at the pool were outrageously priced, and the restaurant food was mediocre.  The grand finale consisted of the front desk staff unable to send a facsimile for me.  This isn't a hotel focused on the business traveler, but come on.

I stayed three nights at the Surfcomber. I really enjoyed my time there. The staff are very friendly,positive and accommodating. They did a great job of making sure all my needs were met. The location is awesome!! Just a few steps away from the beach, shops and entertainment. My favorite part was being served cold drinks and lunch while on the beach. The pasta salad and chicken sandwich were delicious!! The room was clean. The pool area is very nice. They also offer coffee and tea in the morning and host a wine hour in the evening that is a lot of fun. I had a fabulous time. Thanks to the Surfcomber team.

Super Positive: The staff is incredible. The front desk helped me check in early and recommended great food. The concierge staff provided the most thoughtful amenity I've seen from any Kimpton all year. The bar, restaurant, and pool members all took the time to strike up friendly conversation and make the visit more personal and relaxing. Positive: Great location right next to the beach and within walking distance of Lincoln Road and Ocean Drive. Neutral: None. Negative: None.  I've stayed at about twenty different Kimptons nationwide in the last year. The staffs are generally above average. The Surfcomber team is awesome. They provided one of the most relaxing weekend getaways I've had in a long time. Thanks so much!

Stayed 3 nights with our 20month old son and thoroughly enjoyed it: staff were particularly helpful (thank you Keith for our welcome and advice; thank you Monty for providing crayons while we waited for our car; and Jenny, thanks for advice on the keys). It was very relaxing and everything made easy.   The hotel has great access to the beach, and a lovely pool. We didn't eat at the restaurant but my son enjoyed his food there (kids menu) and the locations provides good access to the main sights of south beach. Would definitely return.

Just spent two nights at the Surfcomber with our son and his partner before going on a cruise. I have to say the staff here are amazing! Everyone has been so friendly and helpful- it really is true what all the other reviewers have written! The hotel is so truly boutique and trendy- unlike anywhere we have ever stayed! Breakfast was perfect- very good burritos and eggs Benedict. Loved the wine hour and great morning tea selection. Especially appreciated the double set of bathroom towels, excellent air-con and 12pm checkout! Only minor downside was no one noted it was my birthday, unlike previous guests mentioned- all I got at 3.15 was an unmade room because housekeeping hadn't got there yet! Not a big problem because I am a grown up after all!!! Thanks anyway for a great stay.

The pool was beautiful and everything was just perfect. I was really glad to meet such a giving caring staff.Especially Chris Bones, the female manager, and the other Chris. These three people were exceptionally skilled at taking care of customer needs. They were generous and kind and were very knowledgeable about local places in the area. I had such a great experience i plan on returning every time i come down and staying at the Surfcomer. With such a great location, great staff its an easy convenient location for travelers to enjoy the essence of Miami.

Small room with no balcony which we knew. Pool and beach awesome. Free wifi and evening complimentary wine and morning coffee. Very good food. Pool staff worked hard and made us feel at home. 2 Chris's, Marco and Jonathon at pool were excellent as was Day Mgr Chris. So helpful and friendly.

Ok where do I begin, From the time I walked in the Hotel I felt like Family. Dorgis was great..He took our bag & held them for us because we was early. Valerie was great when checking us in. The hotel is truly amazing & clean. Everyone post that the rooms are small,we had a courtyard King it was the best no noise spacious & perfect for my husband & I. Ryan helped us book my birthday dinner,as well as Brian very attentive staff. Jackie was overall the best I asked her if we could get a late check out & gave gave us one. Oh I forgot about the Wine hour AWESOME!! The pool was great Chris was very attentive & sweet.. I never had a bad experience,,I def will be back I loved my birthday gettaway,,Awesome Staff & keep up the good work!!! Tina from New Orleans :)))

I had such a great experience i plan on returning every time i come down and staying at the Surfcomer. With such a great location, great staff its an easy convenient location for travelers to enjoy the essence of Miami.

Small room with no balcony which we knew. Pool and beach awesome. Free wifi and evening complimentary wine and morning coffee. Very good food. Pool staff worked hard and made us feel at home. 2 Chris's, Marco and Jonathon at pool were excellent as was Day Mgr Chris. So helpful and friendly.

Ok where do I begin, From the time I walked in the Hotel I felt like Family. Dorgis was great..He took our bag & held them for us because we was early. Valerie was great when checking us in. The hotel is truly amazing & clean. Everyone post that the rooms are small,we had a courtyard King it was the best no noise spacious & perfect for my husband & I. Ryan helped us book my birthday dinner,as well as Brian very attentive staff. Jackie was overall the best I asked her if we could get a late check out & gave gave us one. Oh I forgot about the Wine hour AWESOME!! The pool was great Chris was very attentive & sweet.. I never had a bad experience,,I def will be back I loved my birthday gettaway,,Awesome Staff & keep up the good work!!! Tina from New Orleans :)))

Couple of my girlfriends and I decided to have a girls weekend in South Beach Miami. It was our first time and we stayed at the Surfcomber Hotel. Great location! Walking distance to lincoln road. Steps away from the beach. The staff was amazing. Special shout outs to several bellmen. Tony who gave us great recommendations where to party. Curan who escorted two of my girlfriends back to our room after a creeper followed my other friend and I up the elevator. And finally Keith who always waved a taxi down for us. You guys are great! You made our stay awesome!

Wow, such a nice place! If'you're in South Beach you definitely need to go to the Surfcomber. First of all, it was the best staff ever. There was always someone to open the door for us or to call a taxi, and we had a lot of fun with the staff at the reception, especially JACKIE :) It's one of the best spot on the street, the rooms were clean and we like the vibe that was going on there. The only thing I think they can improve is the wine they are serving free from 5 to 6, but hey it's still free wine! I will recommend all my friends to go there and when I'll come back to MIA, i'll be at the surfcomber and nowhere else!

Fantastic location.. Poolside nice and quiet( compared to adjacent larger hotels) and steps away from bike path and beach. Service was excellent, not a second of aggravation. The social club's (restaurant) food was reasonably priced and very tasty. All of the Conceirge's  reccomendations were good. If you visit say hello to "gorgeous Dorgis" at the door! If I ever make it back to So. Beach I wouldn't consider staying anywhere else.

This is second time staying at a Kimpton hotel and it was awesome. The location is perfect for the beach lover which I am. Another plus is that Kimpton loves dogs so I brought mine along for this stay. My room was on the first floor and was very quite and cozy. The bedding is so soft and the pillows are plush.The evening wine hour is a great bonus.We sat in the lobby with our four legged friend and sipped on wine and ordered some small plates from the kitchen which were a work of art.I can't wait to try another Kimpton hotel.

My husband and I found this hotel Labor Day Weekend. We were walking on the boardwalk and heard a DJ spinning beats and as we were walking by they invited us in. We got drinks at the back bar, hung out and partied in the pool. Great atmosphere and friendly workers. We will definitely spend a night here the next time we are in town. It is a great location from tons of hotels, bars and clubs.

My friends and I had a great time. We sure took advantage of the complimentary drinks from 5-6. Marco(s) and the rest of the guys around the pool were awesome, they treated us like family. The people inside the hotel were pretty cool as well.   Only problem for a guy my size, the bathroom upstairs was mighty tight and bed was for the size of my friend 5'5(little person status)

This is a great hotel. From our doorman, Ghulam to the hostess in the Social club ( i think her name was LaToya) the people were friendly and really seemed to like their jobs. In my world that speaks volumes. Our room was spotless and we ate all of iur dinners there. We recommend the Miami Spice dinner deal but, we also ordered from the main menu  ( beef shanks - OMG) and we really were happy with everything. OK we even started out wirh a little trouble in our room but the fixed it immediately and the head of housekeeping, Chris A. personally apologized, who does that?  Someone who cares. We shall be back. Thank you for making our mini vacation a great vacation.

We visited the Surfcomber in January of 2013 to add a couple of days to our cruise.  We have several Kimpton Hotels in Washington DC and they are all known for their quirky vibe and excellent service without the snobbishness that sometimes comes with nicer hotels.  This property is beautiful, contemporary and the staff are helpful and fun.  It's right on the beach but we barely spent time there since the hotels grounds were so nice.  this is a very pet-friendly hotel -- they even have treats and amenities for your dog!  There is a free wine happy hour each day and they even have cider there for the kids.  This isn't a cheap hotel but we liked it so much that our family of four all vowed we would come back and make this our destination.

The deciding factor in choosing this hotel were the many  trip advisor reviews mentioning the excellent customer service. They were accurate. Every staff member greeted our party with a warm smile and were exceptionally helpful. Room service was prompt. The rooms were clean and well-appointed. The readily available fruit infused water in the lobby and pool side, as well as the included sangria/white wine happy hours were nice touches. I would definitiely stay here again.

Couldn't be happier. Even a birthday surprise waiting for us upon arrival (cupcakes, champagne, card). Free bikes, great for morning ride down the boardwalk. A short walk to main strip at Lincoln rd. additional perks if u become a member of kimpton like free Internet.

The hotel was beautiful, clean and the staff were amazing!  Especially the pool guys and girls, who were kind, courteous and attentive.  my girlfriends i stayed labor day weekend 2013 and enjoyed every minute of it.  We had stayed at the Surfcomber 10 years early (Labor Day 2003) and had such great experience that we stayed there again!!!

We stayed here in August 2013.   I had heard a lot about this magical Miami Beach hotel and had high expectations. I was definitely happy to have them blown out of the water (like 'kaboom' out of the water).  I could follow with a pun as to how amazing the pool area is, but this may not be the appropriate forum and it wouldn't do it justice. Let's just say I didn't want to leave. Ever.  Very happy with the service and the bar had great drinks as well. Probably too many good drinks.   Recommend this to anyone making it out to sunny Florida!

From start to finish, our weekend stay at the Surfcomber was superb.  I have zero complaints.  Front desk and housekeeping staff were very friendly and accommodating.  Rooms and lobby are updated and clean.  This hotel is a complement to the Kimpton brand.  Highly recommended!

We spent 2 nights at the Surfcomber in April and really enjoyed our stay. From the staff at reception to housekeeping and the pool staff,  everyone was friendly and helpful. Our room was compact but very clean and had all we required in it. The pool area was lovely with plenty of chairs available while we were there and an added bonus of free wine at 5pm every night. We ate a meal at the restaurant by the pool our first night there which was very nice with a helpful waiter recommending drinks to compliment it. We had complimentary breakfasts as part of our room rate which we hadn't realised before hand and was a nice surprise. The the location is great with shops and restaurants close by. I would be happy to stay here again if we ever came back.

I was at this hotel over the weekend and found that the location is literally perfect, the grounds are clean and the staff very friendly. The hotel is a lot bigger inside than it appears. It is quite a large hotel with clean updated rooms. The beds are super comfy and the decor serine. I would go back in a heartbeat. Thank you Surfcomber for making my Labor Day holiday great!

My husband and I stayed at this hotel for 6 nights, on the 1st week of June 2013. The location is perfect. We could walk everywhere, with the beach being very close. We had a room with a very nice view of the pool and ocean. The size of the room was good, although the bathroom was very small. The pool area and garden were very nice to just relax if we were not going to the beach. All employees were very nice and always with a smile. The bar in the garden was great, to just grab a beer after or before the beach, we had a very nice end of afternoon on our last day with Leslie and Robert, very nice conversation and great time, they surely know how to entertain while doing a great job! I'm sure I'll try to stay at this hotel next time I'm back to South Beach.

I am a frequent traveler for business, but went on this trip with several of of friends and I have to say this is the best customer service I have ever experienced. The pool staff was extremly attentive and made sure we were comfortable the whole time. To be honest, I had the worst hangover one could imagine (Miami....) and the pool staff brought me pitchers of water, a umbrella and a cool towel without me even having to ask. So a big thank you to Jon Hernandez and Jenny! thanks for a great weekend

We checked this hotel online and booked it. The check in guy seemed to not like us very much. They ask for 150usd on your card for incidentals which I felt was high. Our room didn't have a really nice view. The pool is open 24hrs with direct access to the beach and the pool staff were more than helpful. The night staff were actually friendlier and quite cute. Drinks are quite expensive here but it's a good stay all in all. Yeah and it's about 40dollars for all day valet parking.

We decided to treat ourselves and book at the Surfcomber, best choice ever!! The staff were wonderful, so lovely. The hotel is beautiful and quirky, lots of cool statues and colours. At the concierge I mentioned that I was celebrating my 21st birthday the weekend before, when I returned to my room there was a bottle of champaign and a birthday card. Couldn't get the smile off my face. Thank you to all the staff, I wish I could have stayed here longer, it truly is amazing.

The customer service at the Surfcomber is excellent starting from the moment you arrive to the moment you leave.  The staff goes above and beyond to make sure you feel welcome and have a relaxing stay.  Chris B. at the pool took excellent care of us while we enjoyed the sun!  He was very attentive to our needs and made sure we were comfortable.  My husband and I have been going to the Surfcomber every summer for 3 years and will return again next year.  I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking to stay in the South Beach area.

Honestly, this hotel was a pleasant surprise! We have stayed in Miami Beach before and nothing compares to this hotel as far as service, value, style and location. The staff was accomadating and the bellhops welcomed us "home" every time we returned back to the very stylish lobby. Complimentary is not a popular word in South Beach and we were shocked by the free wine hour and free coffee hour each day as well as unlimited sunscreen and fruit infused water. The food was delicious and reasonably priced. Last but not least we loved the artsy decor.. We even took a few pictures for ideas at home! You won't be let down when you stay here, especially for the price!

The positives: Very friendly staff. Great lobby and pool. The negatives: The rooms are very very small. The noise. Very loud music every day from 11:00 until 23:00 (and always the same) The noise!!!! No security in the property means that people come drunk at all hours of the night. The screaming, laughing, and carrying on in general with no one around to curtail the behavior, means you will be woken up every time a group of people come back from a night out. If you are in SB to party, this is ok, in my case, I chose this hotel based on reviews by others and after three days of not sleeping moved out.

Stayed with my wiefe and three daughters, in July. Wonderful staff, friendly, eager to help. Confortable rooms, decent breakfast. The can be used  at night, which isn't common. We definitivly recommend!

The only negative thing I would have to say is, the rooms are not equipped with coffee maker or microwave and are small, but if you are not planning on spending a lot of time in the room, then this is the place, it is close to everything and the beach is great.

We were a little nervous to stay at such a "boutique" hotel with kids, but Surfcomber made them all feel welcome.  We had a blast.  Such an amazing staff at this hotel.  Nicole rocks the front desk.  She, along with Brian were able to get us a reservation last minute for 28 people on a Friday night.  No task was too daunting for her.  She rises to challenges and enjoys doing so.  Oh yes, the pool staff.  Great group of people.  Marco, Marco, Marco, you made our trip.  Thanks for all of the basketball  games.  Jonathan, Jenna, and Bryan also were quick to help out. A big thank you to them as well as Chris.  We can't wait to come back.  The beach was beautiful it was such a relaxing vacation.   Best we've had in years

Thank God we booked this hotel at Collins Ave. (South Beach) for 4 nights. It was the perfect stay. Very friendly staff, especially Bryan!!! We had a rather noisy room but Bryan and his staff solved the problem right away by giving us another, upgraded room at no extra charge. Also the people at the pool deserve a special note: they were really great. We will definitely come here again.

This is the second time my partner and I have stayed in the Surfcomber, South Beach and it never disappoints. The rooms are fresh, fun and very modern. The hotel decor is very Miami and a haven away from the hustle bustle of Collins Ave but extremely close to the beach. I would like to draw attention to two fantastic members of staff Leslie and Robert... whilst spending a lazy day by the outdoor bar drinking copious amounts of beer, they made us feel so welcome and are a real credit to the hotel. They couldn't have been any friendlier, we had a fantastic day laughing and chatting.  If you're thinking about staying here, do it. You won't regret it.   Clyne & Simon

My wife and I stayed at the Surfcomber July 14-19.  We really had a good experience at the hotel.  I glad we followed the advice of other travelers about getting a room on the courtyard side of the hotel.  The positives were:  the standout staff (Nicole, the concierge, in particular;  Aaron, Ricky, and Chad), the beautiful pool, the happening happy hour, the free morning coffee and newspaper, the premiere location, and the overall laid back vibe in the hotel. The negatives were:  the smallish room and bathroom, the pricey breakfast, the limited workout room, and the loud music playing at the hotel next door while we were at the pool during the day.  The positives far outweighed the negatives in our opinion.  We already discussed staying at the hotel upon our next visit to Sobe!

If you get a good deal, the hotel is a solid choice. Great location, just a block away from Lincoln Rd (many restaurants, shops, people watching!) and the beach is perfect here. The pool side and beach attendants were pretty on point and coming around often. The hotel has a free wine hour in the evening and coffee in the am. I would stay here again and would recommend.

Rooms were very clean, hotel was very clean and beautiful inside and out, the staff were amazingly nice and went out of their way to assist us when not even needed. The pool was so nice with limitless water and sunscreen and every night there was free wine hour. The beach was directly behind the hotel and either on beach or at the pool, you can have drinks or food delivered right to you without getting up! We are already planning next summer to stay here again and will always look for Kimpton Hotels when traveling from here on out. Simply amazing altogether!!! If we could live there, we would!

What a great stay. Amazing pool and amenities. Free wine and sangria happy hour, free wifi, direct beach access, everything you can ask for from a south beach hotel. The rooms though a bit on the small side is average of larger than most south beach hotels. This was my first stay at this hotel but I would definitely stay again. It's away from all the major hustle and bustle of south beach though on walking distance of all the main attractions and one block from Lincoln road. My only caveat would be when I requested an extra blanket one night and it took about 45 minutes to arrive. Other than that it was clean and comfortable I would highly recommend.

The Surfcomber is a wonderful hotel.  It has a great location in the heart of South Beach.  The rooms are good sized and very clean.  It has an amazing pool and is right on the beach.  They have some nice small touches such as free loaner bikes and a wine tasting for the guests every afternoon that set them apart from most other hotels.  Last and most important, was the staff.  They were helpful and extremely friendly.  I would recommend to anybody going to South Beach to check out the Surfcomber.

My wife and I enjoyed staying here.  The location was great.  All you have to do is walk out the back of the hotel by the pool and you're on the beach.  5 p.m. daily wine happy hour was great.  Service was great.  Everyone was attentive.  A special shout out to Chris and the poolside crew for being very attentive.  You're also only one block away from Lincoln Road and all the stores and restaurants that you can imagine.  It was our first time staying in Miami Beach and we definitely look forward to going back and staying here.

Great staff, especially Chris and the poolside staff! They take care to make your stay very relaxing and comfortable. This hotel has great service all around and the 5:00 daily wine hour is a nice bonus! It is in a great location and walking distance to Lincoln Road and Ocean Drive. I would highly recommend staying at the Surfcomber.

Location is on the beach with a nice pool area. Getting chairs at the pool was no problem. Pool service and food poolside was very good. DJ Music was everpresent and not too loud. Join Kimpton's InTouch rewards program for small amenities. Hotel is only 3 stories. Room/bathroom was small, as is typical of South Beach hotels, with upgraded decor. Beds are comfortable. No noise problems with our courtyard facing room.  Valet parking is expensive but public garages are two blocks away. Front desk service was competent and the entertainment manager, Chris, was very personable and everpresent. Free wine offered nightly. Cuban sandwich in the restaurant was good. They made a mistake entering our food order but made up for it with free drinks.

Everything is close by from the nightlife to a day filled with shopping. I cant wait to come back soon to Surfcomber.

This is a great hotel for its size and location.  The Kimpton brand has a high reputation for service and it shows the moment you step inside. Their lobby is very open and inviting; you actually enjoy sitting here having one of their outstanding cocktails from Chad or Ricky.  Speaking of libations, order The Eighth Day - fantastic drink!  Atmosphere is laid back and the staff always cater to your needs.  I highly recommend staying here on the off-season. Location cannot be beat - a block away from Lincoln Mall (outside mall) and several blocks from the strip.  You will have no problem walking/riding in South Beach.

This is a great hotel.  The bellmen, Dorgis Delgado is very sincere, courteous and professional, as well as his colleague Erick.  Great hotel & great people who work there, especially Dorgis & Erick.  We obtained this hotel through SWA Vacations.  I'm glad that we went here and we will be returning as soon as possible.

I had so much fun in Miami Beach!  The stay at the Surfcomber was excellent!  The room was unique and the service was the best; everyone was friendly.  This hotel added greatly to my overall experience in Miami.

10 of us stayed at this South Beach Hotel for a Bachelorette Party in May.  They have done a decent job upgrading an older hotel and service was great, but for the amount we paid to stay there, it was disapointing to be woken up early each morning to hear people talking in the hallway, kids running and laughing, just a lot of noise through the thin walls.  The service at the pool was average at best and the food was not great but also not terrible.  If you are looking for the whole South Beach pool scene, there are better places to find it.  All that being said, the location was great, it has beach access and the bar inside was very nice.  Like i said, nothing special, but if you find a great deal or something, go for it.

The Surcomber in Miami is a fantastic little hotel located right in the heart of South Beach. It's staff are friendly and welcoming and you are always guaranteed a smiley face when you go to enter the hotel. The check in a d out experience is good, with no fuss or nonsense, just good efficient service. The rooms are well set out a d very comfortable. The pool area is excellent and not overcrowded as the hotel is one of the smaller hotels in the area.  Overall this was a great experience and we will certainly be visiting the Surfcomber again in the future.

Loved this place. The staff really goes above and beyond to make you feel at home. My dog was treated like royalty they brought him a bed and he was greeted by name everywhere he went. My children were given cute goodie bags upon arrival and when my son tripped they tended to him and treated his "wounds". The location is perfect, you walk right out onto the strip. Will definitely recommend this place!

Perfect location with nice pool and beach access.  Walk to everything.  Service was great, esp at the pool (thanks, Chris!). Ice cold water available 24/7 is a big plus in the heat.  Bathroom is small, but was not a problem for two people.  Only downside was the beds - too hard for our taste.  Pillowtop mattress cover and upgraded linens would make this a 5 star.

I live on south beach and dropped by for a quick drink and a snack at social club..  I was on my way out on the town so I was not sure what to get. i eventually ordered the scallops and a drink called "28 days later" recommended by Richard.  Both were AMAZING.  Richard was so nice and helpful. His patience and demeanor made me feel so welcome I decided to stay for a second drink..  I wish social Club was open late night because I would not have left..  I met Serena the manager and had to tell her how great a time I had..  The drinks, food, and  ESP Richard's customer service will keep me coming back for more! :)

This was our second time at a Kimpton Hotel, and we were as impressed with this one as the last. The staff are friendly and very helpful, and the service wonderful. Yes, the bathroom is a little small, but every other thing cancels out this one negative. We travel a lot, and when a hotel offers complimentary coffee and wine, it really makes them stand out from the rest. We stay at a lot of high end hotels, but sometimes get fed up with paying for EVERY little thing, so this makes Kimpton a refreshing change from some others. Definitely had a wonderful time, and would definitely recommend.

We love Kimpton!  This hotel is in a very central location in South Beach.  It was great to relax by the pool or walk right out the back gate and be on the beach!  The hotel had chairs that you could reserve and use on the beach.  The rooms were small but nice and most of them either had a view of the courtyard or another hotel.  The staff of this hotel were awesome!  The valets were extremely helpful and the front desk staff were accommodating and welcoming.  Of course, we love the evening wine hour.  We would definitely staff here again.

My wife and kids had a great stay at the Surfcomber. From check-in to check-out the staff works really hard to provide the customer with the best possible experience. I was not able to go but worked together with Michelle and Chris to have a surprise ready for my kids: everything (and more) had been taken care of to perfection. Combine great service with a great location on the beach and you know you will not regret staying at the Surfcomber. Just hope next time I will be able to come along ...

I recently spent a week at the Surfcomber with my 16 year old niece as a celebratory birthday gift.  Right from the get go, it was perfect.  Michelle and David and the front desk team were brilliant in providing some advice on activities, but also in organising our room with a birthday surprise for my niece.  The hotel is very funky and fresh and has wonderful beach front access.  All of the staff were brilliant and our meal options top notch.  The hotel is in a great location within walking distance to the Lincoln Street mall, water sports, and numerous restaurants.

We booked 1 night via a Hotwire so we did not know which hotel we would get. We were quite very happy about the selection. The Hotel ist located very close to the beach, with a nice pool and access to the beach right after the hotel premises. The staff was very friendly and also the valet parking worked well with a pricing which was ok for Miami Beach.  The room was quite small, but very nice and clean. They had some intersting activities, e.g. a "wine testing" where we had sangria for free.

the hotel was just as pretty when we arrived as it was on line, what a great place to relax and have fun.  we were celebrating our 10th annual getaway and this was the perfect place.  the  staff was amazing and Tony, Chris and Foxy were all so professional and friendly we will visit again.  lots of band for the money we spent.  the wine reception every night was so nice.  imagine arriving back to the hotel after a long day and getting complimentary wine.  :) perfect location for young and old

After staying in a dowtown Miami hotel on business during the week I decided to extend my stay for the weekend and move to the Surfcomber at Miami beach. Excellent choice. Very well located at Miami beach, close to the corner of Collins and Lincoln Road. The swimming pool and beach areas are very nice and not crowded and most importantly, the service is great and typical of Kimpton, with staff making sure you have a great experience. Rooms are comfortable, spacious but not luxurious. I would definitively recommend it.

I had a one night stay here at the Surfcomber, the staff, specifically Jackie were all excellent, helpful, and friendly! Room- large enough for me, I didn't quite like the half shower door, but who cares when the water is feeling good! The pool area was nice; I wished it was attended to alittle later than 6pm though, possibly 9 for maximum pleasure, or open up earlier. Us one day travelers would like to enjoy ALL the amenities offered!  I LOVED all the complimentary items, just as the other reviews stated! My room of choice again would be 312 lol! I'd definitely return again if I get another great rate! It's close to everything, and I enjoyed the vibe! Kudos!

What can you say about the SC, well quite a bit, since Ryan and Chris are on the scene the place has stepped it up ( it shows from check in to the whole vibe).. This is the place to hang in SB.. the staff truly make the scene and take care of you as return vips, not guests.  Stella loves her room and wanted to say wow.... getting better every stay Cheers.. coming back in September!  Tom and Stella McDermott

We had one night to spend in Miami Beach, so we decided to return to the Surfcomber.  This recently updated art deco hotel is on the beach, close to Lincoln Road and Beach Drive, with friendly staff and great service.  The daily, free late afternoon wine bar is a great start to an evening of fun.  The lobby bar is a wonderful place to wind down after an evening out.  The room was clean and the staff responsive to the few requests we had.  You can enjoy breakfast outside near the pool or inside if the temp and humidity are too much.

Intimate hotel with great personal service in the heart of South Beach.  The little extras make this place.  Beach and pool were flawless.  Food and drink were expensive.  Slight delay in checking out as a result of billing errors.  Rooms were clean and linens were excellent.  Walls were thin and sound traveled.

Very good boutique hotel, perfectly located on the beach and just 3 min walk to the Lincoln road mall. Ocean Drive is 10 min walk. Friendly staff, very kind and very helpful to meet all your needs. Their dressing code is cozy and cool. Fantastc pool, not crowded at all but a bit noisy for the very loud music coming from the SLS hotel which is the next one. They start disco music at noon and don't stop until 2 am. For this reason, if you ant to sleep at night, I suggest to ask for a room on the North side of the hotel Overall, we had a very pleasant stay, very good and tasty food at the restaurant.

On a scale of 1-10 the service was an 11. Complimentary champagne for my friends birthday along with a card signed by the staff. From the pool boy the the managers they were more than friendly and helpful. Made our group feel like we were the only guests in the place. Pool was beautiful and just a hop across to the Beach. This Place has found a lifelong customer. Amazing only begins to describe my experience. Thank you

We stayed two days on our way to Anguilla and it was the perfect starting point to our vacation, we should of stayed longer. The room was comfortable and relaxing after a fun night out in wild south beach. No need for a car, everything was in walking distance, great restaurants, entertainment and beaches. The pool was fantastic and relaxing. The service was the best I have seen in a long time. They made us feel so welcome like we were the only guest in the hotel, they preformed above and beyond their duties. Now I have a great reason to go back south beach more often. Thanks again for the memorable time, it made my wife's 50th so much better. Tim & Mary Palko

Took a few days off after business trip to Miami.  Surfcomber has a comfortable/at home feeling, rooms are a good size, pool is perfect - you have room to move around and never feel crowded, direct access to the beach and a great location in South Beach.  Would recommend to everyone!

column3: Intimate hotel with great personal service in the heart of South Beach.  The little extras make this place.  Beach and pool were flawless.  Food and drink were expensive.  Slight delay in checking out as a result of billing errors.  Rooms were clean and linens were excellent.  Walls were thin and sound traveled.

Very good boutique hotel, perfectly located on the beach and just 3 min walk to the Lincoln road mall. Ocean Drive is 10 min walk. Friendly staff, very kind and very helpful to meet all your needs. Their dressing code is cozy and cool. Fantastc pool, not crowded at all but a bit noisy for the very loud music coming from the SLS hotel which is the next one. They start disco music at noon and don't stop until 2 am. For this reason, if you ant to sleep at night, I suggest to ask for a room on the North side of the hotel Overall, we had a very pleasant stay, very good and tasty food at the restaurant.

On a scale of 1-10 the service was an 11. Complimentary champagne for my friends birthday along with a card signed by the staff. From the pool boy the the managers they were more than friendly and helpful. Made our group feel like we were the only guests in the place. Pool was beautiful and just a hop across to the Beach. This Place has found a lifelong customer. Amazing only begins to describe my experience. Thank you

We stayed two days on our way to Anguilla and it was the perfect starting point to our vacation, we should of stayed longer. The pool was fantastic and relaxing. The service was the best I have seen in a long time. They made us feel so welcome like we were the only guest in the hotel, they preformed above and beyond their duties. Now I have a great reason to go back south beach more often. Thanks again for the memorable time, it made my wife's 50th so much better. Tim & Mary Palko

We stayed for five nights in late April and early May. The location is great to explore from 24th Street to 14th Street on foot and Downtown and the airport are a short cab ride away. Shopping is handy in Lincoln Road and the nearby area includes numerous quality restaurants and bars. The staff is helpful, friendly, and very knowledgeable. The restaurant offers good quality dishes and the bar has a great menu. The pool area offers cosy corners to chill and the beach access is conveniently located right behind the pool. The hotel's beach facilities are also very nice. Make sure you get to know about and make the most of the resort facilities once you check in.

This hotel was amazing! It is gorgeous, clean, well kept, great location but most importantly the people are outstanding!  Every single person greets you with a smile and a hello.  Ryan at the reception desk greeted me with a big smile, answered all my questions, and made me feel welcome.  The doormen will open the doors for you and run to get a cab open the cab door and close it for you.  Pool boys Jonathan, Eric and Marco were amazing!  Very friendly set up our towels brought us water and chatted with us.  I would definitely recommend this hotel great service for a reasonable price.

My girlfriend and I spent a long weekend at the Surfcomber this past Friday and checking out on Monday. Our stay could not have been any better. From the minute we arrived Late Monday morning, we were able to check in early, as our room was ready for us. Your front desk staff, greeters, pool side attendants were absolutely fantastic to deal with and chat with. We did not want to leave last night and will definitely stay at the Surfcomber again next time we visit South Beach. It was a true pleasure meeting all of your employees. Regards, Mary Higgins and John Weeks

Pleasantly surprised by The Surfcomber in South Beach. The prices are a little high, but it's Miami so to be expected. Jonathan and Eric by the pool were FANTASTIC.  So friendly and helpful. Would definitely stay here again.

Loved our stay here in February! Weather was perfect and so was the service! Drinks served right to our beach and pool loungers. This place is very pricey but worth it if looking for a quick luxury getaway.

The decor is very fun, too, and the location is unbeatable. The staff is excellent, and Amanda at the front desk was super helpful.  Join Kimpton's 'In Touch' reward program and get 'Raid the Minibar' privileges, free wifi and newspaper.

From the moment I stepped out of the car, to the moment that I departed, there was always someone nearby to lend a hand.  The customer service is amazing.  Many other hotels and businesses should learn from this incredible example.  A hugh smile and plenty of "spot on" advice came from Jackie at the front desk and after changing and going to the pool, I was greeted by pool attendents Chris and Jonathan. They immediately set up the chairs every morning with a smile and came by often to make sure that we had anything that we might need. In the evening, we took a short walk to Lincoln Road for dinner and some great shopping.  There is no doubt that there will be a return trip!

We love this hotel! It IS Miami and embodies the spirit of the beach...the staff our extremely friendly and very helpful. We love the art deco design and style. We love the pet friendly policy...this in itself speak to the relaxed atmosphere at the hotel. The pool is awesome and the beach is a few yards away. What more could you want. The food at LanToa restaurant is very good. It reminds us of Singapore, where we lived for 20 years. We have been going to Miami regularly for the past few years and this is our fav beach hotel. We will be back.

We stayed at this hotel for three nights and had a great time relaxing in the Florida sun. From the moment we arrived, we felt looked after in a way that only a boutique hotel can make you feel.  The wine hour was a welcome surprise and the pool was great with the staff ever ready to help you with towels.  The hotel has access to the beach front and is close to Lincoln Road and a host of good bars and restaurants.  A special mention for Dorgis who couldn't have been more helpful. There might be swankier hotels in South Beach but I doubt that there is anywhere offering a more friendly welcome. We will definitely return in the future.

My husband and I and our 2 standard poodles stayed at surfcomber for a night to celebrate our anniversery. The staff went above and beyond to make our stay wonderful. The pups were treated like celebrites and welcome by all.  A special shout out to David who made our resevations to Luz at the frontdesk they couldn't do enough. From the minute we arrived the door/bellmen and valets were also very welcoming.  The entire hotel staff was friendly and welcoming.The location was great , almost everything was in walking distance.  Great hotel people and pets. Stay here if you want to be in the heart of south beach.

My husband and I stayed for two nights before our cruise.  The hotel was in a great location.  It was beautiful inside and outside.  The staff were very welcoming.  We had an ocean front room with a balcony.  It was clean and comfortable.  The pool and beach were awesome.  Everything about the hotel was great.  Ben the Concierge even sent a bottle of prosecco, balloons and cupcakes to our room to celebrate my husband's birthday.  My only complaint - and it has nothing to do with the Surfcomber -was the constant thumping music from the SLS hotel that went on until 2 a.m., very difficult to sleep and then their fire alarm went off at 3 a.m.

We stayed at this amazing hotel in South Beach, Miami for two nights. The one bedroom room we were staying in was warm and the decor was nice. We had a beautiful view of palm trees and ocean! The staff was outstanding, they were friendly, considerate and helpful. Location of the hotel was perfect. It was just north of Lincoln Road Mall and all the shopping and restaurants. This hotel exceeded our expectations and we hope to return here again.

From the time I booked until we left the Kimpton Surfcomber was a class act! We asked for an early checkin and although they were not sure if it would be possible we were accommodated very early. The wine hour was very nice. Join the Kimpton group website and get free internet during your stay. Perfect wake up call at 4:00 am and taxi waiting for our ride to the airport. The next door hotel was a party scene all day and night, which was NOT what we wanted, so for our stay the Surfcomber was perfect calm and quiet. Front desk was very friendly. Beach employees were excellent. Continental Breakfast was just enough and included in our package.

The cleaning of the Room is poor or only focus on arranging the bed clothes.  I took twice the breakfast in the room and when I arrived late in the evening the tray with breakfast from morning was still there. No one picked it up.  Cleaning of bathroom is not great either.  Carpet is not clean during your stay with the vacuum cleaner as I would expect for the type of rate I paid for.

I attended an event here and it left much to be desired. No signs indicating location of event in lobby or out near pool. One of two bars dedicated but you had to climb over the people at the pool to get there and walk in the sand with heels. Inside restaurant food was not hot; however, the inside venue was so hot people left before the cake was cut. Lobby quite stark but staff was lovely and polite but could really carel ess or they would have called the GM on duty to hear my complaints. Never took my phone number and name. Location of this hotel is everything so make sure that you get a good room. Day rate pool/beach cabanas available to rent which is a good thing now that the "season" is over. Negotiate.

By far the best customer service I have ever encountered at a hotel, all staff was very nice and helpful constantly greeting you with a hello even when passing by.  The decor and cleanliness of the hotel was impeccable (and I am very picky) even down to the bed sheets.  The location and proximity to the beach -amazing! My only concern which I refuse to account into my star rating because the hotel has no control over is the size of the rooms, we stayed in a deluxe king and between the size of the room itself and the bathroom it reminded me of a cruise ship stateroom.  However I am sure other rooms are larger not to deter ANY one because this is one fantastic hotel and we will return!

There are some good but some very bad points about this hotel. First the good.... Great location for beach nice touches like free wine around the pool and staff generally helpful. Now the bad.......the outer rooms are very very noisy, if you are unlucky enough to br allocated a room on the outer section of the hotel you will not sleep a wink all night every night as the hotel next door clears all their rubbish and bottles all night long near the outer rooms, there will be coming and going all night long then the rubbish van will then arrive in the early hours to continue the noise. I would not stay at this hotel again because of this reason.

This hotel was very nice all around (as i find most Kimpton hotels to be.) I have no complains which is often the case.   The room was nice and clean. The lounge was busy but accommodating and the food they served was excellent. The poos was busy and charming, the pool help was helpful, and the drinks were very well mixed.   The front desk help was also top notch. They checked us in early and allowed for late check out. The luggage was tagged and taken promptly and there was always someone happy to hail a cab. It was right on the beach.

I highly recommend Surfcomber in Miami Beach. It's location is wonderful for leisurely walks to a myriad a fabulous restaurants and venues in South Beach. The hotel is warm and most welcoming. I thoroughly enjoyed my stay there and would go back there the next time I find myself in Miami.

We have really appreciate the atmosphere in the Surfcomber Hotel : warm, open, friendly, artistic, smiling ... Even the location is great : on the beach (no road to cross with children), walking distance from Lincoln Road and Espanola Way. We had some problems with the very tiny rooms (impossible with 2 childrens) and bathroom and the services in the room (always late). On the other hand everything is close in the Surfcomber : the heated pool (heaven for children), the reception, the beach, the bar. Best expercience the complimentary wine reception (5 to 6 pm) and the pool with complimentary sun cream and water.

Our large group wanted a day at the beach and ocean. We spent the entire day at this fabulous hotel.  We had lounge chairs and towels by the pool as well as two covered cabanas. Maria waited on us and did a fantastic job. The food and service were great. Loved it!

We were a family 4 staying in a deluxe double room for a short visit - 2 adults and two teenagers. The hotel has undergone a modernisation and has a funky feel about it.  I would recommend careful thought before booking as we found it small by US standards  Positive Beach location and within easy walking distance of Ocean Drive and Lincoln, etc. Pleasant pool area and we encountered no problems securing chairs. Pool staff and front of desk were very warm   Negative Delux Room is too small for family of four. One small rail and 4 drawers was the only storage. We had to put some cases into storage to make floor space. Bathroom was tiny and air condition unit noisy .  External noise from outside and other rooms.

I stayed for the first time at the Surfcomber in February 2012, and returned there for the weekend of April 5 - 7, 2013.  The property is in great condition and the location -- with its own access to the beach and proximity to Lincoln Road -- is unbeatable.  Ambience is stylish and fun.  Friendly and responsive staff, as always at Kimpton hotels.  Breakfast on Lantao's sunny terrace was a pleasure, and the poolside staff effectively manage the heavy demand for lounge chairs and towels.  The Surfcomber is not the cheapest hotel in South Beach, but unlike many of its competitors, it provides the kind of quality aimed at encourging repeat visits.

we were delighted by our 2 night stay in April. Stayed during spring break.  The hotel was great.  They had a music party going on at the hotel.  They were very organized, had plenty of security and the loud music didn't bother us late at night.  The location to the beach can't be beat.  The location alone is worth the price.  The room was on the small size so know this before you book.  We were also close to really nice restaurants and shopping.  I would stay here again.  They didn't have a coffee maker in the room but we called the front desk and they quickly brought a very nice coffee maker to our room.  Beds were comfortable.  Front desk staff very nice and professional.

Not sure what hotel some of these other reviews are for, but the one I stayed at was clean, comfortable and pretty helpful staff.  Good location to beach, and art deco district. My only knock is the quality at the Lantao restaurant for breakfast was not right for the price. I don't mind an expensive breakfast but the food needs  to be up to the price level.

This beautiful, fully renovated property is amazing from the rooms to the lounge. As always Kimpton's hospitality is unmatched. This was a Double Tree property, which was letting the property go but now it has been revived as one of the premier Art Deco Hotels. Located right on the ocean and one of the few properties with a double lot, with cabanas and cabana balconies on  both sides of pool. The food is nothing like you will find in Miami. It was refreshing to get a break from the same old same old that Miami restaurants put out. I highly recommend this hotel.

My hub and I spent five nights here Christmas 2012. It had been renovated in the past year or so. Any glitches were taken care of expediently and graciously by management. Our room/bath were immaculate, and the grounds were pleasant and well-maintained. It's a fun little boutique hotel with a beautiful, broad beach.

This was a Double Tree property, which was letting the property go but now it has been revived as one of the premier Art Deco Hotels. Located right on the ocean and one of the few properties with a double lot, with cabanas and cabana balconies on  both sides of pool. The food is nothing like you will find in Miami. It was refreshing to get a break from the same old same old that Miami restaurants put out. I highly recommend this hotel.

I would have given this hotel a five star if it wasn't for a huge disappointment we just had. But I did learn something: "I will always call a hotel ahead of booking a reservation to see if there are any special events that may impact our stay".  I picked this hotel for it access to the beach and its pool.  Upon checking in with our daughter (19 yrs) we were told that the pool area and access through that area to the beach would be closed to anyone under 21 years old for a 3 day music party (11am to 11 pm). We had to walk around the block to the beach and when we asked we were told that we could use another hotels pool down the block (huh - I wonder how that would look walking down the street in my robe - Ha - not pretty)!

We were here for a 2 night stay in January prior to a cruise.  Picked this hotel based on reviews and location.  Room was fairly small, but nice and the staff at check in were incredibly pleasant.  Good location for south beach amenities - loads of places to eat in the surrounding area.  Pool area was nice and enjoyed the "wine hour" which actually also offered lovely cider which we both enjoyed.  Was quite expensive to stay here but seemed to be standard for south beach to be honest.  Would most likely stay here again should we go back to miami

OK - so its not the Fontainbleau, or the Ritz, BUT its a clean property that usually runs about half the cost of SoBe's finest.  The pool is fun, the walk to the beach is short, and yes, it boasts Kimpton's free wine hour! Hey - that never hurts.  Rooms were a little small, but we didn't care we were never in it!  The pool area is nice and very convenient to the beach. Just a short walk across the boardwalk.  So, when looking for a fun stay in SoBe, the Surfcomber is a great choice and will help save some extra cash for out on the town.

Hotel backs on to the beach and is a short walk to Ocean Drive. Friendly and helpful staff. Very nice pool area although the banging tunes being played at uber-chic SLS hotel next door can get a bit much.  Small rooms but very clean.  Highly recommended.

This hotel was the best experience I have ever had. The staff treats each guest as if they are a celebrity. I really felt as if the staff loved their jobs and truly cared about people. The atmosphere was most relaxing and tropical. I cannot wait to return.  We are at their two restaurants every day for our entire stay... It was that delicious.

5 stars for the best service in SoBe. From the start, at check-in, the service was wonderful.  We were greeted at the door by no less than 3 employees all of whom were eager to assist with our bags and valet parking.   At the check-in desk, the staff was exceptionally professional and friendly. The team here at the hotel are just amazing.  It was our honey-moon, we were welcomed with greeting card, free champagne and great dessert.  Absolutely great experience, resort atmosphere in the heart of south beach, great pool service comfortable close to everything, 3 blocks to Lincoln road, same to ocean drive.  Awesome new renovations, great new rooms, heavenly comfortable beds,  Also free wine from 5-6 : )  Afterall we extended our stay for 3 nights more than we originally planned !

This place was fantastic! It is a very small SOBE hotel.  The service, location and pool is great!  The only downside is that the rooms are a little small, but you don't spend much time in them anyway. It was perfect for a relaxing girls weekend.  Plus, they have a nightly wine happy hour that is great.

Really enjoyed our 4 days here. Tasteful rooms, a great location, and the staff are really helpful and friendly.    My only average grade would be on the restaurant which we only ate breakfast at, but with so many dining options close by, it's not a big deal.  Our room was on the street side which can be a little noisy on weekends, but hey, you aren't in South Beach for quietness!  Weill definitely stay here on our next visit to South Beach.....

With direct access to the beach, a nice location. A few blocks north of the main action on Ocean Drive, staff is thoughtful and very good. The rooms are smallish. I'm growing weary of hotel rooms with only the bed or a desk chair for seating.   The bathroom is small. Biggest problems with 355 were the thermostat and the shower. No matter what setting, the room stayed at 61 degrees. Cold. Like the air, water in the shower was reluctant to get hot. And note to all hoteliers: when the shower head starts to spit and sputter due to age, replace it.   Lastly, it's a Kimpton property. Quirky. Watch out for the farm animals and livestock.

Great location for south beach. Walking distance to all of the of the hot spots in south beach. Front desk staff was great and helpful on finding new areas to explore. Room was good but the wash room was a bit small. Spend 8 hours siting in the beach with friends, the hotel offers food and drinks in the beach, the bill was extremely high but worth it.

On our way home from the Caribbean, we had 24 hours in Miami and as a member of Kimpton's InTouch program, I opted to stay at this property. Everyone we encountered was welcoming, pleasant and genuinely interested in ensuring we had a great experience.   While the room was a bit small, it did have great amenities, including the best minibar options of any hotel chain I know! The bed was immensely comfortable and we really enjoyed wandering around the hotel as well.  We dined at the hotel twice and enjoyed both meals. The service was top notch and hanging out by the pool made us wish we had more time to be there!

Great location center of South Beach... Staff was great we went down to see a concert and the helped with transporation to AAA and back. Room was perfect. Next day the pool was very relaxing and we could walk to all the resturants and shopping and of course the beach.

In the future I would also check if there is a kimpton hotel in the city I am traveling to and stay there!  I love that they are pet-friendly but are very clean and don't smell of pets at all!

We stayed overnight on our way back from the Keys, and have stayed in South Beach a number of times.  Really nice hotel - beachfront with a nice pool.  Room was nice, and service was good.  The only big disappointment was the onsite Asian restaurant, Lantao.  The food was not good overall, except for the Hamachi appetizer.  DO NOT EAT HERE -  if they are smart, the management will ditch the Pan Asian fare, and switch to straight sushi only or come up with a new concept!  But we are "In Touch" members, and would stay here again.  Next time we'll just be sure to walk down to one of the Lincoln Road eateries.

We are people from Belgium and for us (europe)these kind of prices for a room are exceptionnal...but indeed this is South Beach and I must confirm previous reviews...Super hotel...cozy and romantic hotel...3 floors...and the best attraction of this hotel is the pool !!.. Whawwww I never saw such a great service at the pool ...we took also lunch at the pool...Bryan and Ryan where also very kind...and the most important of all ...the quality for sleeping is very high..we took a room near the garden and that was top...i find the room not small..just great enough...so guys don't hesitate and book a room in this cozy and sexy hotel(the pool girls are very sexy :))))

We stayed at the Surfcomber recently while attending the South Beach Wine and Food Festival.  The location was great...we were on the north end of the SOBE WFF beach activities.  This hotel fits the bill of being a boutique hotel...the front desk staff was very accommodating and helpful; the pool was awesome; access to the beach was great; since it was a boutique style hotel, our room was the size of a typical European room...a little on the small size, but still fine for a vacation room.

I have to say this is one of the best hotels I stayed in, in terms of service.  The hotel was nice but the service was great. Great location: one block from Lincoln Road and right on the beach - super path for biking, hiking, walking. Exceptional staff: Brian and Jonathan at the pool for all your needs; Andrew, Valerie, Michi, and Ben (concierge) smiling and accommodating. Lucien, Naomil, and Chris ready to give exemplary room service.  Highly recommend for singles, couples, and family. Try it - you will love it.

Fabulous stay from start to end. Staff very friendly and welcoming. Facility well maintained and a beautiful beachside location with a lovely pool area. Had breakfast in the room, lunch by the beach and free wine by the pool. A great place to go and unwind. Thank you!

Just returned from a business meeting I held at the Surfcomber. It was an excellent hotel! James and Nicole, both of whom I worked with for the planning of the meeting and while on site provided excellent customer service! Everyone that worked there made every attempt to make you feel special. The wine hour by the pool made the last part of the afternoon nice as well. I would highly recommend this place and will definitely go back!

Recently spent three nights at this hotel. I'm a fan of Kimpton hotels (having stayed at other locations in San Francisco and NYC) and this one did not disapoint. The service was extraordinary...everyone that works there is very friendly and helpful. The location is super central (a couple blocks from Lincoln). The lobby is really nice (great design elements) and the pool & beach are great. Lots of nice little extras like complimentary wine hour and mimosas on the beach!

We went to Miami for my birthday. Not only was the hotel amazing, the staff was the friendliest staff I have ever met at a hotel. No matter who we passed in the hallway, they always said hi... We were greeted with "Welcome Back" when we came back in from a night out. The location was perfect with direct beach access and a short walk to Lincoln Road. The bartenders were a joy to talk to and were creative in coming up with new drinks for my friend and I. Even when our trip was extended due to the Blizzard back home the Surfcomber was incredibly understanding and we were able to enjoy an extra two days in the Miami sun! I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Miami and I can't wait to go back myself!!

Rooms are small but well appointed and immaculate.  Great ocean view from the balcony and delicious and hot coffee via room service...withing three minutes after the call.  Who could ask for more?  Well...maybe Grey Goose Orange Vodka at the bar...I will definitely make it my port-of-call for my next trip.

The rooms are small but clean and the bathroom was tiny by modern standards but the Hotel is old and that is to be expected.  It was clearly refurbished a couple years ago and has been well maintained by the Kimpton company.  The front desk staff is very helpful and friendly. The pool area is also very attractive and the beach is right across a walkway behind it.  My only complaint (and I do know this is south beach) was the cost of food and drink.  If your going to charge basically 20 bucks for a gyro wrap make it a good one.  The food was way over priced and at least at the pool of poor quality.
