After staying in Miami beach at the Delano, Loews, we have found very nice reviews via Tripadvisor for the Surfcomber and reserved the hotel for three nights. We have experienced a warm welcome and a persanolized atmosphere. Rooms are clean with good beds If you want to spoil yourself a bit, please go for the beach view and balcony:-)  What we have found very nice of this hotel was the stuff they organize for their visitors like the complimentary wine hour each day, the drinks passport and the good service around the pool. A small addition, depending on your specific mood of that day, is that most visitors are not of the "showing of" kind. Keeps it all very decent.

I really enjoyed my stay at the Surfcomber. The staff were really friendly and attentive. The rooms were  clean and functional and the decor is fabulous and what you would want in a South Beach hotel. The location is great, only a short walk from restaurants, shopping and clubs. It has direct access to the beach where cocktails are served to you on your banana lounge. The free wine hour was a great way to meet others staying in the hotel - also the staff were very knowledgeable about the wine that was being offered.

My husband and I chose to spend a little time somewhere beautiful and calm before our first child is born, and this was a perfect choice.   Ryan at the front desk and Jonathan at the pool were only two of the many staff who made our short stay as wonderful as it was.  We loved the nightly wine hour (though I didn't get to partake much of that), the roaming sheep and cow sculptures, and the elegant but relaxed atmosphere.  The rooms are small but kept clean and lovely.  I very much want to stay there again.

Was here for work, so I didn't choose the hotel.  It's an older property, built in 1947 but has been updated.  The lobby and pool area are very nice.  The elevator was the smallest I'd ever seen, 3 people each with one carry on bag seemed crowded.  Room was small but nicely appointed.  Mini bar was super stocked if you use it (we didn't).  Nice bathroom amenities.  Not a place I would personally book but I'm sure the price is average for the area.  Easy walk to several restaurants and shops. Kept hearing loud noises during the night, like the a/c.  Our view was of the wall of  hotel next door.

Chose this hotel because of its great reviews on Tripadvisor. Reviews were definitely accurate - we loved our stay here. We were only here for 1 night, but I wish it was longer.  Loved the decor of the lobby; really funky and quirky. There is infused water in the lobby, apples to munch on, and social activities in the evening - complimentary wine and hot chocolate by the pool. The pool was large and gorgeous with plenty of beach chairs. There were also bikes available to rent and ride on the beach pathway right behind the pool.   Location of the hotel was perfect - right near the middle of all the action, only metres away from the beach.All the staff, from the bellhop to the concierge and front desk staff were really friendly and super helpful. Will definitely be back!!

I really enjoyed my stay at the Surfcomber...the customer service was excellent, the perks were great (nightly wine hour) and the hotel had a relaxed but sophisticated and modern vibe! Central location was also an added bonus. Loved the pool and easy access to the beach. Very relaxing, yet fun time! I will definitely stay with Kimpton again!!!

The Surfcomber is a fabulous hotel.  The hotel lobby is beautifully furnished, room decor is very cool,beds are super comfortable, staff is warm and helpful, location is great (on the ocean with easy beach access), heated pool is gorgeous, and the food and drink are excellent.  We enjoyed a fun and informative bike tour of South Beach with Chris (who also offers walking tours and other activities for guests) and loved hanging out at the pool. Other nice amenities are:  complimentary coffee in morning, hot chocolate at night, wine in the evening.  I can't emphasize enough how friendly and accommodating the staff are.  Great choice for South Beach. Highly recommended.

Great location, lovely pool and beach access.  The bus from the airport basically drops you right at the corner of the hotel.  The staff there were so kind to provide us with water, rice krispy pops and a bottle of wine when they knew we were there for a bachelorette!  We also enjoyed the complimentary tea/coffee in the morning, and hot chocolate at night.  Rooms are small, but I think that is the norm at any hotel at Miami Beach.  Would definitely stay here again!

column3: Chose this hotel because of its great reviews on Tripadvisor. Reviews were definitely accurate - we loved our stay here. We were only here for 1 night, but I wish it was longer.  Loved the decor of the lobby; really funky and quirky. There is infused water in the lobby, apples to munch on, and social activities in the evening - complimentary wine and hot chocolate by the pool. The pool was large and gorgeous with plenty of beach chairs. There were also bikes available to rent and ride on the beach pathway right behind the pool.   Location of the hotel was perfect - right near the middle of all the action, only metres away from the beach.All the staff, from the bellhop to the concierge and front desk staff were really friendly and super helpful. Will definitely be back!!

I really enjoyed my stay at the Surfcomber...the customer service was excellent, the perks were great (nightly wine hour) and the hotel had a relaxed but sophisticated and modern vibe! Central location was also an added bonus. Loved the pool and easy access to the beach. Very relaxing, yet fun time! I will definitely stay with Kimpton again!!!

The Surfcomber is a fabulous hotel.  The hotel lobby is beautifully furnished, room decor is very cool,beds are super comfortable, staff is warm and helpful, location is great (on the ocean with easy beach access), heated pool is gorgeous, and the food and drink are excellent.  We enjoyed a fun and informative bike tour of South Beach with Chris (who also offers walking tours and other activities for guests) and loved hanging out at the pool. Other nice amenities are:  complimentary coffee in morning, hot chocolate at night, wine in the evening.  I can't emphasize enough how friendly and accommodating the staff are.  Great choice for South Beach. Highly recommended.

Great location, lovely pool and beach access.  The bus from the airport basically drops you right at the corner of the hotel.  The staff there were so kind to provide us with water, rice krispy pops and a bottle of wine when they knew we were there for a bachelorette!  We also enjoyed the complimentary tea/coffee in the morning, and hot chocolate at night.  Rooms are small, but I think that is the norm at any hotel at Miami Beach.  Would definitely stay here again!

I truly had a fabulous time at the hotel. Everything was fantastic! I had fish one night at Lantao and it was just superb. I'm still talking about the trip and I intend to be back in the very near future. The staff are top notch and really went out of their way to make my stay memorable.

Great staff!  Chris (?) gave us the BEST advice on restaurants including specific dishes to try or avoid, and gave us an hour and a half VERY entertaining walking tour.  The hotel itself has a 1950's vibe, small rooms, but very well kept, good location.

All South Beach hotels are expensive in the winter. So we stayed here which was less than the other nicer hotels in the neighborhood. Staff was great. Incredibly invested, sweet, and helpful. Location is everything you'd want from SoBe. Pool area was very nice. Room was a tad small but if you're going to SoBe to stay in your room you should see a shrink.

Special shout outs to Jessica, both Michelle's, Tony, Brent at wine hour, John at the pool, the doll at Lantao who tended our cabana, the list goes on and on. This experience reinforces why I love kimpton and working with such awesome people!

Great location right on Collins backing up to beautiful Miami beach. Hotel was nicely appointed, rooms are large with comfy beds, but bathroom is a bit small. Would absolutely stay here again!

...was in search of a quick getaway to Southbeach...the Surfcomber popped up in my internet seach.  The more I read, the more I like.  Live and in person, it blew away my research expectations.  From the friendly greeting and glass of proseco at check-in, the staff bent over backwords, looked you in the eye, and smiled with genuine warmth as they catered to your needs.  Right on the beach.  Awesome pool.  Location, location, location for walking in South Beach.  I highly recommend this property and will look into other Kimpton properties on my next trip.

I would recommend this hotel to my friends. Excellent customer service. They worked hard to make our stay memorable. The amenities are great. The pool area is luxurious. The beach is right out of a picture. The staff was friendly and helpful. Couldn't ask for anything more!

I had a wonderful stay at the Surfcomber from January 8th-10th. It was a really special occasion and the staff did a wonderful job making us feel like the hotel was celebrating with us! Especially BJessica who left a really sweet handwritten note in our room (and who I had the pleasure of meeting during the stay! She was absolutely wonderful!) Brent at Checkin was also extremely sweet and friendly. Everyone smiled and said hi. The hotel itself is also great, the lobby is big and has a lot of places to hang out with a cup of coffee or a cocktail. The pool is great and the location even better. Rooms are on the small side but who wants to stay inside their room at South Beach?! Overall it is a really great hotel and I would definitely recommend it, if not just for the staff!

Hotel is virtually next to Delano where we used to stay. Hotel is good value for money at this location. Service was outstanding ( except for retaurant) and friendly. Nice typical sobe pool area. Room was rather small but appropriate with simple but decor, comfortable but not luxurious ( boutique hotel), perfectly clean. Less stylish than Delano etc but certainly a very pleasant place.

We stayed at this hotel for two nights after a cruise.  The position is great right near Lincoln Road shops and restaurants and right on the beach and the pool area is lovely.  The room was a good size with a nice bathroom.  Problems were that at 3.30pm when we checked in the room was not ready. The parking is $37 a day which we thought was steep. and it was very noisy at night in the hotel and from outside, soundproofing not good.

Lovely hotel with gracious, courteous and welcoming service. An exceptional property run consistently well like other Kimpton hotels. The value and given location is excellent for South Beach.  A very laid back stylish feel, but not trying to be something else like a lot of the other hotels.. A true gem in every way!

I like Kimpton Hotels. The quality is good and the properties are well run. This hotel was not an exception. The downsides are 1) the rooms and especially the shower room ( no bath tub ) are tiny tiny and , 2) a vodka and grapefruit at the lobby bar was $17 ( come on , that's ridiculous ) . With all the places on Collins Ave beachside being $400 plus a night , you can find a place with more spacious rooms and baths . Also the view from our room was of a wall !

Hotel is located directly on beach close to Lincoln road.  Staff were outstanding.  From front lobby to maid service to restaurant to pool staff.  Very warm and welcoming.  Rooms a bit small but didn't spend a lot of time there.  Ate at restaurant for lunch each day. Food very good.  I would definitely return.  Went next door to SLS for drinks one afternoon.  Nice to return to surfcomber's peaceful quiet pool after the club scene.

Short but sweet stay at the surfcomber. Rooms were OK, have had far better for price but this is Miami and location was exceptional. Service was very good, concierge provided a free bike trip which was fun and informative. Pool was busy and beach felt more relaxed. Loungers on beach are payable but the beech was far more relaxed and fun.  We ate out so cannot comment on hotel food but friends who came with us said their food was very good. Outstanding restaurants in area but not on main front, these were a real rip off and quality average at best.  Lincoln road has great places to eat, also best place to shop

I stayed at the Surfcomber on my first trip to South Beach and loved it! Although I found the room small and the sound insulation could be upgraded, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay.  Every member of the staff was very attentive, professional, courteous and extremely helpful.  The attention I received from the concierge, the service staff and the reception staff was first class all the way.  Congratulations to the whole team at Surfcomber (and a special thank you to Andy at the pool)!  I will be back and will try other Kimpton hotels based on this South Beach experience.

Our first visit to Miami Beach was excellent and we could not fault the great location (short walk from beach, shops on Lincoln etc).  However, at over $600/night the quality of the room and facilities did not meet our expectations. The room size was adequate but the shower was too weak and the thin walls meant noisy neighbours regularly woke us up during the night. The 1 cleaner for 20+ rooms also ran out of time to clean our room on one of the days we stayed.

We made last minute reservations, and had few choices amongst the "quality" places on South Beach so we defaulted here and were pleasantly surprised. Outstanding service, great location right on the beach, on Collins, and steps from Lincoln. Pool is great, spacious with some nice amenities. Only slight downside was size of rooms, which were Euro-esque in terms of size. But at least clean, which is most important.

We stayed at the Surfcomber this past weekend. The front desk staff is very good. The valet is awful and for $37 a night that is a deal breaker. The hotel was over $400 a night with out taxes and valet for a small room. The bed is comfortable. But they gave us a horrible room location over looking an air conditioning unit.   They tell you the valet takes 15 minutes so we called down each time before we needed the car each day it was the same issue the lazy employee never called resulting in 20-30 wait for the car.   There are tons of hotels in South Beach and we come to Miami for work about 4 times a year. Unless we had no other choice we would not pick this one again......

What an absolute Gem of a Hotel ! The management and staff should be truly proud of their efforts in providing the best in customer service. From the door men to the hands on management, every single member of staff at this hotel are totally focused on their guest enjoyment and convenience.  Small, personal and friendly are the perfect compliment for this hotel, positioned perfectly on South Beach but within 2mins walking distance of the shops and restaurants of Lincoln Drive.  This hotel has the feel of its more luxurious contemporaries, from its trendy interior decor and subtle touches from the complementary wine hour to the free hot chocolate night time service.  Will definitely return to this gem on the beach..

We are Kimpton loyalists (we have stayed at several of their properties in NYC, Chicago, SF and elsewhere) and we were not disappointed by the Surfcomber. While there are more "luxe" properties in the neighborhood, like the Ritz Carlton or new SLS hotel next door, you won't find a better value if you plan ahead or get a great last-minute deal. (We used the AAA discount.) And the people at the Surfcomber couldn't be nicer. If you want a laid-back, modern, clean, well-located hotel (and are willing to sacrifice a bit on room and bathroom size), the Surfcomber is a great choice.

We can't say enough about how  much we enjoyed our stay at the Surfcomber in South Beach.  The staff, from the doormen, front desk, concierge, cleaning/grounds, restaurant, and pool-side, were all so friendly and helpful!  They made each guest feel truly special and welcomed!  The property itself is beautifully maintained and very welcoming and safe for children.  And the evening wine receptions by the pool were the icing on the cake!

This hotel is right next to the beach and not a scene at all. If you don't want to head over to the beach, the pool area is quiet and relaxing. It's true, the rooms are a bit small, but they are very comfy. Everyone is very polite and helpful. THe coffee in the morning is strong (which is a huge plus for me) and every night there is tasty hot chocolate with marshmallows.  Taking away one star only because there is no type of breakfast. I just stayed at the Surfcomber in South Beach and I was blown away by the amazing staff there. The server at the pool, Maria Cooper was great. She was always helpful and went above and beyond constantly. Since I was traveling alone, she was helpful in recommending things for me to do at night and for dinner. She really made it a great trip for me and was there whenever I needed anything. She is a great representation of the Surfcomber hotel and I will definitely stay there again on my next trip to South Beach.

I just stayed at the Surfcomber and I would like to pay tribute to their concierge Ben.  He has an ability to relate to a wide range of temperaments and age groups. The hotel is in a perfect spot that is beautiful and has activities to meet your needs whether for socializing or for fitness.  I cannot wait to go back again!

Every staff member at the Surfcomber was genuinely friendly and eager to please. Our room was spotless, stylish and comfortable. This hotel is an excellent value and featured luxuries including Frette bathrobes and Etro toiletries. The pool was beautiful and not too crowded, and there was direct access to the beach from the hotel. I would unquestionably stay here again and highly recommend this hotel.

We loved staying here because of the "can do" professional attitude from the staff and the ease of our stay. From the entry people, to the front desk, to the pool/waitress staff, to the hotel fix-it man, we had such pleasant experiences. The beds were VERY comfortable, really great. The room, and bathroom especially, are small but nicely decorated, not my favorite personally but my design school daughter thought it was great. I loved the whimsical touches around the hotel, the sheep and cow life size figures in the lobby and pool area add a silly and homey touch. We loved Maria at the pool, would go back just to have her make me another mojito. Loved the little tastes of frozen grapes or shooters of daiquiris they offered around the pool.

Spent 2 nights at this hotel in December, and it is a very nice boutique hotel, in a great location close to the beach and a lot of great restaurants. The employees go out of their way to make you feel welcome, and are quick to help. The rooms and bathrooms are small but typical for the Miami area. The boardwalk runs right behind the hotel which is great for exercising, and the pool area is nice with the hotel staff constantly replenishing fresh towels for the guests. Lunch at the restaurant was okay, but will say that the breakfast was good, if you don't like asian food you will want to skip.  Will definitely stay here again when I am back in Miami!

I recently stayed at the Surfcomber for a staff retreat with several colleagues. The hotel was very nice, the pool area was beautiful, the rooms were great, the location is good and central, but most of all the service was excellent. From my first email to inquire about a reservation through our last day at the hotel, the staff was friendly, welcoming, proactive, and very helpful. Our entire retreat went off without a hitch. We had our retreat meetings in a conference room with lots of natural sunlight and nice touches, including pitchers of water with slices of orange or lemon in them, which were replenished every few hours.  The entire experience was very enjoyable. The hotel was great for our staff retreat, but would also be a wonderful place to vacation. I'd love to go back!

Went here for my 30th birthday with a few friends, and I have to admit after reading such promising reviews, I had high expectations...and I was blown away.  From the minute we got to the hotel, the staff was impeccably attentive and there was champagne and a nice card signed by the staff in my room waiting for me...Surfcomber made my 30th birthday unforgettable!!  From the amazing food (orange duck noodles were awesome), hosted wine hour, great beach service, Ricky at the Mixology lessons, I honestly would not have changed a thing.  We are actually staying at another Kimpton in Arizona just because of the great experience we had...I hope they live up to the standard that Surfcomber set!  Thanks to all the staff for an amazing trip, and we will definitely be back again!!

I have been to South Beach many times.  I usually stay at a hotel a few times if I like it and then try somewhere new...just because.  Friends told me about the Surfcomber, so it was time for a try.  Everyone on staff was so pleasant and accommodating.  The hotel is low key and very pretty.  Rooms were average size and nicely appointed.  Pool area is so pleasant and relaxing.

Recently stayed for 6 nights.  1st time at a Kimpton, and hopefully not last...very nice hotel; unique style, and good service: thanks to Michie, Vanessa and Ehren for making my stay a pleasant one.  Good location and great beach & pool service.  Rooms are nicely decorated.

My wife and 7 yr old and I stayed for five days in August, and it's hard to imagine a better hotel and beach experience.  Everybody, from the moment you walk in the door, is dedicated to making sure you are getting whatever you need when you need it.  Beach chairs, towels, a cup of coffee, food, whatever you need will be provided and with a smile.  The beach is right there, the pool is perfect for family fun.  Wow.  The food at the restaurant is excellent, with a varied menu.  Never had an experience at a hotel like this.  Never encountered hotel employees like these.  It's true that the rooms are small, and so are the bathrooms; if you need a lot of space this is not the hotel for you. But everything else is five star.  We're coming back as soon as we can.

The Surfcomber is a great hotel in an outstanding location on the beach, in the heart of Miami Beach, near Lincoln Road. The location is the best part of the Surcomber experience. It's a nice hotel on its own but it can't overcome the fact that it's a renovated old hotel. The rooms are small and the walls are thin. The staff are exceptional and the pool area is lovely. We consistently had trouble with the Wi-Fi connection being extremely slow. Overall, the experience was quite good and we would stay here again. There are better, more high-end hotels nearby but the Surfcomber is the better value.

Activities are wonderful.  Decor is stylish yet comfortable.  If you're looking for a hotel in a great location, with good food, want a relaxing experience, and want to avoid the loud boom boom of music at other hotels nearby, this is the hotel to stay at. i stayed at this hotel last year and really enjoyed it, but this year with the new renovations, it is truly spectacular.  the staff are the most attentive and friendly staff of any hotel i have ever stayed at.  the decor is creative and beautiful and interesting to look at. rooms were very comfortable and immaculate.  i highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting miami beach.  (this hotel is also an historic art deco hotel to boot!) , and is right on the ocean.  i could not bring my dogs on the plane and i loved visiting with all the great dogs staying at the hotel.  i love how the hotel welcomes pets.

This was our 2nd annual Thanksgiving trip to the Surfcomber.  We were 9 in our party and we all had a great time!  We alwyas look forward to visting the Sufcomber in South Beach and never get disappointed. The staff is extremely professional and always courteous and kind. We love everyone's smile and the way any questions or requests are treated with true care and dedication. The location is wonderful, the ambiance terrific and the value is great. We spent this Thanksgiving with our family and enjoyed every day of our 5 night stay at the Surfcomber. Great job staff and management. Your attitude and professionalism should be an inspiration for many other hotels. We look forward to seeing you again in the near future.

While the hotel has a good location and updated contemporary decor, the cleanliness and service are lacking. Good luck getting service by the pool. While there are three young employees that are supposed to be tending to the many guests they mostly stand around ignoring them while talking to each other. I guess the local gossip is more important than taking food and drink orders.

Lovely place, nem and stylish bedroms, very confy bed. Awsome helpull and friendly service! Really, been to many great hotel But Never saw nothing quite like it!  On the top of it, the food is great and at honest prices. The location is just perfect,close enougth to enjoy ocean drive and walk to lincoln road, But fat enougth só you can rest. Odorable pool! Great music (relaxing) By the pool. Loved the cows, sheep and the "why not" concept.  Never heard the word "no" here. And Thats a big plus for me.  Must know, dogs welcome, even to rang out By the pool, só if that botters you, be aware.

Fantastic hotel right on the beach and, as we were traveling with our dogs, the only hotel on S. Beach that would take dogs!  Incredibly helpful staff, plenty of activities (including a 'fun run'), and impecably clean rooms.  We were celebrating our anniversary and they brought us wine up to our room after we checked in, which was an awesome gesture.  Also, after the fun run, Michelle and Nick invited my wife and I to join them for breakfast with another couple, which was an excellent time. Right in the heart of the Art Deco district, and about a block away from shops at Lincoln Road.  When we made reservations, we became Kimpton frequent stay program, which I recommend if for nothing else other than free wifi.  I will definately be coming back to this hotel in the future!

I was traveling to Miami on business and learned, with great dismay, that I left my toiletry bag at home. I called downstairs and the Kimpton team were able to replace EVERYTHING in my bag, no extra charge. And they didn't replace things, like my contact solution, with no-name generics. No, they sent up the real deal. Overall, the location and the property are great - but the staff are what makes it truly amazing. Recommended!!

I don't know where to begin.. from the early check in to the personalized accommodation, The Surfcomber Hotel was the best!!  I stayed here for 3 beautiful nights and had an amazing time. Everyone was so friendly, the food was great, rooms were clean, and the ambience was BLISS.    The poolside experience was beautiful and I couldn't have asked for a better birthday trip.  I will definitely make it back there within the next few months.. GREAT JOB!!   I would especially like to acknowledge the concierge and service staff namely Andrew L who attended to my every need with such a warm spirit...  I hope to see him when I return :)

Me and my wife stayed at the Surfcomber for two nights on our wedding anniversary, after a week in Orlando. Our plan was to rest from all the parks and shopping before coming back home. And rest we did! The hotel has a great pool, excellent service and is very well located, very close to great restaurants like Pied a Terre and Casa Tua and a walking distance aways from the northern end of Ocean Drive. Prices are not the best, but it's worth it if you're looking for a nice place to relax in Miami.

I found our experience here so extraordinary that I found ti neccessary to have this be my first trip advisor review.  We arrived at 6 AM and our room was ready. We are going to make an effort to come back here and to stay at as many Kimpton hotels as possible.  I would be shocked to hear a valid complaint about this place!  Nice work Kimpton!

My great experience started as soon as I checked in.  My room was ready at 9:00 am. and the front desk staff was very pleasant. I had just come from another hotel were the staff didn't even acknowledge my presence. I try to stay at Kimpton Hotels whenever possible as I enjoy their funky ambience.  The room was nicely decorated and comfortable and I thought the "blinds" were very South Beach.  The pool area was beautiful and the staff very attentive.  Customer service was the best.

Amazing customer service.  Everyone at the hotel was so nice and helpful.  Jessica at the front desk was great, even though she's a Gator fan.   I booked this hotel after reading the great reviews on TripAdvisor, and the reviews were spot-on. The rooms were very nice and the bed was comfy.  We even had a live goldfish in our room.  The food at Lantao is awesome.  The pool area is very nice.  Very easy access to the beach, where you can rent an umbrella and chairs.  They also offer drink service on the beach if you are renting a chair, which was nice.  Great location near Lincoln Rd.  They have fun activities scheduled every day, like beach yoga and a free wine happy hour.  I would definitely stay there again.

Incredibly welcoming staff.  They upgraded me to a fantastic room after handing me a glass of champagne on arrival. They sent nice little gifts and notes to the room. By the pool they were so fun and attentive. It's experiences like this that make me glad to return again and again. It's a relatively small and intimate property.  They make you feel special without it feeling fake. What a gem. Treat yourself. (PS: I'm picky to the point of pathology according to friends--so for a place to get a rave from me means that even though I tried to find something wrong, I couldn't )

Loved our stay at the Surfcomber last week from the champagne welcome to the wine happy hour to the upgraded room, it was the perfect stay!  The pool attendants are so nice and are ready with fruit infused water and even have sunscreen on hand.  The Kimpton InTouch program makes you feel very welcome and gets you little perks like a mini bar credit.  The location is awesome with the boardwalk, bikes and beach in your backyard and walking distance to tons of shopping & dining.  We got great lunch and dinner recommendations from Ben at the concierage.  Would definitely stay again!

Amazing...wow! The customer service was simply ideal. The room was spotless, the staff was super friendly and informative.  We travel yearly and we have never experienced such quality people. The food was delicious as well as their cocktails. Louis is the master of cocktails, wow! His drinks are superb. Please drop by and ask for Louis.   Thank goodness that the front desk has shinning stars who make a person feel like they are family. We were looking for a hotel after having a horrible experience at the Shelborne and luckily ran into this hotel. Andrew greeted us and showed us a room. We were truly impressed!   We will never stay at another hotel... Surfcomber is a five star!

This is an Art Deco building - there is only so much that architects or designers can do within those confines, so the rooms have king-sized beds, storage and a desk - what you need. The shower room is nicely designed - small but the shower was powerful. I would have cared a great deal more about a large bathroom with a weak shower.  Service was always friendly and our questions were answered quickly and correctly. They were super helpful in arranging late check out, and knew all the local bars and restaurants. The beach is a spit away and there are reduced prices on sun beds and umbrellas for hotel guests.  The complimentary drinks which pop up at different times of the day are a nice touch, as is the never ending supply of iced, fruited water by the pool and in the lobby.

Well the room was ok. Two double beds. Not a huge amount room though. Wardrobe was non existent though. Chest of deep drawers. And there was a random glass table that had a chair that wouldn't go under, a stool would have been more practical.   The bathroom was ok. Standard. The bath was flaking though. And the shower pressure was lousy.   Pool wax great. Lots of sun. Lots of loungers.   Beach was a stone throw away. Which was great.   The staff were v friendly and pleasant.  It isn't all singing all dancing, but it was a good base to explore. Close to akin Lincoln Rd and Washington. Ocean drive just a few minutes walk away.   So good. Average overall.

column3: This is an Art Deco building - there is only so much that architects or designers can do within those confines, so the rooms have king-sized beds, storage and a desk - what you need. The shower room is nicely designed - small but the shower was powerful. I would have cared a great deal more about a large bathroom with a weak shower.  Service was always friendly and our questions were answered quickly and correctly. They were super helpful in arranging late check out, and knew all the local bars and restaurants. The beach is a spit away and there are reduced prices on sun beds and umbrellas for hotel guests.  The complimentary drinks which pop up at different times of the day are a nice touch, as is the never ending supply of iced, fruited water by the pool and in the lobby.

My friend and I stayed here for one night last weekend on a trip to SoBe to celebrate her recent promotion. The hotel staff exuded warmth (special shout outs to Chris at the front desk and Brian the bellman). Our room was adorably furnished with a spacious balcony with lounge chairs, and as an Inner Circle member the welcome amenity the general manager provided for us was fabulous. Will definitely be staying here again!  Thank you for a wonderful stay!  Joanna K. NYC

Extremely helpful and capable staff, in this well located-mid-sized  boutique hotel on the oceanfront Miami Beach. Nice pool, and free wine and sangria served from 5 to 6!  Let down a little by the rooms - no view for the vast majority of rooms and a bit cramped.  The Asian styled restaurant is also worth a visit with good and imaginative menu.  Not a large number of kids, but was fairly kid friendly.

The Surfcomber is in a fantastic location and provides easy walking access to plenty of nightlife, shopping, and fantastic food. But, I also enjoyed just hanging out on the property. Great pool. Good beach. Amazing lunch at Lantao. Awesome crowd as well.  The staff was impeccably attentive, addressed me and my friends by name, gave great recommendations for local food and clubs, and all in all couldn't do enough to make sure we had a great time.  If you haven't discovered Kimpton properties, you're in for a treat. As amazing as the Surfcomber is, it is what I've come to expect with this small hidden gem of boutique hotels. Great rewards program as well. The Surfcomber did not disappoint. In fact, it raised the bar once again!

the Surfcomber under Kimpton management is a nice mid-range cost option, with the South Beach pool and ocean experience but without as much of the social "judgment" you get at some of the swankier establishments on Collins. Guests were well behaved around the pool, mostly young to middle aged couples. A few kids but in control.   It is far north enough of the Ocean Ave tourist stretch to be peaceful yet close enough to walk to restaurants or drive/cab not too far. Rooms were pretty, but not about views as the buildings are low and around a courtyard. Still it was quiet. And you can't beat the wine hour. I don't think they have a full spa, but do offer spa services poolside or in your room. Restaurant was good for snacks.

Can't say enough great things about this property-they have it all. Great location (seconds from Lincoln Rd), beautiful decor and lobby, nicely appointed amenities-great pool area, and above all great SERVICE! Both Vanessa and Michelle at the front desk are superstars. They are part of the key to the hotel's success. Also can't say enough about the rooms- spacious, great layout, and beyond comfortable and beautiful. If you go don't forget to checkout their activity calendar-bot lame at all. Can't wait to return!

I stayed for a weekend and what great service.  I must mention marco the pool attendant. I asked for two poolside chairs during a busy time and said I'll be in the pool and call me if something comes available. I watched him go to the second deck and bring down two chairs. My wife said thats not for us an d i said yeah, i think they are.  Sure enough he set them up and waved to me that they were there when I was ready for them. Dorogos, the valet, welcomed me upon my entrance and gave me the ins and outs about the room, where to access the beach, and who to talk to about chairs, drinks etc. He was spot on and everyone was so helpful.  The wine hour is also terrific. What a great plus.  Head chef helped serve drinks and maade time to talk to customers. I would stay there again.

From check-in to check-out - a fantastic experience.  I visit about 20 different hotel yearly and this one stands head and shoulders above the rest.  Nice to stay at a hotel where the staff really look like they are enjoying themselves.  Even the gentleman pushing a cart of dirty laundry out of the elevator was friendly, with a nice greeting and smile.  Brian at the front door, Chris at the night desk and Maria at the pool....all were fantastic....you have to stay here....tell them Allen sent you

It's so difficult to find a 4 star hotel that accepts pets without lots of additional fees.  The Surfcomber is a very cool hotel with high-end amenities that's in just the right location -- on the ocean just off Lincoln Road, near the Delano and Ritz Carlton. No additional fees for dogs.  Great room, though the bath was small. We'll definitely stay there again.

Love to come back to this wondeful hotel. The staff was so friendley and helpful, excellent service. Location was perfect, quick walking distance to Ocean drive, Lincoln street, and restaurants/shops. Beach access, wine hour, pool deck, the staff was there for you all the time to make sure you had everything you need.

This hotel is excellently located in Miami, near the beach and Ocean Drive, but far enough away from the noise of Miami when you need to get a decent nights sleep.  The rooms are a little small by international standards, but large by Miami standards.    The hotel overall was very clean and well maintained.  A very special mention to the breakfast restaurant staff who were very friendly, our cocktail maker in the hotel bar and Brian the bell boy.  In fact, the staff here are probably the most friendly and keen to help I have ever met.  All in all, this is an excellent hotel which I hope to wish again soon

Having stayed at two different hotels along Collins Avenue in South Beach in the past, I would have to say Surfcomber (a Kimpton Hotel) is the best -- best if you want 1) location (quick walking distance to Ocean drive, Lincoln street, shops/restaurants, 2) beach access, 3) bike rental (doesn't get any more convenient than to have a city-wide bike rental station on hotel grounds, 4) reasonably priced room rates (very reasonable), and 5) very courteous staff (from concierge who went out of his way to get information he did not readily know, to front desk staff to attendants opening the door for you everytime you enter/exit building.  Rooms are nicely appointed as this is a boutique hotel.  Will definitely stay there again.

Front desk staff was friendly, efficient and FUN!! We were offered champagne, directions and a welcoming smile.   We enjoyed the hotels amenities including the awesome pool deck, beach, wine hour.  Bike rental on the property--take advantage of the boardwalk.  Also attended beach yoga... great instructor and beautiful setting.   Kimpton's Surfcomber is South Beach!

We are so excited to be heading over to South Beach to stay at the newest Kimpton hotel in Fl!   We are huge Kimptonites and hard to drive by the Epic.. however Seth at the Epic has given us such great service over the years we wanted to try the new property....So far the entire team that set our reservation has been top shelf!  Will update our experience next week Cheers!  Tom and Stella McDermott

Stayed her in early September and had a blast! First time in Miami and this hotels location was excellent. Backing onto the beach our walk was only a couple minutes the pool area was awesome heated and open 24 hours. The consiarge and front desk were super friendly guiding us towards the best restaurants and always ready to help with reservations. Only draw back was that the rooms were kind of small (we booked the regular double) but we hardly spent much time in there. The food is economical and super good! Make sure to try there new pork/beef sandwich! I will definitely be coming back!

After my flight I was a little bit frazzled by the time I got there.The staff were welcoming, helpful and efficient. Lucia at the front desk offered a complimentary glass of champagne and explained everything I would need to know about the hotel. Before I knew it I was relaxing in  my suite, listening to some music on the speaker dock. The Surfcomber had a great mix of quality, class and style. The staff really does make the difference between a good hotel and a great stay. I would definitely go back to stay there again.

My friends and I were celebrating turning 40 and thought what better place then to stay at the surfcomber Miami beach.  This turned out to be the perfect choice.  Great hotel and fantastic service, everyone from the valet to the front desk were so friendly.  Chris at the front desk went above and beyond making reservations and making suggestions for us.  We ran into Chris on his night off on ocean drive and he stopped and asked us if we wanted to join the party he was with, we thought that was great and shows you the type of people being hired at this hotel !!!!  Great location as its within walking distance to everything!  I will recommend and stay at the surfcomber again as its the place to stay if you want the service to make you feel like a rockstar!

The decor was very cool, even down to the Penguin staff uniforms (very European). The staff were all young and knew their stuff, meaning we enjoyed meals at Mr Chows at the W, as well as taking in the 'sights' of Nikki Beach Club...both good in very different ways.  Another plus point was the free wine between 5-6pm around the pool. As a tight Brit, anything free is a bonus! Therefore in the words of Simon Cowell; "I like you....do I think you have the X Factor.....yes I do"  Well done. 5 gold stars and a big smiley face.

We stayed for two nights (before and after a cruise leaving Miami's port).  The rooms are a bit on the small side - we're used to cramped quarters but were expecting some more space in Miami!  But nicely furnished - and clean.  Loved the service/amenities.  As Kimpton members we received a glass of champagne at check in and free wifi.  Poolside service was excellent, and the front desk staff was fantastic and accommodating.  We ordered room service once and the food was tasty.  Breakfast/lunch were good as well.  Would definitely stay here again, especially if you can get a good deal!

The service and staff (and hotel) at Surfcomber makes Miami more amazing, especially compared to the slackers at the neighboring SLS hotel. Surcomber is exceptional in its location, service and amenities. There is no reason to leave the hotel grounds...in fact every time we'd leave the hotel, we'd regret it and just want to go back to hangout with Brent and Chad (best mixologist ever), Mike (best server Lantao) and everyone else at the hotel. Lantao has fabulous food and patio by the pool. The custom Cabana massages were the best (provided by Rest & Relaxation). The wine hour (5-6) with complimentary wine and sangria is always a nice Kimpton perk. Surfcomber is the only reason to go to Miami and the best place to stay on South Beach.

First time in Miami and can't wait to return next year, this hotel is one of the best we have ever stayed in.  The rooms were really comfortable and clean, lots of goodies in the rooms too!  Fantastic pool with wine tasting between 5pm-6pm.  The thing that really impressed us was how friendly and attentive all the staff were.  Really was fantastic service and made us feel so welcome, not to mention some of the best cocktails we had in Florida.    If you are going to Miami stay in this hotel, you won't regret it!

Stayed there during tropical storm ISAAC with my daughters 15 & 17 years old. Room was nothing special, but overall service and friendliness of staff was great. Very good location, nice pool area, everything clean and neat. Free popcorn during ISAAC, very fast Valet Parking, very helpful staff, 24 hours friendliness.  What could be improved: the complimentary wine at the pool is nice, but it is not a tasting as we were served the same wine for 7 days; selection for breakfast should vary... same jam for 7 days :-(

I stayed at the Surfcomber 08/17-08/19. The staff, especially Lucia, was very friendly, and accomodating. The people there were just very nice and they treated us like royalty. Everyone seemed happy to work there and it was just a pleasant aura in the air! The rooms were very nicely decorated, and the lobby was beautiful. The poolside atmosphere was very upbeat and yet relaxing at the same time, and I loved the daily happy hour! What a wonderful place, and the location was perfect (i luv the Lincoln Road Shopping area)

I stayed here one night over the Labor day weekend. Had a great time. I brought my dog with me and all the staff and half the guests just fawned over him.The hotel is just a couple blocks from Ocean Dr. and just as close to Lincoln Mall, and right on the ocean. While the hotel isn't cheap, there was no extra charge for pets. The pool was fantastic and the free wine a plus. Nice to find a hotel of this caliber.

column3: I recently stayed at this hotel for my first vacation to South Beach.  The staff, I don't know where they found such accomodating, friendly, and kind people.  We were given a glass of champagne upon our arrival, and the decor in the lobby was absolutely beautiful.    My first night there, I realized I hadn't brought any Q tips, so I called the concierge to see if they had any.  The concierge insisted that would bring them up to the room, and they knocked on the door within a minute!   I will absolutely be returning to the Surfcomber on my next trip to South Beach.

My wife and I stayed here last week (less our 4 kids) and we had a great time!  Property was clean and well kept, rooms were perfect and the bed was very comfortable.  Overall experience was excellent, the employees were all very attentive and extremely helpful.  Pool and beach areas were clean and pool staff very helpful and friendly.  Location was perfect, only blocks from Lincoln Road and a short walk to Ocean Drive. Use the valet parking it’s much easier than trying to find parking and walking in.  We ate poolside from the Lantao Kitchen and the food was excellent.   Be sure it hit the daily wine and sangria for happy hour between 5 & 6, it is simple, but it’s “complimentary” so hit the bar if you want something more.   Thanks to the entire staff for making our stay perfect!

My wife and I stayed here this past week for 3 nights and couldn't have been happier. The hotel is located in a perfect spot a few blocks from Ocean Drive and a couple blocks from Lincoln Street.  It is nicely decorated inside and the rooms are small but well done.  The service at the hotel was some of the best we've ever seen. Every employee is friendly and helpful. We received champagne and snacks for our anniversary as well as great service outside at the pool. We had a problem with water pressure in our shower and they were quick to repair and even left little chocolate wrenches for us when we came back from dinner. They really made our short stay in Miami a great experience.

Our room was very comfortable and we had all the amenities.  The pool area is very nice but doesn't compare to the National or Delano pool areas.  The Surfcomber is trying hard to be cool & hip with the large ceramic animals in the lobby and the big beach balls in the pool - it's a fun vibe but not elegant.  Happy hour in the lobby is great although, again, not elegant (plastic cups, not great wines).  Our room was quiet although there was a huge family group ordering pizzas in to their rooms down the hall.

Had a great stay in this very comfortable and welcoming hotel. All staff very friendly and the rooms very comfortable. The pool area was stylish and spacious. The staff at the poolside were particularly attentive. Excellent location. Only one negative : We paid for a deluxe double queen for our two teenage boys but these were overbooked and we had to have a queen with rollaway for one night [ much smaller despite assurances from staff to the contrary]. The staff told us that the problem was we had booked through Expedia which doesn't guarantee a certain type of room even if you've paid for it. News to us. So make sure you stay at this hotel but avoid booking through Expedia!

My husband and I stayed at the Surfcomber four days in February, 2012.  Our room was freshly decorated with a nice bathroom. Staff was young and very friendly and accommodating.  We were warmly greeted every time we entered the hotel.  The pool area is very nice and relaxing.  Every night at 5 PM, they host a wine happy hour in the super modern lobby.  The adjoining bar is cozy and the bartender was very pleasant.  Location is great for beach, Lincoln Road shopping and cheap city bus to the airport.  Free Internet was certainly appreciated.  My only criticism is that the hall-ways are painted black and it is so dark that it is difficult to find your room.

Had a blast, Ryan took great care of me and my son during our 1+ week stay. The whole staff was great, but Ryan made sure that my son and I were having an awesome time every time he was around.   I would recommend the surf-comber to anyone and will definitely be staying here every time I am in south beach for work or leisure.   +1 for my man Ryan!  Jr from NY

We had an amazing time in Miami and so much of it was due to our wonderful experience at Surfcomber.  The rooms were contemporary and fun, the common areas were really quirky (we especially liked the roving sheep statue) and the pool and beach areas were both beautiful.  What made the stay even better was the staff.  Chris at the front desk was great when we checked in, super friendly and helpful. Louie and Billy in the restaurant were superstars and gave us excellent suggestions of things to do and places to go while we were in town.  It was really all about feeling like we were staying with friends and we will definitely be recommending the Surfcomber to everyone who is headed to South Beach!

Really enjoyed our stay here - great location, top notch service and great little extras like the 5pm Happy Hour and our early check-in!  Just wouldn't waste your money on a cabana...they are "indoor" cabanas which I found to be a little weird - however, they came in handy when it started to rain.

Where do I start, the hotel staff were warm, friendly, helpful and absolutely made our stay. We stayed there for our anniversary and got a superb room, great decor and roomy. On the Friday night, we had dinner with a friend in the hotel and stayed at the bar all night because we loved it so much. A wonderful pool area where you can get the sun right up to sunset. Again, the staff at the pool area were wonderful. Chad, mixologist, is a great addition with fab cocktails. Looking forward to returning already. Thanks very much to the Team for making a wonderful holiday supreme.

This hotel is very miami, and has a sexy pool. The location is excellent, close to everything. They have a happy hour and cold water by the pool. Very nice staff. Our purses were stolen on the beach and the staff was very helpful. I would stay here again next time I come to south beach.

This is a awesome hotel with a perfect South Beach locationl.  Though hotel had a great mix of quaint and trendy.  The service was outstanding and they had great perks like evening wine hour.  The pool area was resort like and pool staff was very attentive, yet the hotel also has direct beach access.  Only one block from Lincoln Road and walking distance to Ocean Blvd.  Well worth the money we spent on the hotel.  Sharaf evening night receptionist did an amazing job making us feel welcome.  Definetly will book again.

Great location, walking distance from ocean drive and right on the beach. Great pool and amenities. Not recommended for families as the rooms were pretty small, kind of what you would expect on south beach. Great experience and wouldn't mind staying there again.

All in all, a wonderful hotel with extremely helpful staff! We'll definitely be back next year.

This Surfcomber is highly recommended and may be all round one of the best hotels I have ever stayed at. It's in a great location, amazing food and superbly clean.

We chose this hotel for good location and value. They really go an extra mile to make your stay nice. Lantao restaurant on premises has nice Asian fusion dishes and we were given coupons for continental breakfast consisting of fruit cup, coffee or mighty leaf tea and a bagel.  Hotel has a nice pool and they have free sun screen lotion, goggles, and flotation devices for you to borrow and sangria and wine between the hours of 5 and 6! That's what I call nice service. Design of spaces is very interesting and books on art to check out in the lobby are outstanding. We loved staff at the hotel and recommend it sincerely.

We have just returned from our second stay at the Surfcomber and we will be back for a third trip.  This is a fantastic hotel with excellent staff and facilities! The location is superb and walking distance to many bars/restaurants etc.  The staff particularly Jessica and Michelle helped to make it a memorable holiday even remembering our names every morning and nothing was too much trouble including providing a wheelchair.  Hotel has been refurbished since our last trip and they have done a great job.  Loved the chilled water by the pool - perferct addition. Hope to be back shortly!!

Travelled out from the UK on 23 July and write this review whilst staying at the Surfcomber with my wife and two young children.  The hotel is in a superb location and the service is excellent.  From pulling up in the taxi everything has been taken care of.  Highlights so far:  Lantao continental breakfast (inclusive in the room offer). Pool and service, ice cool water all day and ice cream for the kids! Complimentary wine tasting and Sangria from 5:00-6:00pm.  All in all a great place to stay and we will most likely visit again to end our holiday before we fly home!

I have stayed at many Kimpton Hotels and Surfcomber is just like all the others......awesome. Great location, decor, rooms are nice, price is good for the location, and the front desk staff was fantastic.  My only complaint would be the fitness center, it was the size of a closet. Otherwise, awesome place to stay.  Thanks for a great stay!  Keep up the good work.

This was my first time staying at the Surfcomber in Miami and I will say the staff from the doorman to the housekeeping staff my experience was wonderful.  The rooms are very clean.   The staff is very polite.  The fact that the pool was available at anytime.  They have various activities every day for kids and adults.  Great location.  Special shout out to Andrew for assisting with a smooth checkin and checkout.  I WILL BE BACK!!!

This weekend was my 3rd trip to Miami,  the 1st time that I stayed at the Surfcomber. I had 7-10 rooms booked under me for family and friends and they all loved the hotel as well. The location is walking distance to all the nice spots and no more than a $5-$10 cab ride down to Ocean if you don't want to walk..  Hotel management was the best. Andrew at the front desk should be given a promotion. I work in customer service and own a few businesses and would hire him in a second. He handled all of my request and spoke each and everytime that he saw me. I knew the hotel was full and they had other guest to attend to, but they really made me and my group feel special.  Sean Washington, DC

Happened to be in the Miami area and decided to stay in South Beach for a night. Used Trip Advisor to ID a hotel and was very happy with our choice. The Surfcomber is more reasonably priced than many other choices and it's a small hotel, which we consider a plus. It's on the northern end of SoBe, and it offers beach access and a great pool. Only reason for not awarding this property a "5" was the tiny bathroom. You can barely turn around in it. Staff was great and very helpful. Valet parking was handy but pricey at $34 per day.  I would stay again for another short trip.

My partner and I have stayed at 5 different hotels in South Beach over the years. The Surfcomber is by far the best. The staff is friendly and they genuinely seem to enjoy their jobs. Great service and little perks like a free wine hour every day and iced fruit given out around the pool are small gestures that make a big difference. Rooms are spacious and all of the hotel has been outfitted with a good eye towards design. Interesting mix of guests, from singles, families and couples of all ages. We've already booked another reservation!

Great location, incredibly helpful and friendly staff, rooms were clean and nice.  Pool was fun and full of bachelorette and bachelor party groups, but in a far more chill vibe.  Food was good as well not to mention the free wine happy hour.  I'd stay here again for sure.

While the rooms are small and the windows don't open and some things don't work 100%, the staff are nice and friendly. Even the restaurant staff were friendly, but they weren't very good at refilling or checking on you. Jessica, especially, at the front desk was wonderful. The main problem with this place, and all of South Beach, is the automatic gratuity. 18% is added on to everything, even a single shot of whiskey at the overpriced bar.

I stayed with my mother and sister in June 2012 for 2 nights and we wished we had been able to stay longer. We arrived hours before check in but this wasn't a problem. We were given a room straight away. The room was perfect for our needs and the staff went above and beyond to be helpful and friendly from the staff at front desk, to the cleaning staff who always said hello when we saw them in the hallway, to the lovely concierge who went above and beyond to help us find a shopping centre we wanted to visit, even printing out the bus timetable for us. The location is great, right opposite the beach and very near to a lot of shops and restaurants, Lincoln Road etc. I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again or to recommend it to friends and family.
Customer service makes the difference. The staff is FANTASTIC.

I love the Kimpton Hotels for their unique and boutique hotels. We stayed for two days on my birthday weekend and the staff had ballons, card and champagne in our room. We rented a car from the airport but didn't need it because of the location, next time we'll catch the shuttle. The hotel is centrally located to shops and restaurants. The staff is always friendly. The lobby is swanky and adorable, but we found the hallway to be dark, it can use a brighter color. I will definetely come back.

This hotel is just ok...not amazing neither bad. Good points: the room was clean and nice; the ladies in the reception are very nice, there was good music in the hall, and it is cheaper than many other hotels in Miami. Bad points: there is no breakfast, and they remove the coffe at 10:00...to early if you go in Miami to enjoy the nightlife; the corridors are dark and very cold....and there are horrible statues of animals all around..but still is a good choice for a cheap hotel in Miami (besides, who goes to Miami to stay in the hotel! ;) )

The services are excellent, the room somewhat has small washroom/restroom, technical people reply fast to malfunction of binds, swimming pool services excellent, reception group are excellent, accessible to the ocean shoreline, food is good with a good services

Good access to the beach, convention center & shops on Lincoln. By the time you crash on the comfy bed, you will forget how slow the elevator was. Staff workers were professional and helpful. They would be wearing jacket-and-tie if it is located in the middle of a city, but polo shirt to match the beach location. Recommended.

We had a great time at the Surfcomber. If you don't mind the small rooms, which we were only in for sleeping, it is fantastic! A great location, spotless with very helpful and lovely staff.  We were met by Brian & Chris who couldn't have been more helpful. We're Brits and had many a long chat with them and they were so kind to our 7 year old daughter, providing her with a 'goodie' bag on arrival. Would highly recommend this hotel and would love to go back!

I highly recommend this hotel to anyone who doesn't mind having a bit of a small room, but wants a direct access to the beach and all the shops, clubs, etc that South Beach has to offer. The staff was amazing when it came to giving us great tips on where to go! Chris, at the front desk, recommended great places to eat as well! This hotel also is amazing for large groups (I was  part of a group of 12)! As I mentioned before the rooms are a bit small, but they are clean and the beds are comfortable. And when you're so close to the beach who would be staying in their room anyways :)

The Surfcomber is really a cool place that exceeded my expectations. It has an excellent South Beach location and a neat ambiance. I live in Miami and just wanted a getaway weekend and this hotel exceeded my expectations.The staff is extremely friendly, excellent and make you feel at home. The staff at the pool were very attentive to my needs and excellent service from the bartenders. Looking forward to return stay at the Surfcomber.

I just left there today and I just wanted to say thank you to the amazing staff! Especially Andrew! He is so sweet and really took care of us. He always greeted us with a welcoming smile and by name an that is not always something you see nowadays in customer service. Granted, I like Kimpton Hotels but the Surfcomber is really a cool place.  It has an excellent South Beach location and a neat ambiance.  I have stayed there three times and enjoyed each stay.  Typical (and appreciated) amenities such as coffee in the morning, wine hour in the evening, etc!  The staff is excellent.  Very friendly.

The staff is friendly and accommodating. Winnie at the front desk was so nice and exhibited the great service that is often associated with the  Kimpton brand.    However, I will never stay here again.  The hotel has an abandoned apartment complex vibe. The hotel is literally 3 or 4 stories tall and just looks circa 1984. Please, whatever you do, don't get a room on the first floor. The restaurant is at the end of the hall on the first floor and you will smell it in your room the entire stay. On second thought, whatever you do, just don't stay at this hotel.

From the moment we arrived until the taxi for the airport the staff at the Surfcomber could not do enough for us. The hotel is urban and cool in a non pretentious way they offer free wine every evening and have either a DJ or percussionist as background. The hotel is on Collins Ave which is walking distance to most everything. Chad the barman and expert mixologist will mix you up any cocktail you choose or even create you one if you are feeling brave! We travel to Miami every year and will certainly be staying there again.

My sister and I stayed at the Surfcomber from May 20th-22nd.  The hotel is nice and impressive and is centrally located to all of the restaurants and shopping.  I got a good deal through Priceline, however, the hotel charged me an extra $25 + tax per night for a double bed room.   Check in/out was quick and efficient; the staff was nice and friendly. The pool area was clean and they offered happy hour from 5pm - 6pm. You can access the boardwalk outside the pool area. As other reviewers have mentioned, the room/bathroom were quite small.  The hotel charges $34/night + tax for parking, however, there is a public parking lot about 1 1/2 blks. away that charges $16 for a 24 hour period.  I would recommend this hotel.

I think you would get the best out of this hotel if you are under 40 or perhaps 30 .  There is a very young atmosphere which is highlighted by the appalling loud noise that purports to be music in the lobby in the evening. Music also blares away by the pool constantly.  The location is excellent on Collins with access to the beach. The staff are all very polite and good. The rooms are not up to my experience in a Kimpton hotel, our bathroom was smaller than ones that I have had on a yacht.  However we enjoyed a good nights sleep in a comfortable bed with good linen. The room was also very clean. So mixed feelings.

We only had one night in Miami and wanted to see South Beach and the surrounds. This hotel was a little expensive, however, most in the area appeared to be.  Location for us was good and only one block from Lincoln Mall. We didn't hear any noise day or night in the room and we had an ocean view room. The room was small for average hotel rooms, but, reasonable size for the art deco district.  Parking was quite expensive ($34 per night) and only offer valet. Two days after checkout we were billed $48 when we had no expenses during our stay. All it took was one phone call to refund it back onto the credit card with no questions asked.

Spend the nights in comfort and style at the latest in the Kimpton constellation. This beachside gem is just perfect for great food, great rooms, and the nearby beaches. One simply has to walk through the pool area and the beach awaits. Spend time lazing about the beach, taking in the sites, having staff bring you drinks and food. Why leave? If you must, you can do the same by the gorgeous pool that the hotel offers. The staff are great, the service unmatched, and it is South Beach! Don't waste you time slumming, go to the Surfcomber where you will be pampered with style and panache. By the way, if you get the chance, check out their restaurant too--Lantao. It is well worth it!
5 star service and style. Pool perfect, design wonderful, kids friendly, location the best. All reviews are true, this is the best place on SOBE. Thanks and we'll be back.

My wife and two kids (ages 12 and 15) stayed at the Surfcomber for two nights over spring break and it was fantastic.  We loved the pool and the restaurant, the room was small but more than acceptable, and the staff was incredible.  Every single request, large or small, was addressed with grace and hospitality.  Michie, Ghulam, Vanessa and Lucia were fantastic ambassadors for this property and for everything Kimpton Hotels have come to be known for.    Thank you all (plus those whose names I missed) until I next return.

I travel to South Beach often and have stayed at all the so called "top" places. The Raleigh, Delano, Fountain Blue, and none of them even come close to The Surfcomber. The staff here is amazing!!! From the front desk all the way down to the cleaning crew. They took care of anything and everything. The renovations are top notch, nothing was over looked. Close to all the shopping and restaurants. if you truly want the South Beach experience you have to stay here. Ive already booked my trip back with them.

Best hotel I have ever stayed at.It was the first vacation I have taken with my wife,and it was just perfect.The service was completely amazing.I stayed for a week and I honestly did not want to leave.The rooms were very nice,and they have everything you need.The pool was probably the best part of all.The hospitality was great.The Thai restaurant has some amazing egg rolls that I highly recommend.The 2 gentlemen at the front desk Ben,and Rashad were very helpful to me and my girlfriend,they suggested a lot of good spots in town.The rest of the staff were very nice as well.I will def be staying here again in the future.

We have been staying at the Surfcomber for a few years now and we are very happy with the updates and changes made by the Kimpton Hotel Group. The new restaurant was much needed and really good (except for the Pad Thai). The rooms were all updated, and are very nice. The pool is fabulous. The beach out front is great. The esplanade is awesome. The hotel is very walkable to great restaurants (Ola, Lincoln Road, etc). Lucia at the front desk has been there the last two times we've been to the hotel, and is a pleasure! We will certainly be back. It's our place in Miami!

This hotel was outstanding, from the location, to the restaurant, to the pool down to the customer service provided. I booked my hotel through priceline.com from a Thursday-Tuesday so I couldn't be accomdate on the first few night for a double bed. Recently stayed for 1 night while at a convention in SoBe.  The hotel was conveniently located near the convention center and on the beach.  The hotel itself is a renovated art deco place in Sobe.  The renovation by kimptom is quite modern.  The rooms themselves were quite small with tiny bathrooms and the vast majority dont face the ocean (this the fault of the original build obviously and not the renovation).  The pool and courtyard were very green and relaxing and the location was superb.  The reason for 4 stars is that the service, while good, was not quite at the par of a higher level place (not so helpful with dinner reservations, didnt help everyone with bags, etc).  Overall, this is a solid, clean, modern choice with a great location.

I stayed at the Surfcomber for a 4 day conference. I had never been to a Kimpton Hotel before this trip but will probably look for them when I make my next travel arrangements if they are as good as this hotel. The staff at this hotel were great and went out of their way to make sure that I and other guests were more than satisfied with our stay. Lucia E and Jessica F. were exeptional to our group. They remembered all of our names and our purpose for the trip. It was obvious that they had the same rapport with all of the guests at this hotel. I will be going back to this Hotel. Jason H

We will definitely stay there again!

Perfect location for sure!!  Loved that the most of this hotel.  This hotel is not as chic as I wanted, at least in the rooms, but the lobby was such a grabber you would think the rooms would've been as cute.  They were recently changed from the Hilton and I think may have still been in a transition. Clean rooms...Uh, what more can you ask for?  Very alive during the night and the pool area is super cute and I love that.

Had a great 3 nights at the Surfcomber with my husband and daughter.  Our luggage didn't arrive until 24 hours after we did and the front desk were excellent at providing us with overnight amenities and did as much as they could to help. It was a real relief to come up to our room and find AA had delivered our baggage- better late than never!. The rooms were beautifully designed and although not large there was enough room for the 3 of us. We enjoyed the beautiful grounds, breakfast and appetisers at Lantao, access to the beach and being just near enough to all South beach has to offer.

Despite some issues  with check in, we had a wonderful stay at this hotel. The staff is great and more than made up for the problems we encountered when we first arrived.  The location is perfect, right on the beach and walking distance to everything. Our room was spacious and very comfortable.  We've been vacationing in South Beach For the past decade, never staying at the same place twice, until now. We'd definitely return to this hotel because of the personal service we received during our stay. The staff made us feel like VIPs the entire time, and we loved it!

Overall, we enjoyed our stay and had a relaxing and fun time.    The onsite restaurant is excellent, good food at a reasonable price!

The rooms were not worth the price...sure it is a Kimpton, just a small handful of staff have the great Kimpton personality, other than that you have the typical Miami people attitude which is non customer service oriented and makes you feel like you are inconveniencing them.  Was with a friend the first room was two beds and so cramped there was no room for your luggage.  We asked for a suite but had to wait, It was much larger and requested a nice plush roll out.  They have an afternoon happy hour of sangria and wine which is a nice touch before leaving for dinner.  The concierge suggested nice places to eat and made reservations for us.  The location is right on, you can walk to everything.

my stay in kimpton hotel was very pleasant. even though the room is small, but it got everything inside and extremely clean and tidy. the environment is elegant and there is a beach belonging to hotel which located at back of the hotel. Besides, another advantage it has is the fact that it is very close to the famous south miami beach. The service of the hotel was satisfactory, i would recommend this hotel to anyone who is going to miami and wants to enjoy the best beach there.

Sadly our flight to Miami was cancelled and we only had 1 night at this great hotel, It's a great size maybe 50 rooms with a groovy bar free afternoon wine by the pool a nice mix of people staying there some families mostly couples.  Nice pool right on the beach  The staff at Kimpton  properties always makes the experience even better   Can't wait to come back

Booked two rooms for my sister's bachelorette. Wasn't expecting a luxury hotel but was pleasantly surprised at the quality of the rooms and the pool. The customer service was great from the minute we checked in and there were always chairs available for our group by the pool. The prices for drinks & food at the pool bar were a little unnecessarily high but overall we had an awesome weekend and I would definitely stay here again in the future. AMAZING location. can't beat it.

The surfcomber is well managed, the rooms and decor are what you would expect from a cutting edge South Beach hotel. Our favorite, the K17 beach club, out of all the competing "beach clubs" this is by far the best, from their food to the chair/bed options to the staff, really enjoyed the beach relaxation. Perfect for our vacation!

Had a really great trip to South Beach staying at this hotel. Everything is in walking distance but if you need to go further the bus line is right outside the hotel.  Employees went out of their way for you.  The room was fine but the bathroom was small.  I did not eat at the restaurant because Lincoln Ave was only a short walk away.  I would go back for a weekend getaway.

The hotel was a very nice hotel with a perfect location close to the convention center. The rooms are refurbished, small, but comfortable. the service was very good. Only the inhouse restaurant I can't recommend, as the choice was a bit poor.

Rooms were small but clean. (and safe was placed too high).  Hotel was noisy (could hear every word of our neighbour's conversation),  location was great, but.... pool was closed (gay & lesbian event),  so sad for our 5y. old son.  We would never stay there again, we left this hotel and went to Loews hotel, Miami Beach, which was fantastic!

We recently stayed here during an event weekend, and on balance, the stay was very pleasant.  The rooms and common spaces are very nice and feel clean and modern.  We had an issue with the black-out blinds during our stay, and although Engineering was not able to resolve the issue, the front-desk staff was extremely apologetic and accommodating in other ways.  We would definitely stay here again.

We walked in to the beautiful newly designed lobby, and were greeted with such a pleasant smile. From that smile Brent became our instant "go to Man". While walking us to our room he explained all the amenities, how the whole hotel has been recently renovated, comfortable beds and even how we recieved free ticket to their pool party for staying at the hotel. He was so informative, professional, while still keeping the vibe laid back and un-stuffy! ......... And by the way, that pool party Brent told us about, was one of the best I've ever been to down here!!! And I'm a native.
I have to say that if you want detail.... It's covered Tony totally took care of us we will def be back. It's the little things that make us happy. Thanks tony !

We just got back from a wonderful relaxed week at the Surfcomber Hotel. The renovation of the hotel is great, nice job, The employees are warm and caring, especially Vanessa at the Front Desk, Elena at the bar and Ghulam the bell boy. Nice job guys, hope to see you again.

I had a most wonderful time at this property. Great location as it's right on the beach and only a block away from Lincoln Road. Staff couldn't be any nicer or more helpful. Kimpton has done a wonderful thing by taking it over as I heard it was just so-so when it was a Doubletree. Crowd is very mixed which I like. No attitude (which is kind of rare in South Beach).

Ok , the location is really great and the lobby is cool in it's design. But $450 per night only bought a small room on the ground floor looking out on the walkway - really? The bathroom was so tiny, I still marvel that they were able to fit a sink, a toilet and a shower into it.  The pool was dirty and crowded ( ok, it was a Saturday), and the hamburger we ordered from the pool snack menu came with the soggiest bun I ever had - for $18! Unless you get a great deal, stay elsewhere!

We stayed in this hotel for 3 nights and we were very pleased with the location, the service, the rooms, the pool...everything was excellent. The surfcomber is located right by the beach and it is very clean, trendy, modern! We loved the fact that it is not a gigantic building with not too many rooms. It is 1 block from the shopping area of lincoln road and 5 min walk to the heart of ocean drive. Highly recommended! The only issue we had is the people in the room next door who were really noisy, especially at 3 in the morning...but we contacted the concierge who called them right away.

From the cheap furniture, to the broken window, the outlet that doesn't work (fridge with the beer was unplugged and warm), to the staff forgetting about our luggage, you could say we're a little unsettled about this Kimpton experience. This is the most expensive Kimpton hotel we've stayed at ($370 per night for a basic room), yet it completely lacks the fit and finish we've come to enjoy.  You're basically paying for beach access.

The hotel is new and clean and quite nice. It is centrally located just a few blocks from Lincoln Road. The restaurant is pretty good, Asian inspired, and that is the limit of what you can eat in the hotel. But if that's not to your liking there are a million other restaurants and hotels just outside. There really weren't negatives other than the elevator - which is slow and small and there is only one per wing.
