I have stayed at the Surfcomber twice so far, and I would definitely go back and stay there. The location is fab, a one minute walk to Lincoln Rd! I was with a large group this trip, the Concierge were extremely helpful in giving us suggestions and making restaurant booking for us. The hotel has a lovely poolside, right on the beach and the rooms are cozy & newly refurbished. I would definitely recommend this hotel to all! Thanks to all the friendly Surfcomber staff! Tanya Bux

I have been coming to the Miami Boat show for 12 years and my stay at the Surfcomber was one of the best I have ever had! The room was perfect, staff very attentive and helpful with all my needs, the bar was fun and the hotel very clean and updated! Our group made reservations for next year at the Surfcomber during the boat show and we have never done that before. I have stayed at many Kimpton's and this one is right up at the top of the list! We love South Beach and your hotel is centrally located and fits in very good with the top spots. I look forward to my stay next year!

Stayed one night at the Surfcomber in late January.  When I first walked in I was like:  Oh, God it's kind of modest... then I realised they were going for a shabby chic style.  I very much liked this hotel and would happily stay again.  Room was nice, they did an upgrade without my asking, which is always an easy win!  It had a great king size bed with terrific linens and a good firm mattress.  Bathroom wouldn't fit two people but it was well designed.  A view over Collins Ave.  One of the greatest strengths is the property... great pool, attractive grounds, nice cabanas and direct access to the beach.  I think this hotel is quite good value overall.  Staff very friendly and more than one asked me directly if I was enjoying my stay.

Our group made reservations for next year at the Surfcomber during the boat show and we have never done that before. I have stayed at many Kimpton's and this one is right up at the top of the list! We love South Beach and your hotel is centrally located and fits in very good with the top spots. I look forward to my stay next year!

Stayed one night at the Surfcomber in late January.  When I first walked in I was like:  Oh, God it's kind of modest... then I realised they were going for a shabby chic style.  I very much liked this hotel and would happily stay again.  Room was nice, they did an upgrade without my asking, which is always an easy win!  It had a great king size bed with terrific linens and a good firm mattress.  Bathroom wouldn't fit two people but it was well designed.  A view over Collins Ave.  One of the greatest strengths is the property... great pool, attractive grounds, nice cabanas and direct access to the beach.  I think this hotel is quite good value overall.  Staff very friendly and more than one asked me directly if I was enjoying my stay.

I absolutely love everything about this hotel. Any future trips to Miami beach this hotel will definitely be my first choice.  Been to Miami numerous times, first time at this hotel...staff was incredibly friendly, helpful, and pleasant. Pool was great, bar was a bit pricey.  Great location to be a few short blocks away from art deco area of south beach.   Can't wait to go back!!!!

What a cool vibe hotel! I Suggest eating in the restaurant the food is amazing!  The front desk staff was helpful throughout my whole stay.  I think her name was Diana been a month since we stayed there but she was a sweetheart when we needed help finding some things to do around the beach.  The construction was annoying sometimes next door but they cant really control that I would just recommend not getting a room that is on that side of the hotel if you can.

I recently stayed at the Surfcomber for business. It was swanky with a great location. The service was outstanding by pretty much everyone at the hotel. Mickey Montella was a fantastic concierge and really made my stay enjoyable. He was very knowledgeable about the area hot spots and went out of his way to accomodate. High recommendations for this stay.

They should warn you when you book that there is construction next door.  We awoke to the sounds of a jackhammer and metal on metal at 7 am - it was right outside the window, just a few feet from the wall and very loud.  I was looking forward to sleeping in a little but that did not happen.  Checked out and moved a few blocks down to Lowes to get some peace and quiet.

My husband and I recently stayed at the Surfcomber for 3 nights and I can't say enough good things about this great re-done hotel. The location is perfect, the staff is incredibly friendly and helpful, the pool is beautiful (although it was too cold to swim while we were there), the beach is easily accessible, and the rooms are spacious, chic, and comfortable.   My only demerit was that the pool menu is heavily meat-oriented. There's not any options for vegetarians, but they were very accommodating in trying to create a poolside snack that I could eat.   Sign up for the Kimpton Rewards program before you go (it's free): you get free Wifi while at the hotel, and $10 off of the deliciously-stocked minibar.

Hotel staff genuinely friendly and eager to help.  Trendy hotel, comfortable rooms, liked the sangria hour in the afternoon and the coffees and fruit in the morning.  Lovely touches.  Perfect location on south beach, highly recommended.  Building work being done next door, but did not begin till mid afternoon so did not ruin our sleep.

I recently stayed at the surfcomber hotel in miami beach and was surprised at the remake this hotel has undergone from the days of the double tree. Besides the cosmetic changes, the new staff members were very welcoming and helpful. This is from the doorman Guliam, to the house keeping. Most of all my experience was enhanced by the ever so helpful Lucia, Vanessa, Michi along with the other ladies and gents at the front desk, led by the example set forth by Michelle, the front desk supervisor.  The surfcomber is well situated in the heart of the activities of south miami beach and within walking distance to restaurants, clubs and shopping. I give a five star tot he staff that make the guest feel at home.

Kudos and thanks to friendly, helpful staff at this newly renovated South Beach hotel where we spent the week after Christmas, 2011. Great price and a bright, clean, offbeat contemporary interior design. Outstanding beach access. The following people were especially helpful and effective: At the front desk -- Reuben, Michelle, Lucia, and Brian. In the culinarily creative and enjoyable restaurant -- Monica and Houda. My wife and I had a great time.

Hi  I was fortunate to stay at the surfcomber a few months ago.  What a great hotel.  The staff were outstanding, from the attentive doormen to the front desk, to the rooms.  Everything was "spot on". It was so nice to be close to the beach and hear the ocean from my room.  I have been recommending this hotel to everyone I know who is visiting Miami, and can't wait to stay at the surfcomber again. thank you!!  Michele Byers Stiles

The food was tasty and flavorful!  The service was friendly and expedient.  This is a rare find in MB.  I have lived here for 14 yrs; I know how hard it is to find great service here.  The atmosphere was warm and un-pretentious; perfect for dinner with friends.  There was a slight mix up with the reservation and the manager gave us a discount without prompting.  Talk about excellent service recovery.  Will definitely come back!

Stayed here for 5 days on business because convention centre is a short walk away. This hotel is very well located, right on the beach and a walk to dozens of great restaurants. Pool is sheik and fun, with bean bag chairs for relaxing in the garden. Free wine hour and always cold water in the lobby is a nice touch and the concierge service is second to none. Staff is super friendly -- never did one pass me without a genuine hello. Bar drinks are bit pricey -- but this is Miami so who's counting. I'm looking forward to bringing down the family to this property. OH yah...the showers are cool without any glass doors so you can take the party in with you and the bath robes

My wife and I love Kimpton hotels, and we love South Beach.  We were very excited to stay at this new Kimpton Hotel located right on the beach.  It has been remodeled very nicely.  Our room was lovely.  We enjoyed the large pool and direct beach access.  Our room was very nice.  We loved the complimentary wine hour.  The staff were all very friendly.  We were very satisfied!
Good localization, service and food. Direct acces to the beach. Free and fast internet. The price is high, but, South Beach... Need to come back but in vacations now.

Booked a last minute weekend trip.  Great staff.  Poolside and beach services were terrific.  Great location close to South Beach, but quiet and peaceful hotel.  Will definitely return again.

We stayed here for a day before our cruise and had such a great time, we didn't want to leave! If you are used to chain hotels, this place is such a welcome change. It was clean, unusual, and well located for our first trip to South Beach. Of course, the most important element is the people and everyone was extremely pleasant and helpful, especially Brian. From the time he greeted us on arrival to the minute we left, he was super helpful and pleasant. Thanks to all who made our stay so memorable!

Upon arriving, the doorman gave a warm greeting with a big smile.  The lady at reception was equally friendly and helpful.  The location is great, on the ocean and short walks to anything you want to do (shopping, dining, people watching).  The rooms were comfortable.  We spent a day by the pool which was very relaxing.  The wait staff at the pool were attentive, and quick with the food and drinks.  Mickey the Concierge was a great help in organizing a day long everglades tour.  He also had other great suggestions about things to do in southern Florida.  We were very pleased with the hotel and staff.  If we go to South Beach again, we'd stay at the Surfcomber again..

We stayed at Surfcomber in the past as a DoubleTree and now, recently as a Kimpton property.  Same hotel but with all new remodeling of rooms, lobby etc, and excellent staff and management.    The location of this hotel is excellent, on the beach, 2 blocks from Lincoln Mall and in the middle of Deco area.  The rooms are small as is typical of the older Deco hotels but the remodeling was very nice.  The lobby is casual and fun with seating areas and bar.  We really liked the open wine-bar hr even afternoon.  The pool is large with lots of seating areas and places to escape the sun.  Staff was helpful and friendly.  Only comment would be on the restaurant where service was slow.

From the minute you walk into this low key welcoming hotel you feel like your at home....At only three stories it's like a funky artist's home with an interior designer you could never afford ( nor quite understand) but nevertheless it's yours to explore. Surprising details at every turn kept this architect smiling constantly.   But what really makes the place is the staff , no pretension and complete politeness from Lucia and Vanessa at the front desk to Jessica serving complimentary wine at the pool to Gillian taking care of me at the bar with great conversation and drink recipe tricks.  Funny thing is I came here for the pool grounds and location... Everything else was a bonus!

Flew in for a guys weekend.  The hotel was well located, close to the clubs and shopping.  The concierge, Mickey did a great job getting us to the best spots and also did all the legwork on our trip to the Heat game.  He was proactive and made our stay effortless.  The staff was very responsive (attractive as well) and the daily happy hours by the pool set the Kimpton hotels apart.  Would highly recommend and would stay again.  Bravo Kimpton...

The Kimpton hotel chain has a reputation for being refined, yet contemporary. This hotel is no exception. The interior decor was up to Kimpton standards. It was a wonderful renovation. Staff were Kimpton professionals, i.e. warm and competent. The pool area was very pleasant and quiet. It overlooked the beach. The rooms were spacious, but not enormous. My sole reservation concerns the asian fusion restaurant. The concept seems a little dated. I would have expected something a little more innovative, i.e. locally sourced organic, etc. There are plenty of restaurants nearbyto choose from. The biggest challenge for management will be to maintain the refined vibe when South Beach can be very seamy.

This hotel is a very cozy modern hotel. Great service. The minute you walk in you are greeted by the bell boy to help you with your luggage. You are directly checked in and are ready to enjoy the beautiful hotel. The staff is great, very helpful, the pool boy is always willing to pull up a lounge chair for you. The rooms are great also. Fully remodeled and very nice. The food at the pool is exceptional. Highly recommend this hotel. They even serve complementary wine in the afternoons and coffee in the morning!!!

Kimpton has done it again with the Surfcomber, they combine a trendy experience with warm welcoming hospitality. South Beach can make you feel like an outsider, not here. Yes, the rooms are small, but they make no secret of that on their booking site. It clearly states that most rooms are 200 Sq. Ft. Everything is new, fresh and comfortable. Complimentary wine is served in the lobby every evening from 5-6. Coffee is also served every morning. The restaurant is excellent for breakfast and lunch. Poolside there are plenty of lounges and beach access. I will be back.

What I like about this hotel is that it's small and intimate, but fresh and modern (and smack on the best part of the beach).  The staff remembers you, the pool (which is actually quite large) has plenty of chairs, the wine each night is free flowing and everyone I met there was normal and nice.  The rooms are freshly renovated and clean.  The location is super close to Lincoln Rd and tons of restaurants, etc.  I honestly didn't need a car or a cab.  I walked everywhere.  I also did not hear my neighbor - which is critical in SOBE because many of the walls are paper thin.  I could actually sleep.  Great stay.

I spent 4 nights in South Beach for a work conference and ended up having as much fun as work. Rooms were very nice and clean.  You cant beat the location, beach steps away and great restaurants nearby.  But what really made this hotel stand out was how amazing the staff was. Ben, Katiana and Rashad went out of their way to make our stay fun and unique.  I loved the coffee in the am and wine hour everyday.  Also Brent was so friendly and took care of anything we needed.  The food at Lantao was amazing...must try the ribs. Cant go wrong with Kimpton!!!   THANKS GUYS

We love Kimpton hotels and so when planning a trip to see WVU in the Orange Bowl, I checked to see what Kimpton had in Miami.  The Surfcomber was fantastic!  The staff was extremely friendly and efficient, especially the concierge, the host for the wine tastings, and Lucia.  The location is amazing -- very close to everything on South Beach.  I was worried because our family of four stayed in one room, but there are so many amazing seating areas in the lobby and outside that we were fine.  The pool area is fantastic but so it the front porch overlooking Collins Avenue.  Kimpton is still busy putting the finishing touches on the lobby, etc. -- we can hardly wait to visit again!

Jonathan from nyc; simply the best hotel I've ever bin too, service and hospitality was fantastic, great location , clean the staff ill name some Jessica, Brent, were so nice and helpful, definitely coming back here , if you don't choose this hotel your missing out , I got fresh coffee in the morning, and wine from 5-6 was awsome.

Unless you want to pay for a suite, the basic rooms are extremely small and look at a wall.  There is no room to open luggage and there is barely room to walk.  The bathrooms are even smaller.  The bathrooms are not easy to use and the stool is wedged between a sink and a wall so you had better be a thin kid to squeeze in.  The location is good near Lincoln Road which has very nice restaurants.  Try Paul's, with French bread and pastries, for breakfast.  Very good egg dishes.  Try Rosselina's, an Italian restaurant, with outside tables that allow people watching and has good food and service.

I enjoyed my stay at the Surfcomber. It was a wonderful, hospitable two week work vacation spent here along the beach with amazing shopping. Ben, Rashad, and Jessica were amazing at the front desk by making me feel like I was in my living room in the lobby. The only downfall is that the internet and phone reception go in and out in the rooms but work well in the lobby. Stay here NOW!!!

I stayed here for 3 weeks while I was in town with a show and I absolutely fell in love with the staff of this hotel!  Every person I met was incredibly friendly, hospitable, and willing to help us have the best time in South Beach.  At the front desk, Jess, Ben, and Rashad helped us plan a handful of great nights out, while Brian greeted us at the door with a huge smile everynight, and I lived for our housekeeper Whitlain who I ran into in the hallway daily with the biggest smile on her face.  The rooms are completely refinished and beautiful, plus the pool is open 24 hours for late night swims.  This hotel comes highly recommended!

I thought the location was great.. on the beach, nice walkway to all of South Beach and right next door to the Ritz..    You should give this hotel a try..
What a great hotel, Really enjoyed our stay. Very friendly staff--especially smiley Michie at the front desk. We are already planning our return!

I am very glad that my girlfriend chose Surfcomber. My next and only stay will be at The Surfcomber Hotel

However, Reuben Trane, concierge at the Surfcomber Miami South Beach, went way out of his way to help make the stay something great!  He distinguished both himself and the hotel and in the process made Christmas for someone, who was far from home and stuck working, feel just a little more like home.

One of the best places I have ever stayed at.  Perfect location with the beach just steps from your room. The best part of our stay was the staff-they were professional, warm and catered to our every need. They welcome you from the moment you step foot here and make sure that your every request is met. Mauricio, Rashad and Dorgis were friendly, professional and helped make us feel welcomed. They offered great suggestions for places to eat, suggestions for how to get to the airport, and great hangout spots. I have stayed at other Kimpton hotels, but I must say this beat the other hotels as well. What makes this hotel stand out from the rest is the amazing service, they really do make you feel right at home!! Can't wait to go back!

Stayed at the Surfcomber over Thanksgiving weekend.   They were just wrapping up their renovations - lobby is sleek and modern, the overnight rooms are quaint but fun design!  the bathroom is really cute and well layed out.  Truly can't beat the location - right on Collins Ave and with the pool that overlooks the beach!! Great staff, always love Kimpton hotels!!

It is in an excellent location, the beach is out the back gate. Close to shopping, restaurants, bars but far enough away to be quite. A Miami Transit Airport Flyer stop is just a few steps out the front door($2.35 Airport to South Beach). The hotel and my room were comfortable, clean and updated.  Vanessa at the desk was friendly and professional. Brian (Bellman) ,Dorges,  Mauricio and Chef Freddie gave me some great suggestions when I asked about things away from the hustle of Lincoln Rd and Ocean Dr. I am just sorry I can remember everyone's name. They all went above and beyond to make me fell welcome. Great Place.

The restaurant is new but looks great The furniture is all new and very classy The location couldn't be better, right on the board walk and two blocks from Lincoln Road This place is a "sleeper" and with only a few rooms, be careful how many people you tell.

Not only was I impressed with the appearance of the hotel, but i was very happy with the unbelievable service from the hotel restaurant. Chef Ortiz, the hostess Monica and the  waiter that attended us (Car). The food was delicious and the service was more  than pleasant. Congratulations on a new start! I will be visiting Miami mid-January and will be stopping by to say my hello's and once again to enjoy the unforgettable ice cream sandwich that Chef Ortiz prepared for us.  Once again. Congrats & Thank you! Maria Roca

Love Kimpton hotels. This one is no different. Great location and good vibe. Only complaint is getting to the pool you have to go around the building or through the restaurant. Definitely a great spot and the rates were the best I could find on South Beach.

The Surfcomber is an absolute gem in South Beach. From the location, to the friendliness of the staff, to the comfort and modernity of the the room, it was truly a memorable weekend in every way. The outdoor pool area is beautiful and welcoming and the hotel is close proximity to all of the cafes, restaurants and hip places. The staff is also very helpful and everyone wore a smile on a consistent basis. The doormen and valet workers always greeted us with a "hello, how are you," which was rare and nice. It was a memorable weekend and the Surfcomber was a special part of the trip. I plan to visit South Beach again and there is no doubt that I will be staying at this hotel!
Chilled out, unpretentious, superbly-located and newly-refurbished. No plastic people and self-satisfied body beautifuls. Hooray. European sized rooms i.e. small, but the beach is 10 seconds away.
